item.title: Ms Mikki Monroe Michaelis
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Hi again. Where to start....

I've always thought to myself I need to write down all the things that happen in my life, but then I think all the good stuff has already happened and there is no way anything else interesting can happen in my life.

I'm not a writer so please forgive my composition and unedited, unpolished, and otherwise pointless rant. Ok, good point, I first need a point to write about.

Ok, I already lied, I am a writer; I write software. Maybe I'll get to that story one day but I'm going to skip it for now. Just know that I'm pretty dang good writing code, i've been tremendously successful (not now fyi) and that i'm a liar.

Ok, second lie confession. I'm not a liar, i'm an addict. More precisely I'm an addict in recovery. Well, I was until two days ago. I've drank cheap vodka and smoked some Indiana legal CBD oil, but I have not used cocaine or meth or heroin. I don't plan on it either.

I now have a point to write about today. I guess there is double meaning in that sentence, I will be writing about today, but that's not the point. The point is that I need to put to words my life, I need to write about my faults and study them in depth. I need to have a reason to keep going.

No, this will not be a pitty party, in fact I'll tell you how tremendously successful I will be again soon. And it is exciting, if not that I'll be the star of the show <again> and destined to fail. So, no i don't think i'm actually destined to fail, but those were the words in my head so i wrote them down. I'm sorry if I'm boring and confusing you, the reader.

I'm on a GPS ankle monitor as a requirement of being out on $50,000 bond for Kidnapping.

I got kicked out of yet another drug rehab facility.

I have little money and rely on my family to support my hotel stay.

I have mad professional skills but it's impossible to put them to any immediate use.

I have no friends to help me.

I have people that care about me and that I care about.

I am M2F pre HRT Transsexual person.

I'm in the middle of nowhere Indiana and I can't leave the state (GPS).

I have a brilliant idea for the drug and alcohol community but just can't seem to make it happen.

Those statements pretty much set the stage. I started to write because I have nothing else to do. Ive hit a roadblock with a 3rd party SDK that i desperately need but it simply won't work (computer stuff). I'm frustrated, alone, hungry, a mess, a little hung over and thinking to start hitting the handle (to get me out of this funk).

I also need to shave. On my relapse and prevention plan i listed "stop shaving" as an indicator I'm about to relapse. Yes, I immediately did what I should have done when I got myself kicked out of rehab. I called my sponsor, who never called me back or answered my text. I texted facility at the rehab asking to be put in contact with a woman I feel comfortable talking to. No response. I texted an older man in the rehab and asked him to keep in contact with me, that I need his blunt honesty. Nothing. I texted a woman in rehab and told her she can collect on the 3 packs cigs owed me by another resident. Nada.

Am I really that bad? Do people have something inside them that makes them run from me?

It's 12:03 pm and I'm not an alcoholic, I'm a crack head. I'm going to have a drink and see how this day turns out.

This is my blog and I'm sticking to it,

Mikki

item.title: #Just42morrow
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
The strength I'm finding to stay sober is the faith that tomorrow will be better. I'm mindful in the present and the spark in my heart is faith, faith in myself. "I am strong enough to do this" and other similar thoughts is what kindles that spark into flame.

Cut away all the bullshit, the past and the future. Just focus on this moment and you will see that you are strong enough, if you don't see it, then fucking look for it.

How? You don't actually see it, you think it, then feel that extra beat in your heart, the feeling that you are on to something grand but you just can't grasp it. Think "I'm strong enough" and flame the spark with those thoughts.

It takes a Survivor show contestant a day sometimes to make a burning fire. We are no show contestants, except for the show we star in in our own minds, which we are losing. If it takes a professional many many hours to do something with their hands, how long would that task take in a human mind, a tremendously more complex environment than simply:

{((fuel+heat(friction)) => fire)? life : death;}

This is life and death, a very slow and agonizing death. The fuel for fire you are feeding your mind are old tires and the gasses produced are noxious. You are poisoning your own mind with your own thoughts. This poison draws itself up into things like alcoholism, drug abuse, negative attitudes, depression, and suicide.

Recovery is a life or death choice and a very difficult process. Recovery will slowly clear your mind of all those little trash fires, to let burn burn again the fires in your heart. The heat from your heart warms your mind and gives you thoughts of faith, faith in yourself.

Give recovery time to work. Give your mind time to heal. Have faith in yourself.

The 12 Step philosophy of "Just for Today" is beautiful and simple.

I prefer the slightly more powerful "Just 4 2morrow". I'm living sober today with the faith in myself that tomorrow will be better.

If all this is too much for you today, I have something even easier. Just think "I'm OK". Because the day you can't think that, will be hell. See, fun and easier. Now breath a deep sigh of relief, because you are OK.

With Love,

Mikki

#Just42morrow

item.title: The Twelve Traditions of AM
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
We keep what we have only with vigilance, and just as freedom for the individual comes from the Twelve Steps, so freedom for the group springs from our Traditions.

As long as the ties that bind us together are stronger than those that would tear us apart, all will be well.

  1. Our common welfare should come first; personal recovery depends on AM unity.
  2. For our group purpose there is but one ultimate authority— a loving Entity as They may express Themselves in our group conscience. Our leaders are but trusted servants; they do not govern.
  3. The only requirement for membership is a desire to stop using.
  4. Each group should be autonomous except in matters affecting the community of AM as a whole.
  5. Each group has but one primary purpose—to carry the message to the addict who still suffers.
  6. An AM group ought never endorse, finance, or lend the AM name to any related facility or outside enterprise, lest problems of money, property, or prestige divert us from our primary purpose.
  7. Every AM group ought to be fully self-supporting, declining outside contributions.
  8. AnonymousMeetings should remain forever nonprofessional, but our online service centers may employ special workers.
  9. AM, as such, ought never be organized, but we may create service boards or committees directly responsible to those they serve.
  10. AnonymousMeetings has no opinion on outside issues; hence the AM name ought never be drawn into public controversy.
  11. Our public relations policy is based on attraction rather than promotion; we need always maintain personal anonymity at the level of press, radio, and films.
  12. Anonymity is the spiritual foundation of all our Traditions, ever reminding us to place principles before personalities.

(over)

Understanding these Traditions comes slowly over a period of time. We pick up information as we talk to members and visit various groups. It usually isn’t until we get involved with service that someone points out that “personal recovery depends on AM unity,” and that unity depends on how well we follow our Traditions. The Twelve Traditions of AM are not negotiable. They are the guidelines that keep our Fellowship alive and free.

By following these guidelines in our dealings with others, and society at large, we avoid many problems. That is not to say that our Traditions eliminate all problems. We still have to face difficulties as they arise: communication problems, differences of opinion, internal controversies, and troubles with individuals and groups outside the Fellowship. However, when we apply these principles, we avoid some of the pitfalls.

Many of our problems are like those that our predecessors had to face. Their hard won experience gave birth to the Traditions, and our own experience has shown that these principles are just as valid today as they were when these Traditions were formulated. Our Traditions protect us from the internal and external forces that could destroy us. They are truly the ties that bind us together. It is only through understanding and application that they work.

item.title: Realization from the Past
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My brother explained to me the Construction Hierarchy of Electricians / Plumbers / Painters / Tapers / Drywallers / etc went down the chain. I wonder where Self-taught Software Engineer falls in that order.

It must have been difficult for my step-father to realize at age 8 I surpassed him in digital and futuristic thought. My mind was exceedingly logical.

The first time we butted heads about tech I was explaining at the dinner table the newly released x286 cpu and that its architecture was 16 bits. I believe a sibling or mother posed was "what's 16bits mean"? Dan immediately overridengly blurted out "Intellivision has had 16 bits for years, 8 bits for one player and 8 bits for the other"! It was truly the funniest thing he ever said and i immediately laughed out loud in his direction.

I began explaining, possibly with a developing attitude, and he smacked the shit out of me and I flew backward out of my chair.

Apparently the discipline did not work, i'm exceedingly sarcastic. The man was a fool. I was 8.

I was routinely grounded from using my computer as subsequent discipline. The equalivlent of grounding from school books or homework. Brilliant.

Soon before I ran away, I was working on an AIM-65 my rival stepfathers cousin electrical engineer had loaned me to learn on, but never offered instruction or help, eventually requested with urgency its return, and Dan asked me "if one day I wanted to grow up and be like cousin Rod"? "Rod hates his life and his job and he does not make that much money. That is not a good future to pursue.

That was his "Teenage University Education Parental talk". "technology is bad [, possibly even the antichrist]. you love god, don't you? or are you a sinner like your mother"?

item.title: Friendships & Connecting With Others
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I just realized why I have such a hard time with so many relationships and I don't with Tara. It's pretty obvious to me now. My work is my life and my life is my work at the moment. Tara is the *only* person to have ever shown an interest in my work, therefore my life. I'm able to say things to Tara that I just need to be able to say to a friend. Tara is the only person to connect with me personally and professionally.

So why I can't connect well with others? Well I can, to an extent now I realize. But the fact that I have to cut out such a large part of my life when dealing with others makes the relationship seem, thin to me.

Telling somebody about my production build is bonding for me, it's bonding - for me. I of course realize that other people don't understand all the things I say, but what I'm doing is sharing an experience from my perspective, someting I need to be able to do. I'm not going to dumb things down, I need to talk in my own words. This is important for me and it's somethig that's been terribly lacking for me for a very long time now. I know I've been searching for this person and thought it was Don, but now that I've opened up professionally to Tara I feel a very strong connection has formed on many levels - recovery, friendship, love, compassion, and intellectually - I feel we can communicate - and that Tara learns and understands. She may not understand everything I say, but I've no doubt at all that one day she will. And she will be my best friend. Give this to Tara some birthday.

I also wanted to talk about the things I see in Tara that I would like to acquire for myself. Wow she is strong - and I so totally relate to her expressing the frustration of everbody seeing you as strong and therefore you ... must ... always ... be ... strong. It gets old, and I've been there with you Tara. Hell, I gave up the image of being strong and put on a dress :-) (it's so much nicer here).

item.title: My Brother
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I can't remember the topic of my next writing, so I thought "what, if anything, can I write about?" and I thought "My Brother".

My Brother has been at my side ever point in my life. My brother is my companion. We are doing this "life" thing together, his life laid out right next to mine.

I know my brother is winning. He has done very well in raising a family (compared to my fractured 3), keeping a job (he works hard. Every day he can), and never really getting in trouble (compared to me). He has never had to have "an older brother", like I have.

I am very proud of that. When asked of my family, I think first of my brother, then maybe my children, possibly grand children.

The most important people in my life right now are Charlie and Grammy. It is 100% in their credit I'm here and working tonight.

I love my brother excitement toward technology. Yes a little childlike, but also spectacularly child like. I have no doubt my brothers mind regarding technology would equal mine, it is simply time that is the question. I started many decades ago.

item.title: It was cold when I left
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
When I left, yes it was cold. No cellphones, credit cards, money, friends, family i could turn to, and in open defiance i jumped out my bedroom window and ran.

She was beating me that night. I still clearly see her anger ridden face.

I was skipping English class to ride my bike to my girlfriends Christian school, all the way through Claremont on Balboa Ave. A very long and rather dangerous street canyon divide and incredibly impressive I could bicycle it. She found out I was for the first time ever ditched a class and went berserk.

Bent over at 15 with my ass in the air underwear at my ankles she struck me. I quickly stood turned and took the belt from her hands and said "that will be the last time you hit me". She replied "Wait till ur father gets home".

I didn't, I didn't gather a backpack, socks, water, food, blanket, boots, etc. I simply jumped out the window. And left my cellphone back in 1999.

I ran, toward school. My old path I rode my bicycle to school everyday. I took the San Diego alleys and shortcuts. I walked all the way to school, then all the way back home. It was dark now. Probably 45 F.

I didn't want to go in so i found a blue tarp on the side of the house and rolled up in it. I was very cold, guessing 40 F.

I couldn't stand it, got up and started walking the opposite direction from school into canon wilderness. I followed a dark path I could not pass. The trees bowed over into a tunnel and the black was pure. I froze, I had a terrible feeling, I reconsidered, and again, turned around and fled back home.

At home I slept the night out in the tarp and woke covered in frost. It was a spectacular January morning in San Diego probably 1986.

I went to my girlfriends parents house and asked permission to stay with them under any conditions they set forth. I was eventually told no. So I was homeless. I went to school, stole food, went to parks, sleepted in gf's parents car or in children's playground rocket ships. Or on beautiful San Diego park lawns (btw the sprinklers come on at 3am). I was warmer now, or I don't remember cold ever being another issue.

I stayed to myself. I was scared. I hid and kept my mouth shut. watcher.

I stayed here and there. I met Kelly in school, new transfer from KY, loved her accent, hated her halitosis. But she was gorgeous and had a couch her mom said i could sleep on. I did, then she jumped into my arms in full lingerie (moms) and wanted to fool around. I told her I didnt think sex before marriage was right and declined. I was not a virgin. Her breath was that bad.

She tried to get me drunk by feeding me 'mixed' drinks....aparently "mix some vodka with tequila with rum and a little OJ" is a mixed drink. I couldn't dance and eventually passed out.

I woke with her naked in my arms asking if I wanted to take a shower together, I declined having a first ever splitting hangover possibly alcohol poisoning.

Stayed with Charlies friend Michael Christmas alone. Went to Rocky Horror went to Christmas party at [name].

Went to Oz San Diego

I was there one night, parents notified and brought in for a meeting i was excluded from, was told by the program manager I was "the bet kid they have ever seen" but that I could not stay, my Step Father had refused payment and insurance. Dan was afraid because my and my brothers braces that his company may fire him for using so much insurance. He thought other employees were together footing the insurance bill with higher rates. No insurance.

My mother brought and dropped off a big suitcase of clothing. Honestly i never went through it, it was a burden more than anything. Like i'm burdened now in a hotel with luggage.

She went home got in her car and came and found me walking a side street. She begged me to get in the car. I refused. She was crying. She told me the 'family' was moving back to Missouri, the house sold. Will i come back with them.

Damn I had them by the balls, didnt I?

I should have stayed, but i was homeless. I would have entered the system and quickly identified as a technology prodigy and elevated to foster care in a opportunistic environment. I wish. Who knows what would have happened i stayed.

I got in the car, didnt say a word for weeks, eventually got in fight in hotel room in transit to MO, he stabbed me with a corkscrew.

I did start to get excited about returning to Republic, but i didnt realize how much i had changed. The other kids immediately spotted my social abnormalities and i had no friends, not one. I wrote code instead and hid behind being the resident nerd programmer for extra credit kid working in the office doing daily attendance. printing fake grade cards only for themself. All i ever changed was num days missed. She wasn't going to find out i skipped school again.

I did good today, I wrote a lot. I like it.

I got both iOS and Android Cordova Ionic Angular builds running in simulators and Firebase Authentication seems to be working. Going to verify its working and quit for the night.

"Yes"

item.title: Imagination Station
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Game starts 1st player enters a random world. There are 3 exists or paths from the world. The uses finds and may execute the path of their choice. Once chosen gameplay exists for player 1.

Back in the lobby the two can discuss the events and when ready next player enters the world. A new scenario is presented the player to which 3 choices are given . The cycle repeats until completion.

The world is an enormous network of nodes with multiple entry points such as western, fantasy, space, war, peace, mystery, adventure, etc genre. All new stories must be stitched into the world.

In game clues may be purchased.

item.title: AnonymousMeetings Zoom
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I have developed a phone app I would like to discuss with you.

12 Step programs are tremendously powerful in the recovery community. Both for use in recovery itself, but also in the enforcement of recovery related sentences.

Unfortunately, due to the Anonymous aspect of most 12 Step programs as well as the inherit benefit of in-person meetings, 12 Step programs have all but ignored technology.

I believe 12 Step groups are a completely untouched niche market to benefit from.

A year ago, it may have been difficult to convince a meeting goer to embrace technology. Unfortunately at this point in time, meeting goers realize two things:

  1. their sobriety depends on attending meetings and interaction with other people in recovery.
  2. meetings in the real world are and will continue to disappear from existence.

This puts the entire 12 Step program philosophy at risk of extension. Unless the program adapts to current times and modern technology.

Online 12 Step meetings are currently being conducted online via Zoom. There are a few problems:

  1. There is no directory for meeting id/pw. How is a person to find online meetings. (there are points of meeting organization being created besides my app)
  2. There is no community both inside and outside meetings. For example, in a in person meeting, goers have the ability to talk afterward. Or meet at a time when people can communicate 1:1. Essentially the 'time' when the magic happens. When one addict connects with another. (certainly this can be accomplished adhoc via IM or direct phone calls making direct connection with another during the execution of a Zoom meeting, but it is not easy to do, or laid out in a path)
  3. Open Zoom meetings can and are being bombed by vulgar video spammers.
  4. There is no enforcement. Courts ordering a subject to attend 12 Step meetings have no means to enforcement.
  5. There is no meeting donations. Goers to meetings have no easy way to make the donations of which meetings depend as outlined in the 12 Traditions.

The app I have built, AnonymousMeetings Zoom, is the seed to easily address the above issues. I say seed because I have actually build the full AnonymousMeetings app, but to keep technical issues upon initial release very low, I have limited it to Zoom meetings exclusively. Please keep in mind that I am not building an App, I am building a 12 Step Online Recovery Community that will be facilitated through the App AnonymousMeeting, initially via Zoom.

item.title: PBS Women In Blue
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Watching it, love it. It is an answer.

I was in Indianapolis, Mars Hill area, behind an empty Marsh grocery store. It was very secluded and had a nice raised grass corner with a large shady tree in the center. I'd been there many times, usually at night in a car, only a few times previously as follows.

I pulled my whore red Toyota Taco with bright orange MinniWinny RV trailer in toe up snug to the grass and shade and got in back. From there I could be seen from the parking lot and far main road, but the shade was a requirement.

It was excessively hot Indiana summer 2020, compounded by the aluminum sun oven I was getting into. I was also a raging drug addict in near drug starvation and desperate. I was smoking meth. I can't remember exactly which guy I was waiting for to contact me with usually free drugs. He had previously give me two bumps of heroine, which i had saved.

The next morning the early sun was bright and hot on my life box with no summer breeze. I did the first bump. I waited 30, maybe 60 minutes and lined out the other bump. It was more like two small lines of pure white heroine powder. I did them both and was glad for them.

I started to feel sick. I couldn't stand, must lay, fell into my leopard skin Juicy Contour comforter and pillows atop 9" of amazing foam cushioning. I remember curling up and snuggling myself. It was ok right then.

When I woke up I was soaked and it was excessively hot, I believe the windows closed. Yes, I was going to leave, but wanted a bump first. I knew I was in trouble and could not fall back asleep. The heat could fry my brain being a severely dehydrated severely brain damaged meth addict.

I had to leave, get in the AC cab and go. I put on the closest clothes and jumped out the door and the police were in the parking lot 100 yards away waiting. I ran up to the cab, jumped in, fired her up and waited.

The officer was there within 30 seconds. I was asked for papers and received a spectacular look when he saw me. I'm sure I was a complete disaster, but still glamours. After he questioned me in a derogatory manner and I was kind enough to show my gps ankle bracelet he went back to run me, hopefully discovering I was on bail for kidnapping.

The 2nd car pulled up and the woman in blue came over and asked what was going on. I told her I had fallen asleep in the closed up camper and overheated leaving out the heroin. Speaking of, I was sick and shaking vomiting and sweating like a bathhouse fat man.

She asked me if I was ok. I wanted to say no. She got back in her car.

The other officer came back in a smoldering rage, handed me my license, said to stay out of here, that there is a lot of drug use and prostitution that occurs back here and tells me to leave. I start to back up and he yells for me to let him move the car. I could have made it.

If the woman officer had not been present I have a very strong feeling that incident would have ended very differently. Something would have been found or planted. I absolutely believe that to be true.

item.title: I'm Not Well
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I don’t know what is wrong with me but I know something is very wrong with me.  I have loving and respectful confirmation from my son Michael Edward Michaelis II Prosecuting Atty. Green Co. MO.  My daughter, furious with me, says I have an “I’m better than everyone else” act, which I’ve heard also from my brother Charlie and others. 

Three failed families, failed career, drug and alcohol addiction, prison time, 15+ felonies, pending charges of Aggravated Kidnapping with Deadly Weapon, and DUI.

Kicked out of every treatment facility and program.  Even kicked out of the rehab in prison back into general population.

Suicidal and complete lack of regard for myself.

And I do have a Superior Attitude toward everybody and everything.

I am sick.  I am sorry.  I do not know why I am like this.

I really do love and care about people.

I agree with everybody else now.  I don’t like me either.

I am filth.  The most disgusting kind possible.  I go to those places on purpose.  I enjoy it.  If only everybody who sees me as thinking I’m better only knew how low I actually physically put myself.  In all manners like financially, socially, sexually.  I have exposed my most vulnerable and inner secrets to the world very late in life.

I know I am good.  I know my heart.   It was clean of hate.

Charlie and Mom broke my heart.  I screamed a whole day.  It was a very terrifying scream watching myself.  I could not stop.  I am still having trouble speaking.

What was that screaming?  I don’t want to guess.  It scares me.

It scares me that I am not well.  Something I kept saying throughout my episode.  I texted it to several people also.

I am not well.

I was close to suicide.  Closer at least.  I’ve made more decisions.  I don’t want to be high or drunk.  I want to die sober.  I don’t care what I look like, I do not want visitation.  I would like to be cremated and my ashes disposed of by the funeral home.

It will be a hotel, on my CC.  I don’t care about leaving on the ankle bracelet.

I need to do a dry run here in my bedroom just to go through the steps slowly and become for familiar with the items.  I want it to be easy and rehearsed when I do it.

I want to set everything up for immediate use, maybe even having put it on.  Then leave.  Go and just relax.  Breathe.  Smell,  Star gaze, Moon worship, bare feet in grass, pretty toes and love the Mother Earth.

She understands.  I need to be reunited with her spiritually.  

My spirit is sick.  My spirit may be dead.  I am a very ugly person to everybody.  I see that now.

Wait, no I know lots of people I have quite recently while en episode made very good connections with.  Carol is a friend I made.  She is very sweet to me.  I did try to push her away during the episode, I had just met her and didn’t want to, you know.  And she was sick.  We are talking now.

I sat and talked to a woman on the square living a home free life.  We communicated well, I said “I usually have a hard time communicating with people, but you I can talk to, you are very smart”, she said she was a Psychology phD.  I bet she and I have a similar mental disease.

I son the attorney says I have the sin of Pride.   That’s a good question.  With all my pride I suck dick in Adult Theaters.

Or maybe I just put on this while pride act but it’s really just bullshit.  Nobody knows me, nobody is even close to the mark.  Well, I do have to admit their keenly pointed out observations have become quite truthfull.  Maybe people do know me and that’s what I don’t realize.

Maybe they see me as I really am and the person I think I am is just all fantasy.  Maybe that 80’s show about Dungeons & Dragons making the kids go crazy and live in mental institutions was true.  I will actually be quite honest.  I’ve always wanted to see that movie again because I really liked the idea of being that person who’s mind is locked in an alternate reality while being institutionalized.  Such a happy and peaceful life.

I think I did considerable damage to the development of my brain when I was 15 and started inhaling the fumes of Touline soaked paper towels in a paper bag.  The fumes would be so strong they would burn my lips so I would inhale mouth wide open fingers making big O around my outstretched lips, till my head would hang, my lips no longer burning I could breath so deeply then.  Stop, I’d be passing, deep breath of air, few more times to clean the lungs, then slow breaths of the gas.  I loved the smell the taste. 

Then I’d hear the helicopters and I knew it was time to stop.  I’d flush everything, I was in the garage bathroom.  I’d wash my face because I’d stink.  Mom always thought the neighbors were cooking meth.

I’d go lay down on my bed and just close my eyes.  I have no idea how nobody ever knew I was doing this all the time.  I don’t actually remember but I know it was a lot.  Months I think.  Possibly we ran out of fluid.  Maybe I ran away, yes that was it.  I ran away.

Before I tell the ran away, I want to say at age 15 is a very important time in the development of a child’s brain and I believe I did significant damage to the adolescent development of my brain and psyche during this time.  I never learned social behaviors.  I learned sex from a slut my first wife Melissa.  Oh how it broke my heart when my brother told me.

Note, first love pain caused by Charlie telling me what the other guys used to do with the girl I fell in love with.  My heart broke terribly.  Horribly.

I am a https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/understanding-narcissism/201708/the-truth-about-narcissistic-personality-disorder

Yes and no.  All of the initial description yes, but none of the Indicators except two.  Extreme sensitivity and Overreaction anger.  The two bad indicators.  I was terrified when reading it because it describes such a disgusting person, but it was perfecting describing everything that is wrong with me.  I am scared, terrified even.  

I have no problem with being open about the fact there is a scared little girl inside me. 

And when she gets hurt, I defend her to the extreme.  And when she gets angry, I lose control and go out of my mind.

I used to be able to keep her pretty happy when I lived alone.  I also smoked a lot of crack, or at times drinking, seldom meth and heroine here and there.

I no longer want to talk about my addiction, that now seems almost small compared to my larger mental illness.  Possibly addiction is a symptom of my mental illness?  Yes it is.  Why fix a symptom and not the problem?

I believe the Spiritual growth of recovery is good for any human being in any state.  The Dali Lama would probably enjoy working the 12 steps.  Hmmmm, I should ask him to sponsor me.  Is that NPD?

So, I guess I”m going to Google “How to cure NPD DYI”

Lots of articles I found but didn't read. I want to write more. Another post.

item.title: My NPD
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I am a Pathological Narcissist. See

https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/understanding-narcissism/201708/the-truth-about-narcissistic-personality-disorder

I think I only show two Red Flags for Narcissistic Personality Disorder, they are two of the worse.

Hypersensitivity to Slights

Yes, I am hypersensitive to slights, actual or otherwise. A tone of voice, a look or lack of a look. I feel like I am very good at picking up on peoples attitudes. I hate attitudes and apparently I have one of the largest. Good grief.

Disproportionate Anger

I used to think of my disproportionate anger as Righteous Indignation which is justified of course because I am right and whoever/whatever I am angry at is wrong.

I want to get to the meat of why I'm writing. This is from the article and I want my thoughts on it.

Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD) is the name for a series of coping strategies that began as an adaptation to a childhood family situation that left the person with unstable self-esteem, the inability to regulate their self-esteem without external validation, and low empathy.

Dan raised me as his inferior. He always told me he would be better than me even when he was an old man. He was the original NPD and I inherited his disease.

At 10 when touching my first computer I soon realized I was much more intelligent in the digital world than he was. He also realized it. I was a very gifted child he never ever even once acknowldeged.

I remember I built a whole power grid using my Erector Set and spools of copper wire. It went all along my bedroom floor. Powered with 9v batteries, fuses, etc. I wired up motors as make shift cooling fans for my face. I remember I wanted him to see it so bad, because he was an electrician.

He didn't care at all. Now wait, I do remember a story. This is the shit.

I took my battery powered fan in a school box to school and showed my bff Scooter. I showed him how to make one and he went home and did so. Scooter was also very intelligent.

He went out of his way to hinder me. I was much more intelligent than he was.

Diagnosis. 50yo person with the stunted personality of a teenage computer genius with Narcissistic Personality Disorder developed through interaction with there also NPD Stepfather who physically, emotionally, and psychologically abused them throughout childhood justified by Midwest Christian Values. I also wanted to be Queer, but never told anybody, obviously.

I was a fucked up kid who grew up into a severely fucked up adult.

So I'd like to say the realization in the hard part, but it would seem I now have a tremendous amount of work ahead of me. I would like to be committed and be able to work on these problems outside this every day world. Institutional life would be fine. Or a monastery.

I wish I could just disappear from this world completely. I know what my problem is! I figured it out! Isn't the simulation going to end now? Hello? Is nobody at the games controls? It would be nice just a quick Z flash and "zizz" and black and it's over.

Then the "results" printout of how I did. How well I overcame.

Well, lets see. 2 years ago I was making $12K cash a month writing easy software with a gorgeous sweet wife and a beautiful little girl in a nice home with new cars, etc. I threw it all away for no reason at all. Just the issue of my mental illness.

This is my 4th or 5th go around. I'm tired of this. I want it to end.

My family will understand that I am and have never been well. My leaving will hurt them but I've been hurting them their whole lives and I want it to end.

Alcohol got me that first semester in college and I never went back. I could learn it all myself, losers went to college. I could teach myself. And I did.

I am considering doing it tonight. I feel very numb right now.

item.title: Add title...
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I believe I know myself a little better today. I know I am a Narcissist and my mind is sick. I know I am rather good at fighting depression. I know I have a strong mind and I have the ability to force my mind's attitude how I want, within reason. I know I find tremendous comfort in solitude and work. I know I am not well.

I think I destroy myself in hopes of starting clean and becoming the person I want to be. But it seems each time I start over I'm starting over with a sicker seed that sprouts into something even more terrible than it's predecessor.

Did I destroy my life? Yes. Did I do it deliberately? Yes. Did I do it knowing I'd find myself here now? Absolutely Yes. I just didn't think things would be so dark this time. The Pandemic did not help. It was one of the unforeseen factors.

I also didn't expect to lose all of my family and friends. All of them. I have three family members I can still talk to. Chloe my beautiful artist who knows nothing of my filth. Daniele my little cousin who knows all of my filth but is 5 States away and our communication at times is high but more often rather scarce. Finally my love Natasha, now 9, who is safe and happy in a new family far far away. She will respond to my txt messages maybe two or three times a month.

I feel so empty. Not hollow, thin, like there is no place inside me for something to fill anyway.

I don't know what it is like to be happy. To wake up happy, to exist just living a happy life. To lay my head down at night content, close my eyes and feel the love around me. I have never had that feeling in my life.

Even when I know I should have been living like that I did/would/could not. My mind would always be focused on what I had to do next to make life better. Even during the times when my mind should be at ease the most, I always kept it on high alert. I would use alcohol to quiet my mind and justify its excessive use through my current success.

item.title: Lacking
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Enough talking about bull shit. I am close to gaining enough strength to suicide. It is not easy. It is really quite difficult even when sick.

If there is any doubt at all it becomes impossible, short a brash act of pulling a trigger or jumping. I don't want that.

I find it best not to actually think about the act or the afterward. I don't know what others will feel or think. I know it will not be good, but I think it's better than this continued existence. I got to witness my mothers reaction to her sisters death last week. She cried a bit for herself, wishing she could have seen her one last time. But her sister hid her many years of illness from my mother. Hid even the dual lung transplant she recovered from then died from a short bout with cancer. That is a lot of hiding things.

So was how Aunt Marry handled her illness the right way? I would argue yes. Because my mother and her sisters relationship quality did not warrant marry bringing the worry of illness into my mothers life. She spared my mother a lot of worry, at the cost of their relationship.

So the question becomes, does the value of the relationship outweigh the pain a person endures from exclusion?

I believe in my case, it would be best to let my relationship with others dwindle down to nothing such that when I pass their pain will be lessened. They will hurt for a few days and then forget. I do not have anybody besides my mother who will genuinely mourn my loss long term. That is the truth.

Everybody knows I'm not well. How can they not expect my further demise? I am clearly on a collision course with my own reckoning and I am a good judge of character. It is my own decision if I find my quality of character lacking.

item.title: We are all not well
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I think possibly we all have to some extent mentally ill. For most the symptoms are nothing more than aspects of a persons personality. And for the most part the symptoms do not cause destruction in the persons life or lives of those around them.

Occasionally a persons symptoms may clash with another persons symptoms. At other times I believe possibly the symptoms of two people may mesh into a third symptom they both share. One possibility is that the symptoms of two people may harmonize and cancel, forming a positive bond between the two.

Yes, it is the inherent psych disorders we all as living spirits possess that creates the strengths and vulnerabilities in our own perception of ourselves.

I'm talking about 'normal' people. Not me. I'm really not well. My disorder goes beyond simple lego building block connecting or rejection with others. If there is a connection it is very unstable. I usually see the weakness and disregard it. The few times I have grown relationships I picture them as a hodge podge tower of random lego pieces towering into the sky, always based on the one thing I seek the most.

I need to be valued greatly by others, and others do provide this sort of healthy respect and love. The problem is that I also must value myself. Once I lose favor with myself I dive deep into self hate and loathing riding the wave of mania up and down and up and down until the 'other' jumps ship.

I have done this even on dates, with people who are crazy about me. I have run from dates before, thinking myself not worthy or otherwise incapable. 'Probably good for the other person' thoughts usually seal the deal.

The more I write and think the more I see the sickness in my entire existence. This is not a good place to be alone. I'm not upset while I write, in face I'm completely numb. I'm even not actually thinking. I'm just reading the words as they come out.

item.title: Be careful what I say.
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Out back I was smoking, finished and walking to the door when mom came out. I thought I'll sit with her and tell her. She asked how I was and I said 'Not well'. She asked what I meant and I said 'I have realized I am mentally ill, I love you and I am sorry all the pain I have caused'. I also gave her my thoughts on a 1950's psych ward and how from my perspective right now, it seems like heaven. She didn't understand so I elaborated.

Back in time places existed where I could commit myself and receive long term housing and treatment, while of course being a participant in some phD medical studies (experiments I'm sure). I would submit to any treatment thought by a Dr. to help me.

At this point in time the only treatment thought by a Dr. to help me is to do my best to continue on as I have my entire life, play with some rather benign medications over months and years, and receive regular psycho therapy while actively participating in (hopefully) coordinated therapy and counseling. I believe social activities within recovery groups is encouraged and monitored. That would be the Betty Ford of treatment.

Back to the point, the problem with modern treatment is that I have to continue living my life, which I'm incapable of doing through either lack of desire, legal status, physical status, etc. Even if I were to establish myself in a living routine it would unavoidably end in a social connection leading to renewed disaster.

To the point, I didn't tell mom any of the above. I made it short and to the point and she agreed psych ward commitment would be best for me. Then she asked me if I was running my errands today.

I said "yes, to see my counselor, then to Jordan Valley to possibly see a Dr." She told me to be careful what I say or that I could be hospitalized. I don't know what to think about that?

Shouldn't she want me to be hospitalized if a professional thinks it's necessary?

Didn't I just tell her it would be nice if I could be institutionalized for a term? And she agreed.

Or should I, as she suggests, be on guard and hide my true words from the only people actually trying to help me?

I was released from the psych ward today! And the sun was shining on a beautiful Ozark October 12th fall day!!!!

I'm in mania now. My cycle is 3 months. July 3th to Oct 5th. Or 13 week, or 94 days, which is 3.09 months.

Oddly enough I found this on Google which states that mood episodes lasted an average of 13 weeks

https://www.verywellmind.com/bipolar-disorder-how-often-do-people-cycle-378814#citation-1

I think I might be on to something!

To clarify my last extreme alcohol rampage and motorcycle accident was on July 3rd 2021. That was depression. I came right out of that and released MeetingMaker in early August. That was mania through late September (~2 months). Then the depressions started creeping back in for the remaining month.

Backtracking even further to the cycle ending in the depression of July 3rd. I will stop writing now because this will get dark. I'll just leave this as a reminder to add it as a new post.

The point of this post was 3 months.

item.title: Attitude
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So I was thinking today, several times and had some good ideas I should have written down. I wanted to talk about them on the Love Bus. I felt weird, feel weird about my friends there. I feel like I'm not properly 'clicking' with them or something. Normally I'd shy away and then never go back, but I think I've made the decision to stay. I love Sarah, will probably meet Jon soon. I love The Global NA Love Bus, location Earth.

So I'm trying to remember one of the thoughts I had. I was thinking more like I used to think before the change when things were bad. And I could feel bad coming on quick today. I snapped at mom a few times today and I thought to myself "oh, I need to start being nicer like I was yesterday"...... Then realizing the futility of that having not worked over a lifetime for me so far, I paused.

This is important, critical I was thinking. Have I gone from Mikki back to Mike? I am again going to be stuck in a cycle of Mike/Mikki/WTF/Mike/WTF/Mikki all while trying to 'be nicer to people'. Is not going to work for me. I started to nose dive.

I still am actually, I'm thinking of drinking. This is hard, I'm not thinking of drinking, I'm actually feeling of drinking. Ugh, I'm losing control of my focus....... I can't type anymore.

I'm sorry fellow Bus riders, I know I can't stop myself once I've gone this far.

My body is screaming

to sit out tonight

cold, dark, alone

drinking hard,

painfully hard,

alone, dark, and cold.

Why do I want to do this??? Because you know you will forget. Because you know you still want to die. 2nd time I've though that since being back. Twice today. Mom brought it about once and now, I feel warm, fuzzy, agitated, exhausted, lonely, sad, pain.

I have to stop now, I'm ready to hurt.

I was scared this would happen.

.......

I'll finish the Attitude post. So if I keep doing the same snap things over and over that make people hate me, and I have such little control, it's out my mouth, look still fresh on my face, probably insulting somebody's intelligence, which as much stupid shit I do must really make me look pathetic to onlookers of me being condescending to another......

I can never change my snap reactions. What I must change is my Attitude from which snap reactions originate. My Attitude is what is changing from Mikki to Mike. Specifically family is raising the levels of frustration I'm experiencing, and mood is following suit. It is suicide for me to stay here. I'm just coming off my 'big spiritual change' and have had very little support.

Has Steve or Mom even actually engaged ONCE in talking with me? Well, no, they can't and they know better. So wtf are you thinking they should?

So you have nobody to talk to. Because NOBODY LIKES YOU. Nobody, nowhere in the entire Universe is thinking about you right now, except your mother thinking "I should go knock on his door to tell him pizza is available since he didn't hear me the first time".

I'm going to get drunk and talk to Joanna tomorrow.

NEXT DAY UPDATE: I didn't use, I went to sleep instead.

item.title: Decision to Recover
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
There is a difference between being in the depths of despair and having the 'desire' to die, and being of rational thought and making the 'decision' to die. There is an ocean of difference. What is the difference from my perspective?

It's all about Attitude. Desire is one attitude and Deciding is another attitude.

The Desire to die sets in my mind an attitude which puts me on the path of depression. The Decision to die sets in my mind an attitude which puts my death into action.

The paralleling contrast comes from 12-Step Recovery's "..only requirement for membership is the desire to quit."

The Desire to quit using sets in my mind an attitude which puts me on the path of recovery. The Decision to quit using sets in my mind an attitude which puts my recovery into action.

If you want to die you know to make that happen you have to decide.

If you want to recover you know to make that happen you have to decide.

To make anything happen you have to decide.

Decisions are both super easy and super hard. It's easy to think "I really want to [blah]" and think "I've decided", but is it really in your heart? Maybe now, but later today? Tomorrow? When the dope man calls? So how to make that decision? Everybody knows in their heart when a decision is made, you can really feel it. How to make that feeling deep down that you know is forever? Like the decision to get married, which fades as it seems we all end up screwing up eventually anyway?

Fortunately the 12-Steps were created as a spiritual path any person who has the capability to be honest with themselves can walk. Even better than that, the 12-Steps have created a community that desperately needs to help people walk the path of recovery. This is without doubt the greatest advancement in Human Spirituality this past millennium.

My decision to die came during a significant mental breakdown.

My decision to recover came after taking 3 of the 12-Steps.

  1. My life is unmanageable? yep.
  2. Can believe I have a HP? took a bit but yep.
  3. Made a Decision to trust my HP. Ugh, how to make the decision? Really? One that stays?

I have my answer. I make the same decision everyday.

All I did was decide once that I wanted to be a part of Sarah's recovery life and I wanted her in my recovery. I want to know everybody on the Love Bus because I can see and hear them every night and they are people I want to be like.

Yep, every night I think "I'm not going to talk", "Nobody likes me", "I think Sarah is just playing friends", "This is not going to work", etc etc. But I force myself to go and in the end I am so happy I got on the Bus, I again make the decision to to recover.

It really is as simple of 'just keep coming back'. Find the meeting you can feel at home in and reach out to members. Just like if you wanted to get high you would reach out to a dealer. There is NO excuse for not reaching out, we ALL know how to do that and are not shy about it when we want to use. Get phone number lists, just a list not attached to any individual, and start randomly texting the numbers asking "How is ur day in recovery today?". The conversations you enjoy, continue. The ones you don't, politely excuse urself from.

I hope this post is making clear to somebody besides myself that I we all the skills and experience in Addiction that I can repurpose and use for Recovery. There is no excuse for being of the mindset 'I don't know how to recover'.

It really is this easy to make the Decision to Recovery

item.title: Stranded Dream
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Patti, Natasha, and I were overseas. I didn't know the country or language. It was getting close to the date for our departure flight. Everything was packed, but I could not find my or Natasha's passport required to leave. I hunted through our packed luggage knowing the passports were in there. I found my passport but not Natasha's. Patti, although very worried about the situation, was rather indifferent to searching for Natasha's passport. We discussed where it might be several times The time of the flight came and I was absolutely frantic. Nobody seems to want to help, but everybody was very worried. The flight left and we were all stranded as Patti would not leave Natasha and I would not leave either of them.

Patti and Natasha seemed to disappear from the dream as I was now completely alone. I started to wander the city in which I was located. I was completely broke and had no local resources. I was terrified.

I realized I was not in Thailand but another country. I thought the people were speaking a form of Arabic and had no idea even what country I was in. I was getting hungry. In a shop I picked up a boxed dinner kit for lasagna, then put it back down also eyeing a bag of macaroni. I turned to my brother and asked if we needed them and was given a confirmation to which I stole the lasagna box.

My focus then turned to figuring out what country I was located and using google translate to begin communicating. I was traveling with an unknown local group of people through the city about to take an on ramp to the highway. I noticed the onramp writing and decided to use my iPhone to detect and translate the writing on the highway sign. Pulling out my phone and hitting the home button kept cycling through all previous photos I'd taken instead of returning to home where I could access the camera. The home button continued cycling and I missed my chance to photo and decipher the sign.

It appeared at that time I was also the only person in the vehicle and had to immediately enter the highway to avoid traffic behind me. I got on and immediately exited the highway onto a very small road. The car continued moving down the road until it entered a tunnel. I realized the road had actually ended and I was now on a very disgusting and deep mud rut. I put the car into reverse and hit the gas, and surprisingly continued to move forward and becoming now stuck in a dark tunnel in filthy mud.

The dream ended with me talking to a local man who spoke english. I asked him where I was and he asked me where I thought I was. I said "India?" and the look on his face made me think I was close. I said "Pakistan" and again I felt I was close. I thought "Bangladesh" but never said it as that possibility was terrifying. He also would not tell me the language, however I told him a lie that I was fluent in four language for simple conversation and hopped to learn the local language quickly. This of course was completely fabricated as I don't speak any foreign language conversationally.

I'm unsure of the sequence of the following events so I'm adding them here, non sequentially. A young girl who was also stranded came to me and asked what she could do for money. I asked her if she was open to prostitution as it was a difficult thing to live with afterward. She said no and I said I understood, then in my dream breaking down with emotion myself.

I had a conversation with others in my group (although I was the only person talking) regarding what country we were in. I said that I did not believe this to be a dangerous country as I've been in dangerous places in the world (a lie) stating that there we had to walk with our hands in our pockets because if you didn't have your hands in them, a stranger would eventually have theirs. This place was not like that, the people seemed non aggressive.

Martha was somehow in my dream (possibly replacing Patti). Also she seemed concerned she did not appear worried about her survival. We went our separate ways.

item.title: Communication
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Communicating is a difficult task. Properly communicating is near impossible these days.

My method of communicating is as such. An idea is presented between communicating parties. Each party will state a point to the idea. The receiving party of the point must allow the point presenter time to finish communicating. Sometimes the presenter may pause or otherwise create the perception they are done communicating due to possibly thinking about the point while communicating. Therefore, once the point presenter is finished communicating they should initiate a response point request.

The difficulty the receiving party faces is that they will inherently have responsive points generated in their mind while receiving the presented point. These thoughts must not be acted on as the receiving party has yet to hear out the point in its entirety. Once the initiates a response point request, the receiving party should then dwell on the point and then present their point response.

All too often points are left hanging and never effectively communicated. That creates uncertainty in the conversation because the hanging point presenter may believe their point was effectively communicated. Also the response point to the hanging point may be confusing to the original point presenter. This confusion will lower the levels of communication over time exponentionally.

Points are often left hanging because the presenter is unable to properly communicate their point. Points are also often left hanging because the presenter is interrupted by the receiver. This is where the act of listening comes into play, the difficulty in being receiving party.

Listening is the process of trying to understand the point the presenter is communicating. It is simply piecing together in the mind the idea being communicated. Emotions are communicated effectively when listening is done with little or no active thought by the receiving party.

Listening is not the act of thinking about the words the presenter is saying.

Obviously we are discussing rational high level communication.

item.title: Albeit Pain
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I used to be very in touch with my feelings. 40 years later and I'm numb.

On some occasions I have very strong emotions breaking through the cold numb. These times I am so happy for, I want to cry. But usually they quickly fade.

I was raised a boy and know how to very quickly divert rising emotions. I usually think "Now you're just feeling sorry for yourself" and I immediately feel like my emotion is fake, I'm simply feeling sorry for myself and if I simply stop thinking about what's causing this emotional pain it will stop. By then in my mind I've lost focus of the emotion and it quickly subsides. It feels shameful that I was crying for myself. I go on being emotionally numb again and just a little more ashamed of myself.

There are times though, when my emotions overcome me. If I cry it is obscene and unstoppable. If I don't cry it is completely internalized in acts of panic, aggression, verbal and emotional abuse, and self hatred.

I need a new drug. One that makes me purge all built up emotions. Take a pill and cry in the bath. Somebody should invent that.

Today was one of those strong long overdue emotions. I just felt it, then it fades......

I lost the love of my life, my little girl Natasha. Through my own actions I destroyed my family. My amazing in every way wife divorced me. It was on the basis that I am transgender, but the reality is that I lost control of my own life and created the beginnings of a living hell for my family, which she quickly exited and was right to do so.

My wife very quickly found a new life and began living it. I am very happy for her and proud of her and her family. I am proud to have been the starting point for her here in the USA. I destroyed a beautiful marriage.

I am happy Natasha is with her Mommy and they are moving to Florida. I am very happy for their new family. The distance matters not at all to me, I was never moving back to Indiana, so to see Natasha is now a three hour flight instead of a one.

What does bother me is the young social pressures of the wealthier and high lifestyle areas of this country. I grew up in San Diego, went to 4 different schools my last 5 years of public school. The education was excellent but the social devastation it caused in my psyche has lasted my entire life.

What I do in these times is to work. I work hard, usually drawing from the pain inside me to push me forward. I was terribly depressed today and am renewed with energy, albeit pain.

item.title: Outside Society
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I'm too tired to write code anymore tonight. I'll work again tomorrow, my usual day off, then pretend to go into work Wednesday while actually looking for a new job, then return later Wednesday with some story I'll probably makeup on the fly about quitting my job to pacify my mothers unusual behaviors. Regardless, I'll be writing code tomorrow and have decided to write words tonight.

It's 9:06pm and I'm exhausted. Emotionally mostly, physically I've been getting lots of good sleep lately.

So I don't believe I have yet written about my last relapse. It was Saturday. Maybe I have, or texted it with Jeffery, regardless this version may be from a different perspective.

I rightfully was fired from my job. I can accept that what I did was wrong. I verbally assaulted another coworker. Regardless the situation, I was wrong and was understandably fired. I thought to drink after this happened, but instead went right home and distracted myself by working hard on code.

That day I was scheduled to work till 3pm and scheduled with my daughter Myka a visit with my grandchildren Aster and Arlen. On the drive there I thought again to drink. I did not as I have been warned of that by Myka.

Unfortunately things with the kids were disastrous, something happened that broke my heart, my disease of addiction kicked in and I fled. I drove right to the convince store and conveniently bought a pint of 'Dark Eyes' vodka. I tried making a joke with the cashier about the 'dark eyes' name and it went right over her head as she called in the manager to ask him. Good grief, I suck. After he finally left, I simply said "I was simply joking that I'll be really upset if this stuff turns my eyes dark". Then she laughed, smiled, caught my eye, and I left to get drunk.

I started texting Jeffery my actions and all that shit. I'm very glad for his sake I quickly lost my phone (I'm haunted by a raven).

I had no cash and thought maybe just possibly I had properly set up cash withdrawals on my one remaining credit card and yes, I was soon on the hunt for meth. Well actually before I wanted the meth I wanted to go shopping!

I had fun shopping, it was a blast. Fortunately that day I had wore some tight waisted baggy jeans and could stuff a good 6 items around my waist, making me look even more American having a bulging belly. I figured I got around $400 in items, including a 35XO Morphe pallet, and a usb external dvd reader for my MacBook Pro. I am terrible. I feel the most terrible about the fact that I'm really not sorry at all. I've been steeling so long now I care not the morals. I've had so much stolen from me by people, I don't really even care about steeling from other people, even extremely sentimental items of really very low value to me, other than 'coolness'.

I actually don't want to write about this topic any more so I'll finish quickly. Later that night I ended up taking care of a homeless woman named MiMi and then slept alone in my car at the truck stop, throwing up the 'dark eyes' vodka onto the asphalt, sleeping terribly, and enjoying every second of being free, while in many levels of pain and discomfort.

I want to be homeless. I want to go into the wild and exist completely outside society. I would like to have only my Mac and only write code and blog posts. Besides pornography, that's all I use my Mac for anyway. I can go without porn and strictly limit myself to only writing. I'll bring along a magazine.

I so miss the San Diego tranny escort ads I had access to as a teenager. I wanted to be one of those girls so bad. I never saw those pictures as anything other than beautiful, gorgeous, sexy people, and everything I wanted to be. I spent a lot of money in pay phone quarters inserting the $5/minute required to talk to these beautiful humans. I regret not being who I wanted to be from the start, but I know I could have never until now. I had a lot to overcome. I don't care if I'm late in life for HRT, I'm not doing this for anybody but myself. Does this mean I'm being selfish? No, it means I'm finally starting to love me for who I am.

item.title: Healing the Mind
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
TLDR;

Stated another way I have to realize that my present feelings and thoughts ARE STRONGER than the old thoughts and feelings in my memories. I can either use my present mind to heal my existing memories by remembering them again with new feelings, or I can just dwell on the old ones and let things rot.

My mind is not going to heal itself like my body does, I have to want to heal it and I have to exercise it.

/TLDR;

Today is Day 4 of HRT. I've been working hard as I'm quickly approaching a v2.0 release and want authentication rock solid and lightning fast. I'm taking a break from code, laying here on my bed, contemplating Day 4.

How do I feel? Any noticeable change? I feel calm. Hmmm, I wonder why? My life is rather difficult at the moment......let's wonder why I feel ok in this moment....

I feel like I'm healing. Both my physical body and my mind. I need to give them both some time to heal. Hmmm, that's interesting. How does the mind heal? I know the body just does it automatically, we never even have to think about it, really. The healing of the body is a natural biological function.

The healing of the mind is quite different than that of the body. I don't know how the mind heals, but I know it is not a natural biological function. I know I take medicine which inhibits and alters the biological function of my physical brain, but I would say that the brain is not the mind itself. The brain is simply the house the mind lives in, or technically that the brain is the neural network that hosts the mind. But the brain is certainly not the mind.

Or is it? Let's think about that again, why not? Some basic assumptions are that the thoughts of my mind are electrical signals being propagated through brain neurons in a pattern specific to the thought. I would imagine that the neurons transversed when the same thought is considered twice (ie "I like pizza", "I like pizza") will not produce the exact same neural network pattern in the brain. There will be differences as I know it can be proven repetitive thinking causes increased enforcement in the physical neurons. This dictates change. Think "I like pizza" one billion times and you will either like pizza or hate it. Either way the thought is very reenforced.

So what makes those changes in the brain neurons?

Hmmmmm, so regarding pizza.....I hope the reader agrees the one billion thoughts can actually go in either direction but will be very far in direction, regardless. Why is this?

I think it might be pretty simple. If every time you think "I like pizza" you are also feeling "Oh pizza sounds so good right now, maybe pepperoni? <hunger, desire>", the thought will be reinforced with positive desire.

If however ever time you think "I like pizza" you are also feeling "This is retarded, I do like pizza but not enough to think 'I like pizza' 999,999,999 more times, <resentment>", the thought will be reinforced with negative desire.

Is it that feelings are an active input into our mind in such a way they are encoded into every thought we have? Yes. Is is that feelings can be decoded and felt again on reflection on a specific thought? Absolutely yes.

So my medicine I take to alter my brain. What exactly is it doing to make me better? I would guess it is somehow interfering with the encoding and decoding of the feelings associated with thoughts stored in my brain.

So then the question becomes, if I stop taking my medicine what happened? (besides getting sick and dizzy)

I think the question (from my perspective) is will all the feelings in my memories now be unlocked such that thinking of something terrible a year ago (and has been somewhat numbed from medicine) will come flooding back like a wave in it's original form?

I think that will depend on how much time I have spent inside that bad memory while on medicine. We already know that every time a memory is relived it changes through automatic encoding of current feelings, time distorts memory and things are forgotten, sometimes even things are incorrectly inserted into memories, the 'meaning' of sentences may remain close to the original meaning, however the words are rather frequently shuffled around....ie "it's hot and sweaty today" -> "it is hot and sticky today" (typically these misinterpretations happen at the initial memory recall while the thinker is actively putting the memory together in their neural network, and accidents do happen in recall and most people think if they remember it, it happened, so shit happens I guess).

...

I smoked and thought and had a realization. Now to put it into words....

First I realized I forgot the original realization that started this post. And have forgotten it again....

I think better when I smoke cigarettes and delta 8.

The 1st is that to Heal the Mind I must want to.

The 2nd is that .... I now forget it.....

Feelings are the physical Environment with which our brains associate memories. When something happens to us, along with our 'thoughts' about what happened are encoded into our brain the only physical environment available to the brain are the 'feelings' in the physical body at the time of the event.

The 3rd is that memories are only formed if a person thinks about the event. If something happens in a person's life but they never think about it, they will probably never remember it ever happening. It is only at the time the person first think's about it that is becomes a memory. The more the memory is thought about the stronger it is reenforced and more easily it is recalled.

Again to feelings and memory encoding. Let's say a person is in their garage playing with their dog. At the time the dog was playing nicely with the person and does something unusually cute but the person fails to completely notice or think about how cute it was. If they had, it would have brought joy to their heart and the event would be recorded with the feeling of joy.

Now the person takes the dog inside and the animal bumps Grandma's Urn and covers the house in ashes. The person is feeling many negative emotions some specifically toward the dog. While cleaning the dog starts playing again and does that cute thing again and the person thinks "didn't I kinda see her do that earlier?" and a memory is formed. However that memory is not formed with joy. Whatever cute the dog just did is smothered in frustration, terror (vacuuming up Grandma), anguish, resentment, love and possibly hatred. That is quite a mix, and unfortunately for the dog, every time she does that cute thing the person will be right back to the vacuum, thoughts and feelings alike. I'm sure we all have a memory mixed with very inappropriate emotions.

For example, I had Natasha for a weekend and it was good. I dropped her off at her new house to caught a glimpse of my love running hands in the air into the arms of my replacement. As joyful as the weekend should have been remembered for me, it was instead devastating.

Every time I remembered the event (constantly) my jealousy, self-hatred/loathing, envy, sadness, and depression would all rise to new levels prompted by my own thoughts fueled by a feedback loop of emotions. Over and over and over and over.

I didn't survive in that state long before alcohol use went all the way up, leading to an attempted suicide Memorial Day 2019 via motorcycle which then led to my cocaine use and my visits with my daughter completely stopping. I just could not get it out of my head and decided I was trash and to throw myself away. I lived for a year almost two, I guess, it's hard to remember those times. I don't want to.

I have however come to the realization that Natasha is better off then and now where she is. She has love and she is happy and I know it, because I was lucky enough to see it. That change of mind changes a lot.

Now when I think of her new family, I try my best to think only about Natasha being happy. I try not to run the vision back through my mind, it is still painful. I think what I should be doing though is to actually run it through my grey noodle and feel those feelings again but filter this memory through my new perspective that Natasha is better off. Those memories are very painful, but now I can try to start replacing those feelings with new feelings of Natasha being happy.

To do that, I must force myself to think the bad memory in a new light and with new appropriate feelings. If at first I cry then I cry. If I want to use, I call my sponsor (if I had one).

I didn't cry. Medicine has numbed the pain up pretty good. My heart did ache but not break. Then I tried to feel how happy Natasha was in that moment and I just let the feelings meld together. I felt a little happy for her. It was a start.

By realizing how happy Natasha was in that moment while my mind is in that memory, melded over and over to the remaining pain I feel will eventually dissolve it from my mind and I will only feel the joy I have for Natasha.

My love for my daughter is stronger than the pain I chose keep in my memories.

item.title: I've Made Another Decision
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Last time I made a decision like this I ended up in the hospital psych ward.

So kids, if you are wondering the easiest, cleanest, quietest, painless way to suicide with simple store bought items from Walmart, you have found the right blog.

I'm a life long 'wannabdead' suicide since early teenage years. Early in life I really really wanted to but had no means. The idea of a violent death revolts me. I want my death to be peaceful. No pain, no poison, no splats, no cracks, I just want to sit in my car and fall asleep with a sign around my neck that says to call 911. I'm thinking truck stop parking lot, midnight, nobody cares who is parked there, eventually somebody will see me the next day and call. I'll have a good 8 hours to be dead and this only takes 8 minutes.

What if I told you that you can quietly, quickly, peacefully die with no pills, razorblades, guns, ropes, floors to climb, or officers to point a toy gun at? What if by using this method you would get very drowsy, fall asleep and if you remain asleep for 8 minutes you will definitely be dead?

I think I may YouTube this, kids need to know how to end their pain. I mean a video of me committing suicide.

Ok, here's the *science* (sorry). When you hold your breath that urge to breath is not your body's need for oxygen. Your lungs burn because the carbon dioxide collecting in your lungs. Your body is not screaming for oxygen, it's screaming to exhale the carbon dioxide. A lack of oxygen will simply make a person fall asleep and die. Enough science.....

If instead of breathing air, you breath something pure and completely harmless, like...helium, your body will not know the difference and as you breath and exhale the co2 everything is 100% normal and feels just fine, except helium has no oxygen, so your brain will get very sleepy and die in 8 minutes.

This original method calls to use a plastic hood over the individuals head, however that's fucked up.

So we all know the method of killing yourself by sitting in a running car in a closed garage. I've spent a lot of time living and sleeping in cars lately. I was wondering, if I simply close all the windows and open the helium tanks, the car will fill with helium and the oxygen will be forced down and out of the vehicle through the AC/Heating duct ways. Leaving just helium, pure helium to be enjoyed.

Helium is an Inert Gas, meaning it does not react with anything. It causes nothing and does not even burn. In fact, the only thing that can get helium to burn is the enormous pressure and heat in the center of a star. That's how cool this gas is.

So that's the plan. Buy 4 helium tanks, drill a hole or two in the bottom of my car, close the doors, roll up the windows, open very slightly all 4 tanks (just a little hiss - a little blowing against your cheek), from practice at that rate the tanks will empty for 15 minutes or so, plenty of time for me to be dead.

https://www.walmart.com/ip/Jumbo-Helium-Balloon-Tank-Kit-14-9-cu-ft-Includes-50-Balloons-Ribbon/534063865?fulfillmentIntent=Pickup

I tried this out the other night actually. I had a tank and was on my mania flight and had no interest in suicide, like 2 weeks ago. So I opened it and let the coolness rush out. I put a hose on the tank and held the hose up to my nose and breathed. It really was just cool very clean air. I knew this was dangerous so that if I lost conscienceness I would fall and the hose would move away from my nose. I breathed and breathed and everything was beautiful. No feelings other that 'this is pretty cool' and I think I said some funny things in helium voice.

I could tell the pressure of the gas was reducing so I decided to stop the experiment as I'd soon run out anyway, so I tried to move. It was not that I couldn't move, it was that I didn't want to. I just wanted to stay kneeling at the end of my bed, my head on the end and just keep my eyes closed. I knew I was neither here nor there. I wondered if I was just being dramatic and that at any moment I could just stand up and resume whatever. I just wanted to stay exactly where I was. And I was fine with that. My brain was starved of oxygen, a good 3 minutes - not damaging but certainly extreme. I sat there for longer than what I had inhaling helium. I started to move my fingers for the first time, I'm sure I always could have, if I'd wanted to. It was actually very difficult getting up from the kneeling position into the upright position, which is when I wondered if my room was full of helium and just being in the room was depraving me of oxygen?

All I have to do it put on some music and lay back

Go to Walmart and buy a Helium Tank for making balloons. I will actually be purchasing 4 just to make sure I don't run out.
