item.title: Myka
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Hello Myka,

I just realized I don't know what to say to you. We don't really have much of a connection between us. And that is really my fault and my point.

I first wanted to write Arlen but I'd never want her to read this. I can't tell her what I have to say. I hurt so bad and I feel it's about to get much worse. I'm not well.

I've been thinking of suicide all day today. I've thought about it for so long it is very a comfortable fantasy for me. In that fantasy I can escape and be completely free. I fear no afterlife. I welcome it.

Arlen is my only hesitancy. I could find the strength to live to be with her. If only for the little time I get to see her. She deserves to have me in her life. She would be a better person to have me in her life.

But the true is, I probably won't be in her life much at all anyway. I've already been banned from your house for over a month. When Aster was a baby I got banned for a year? Over cat shit.

Then I realize I've thought the same thing about Mikey. I kept going to try to be a part of his life someday. I am not part of his life.

Then I realized I've thought the same thing about you and Chloe. It was very hard losing you two and the next several years were hell for everybody (thank you Martha).

Then I realized I've thought the same things about Natasha. Natasha is moving to Florida and hasn't responded to a text from me in weeks. We really have not talked in months. I think we have had three phone conversations in the past year. She is happy and living the life of a little kid. She has too much other stuff in her head to ever think about me. I realize that. I'm ok with it. I still love her.

Will I be a part of Arlens life? I doubt it. It is my loss. I think it would be better I leave now because I know there is a mess in my future. I want it to end now. I tried my best and everything is a mess.

I don't have anything beautiful to say to you Myka. I'm sorry. I just don't want to hurt your kids and they are still too young to remember me.

It really hurts me I can't talk to you.

item.title: Digital Democracy App
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
An App/SPA such that a user may submit influence to their local and federal Representatives and Congress People via email direct to the respective office. Users will be notified of current legislation such as bills being voted on in addition to current social topics.

Emails will be form letters either for or against a particular topic and digitally signed with users registered information. Only a single email per topic will be allowed and enforced via userId and deviceId.

The goal of this App is such that I may find the "Missouri Bill for the Recreational Use" and support it by sending an email to my legislative people as easy as clicking a button.

Representatives of legislation (both for and agains) may register for approval of email form letter content.

Groups supporting legislation (both for and against) may register for review of email form letter content.

item.title: I love writing code
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
It is such a challenge, I love reading code too, especially other's code. I like going through an interesting git repository and seeing the progression of the project. Looking at bug fixes. Code styles, commit messages, trying to understand a complex algorithm and once doing so realizing I've understood completely and in absolute terms the authors idea for implementation.

A novelist will paint a picture in the mind of the reader using words. A dev uses code to write out their exact thoughts on how to solve a problem. An algorithm. The code being the implementation of that dev's version of the algorithm.

Understanding somebody else's thoughts in such a way is awesome.

I wish I had some of my old code. I would love to look though my C++ code I wrote for Vyvx in 2000. I've started thinking back and I wish I could read the code I wrote when I was 10 in BASIC on my Timex Sinclair 1000. I wrote a lot, I even tried to write a fighter plane simulator game, which my stepdad said I would not be able to. :-)

I did write it and it did work. I simply created a multidimensional array of ASCII characters to represent the attacking plane and another to represent the players cross hairs. I created For loops to move the cursor and print(fighter[x,y]) depending on the plane's location. It was the best I could do with an asshole stepdad that has absolutely ability to help me explore the technology before my finger tips. I was brilliant. I was absolutely brilliant. I am still brilliant.

I still have my mind and my mind still has my body. My mind is strong. My body is starting to show signs of aging. I'm skinny (195). On HRT (2 months).

I have tonight. I have right now. I have love in my heart. My mind is at peace. My spirt is growing.

My transition has started. I think I've been 3 months on HRT now. [insert dosages]

I love my daughters so much. Myka and Chloe accept me, love me, and embrace who I am. I love you both so much.

I've been crying a lot lately. I'd like to think it's the estrogen unlocking my emotions but it's probably just the decades of pain I have buried in my heart bubbling out like a pinprick of air from a bicycle tire submerged in water. I have hurt my body, my heart is not well. I've known this for a while now. Both my shoulders need surgery. I was exposed to raw sewage while in Meridian Rehab in Indiana, had a staff infection cut out of my thigh, and now apparently cary MERSA. My last moto accident tore up my legs which took months to heal.

But I've also just recently started even caring about myself. My body has been so good to me, I feel bad the hell I've put it through. It has done very well keeping me alive. My skull is thick and my bones strong. My face scared but beautiful compared to the many times it could have been an asphalt smear.

I wrote a lot to Steve, maybe I'll paste that in here. Another blog post of what I write to my Probation Officer.

I wanted to talk to Jeffery but she's asleep bless her heart. I also texted Whit but it's late now in Cali and I know she is exhausted in every way possible. I worry a lot about her. She is a Rock Star, but even rock stars wear down.

One last tear is rolling down my cheek. It is nice, I feel ok, it's the last one tonight.

item.title: Dying alone
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I am alone and dying inside. I've hit a wall and I know I can't go through it. I'm not capable.

My two friends are busy and this is not something I want to talk to them about. There is little to talk about.

It is not that I've made the decision to die, I want to keep going, but I've come to the realization that is not going to happen.

In 30 days I'm faced with either prison or house arrest. The problem with house arrest is that Missouri does not do house arrest. Even if Missouri did do house arrest, I don't have the $3000 to pay the court costs to start the process.

That leaves the most likely outcome being house arrest in Indianapolis. The problem with this is that I very strongly doubt I (alone) will be able to complete the required 3 years of stable residency, employment, and continued recovery leaving me revoked into prison.

The constant anguish I feel now having realized all of this is terrible. I both want to talk about and obviously do not. I don't have anybody to talk to about it anyway. It would be a terrible conversation for the receiver and what's the point? I'm not going to tell them I am seeking death.

I have in the past talked to both Jeffery and Whitney about my depression and at times my suicidal intentions. I feel terrible for putting them in those situations. This is not my depression, this is death. I will no give them any reason to think they could have stopped this.

It's time to go silent. If I continue to involve people in my life, when I die they may feel they could have done something. But they can't! This is not a decision I've made! This is a situation I have put myself in having made a lifetime of bad decisions.

I don't want this! I'm not depressed. I'm terrified facing the inevitable. I've been fine up until today. Today I started thinking things through for the first time in a while and things don't look good for me.

I fear in 30 days the pain and anguish will be too great for me to keep going. I am not going to be OK.

So I asked myself "how do you want to spend your last 30 days here?". I was in terrible pain when that thought went through my mind. The thought lingered as the hurt lessened and it brought me here to write.

I want to be as nice as possible to everybody I can and show the world all the love I have left to give. I am sorry for what this will do to those that love me so I'll try to leave a few good memories of my time with them.

I will fail at being nice and showing love. I already have. I ate with mom just now and was an ass.

I'll end this by saying that I don't want to be here anymore.

item.title: Peace of Mind
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I remember the anguish and despair I was in when writing 'Dying Alone'. It truly was terrible and has now passed. I am glad for that. It is not easy to realize your life is coming to an end. I'm also glad that now, revisiting that post, I can read it and have peace of mind. I'm no longer torn regarding the future. It is very clear to me now. Nothing has changed, in fact the future is even more certain.

I will not be signing the plea deal as I had previously intended. I am incapable of 3 years house arrest alone in Indiana. I did not commit the crimes which I am accused. I will be going to a rushed trial with a Public Defender. I will see if a jury agrees with me or the prosecution. If they find me guilty, once in custody I will commit suicide in county jail.

I don't actually plan to win the trial. But at least a trial is a turning point, not this plea bargain bull that puts me on a hook I'm unlikely to escape.

If found not guilty, I still have a mysteriously unsurfaced DUI in Greene County, which if surfaced I will go to prison for and serve as I was guilty of DUI. I will be fine to serve the sentence and emerge and live the rest of my life as best I can.

But I've had about enough of this Kidnapping bullshit.

item.title: Trial
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've made the decision to take this kidnapping case to trial. I'm done playing games with the prosecution. I did not kidnap Melissa. Yes I hurt her terribly in ways I will never know or understand, but calling that hurt 'kidnapping' is far from the truth. If Melissa is willing to be used by the prosecution to convict me of this ridiculous charge, she must also be willing to live with it the rest of her life.

Melissa will appear for a deposition and she will be called to testify against me. She will be the person responsible for pointing a finger at me and accusing me of having kidnapped her. If the prosecution does not ask her to point at her kidnapper, my defense will. She will be forced to point at me in the court room.

I don't actually expect to win at trial. My paid attorney told me I will not win a trial. I am fine with a loss because win or lose I will have my closure to the pain I've been suffering myself. My pain will end my first night incarcerated.

Melissa has an easy out of all of this as she has brain damage caused from active tumor growth and brain surgery. Medical incompetency reasons alone may be used to exclude her from the witness stand. If she wanted to not play the prosecution's game she has that ability and can do so without risk of 'refusal to testify' repercussions.

Melissa will be the person who sends me to prison and I am not the one putting her in this position. The prosecution is putting charges against me and using her as a witness. The prosecution will put her on the stand first, not the defense. In fact, I don't have any defense at all and refuse to play this courtroom game. She testifies for the prosecution, I get convicted.

I will of course have all sorts of things subpoenaed, like her txt messages in which she admitted having Andrew selling her prescription drugs before he died and other messages asking me to sell her prescription drugs. The sale of perscriptionn drugs is a fellony, and having done so excludes a person from ever receiving narcotic perscrip0ti8olns again,. Oops Melissa, seems ur dark deeds may catch \up to you also.

I don't want Melissa to go through this but I have no choice. I wanted to accept a deal avoiding a trial that will hurt Melissa much worse than the 'kidnapping' itself, but I cannot do that. I will not admit I kidnapped anybody to spare Melissa further pain.

If the prosecution really wants my balls they will have to use Melissa to get them. If Melissa testifies my life is ended. So be it.

item.title: 12-Step Live! Reviews
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
12-Step Live is doing well. It is helping people find recovery online. The proof is in the store reviews. My work is now paying off for others. Not so much for me though.

Recovery is no longer my most pressing issue. In fact, I seem to have the ability to use and walk away from it. Is very strange to me that at the end of things the thing that caused me the most problems in my life no longer has dominance over me. Many times this past year have I picked up and walked away from it. Right now is one of those times. I have 2 days clean.

I feel no need to focus on my recovery because I don't have much time left. What good is recovery going to do me when I'm gone? Why should I even use my own app when there is something so much darker looming over my mind then some ridiculously insignificant issue such as addiction? Being in recovery is not going to fix the real problems I'm facing.

The problems I'm facing are prison and suicide. Those two things are what I know are in my future this year.

I'm not contemplating using or have any desire to do so. I need some time to face the real world and make some necessary decisions without the confusing pleasure of use.

I am so sad now. It has been brewing for a very long time. It is impossible for me to find happiness as my life now has an expiration date. I've spent the past two days in a terrible depression, throwing away two friends and my loving cousin Danielle. I can feel Jeffery is done with me and rightfully so. I was a terrible friend to him. I know he is already waiting for the inevitable phone call from my mother with the news.

I have to find the strength to keep moving forward. I need to be in Indiana at the end. I don't want my body returned to my family. They will not get my ashes because I don't want them to have the expense.

The first thought of going on the run once this bond is resolved just passed through my mind. How odd I've never considered doing so before.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I am becoming more and more excited about my future.

I am starting to visualize surviving 3 years in Indy. It was that first glimpse that prompted me to start writing these ideas out. I believe Mikki can

item.title: Blog Post 80
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I haven't written in a long time. I don't feel so much like writing as I feel like spewing out an endless and pointless rant about whatever comes to mind.

I disappointed myself today. Steve came over for the first time in forever and I managed to show my distain for pretty much everything he says. He questioned why infants even need formula they should be given Cow's milk and if allergic Goat's milk. I'm sorry, I was trying to have an intelligent conversation about Steve's "Greatest [Fucking] Country in the Universe"'s infant formula shortage. I simply refuse to digress and think along those lines of thought.

In reflection to that last statement, which was targeted toward digressing against, I've instead decided to digress in favor of, just for fun. But first I'll elaborate on this statements previous statement and reflect on my reflection.

If I chose to just move on I would be at fault. I would be at fault of not looking at a foreign idea simply because my initial reaction was that it is a ridiculous idea. Maybe it isn't, maybe it is. Who's gut is mine to make that decision?

There is no problem a new regulation can't fix, except...of course...too many regulations.

I should be writing about things I need to write about. Not the above rediculousness.

I shared tonight on the Global Love Bus [zoom id]. I cried. I left my camera on, as Hallejaula Heather does when she cries. I hope others can see my pain and know they are not alone in the same or more pain as I was feeling. I also accepted a Just For Today white NA key tag still a wreck. And was finally asked to read the pink card.

Reading the pink card was difficult. I knew the part about the bitter ends.....jails, institutions, and death was going to break my heart and I froze. It hurt so bad to just know I was going to have to read my future out loud to my NA family, I was ashamed, terrified,

I think they are tired of me showing up every few months with the same sob story, different actors,

I'm not a writer. This blog post is descriptively named Blog Post 80 to acknolwledge the fact Mikki's Mess has 79 unpublished drafts. One or two I have published to allow friends or a sponsor access to read but put back away privately as a draft.

I should write like nobody is ever going to read this, including myself. Nobody ever will #80 will be a draft also. Forever. I'm sure Mikki's Mess will exist in another thousand years. Maybe I should put some time into properly writing a few articles or letters. Keep the rants as drafts.

My original point in writing tonight (not the above start to this blog) the original thoughts were to document what happened tonight after the Global Love Bus NA meeting.

Being a trans person is difficult. Being me is difficult. Being anybody around me is difficult. There is nothing about me that is not difficult. Even typing with my nails on is difficult, although I must say I've gotten rather good at it :-).

I'm going on the run. I will be a real Outlaw. I must from now on exist outside the possibility of any contact with the law. This is my definition of outlaw, making me an Outlaw.

I'm terrified. I'm also heartbroken that I will forever be an Outlaw. I am disappointed in myself. I take full responsibility for all the decisions and actions that has put my life in this situation.

I'm glad I'm terrified. It means terror will at least initially guide me the next few months. The day I'm comfortable with being an Outlaw is the day I might come face to face with the law.

item.title: Why I Have THC In My Life
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I have abused all drugs in my lifetime save one, THC. In fact, through most of my drug use years, I seldom had any weed. It probably would have helped me considerably back then, maybe helping me see my reality for what it was, and I may not have fallen so hard each time.

Weed was an early start to my drug career. Previously I had abused inhalants as a teenager, but I wont go back there. My best friend, Andy, whom I'm sure I was in love with, was an avid light weed smoker, the year was 1988 in Republic, MO pop. 7,000. At that point in my life I was avidly against any drug use. I was All American.

Andy and his girlfriend Karen would smoke and I wouldn't mind. I didn't smoke cigarettes then yet either. Karen would occasionally try to get me to take a drag off a joint. I politely refused. One winter storm, in Andys 70's chevy van, he, Karen and I were going to the driving course to illegally ride the slopes in sleds. Andy and Karen were up front smoking a joint, we had all probably knocked back a 1/2 pint each of whisky, and Karen started the peer pressure. When Andy said something encouraging the use I used.

I don't think much happened, whatever did happen was probably mashed out of my reality by another 1/2 pint. I didn't use very often, eventually buying my own bag, mostly to smoke with my gf and sex. All drugs make me randy.

I took my habit back to San Diego after graduating HS and used weekly. It was more of a social drug, something you used to talk, or relax, or sleep and dream beautiful young dreams. Never was it something to just keep smoking with no chance of getting any higher, never abused, craved, or used compulsively. It was something my boss and I at lunch would smoke on the beach, before I gave oral sex in the parking lot.

Once meth hit the scene my use of THC ended. The year was 1992. I didn't pick back up THC until 2016. I was a very active alcoholic and a friend offered the new thc vape pens, to which I immediately started actively using as it gave me relief from the stress of life. Another thing it did was it opened my eyes to the reality of the disaster of my marriage and life.

I believe at that point my wife was all but done with living with an alcoholic. I was a great father and husband but the love was lost in our relationship. I've written another blog post about this I may share. Instead of focusing on fixing the marriage, my addictive thinking led me to focus on myself and getting out of what could never continue as a functioning family.

I continued to use THC for another year, while continuing to drink alcohol. I was now a single globe hopping Playboy and I ended up in Buenos Aires with a gold metal winning, Cirque du Sole star and trans girl named Crissi. Alcohol destroyed that relationship within a few months. We were very active alcoholics.

After returning to USA I became very depressed and drown myself in alcohol, attempting suicide routinely on my motorcycle until I finally crashed and amazingly walked away from (as to not get another DUI). The strangest thing happened on walking home from that crash.

A older pimped out black man rolls up in an immaculate Cadillac and throws open the door insisting I let him give me a ride home. The leather was perfect pure white and I didn't feel comfortable getting blood all over his car. The man INSISTED, and upon getting in he said "Hi, my name is China White".

We discussed heroin and crack and THC and he had never seen Colorado honey so I gave him a $50 jar once I got home. I never got his number and that was the end of that encounter.

I was shredded, my left shoulder fucked up and the bicep torn. My legs had 3rd degree road rash burns all over them as I was wearing shorts, no helmet, and flip flops. This is when my crack habit began in earnest. It eased the pain (and slowed the healing process). This is also when the use of THC immediately stopped. I gave away all I had left and never got more from Colorado and still haven't since. Is a very strange thing to me that I gave away all I had left, no addict ever does that - if they are addicted to that substance.

item.title: Lovie
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I love you so much and you aren’t supposed to do this alone…in fact we can’t do this alone that’s how we learn to surrender to the program. Seriously call or text me like as much as you need to. Go to meetings and share about fear of self sabotage and success because we don’t just have a fear of failure we are afraid of success that’s why we self sabotage

Lovie I was thinking about a lot of stuff.  Mostly dreams about treating people well.  Good stuff.  Lots of business stuff ending with a company name Butterfly Software, Inc and I was thinking about the metamorphosis processed and realized I’ve built my cocoon and it’s time to go to sleep or as NA would call surrender.  It was planting the surrender seed in ur prev txt that led my mind there ultimately.  Thank you for being my sponsor and planting seeds in my mind.  I Truely Love You.  

Thinking more I am very encouraged to surrender get my much needed brainwashing and emerge in recovery as a spectacular new person!

Now finally, the exciting part!  I realized I get to choose the person I will become!  I chose in recovery, loving, king, beautiful, smart, sweet, dumb, honest, understanding, encouraging, articulate, funny, charismatic, and a teacher!  That’s when I realized I want to be just like YOU!!!!!

So you’ll note I started this txt with Lovie, …. you being the only person I've ever heard say that word.  I consider it the first word my new recovered self said.  I think I’m just gonna call you Love 😊

Baby steps one day at a time.

❤️ ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ ❤️

item.title: Ghandi & Mandela
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I have a question I really don’t want myself to answer……If we are such spiritual beings, why are we not so much spiritual creatures now?  If our spirits will exist beyond our bodies, why don’t the spirits have more effect on humans?  If we actually have spirits in our bodies, I would think the spiritual energy would dominate the body (existing within it) and our spiritual sides would flourish like gardens in spring.  I don’t want to believe we don’t really have spirits anymore, but that’s the direction I’m going.  :0(

If this 4th dimensional spirit traveler of both time and space is so powerful, why is it something I have to nurture and grow?

I’ve came to my conclusion…. It’s because I’m a spiritual infant in a 50 year old human body.  I have to raise my spirit to adulthood and treat it right now like the baby that I am.

I just realized what we think are Aliens really are….No, I’m not drunk or using, seriously! 

If Ghandi was such a powerful spirit, why don’t we feel more of his spiritual presence now?  Well, I guess even I can still feel the love of Ghandi, so that’s a stupid question…… 

What about Mandela?  Yes I easily feel him.  I bet if I went to South Africa I could really feel him.  So the question becomes….if there were No people in South Africa - not even me - would the spirit still exist there?  I would say yes.  Now what if the Earth no longer existed, would the spirit still exist.  I would say no, unless SA had been visited for the sole purpose of taking back a piece of that spirit so it could flourish elsewhere in the Universe.

But my perception of what a spirit is is seriously flawed, or ignorant at this point.  I think a spirit is the feeling you get from knowing something.  I feel spiritual connections through conscience of thoughts, thoughts being knowledge.  For example the knowledge of the Torus Technique, yes as it says it is not the only technique, but to use any other different technique would still require its knowledge.  Therefore spirits may be preserved in media, even digitally.  I guess in my reality, what I just wrote to you, is a part of my spirit.  I really like that!

P.S. You should drink the water you cook vegetables in, that’s were all the vitamins and nutrients go. Open a can of vegetables and the first thing to do is drink the water.

item.title: It's Not Going to Happen
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've started reading the NA Basic Text. I really want a spiritual awakening to happen for me as I see it has happened for so many others. It's not going to happen for me.

I understand what should happen. I spent my childhood in Christian church hearing about and waiting some day for that weird fucking thing that happens to Christians when the flip out for Jesus and start believing fantasy. That never happened for me. Amazingly, I brought my best friend to church and it happened for him. But for me, nada.

Well, now I'm reading the NA book and I know what *should* happen, but it's not going to happen. FUCK I wish it would! I just wish I could buy all this shit hook line and sinker, fall into the NA spirituality trance, let my that others have the luxury of having.

Maybe it takes hard work. So I'm doing my best to read the NA book, but it's like reading the Bible, which I've done many times cover to cover, version after version. The NA book is somewhat excruciating to read and rather redundant.

item.title: Hope
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My only hope for life is a program called NA. It is the only thing that will keep me clean. I definitely can not keep myself clean. If I could use right now, I would. I know I would. I'm an addict. I'm completely powerless over drugs.

Where am I in my addiction? At every meeting there is always a moment of silence for the 'still suffering'. I'm one of the still suffering. Having tried over the past year to quit drugs has left me suffering terribly. Every day is a struggle. Every day is empty and hollow. I feel there is nothing here for me, even when I'm clean. Especially when I'm clean.

If I used right now, I would instantly feel happiness, hope, excitement and all the other wonderful feelings using brings me. I don't speak for other addicts. I don't know what others experience in their use. In my use, I experience a wonderful....errr, well, the first few minutes after using are wonderful, true. But after a bit of time, hours usually, what takes over in me is the desire to use more. And then off I go into a cycle of seeking, using, seeking, using.

Eventually I have to stop for any number of reasons, usually because I've run out of money and desperately need sleep. Then I will wake up into an absolute hell. It won't seem all that bad at first because I'll still be exhausted and able to simply fall back into a deep sleep. But eventually I won't be able to sleep anymore and will exist in that hell. It will be horrible, terrible, suicidal, and I know, I truly know, that I will not survive it. No, I'll survive it, I will just wish I had not.

It makes me cry just thinking about it, well not so much cry as feel a terrible sorrow deep in my soul. Wanting something so much that will leave me worse than I am right now. I think to myself the immediate joy will be worth it. Without dwelling on the reality of suicide and the fact I know now I can never do that to my family, I simply fantasize suicide as the end to my next use, a way to escape the hell it will bring. Right now, it is a dream, a wonderful dream to be able to use and then avoid the consequences.

Warren spoke last night and said he wanted to live forever. That is such an alien thought to me. I simply can not wrap my brain around such a thing. I have never in my life wanted to live even for the moment, let alone forever. I gave up on the idea of an afterlife long ago once my human brain fully developed and I realized what religion teaches is absolute fantasy. The only living forever is life through spirituality, a person leaves behind a part of their spirit others can feel. Ghandi is felt world wide, Mandela is certainly felt in South Africa. Those are examples of a spirit outliving a persons body. But even those examples fade over time and diminish their effects on others.

I write to get things out I guess. The emotions that caused me to start writing this are gone now, so the purpose has been served. What's left are these words which I almost always hide from others, even though I really wish to be read and understood.

item.title: Crisis
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded: I'm experiencing a crisis in my life. I very deep one, an identity crisis. I simply don't know who I am anymore. I don't want to know who I am, because I know that person right now is a terrible wretch. I've become an outcast, I exist in the fringe of society. I hang on to life via NA.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I don't know what to write about. I want somebody to talk to. Somebody who listens and actually engages in conversation. This is not most of my NA friends. I love Kat and I need her. Paul helps me a lot. But I'm tired of the so called 'NA love'...I love you, you make me so happy, so good to see you....all those phrases get passed around like candy, but there is very little meat in my conversations with others.

This is my fault. It's in the 'meeting after the meeting' where people connect and communicate. Meetings are just there to splat out whatever and to receive the placating support of other NA members. I've stayed after meetings but never seem to be able to engage in conversation with others. It's my fault.

I really hate writing. I write what I want to get out, but then it's on paper. It does not go away, it simply spreads from my mind to paper. I want all this gone.

I fantasize death so much. I've probably thought of my death today at least 5 times already, it's late afternoon. I have hours to go before my NA meeting and I'm bored. Ugh work.....

I could work, I want to work, but I need an Android device to test a desperately needed release before I release it. Not testing releases is what crippled my app and disrupted my users use. I feel terrible over it, worthless, like I don't know what I'm doing. I really don't, I've never in my career released any software. I write it, but have never written a complete app, until now.

It really tears at my heart that I've written a recovery app and nobody I know in recovery really has any interest in it. Nada, nothing. I tell people about it but they never install and run it. Or maybe they do once and tell me it's awesome then they forget it.

I have uses that love the app and love my work. That is encouraging, but I'm left with the feeling of 'fuck everybody else in recovery'. Just because nobody has any interest in my app does not give me the right to hate them. I need to calm down, tomorrow I should get my android device and I can continue developing.

I have a lot of work to do, things are a bit of a mess with the app. Things look half assed. I'm not being hard on myself, it's the truth.

I just thought of drinking poison to kill myself. After having lost Gabby to mental illness and her suicide I realized I could never do that to my family. I felt the pain from the other side and it was terrible. It sill is, it lingers on. I think of Gabby almost every day, it's lessening now that I'm away from the Mission. I am jealous of her, she has peace, I have none. I'm not mad at her for what she did, not mad at her for the pain she caused me because I know the pain I felt at first, as terrible as it was, was far less than the pain she felt before she died. Well, I don't know that, she could have been lost in some world of comet jumping or such nonsense in her mind as the reason for her suicide. I assume it was pain only because my fantasized suicide will be because of pain.

I keep returning to suicide. My suicide. It's not a fantasy, it's a dream. My death is a dream to me. Weather natural or not, it's something I want. I will the rest of my life carry a terrible burden, something NA can not remove from me without a terrible price to pay. I dream of laying in my death bed thinking to myself "I escaped my burden, I survived till death".

I wonder if I can escape. I worry every day of being caught. I never feel safe. I both love and hate hiding in my little hole. It's not safe in my current hole. I dream of the day when I'm far far away and as safe as I possibly can be. I see myself living alone and being lonely. Still being sad but being secure in my safe future. That is my dream. To live alone, clean. Doing what I don't know. Certainly not writing code. I'm so done with developing software yet I have my biggest challenge still ahead of me. The complete rewrite of my app.

item.title: My Hole
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This is my life. I live in a hole. My hole is currently an RV in my mothers backyard. I've destroyed my once beautiful life, I've destroyed my family, I've destroyed my career, and I've destroyed my freedom. I'm an outcast, an outlaw, living on the very fringe of society. I can't work, I can't rent, and I'm garnished beyond livability. I'm scared to come out of my hole as a very terrible future awaits me outside my hole if I'm caught.

It takes strength to live this life, a strength that sometimes falters deep inside me. I push the panic back down inside where it sleeps.

item.title: Who am I?
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
'The day I made the decision in my heart to stop using drugs I changed. I didn't feel it immediately, my identity crisis started shortly afterward. What did happen immediately was the complete loss of the desire to use. Later that very day I had in my possession meth, which I tucked away never having the intention to use, planning instead to give it away to some other addict. The next day the kind and beautiful soul who give me the meth was in need to which I surprised him with his own gift. Thinking of him now makes my heart hurt and my eyes cry. His name is Katana and I cared very much for him, and I told him so. He is a lost soul plagued with mental illness and addiction. I also gifted him my broken down tent besides the railroad tracks and then left, never to see him again. It is still breaking my heart.

Three times I was faced with using in my last three days as a lost soul. Three times I easily turned it down. I knew in my heart that those days are behind me. In the days leading up to my decision to quit I was faced with the worst kind of being alone. Completely alone, helpless, freezing, and in terrified fear of being caught by the police. I was a lost soul and it terrified me. My only friend was Katana.

Returning one final day to the homeless shelter I reached out to my mother asking to come home for the winter. I was desperate and she could tell. An hour later she texted me to buy a bus ticket offering her RV as a refuge for the winter. I quickly fled the state of Colorado leaving behind everything except one suitcase stored safely by Jeffery and one backpack. My backpack contained something very precious to me, all my nail polish, tips, files, etc. I had quite the collection for a homeless person, which I was very proud of. I used to say "Everybody homeless has there crazy, mine is doing my nails" and I would spend hours doing mine or any homeless girl who wanted a manicure. I lost the backpack on the Greyhound return trip.

When I came to Colorado I packed two suitcases stuffed full of everything I held precious. One was critical, mostly things I needed or thought I'd need, makeup, razors, etc. The other had every beautiful piece of clothing I owned. All my good stuff, from when I was a rather rich bitch. My dumb ass lost the suitcase of clothing on the Greyhound. Oh and my wallet was stolen by a passenger on the bus. The other suitcase I left at Jeffery's house. Unfortunately a few weeks after my arrival, Jeffery (my best friend for 15 years) and I got into a terrible argument and I never saw or heard from him until my last day in Colorado Springs, when I walked miles uphill to his house to retrieve my lonely suitcase.

Funny story, when I arrived I didn't know what to expect but I felt it would be a quick engagement as the last text I received from him instructed me to call him first and he would leave it on the street. While I was homeless I was robbed of my iPhone and tablet so I was left with knocking on his front door. He welcomed me in with loving arms, to which I had no clue how to react. I was uncomfortable for a while until I realized there was no need as it might very well be the last time I see him in my life. It didn't break my heart or ruffle my heart in any way to say our goodbyes.

Here I am now, living in a tiny RV, after 2 or 3 weeks, it's hard to tell; I've long since lost the ability to judge time in any manner. Maybe I'm losing my mind, or just pieces of it. I've changed now and I know it. I've completely let myself go, terribly. I'm worse than when I was homeless. I've lost all my clothes, not that I have any desire to wear my clothes here at moms house, relying now on sweat pants and t-shirts. I haven't shaved my body in a month, something I at least did weekly at the homeless shelter. I shave my face once a week. My eyebrows are a complete disaster. Makeup not at all.

I look terrible but even worse I feel terrible. But I don't feel terrible because I've let myself go. I've let myself go because I feel terrible, or more specifically, I feel like I've lost the part of me that I loved. I don't know who I am anymore.

And to think, I though coming home would be a dream come true. But it's not, because I'm no longer that person that I still hung on to, the beautiful person inside me who I loved dearly. The person I loved being, the person I loved when I was high. That is my problem. I don't hate that person. I love that person more than I love life.

Sure, drugs are bad, they destroyed my life, and I've come to the realization I will never use again. I've also come to realize I will never be that person again. She is gone and I'm left with a husk of an aging male body, hairy and wrinkly. It's a terrible feeling. It's a feeling I have very little interest in living with, but no interest in ending, I've come to that decision too.

When my best friend Gabby went down the dark hole of mental illness and killed herself it crushed me. It is still very painful. She was 27 I think, beautiful, wise, articulate, powerful, and very mentally ill. I knew her my first few weeks at the homeless shelter. Then she drifted off alone. I saw her once before she died, she was on the edge, I knew it, I felt it, so I took pictures of her when she wasn't looking knowing in my mind that they may very well be the last pictures of her. It broke my heart when I learned a week later she committed suicide. I knew and there was nothing I could do to help her. She was not even a drug addict. She was completely clean.

So I put away my suicidal ideations for good, thoughts that had been with me since childhood. I know now I could never cause that pain in the hearts of my loved ones.

Wow, I've lost the most personal things I have held the longest, dearest and most precious in my life. No more dreaming of suicide to curb the pain in my heart, no more having that escape route, no more fantasizing of the most beautiful ways to end my life. No more drugs as a way to escape my life without killing myself, going into a bliss where I'm happy and free and confident to live how I want to live. No more beauty, no more being the person deep inside me that I love so much, she is gone too. I'm left with only the wreckage of my past.

My life is a disaster. I am a wanted person facing 9 years in prison the day a police officer asks me for my ID - for whatever reason. I didn't even j-walk when I was homeless, always standing patiently at the crosswalks thinking "waiting 60 seconds here is better than waiting 9 years in prison". I will never drive a car - my mother offered me her car today and I turned it down, instead relying on her to drive me to my daughter's house and my daughter the return trip. I will never work a job again having a terrible criminal background, open only to the most labor intensive jobs which my body can not endure. Regardless my inability to obtain a job or work unskilled labor, my child support garnishment is $1600/month so any job I get will be garnished to nothing. I could apply for Social Security Disability on account of my mental history, but that is subject to garnishment also.

I have nothing, I am nothing, I will be nothing. I've lost what little joy I had in using and I've lost the person I loved being when using. I am a lost soul, not really much different than Katana. I know now why it broke my heart to leave him.

On a side note, I'm dreaming of ways to off myself without it looking like I did it - a slightly new twist on the fantasy. I just realized I lost an excellent opportunity. When I was a child I almost died of hypothermia. I remember it was not bad at all, I felt just fine - warm and kinda cozy, but I was near death. But I know in my mind I could easily have stayed out in the cold with the warm cozy sleepy feelings letting me close my eyes one last time. I have experienced that and it was cold at first but then, not bad.

If I had stayed in Colorado, facing the elements alone, I know I could endure the 30 minutes of being freezing cold only to succumb to the sleepy warm and cozy feelings hypothermia brings. I have once read that victims of hypothermia are often found with their coats gloves and hats off as they no longer need them at the end.

I should have stayed homeless in Colorado Springs, CO and been an accidental death from exposure as there are many there every winter.

item.title: Lonely
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I love my NA home group The Yellow Submarine. I worry though, that it may someday go away, like The Global Love Bus did. I never got an explanation for that.

I'm lonely, very lonely. I kinda miss being homeless, then I had friends. People who would reach out to me every day. Real life people, not the virtual people I experience these days. I have my NA family and they do reach out to me, but it's not quite the same.

The difference is my NA family have their lives outside NA. So during the NA meeting I'm quite happy. I guess without going on and on here, wasting my time, I'll just come out and say it; I need to find other NA meetings where I feel like family. I immediately see a problem with that.

Yes, the Newcomer is always the most important in the room, virtual or otherwise. But it does not feel like that is the case. I don't hide, but I also don't talk. I've resigned to not sharing much these days, mostly because I've little recovery to share and shares should be recovery focused. I don't have the brainwashing of rolled up and perfectly packaged cliches to revolve my share around. Yes, I hear them so much in a lot of peoples random shares where they just start talking and throw in a NA catch phrase and start talking about that in their lives until another cliche hits them with their next ammunition for discussion. It gets old and I'm definitely not one of those share types.

But I'm not criticizing, those people that share as such are sharing for themselves and if it helps them in their recovery, I'm totally cool with it and I still listen. I learned today that instead of focusing on what somebody else is doing wrong or that I don't like, I need to focus on my reaction to it and own that.

But back to my main point, I need to expand my NA family. Basically stated, I wish I had a person to talk to right now. Ok, I just texted "hello" to the two people I text with on a daily basis. Our texts are usually me receiving a recovery meme which I read and tapback with love, or the "I love you" messages, but there is no meat to our conversations....actually there are no conversations at all.

I got a response asking if I'm ok. I replied yes, but immediately feel like

item.title: To My Family
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
If you are reading this I’m in prison and will be for a very long time. I don’t know what to say besides how ashamed I am of myself and how much I love you. Through the abuse of drugs and alcohol I have found myself in an unescapable punishment that I fear will punish many more than just myself. I am so sorry I’ve brought this pain on you.

I’ve been living the past two years on the fringe of society waiting for the inevitable and hoping there would be escape. This time I was unable to escape. I did have choices that I made recently that I still do not regret, I know in my heart I made the right choice.

In lieu of a prison sentence I was offered a three year house arrest sentence in Indianapolis. This offer came in the beginning of 2022. During the year of 2022 I worked six different jobs failing at all of them. During this time I actively worked an NA program but was unsuccessful in truly starting a life of recovery. I did not lose any of my jobs due to a relapse, I lost those six jobs because I’ve found myself incapable of working a ‘regular’ job. I did relapse about every four weeks, mostly on alcohol or meth. My relapses were short and I would immediately rebound back to NA. In short, my life was a complete disaster the first half of 2022 as I was still in the grip of a life long addiction.

I realized I would never ever be able to return to Indianapolis and live a clean life with stable employment for three years of house arrest. I would find myself starting in homeless shelters, jumping from job to job, eventually trying to maintain residency in a halfway house, with the inevitable relapse always hanging over my head. I viewed my chances of completing the house arrest to be near impossible. But what really weighed on my heart was knowing that in my desperation, depression, and a lack of any sort of support in Indy, I would find myself very close to suicide, most likely always. I reasoned I would either fail and end up running from the law or dead, so I chose the former.

I left town and went to the Springs Rescue Mission in Colorado Springs, a place I have lived before. There I continued my NA program with a sponsor and remained relatively stable and safe. I admit my use continued there as being homeless comes with many challenges, one of those is being completely surrounded by drugs, alcohol and addicts. Eventually I was found with THC at the mission and kicked out for seven days. During that time living on the streets and by railroad tracks, my heart was laid waste and I made the decision to never use or drink again. Winter came in Colorado and I returned to Missouri.

I have been living completely clean, without even the desire to use or drink for about 6 weeks now. I still attend my NA meetings and work with my sponsor. Unfortunately my past is still haunting me as new arrest warrants have been issued for me. I fear now that at any time the police will be here to take me to prison.

I decided to write this letter in the case I am apprehended. Essentially I want to say how much I love my family and I acknowledge how much I have hurt you. I never imagined anything like this would ever happen to me.

Regarding what did happen is a sad case of extreme drug addiction to cocaine. After my divorce from Patti I went into a terrible bout of depression. I self medicated with alcohol for several months, became very suicidal and took to riding my motorcycle without a helmet while extremely drunk. I reasoned I would die in a traffic accident rather than suicide. I did have a terrible accident but I survived and I gave up on my previous plan for death. I instead turned to cocaine to ease my pain and give me joy. I used very heavily for well over a year on a daily basis.

During that year I was robbed countless times, had four vehicles stole from me, and was surrounded only by people using me. But being in the grip of a cocaine habit a person will fail to recognize reality from fantasy - even if the fantasy itself becomes hell. Near the end, before everything fell apart, I reached out to my son and his mother, those cries for help now irrelevant. I realize now that neither of them had the capacity to actually help me, nor the desire.

At the end, when my mind was snapped, I reached out to Melissa for help, which because of my own actions resulted in her trying to leave me back at my house, completely broke, with no means of communication, no vehicle, and barely able to walk. I remember thinking to myself “I’ve had four cars stolen from me, I’m going to take hers”. And I did. She drove us back to her house and I remember not a single thing during that drive, I was completely blacked out and I was very verbally vicious. It wasn’t until the prosecution read their summary during the sentencing that I was ever even aware of the things I said. I was guilty of some very terrible threats and actions but not that of kidnapping, to which I was charged and sentenced.

It has been a long journey since that day in 2020, I’ve spent the last three years of my life regretting all of it, my breakdown that led to divorce, my journey through alcoholism and drug addiction, my suicidal ideations, my path into insanity, and my threats and verbal abuse toward Melissa, her family, and her dogs.

I’ve spent the past three years of my life living on the very fringe of society as I am now an outcast and an outlaw. I have battled homelessness for over a year and the rollercoaster ride of addiction. I’ve lost many people that were close to me. My heart is broken and will be forever.

As I write this, with the help of my mother we are trying to find a way out but I fear it will not come soon enough. My options are plain, I must leave and do it quickly. I have nowhere to go besides being homeless. With the upcoming winter I fear greatly for myself. With a pending arrest, I fear even more for myself.

I am sorry I lied and kept most of this a secret. I am sorry I never reached out to the people in my life that actually loved me. I am so sorry for myself that I will miss Aster and Arlen growing up. I am so terribly sorry Myka and Chloe, I’m very proud and love you both so much. I’m sorry mom, you tried your best and I love you so dearly for it. Thank you for the time I had in each of your lives.

Natasha, I don’t know when your mother will let you read this, I hope not soon as you don’t really need to know all this just yet. I know we seldom talk anymore and that is my fault. I think of you every day, I wonder what you are doing and how you are feeling. I’ve long since come to realize that you are happy, you mother has done a good job in ensuring that, but I want you to remember that you were happy when I was your Daddy too. I’m sorry I left you, it broke my heart and I was unable to handle the pain. I was very sick and I got even sicker, as you now know. I know that you still love me because you trusted me and I’ve never broken your trust. I know a lot of the reason we never talk is because I still see you as a little eight year old girl and you have grown far beyond that and I’m unable to connect with who you are now. Even so, it breaks my heart that we will not have our occasional conversations as Daddy and Daughter. I pray to my Higher Power that you will never have to read this.

I do have a plan, a plan of hope, NA has given me hope. There are two tunnels with light at the end of both.

If I manage not to go to prison, I have a good future. Through the trials and pain I’ve endured these past three years I have overcome the bonds of addiction, I know in my heart I am done with drugs and alcohol - it has come at a terrible price. I am still and always will be an addict and that is why I have NA and Kat my sponsor. I have worked tirelessly and endlessly for the past 2 years to write a recovery based app that gives hope to both myself and all those that use it. I wrote this app for “the still suffering addicts” as I was one of them during the majority of its development. I have not finished it and hope to do so while I am still free.

If I go to prison, I will survive. I have endured so much pain in my life I know I will make it through prison. I am a very strong person and I have all of you to hang on to for my strength. Someday I will be able to be with you all again.

If I go to prison, my app may fall into ruin. I will try to leave instructions to keep it running for as long as possible. I’ve turned off the Rating system so users will seldom rate it as I fear its decline and negative feedback, but during the summer of 2022 I received many wonderful reviews. It would make me happy for those that I love to read them and know of the little good I’ve left in this world. The app can be found at https://aana.live.

item.title: To nobody in particular
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I hate my life. I hate recovery. I hate everything about myself. I hate the past. I hate the present. I hate the future. There is nothing in my life I want to live for. Don’t give me that ‘live for your grandchildren’ bull shit. They are perfectly fine without me. In reality, better off without me. I would rather them know their grandfather died while they were young, than to have to reconcile having a criminal loser incarcerated addict as a living role model.

I hate I can’t be who I want to be. That person is dead. Mikki is dead, she’s been dead now for months. She is gone, I can no longer feel her. Recovery did that to me. I would rather be drug addict Mikki than the hollow shell that I am now.

I’m watching a beautiful man on TV with beautiful makeup on and I feel so jealous. I can’t be that person anymore. I’m a criminal, an outcast. Society does not want anything to do with me. I don’t want to be seen anymore.

I hate having my camera on now in meetings. I also hate that I used to have my pronouns up. I have abandoned that life. I hate sharing in meetings. Every time I share afterward I tell myself never to share again. I just want to disappear forever, and not disappear alive. I want to be dead. I want to be dead. I want to be dead. I want to be fucking dead.

My software sucks shit. I can’t get anything working. It frustrates me to death. The frustration is not helping me at all. I want to end it. I just want to fucking die. I want to die soon. All I want is to be dead.

I hate my hair. I hate my body. I hate my dick. I hate all the hair on my body. I hate everything about me. I wish I’d never gone into technology. I’m terrible at it. I never went to college and learned discipline. I wish I could go to Ukraine and fight and die.

I know that when I’m dead my home group will forget me after the first meeting they learn I’m dead. I will be two sentences in Kat’s share and then I’ll be gone to them. They have to keep moving forward, keep working the steps, keep going to meetings.

I hate going to meetings now. I will never share again. I don’t want to. I don’t want to share my disaster of a life with other addicts. I don’t want them to know who I am, who I was, and know that I want to die.

I feel better now, just a little. I still want to be dead.

I want to give up. I want it to be over. I want to find relief in planning my suicide. I want to dream about my death, get lost in my emotion and just let go. I want to save up all my pills and just die that stupid way. I want to drink a bottle of Pepto and take 6000mg seriquil and stay awake as long as possible to avoid throwing up, then I want to sleep forever.

I really want this. I really want to die. I only have 4000mg atm so I’ll have to wait.

I want to be dead before the police come to get me.

Please just let me fucking die. Let me find the courage to do it.

If I had the strength, I would get on a bus to Colorado Springs. Go to murder park and buy four blue pills. Snort one up each nostril and put two up my butt. If I had the courage, if I was a respectable person, if I had any strength in me at all, I would go to the Springs. If I wanted to safe my family the pain of seeing me anymore. I would leave now and never come back. Leave now and never come back. Leave now and never come back. Leave now and never come back.

Myka just asked when I am moving to her driveway.

OMG I can not go to prison. Dani says I won’t and I believe her. I don’t know why, but I do believe her.

Helium seems to be the best choice at this point. Pills won’t work. I know better than to take pills and end up in a hospital alive, or a prison cell, I have to make sure it’s not a failed attempt, I don’t want to risk EMTs calling the police and then waking up somewhere.

Helium is deadly. Helium is painless. Helium is fast. Helium is easy. Helium, photons, and heat are the output of a star’s fusion engine. Helium is beautiful.

  1. Helium tank
  2. Fish tank air tube
  3. Turkey bag

PS Fuck your christmas

item.title: My Baby I Gave UP
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My heart is finally breaking completely. My heart is rotten and filthy. I have defiled it with my self centered mind, wants and desires. I hate myself in a wave of self pity, suicidal ideation, and loathing. I want to die in terrible anguish grasping at my chest unable to comfort the pain of my heart being ripped in half. I want to die alone, in a prison cell, isolated from everybody who has ever loved me, unable to feel any human compassion, or the physical touch of love.

D

item.title: My Prayer
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Dear Judæo Christian God,

The One who’s anger burns,

The One who hates,

The One who is jealous,

The One who harbors unforgivable sin,

The One who destroys in His name,

The One who is a racist having created a chosen race,

The One who has set His peoples races against each other,

The One who’s race wars still rage on to this day,

The One who desired to destroy his chosen race,

The One who’s Heaven allows only the chosen race,

The One who’s foes burn for all eternity in His hell,

Yes, You, the God of the Bible,

The One who’s followers believe Your love, compassion, and forgiveness is boundless,

The One who is a liar,

I ask in Jeasus’s Name for Him to leave my heart,

For I have a Goddess,

You are right to be jealous of Her,

I ask Her not for forgiveness,

She has nothing to forgive,

She knows not sin,

I ask not for Her love,

She has loved me always,

I seek not Her guidance,

She guides me always,

I ask not for Her protection,

She has protected me since the Beginning,

I ask only of Her for Wisdom,

To show Me how to love like She does,

To show Me how to let go and not harbor sin in my heart,

How to teach Others like She does,

How to know right from wrong,

How to pray to Her,

How to trust Her,

How to love Her,

How to share Her with Others.

I pray to her not to be in Her heaven,

For She is Heaven,

And All are welcome to her regardless their race, religion, sexual identity, gender identity, or belief in Her,

For the path to Her are spiritual practices,

Not religious practices,

She is a God of endless names and persona’s,

She is infinitely deeper in her Love and Understanding of Humanity than You are,

She is a feminine energy capable of creation only,

You are a masculine energy not capable of creation but of destruction.

I love you God,

I thank you for opening my eyes,

To sin, hatred, hell, racism, pain, destruction, evil, jealousy, war, and religion,

In Her Name I Pray,

Amen

item.title: Step 1 work ramblings
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This isn’t fun anymore.  I’ve lost my obsession to tackle these questions tonight.  I’m going to write code till my brain is numb, tune this stuff out and probably fall asleep around 7am, crawl out of bed at 11am and cuddle with my granddaughter all afternoon.  Even though I don’t deserve that.

I just had a very strong desire to forgo the code and drink myself into oblivion.  And I just realized that a full bottle of coffee flavored Irish whiskey is in the house, which I can get easily.

But, I’ve reconsidered, although they wouldn’t notice it was gone for a long time, and probably then just think somebody else stole it, I’d have to replace it eventually, but I don’t like lies.  But more than that, I could never let my daughter ever possibly think I drank it while here at her house.  That is what will stop me from drinking tonight.

I’ll write code instead and let it go.  I’m freezing here in the RV and it would feel good to drink though, it’s so hard to just let go.  I need to tell my daughter to put it away tomorrow.  That’s what I’ll do.

Oh my diseased mind just won’t stop.  Now the thought is that I have full prescriptions of both Trazodone and Quetiapine and can take enough of those to easily fall asleep, without killing myself.  Both full bottles won’t kill me, I’ve done the research on those drugs quite extensively.  I know what will and what won’t work - it’s actually very hard to die from those drugs.  I’d have to also drink the bottle of whiskey to do that trick.  Maybe, I would probably need another prescription of the Quetiapine to be safe.  Which I can get tomorrow, if I wanted.  These thoughts are my life long Obsession with suicide kicking in.  They make me feel better, stop crying and let me go cold inside.  I play with these thoughts like others play with thoughts of vacations in Hawaii.

I know I won’t kill myself,  certainly not in my daughters driveway.  I’d have the decency to get a hotel room, which I’m totally unable to do tonight.  Well I guess I could actually via Uber.  But I can’t do that to my family.  I learned that lesson when my girlfriend Gabby offed herself in Colorado Springs.  Even though now, I wish I could, I remember that when Gabby did, I thought “I could never do that to the people that love me”, so it’s just another pie in the sky dream for me to be free of this hell.

Speaking of Hawaii, I watched Moana today with my granddaughter.  Ok, actually she played on her tablet and I watched it myself.  I love that movie.  Moana reminds me of my baby girl, she looked like Moana being half Thai.  We used to watch it all the time together and I would sing for her and dance with her.  I cried several times today during the movie, remembering.  

I talked to my baby today, and asked her to be my Valentine.   She was distant when I talked of memories and didn’t want to remember with me.  I asked her today if she wanted me to send her some pictures of memories of us playing together in Thailand and she simply said “no thank you”.  It hurts, but I get it, those memories are from a life for her that is long gone.  And I life for myself that I threw away, and she knows I threw it away.

I then started to talk to my daughter Myka about how beautiful Hawaii is.  I told her I wished I could take her there some day.  She seemed disinterested and dropped the conversation, either knowing that I will never be able to again, or knowing that when I could I didn’t.

I usually write this stuff in blog posts that I never publish.  I want to keep this in my step work, otherwise it will get lost in all my other ramblings that compose ‘Mikki’s Mess’.  It hurts me that nobody I’ve shared my posts with has ever subscribed to my blog.  Generally when I share from there it’s rather profound.  So, since nobody subscribes, I never publish them.

And that bout of self pity brings me to my other heartbreak.  My app.  Not a single person that knows me is willing to use my app for more than the obligatory use.  Except Kat, I know she’s used it a bit, like 6 months ago.  But that’s better than nothing, right?

I have to wonder, is it me?  Other users absolutely love it, but everybody in NA I’ve ever told about the app shuns it.  I think it’s because people that know me think that I’m going to do something nefarious with their phone, identity, data, meeting history, whatever.  I’ve no idea.  But it seriously bothers me, which is why I never tell anybody about it anymore.

It’s funny, because in the YMS What’s App chat, I’ve seen somebody post the link to download from the web an Android Just for Today app.  HA!!! Fucking incredible.  I didn’t say a word, but fuck, downloading an app from the web (and not Play Store) is EXACTLY how nefarious apps get installed.  WTF?  I mean if the app was legit, it would share its url to download on Play Store.  I actually hope YSM homegroup members download and install it, I think that link gets shared quite frequently as it’s contained in the JFT message.  Whatever.  I’m not here to educate anybody.  I’ve never mentioned AANA has the JFT also.

I’d tell Sarah, but FUCK Sarah.  She’s so fucking full of herself and her love is BULLSHIT.  I’m glad she isn’t around much on the YSM.  She acted like she was all about being interested in AANA, so I told her a little, she asked me again a while later, I told her more, shared the links <again> but she never even looked at it.

I guess people I know are afraid I can see their usage of the app and that scares them.  But well, I am the developer, and any developer of any app can and needs to monitor the app usage.  I guess when you don’t know the developer you don’t care.  Ignorance is bliss, right?

So to end this madness I have over my NA friends shunning AANA, I’ve decided to make authenticated logins optional for users.  I didn’t do this initially because if it was 100% anonymous, AANA could be used to zoom meeting bomb.  But now, with the changes I’ve since made, users can’t bomb, unless the people running the meeting have the security wrong (like allowing a user to turn on/off their audio at will) - like the YSM.  Yes, a bomber can still hang their dick out in front of the camera, but that’s what a gatekeeper is for.  So the actual risk of AANA being used for bombing is rather low these days.  The serious bombers were using an ancient version of the zoom sdk that is now deprecated and will not connect to meetings.  That was a fuck up by Zoom.  Teenage boys will be boys and shitty zoom software is to blame for bombing (but nobody actually knew that).

Anyway, I’ll make the free version of the app accountless and I plan to move all data to be stored on the users device.  Nothing in the cloud, actually making things a lot easier for me.  Technically I can make the app completely accountless even with the user wanting a subscription, but that would take some serious rewriting.  I don’t want to go that far.  Subscriptions will require an account.  There will be those that pass on a subscription due to account requirement and hit the app income.  But, the larger audience of account free users will overall generate a much higher subscription rate than I currently have.  I really only want users that require meeting verification to have subscriptions anyway.

Well, I’m bored with writing now, and it’s fucking freezing in here.  Fuck it, I’m cutting this out so Kat can’t read it, even though I doubt she would actually read this far.

item.title: Compassion for Myself
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I was asked by my sponsor to write about what the title means because I expressed I didn’t really understand it.

Compassion for myself means to love myself unconditionally, forgive myself, have self respect, value myself, and value myself as being someone of significance in relationships with others.

Well, I think I actually know what compassion for myself *means*, the question I’m really asking myself is “how do I treat myself compassionately”. That I don’t know.

I kind of feel like the answer is similar in nature to writing about how to ride a bicycle. It’s not something that can be intellectualized, it’s something that must come from within.

Actually I like the bicycle analogy. To ride a bicycle you must have:

  1. A bicycle
  2. Confidence in yourself
  3. Self respect
  4. An appropriate amount of self preservation
  5. Balance
  6. Patience
  7. Practice
  8. Support network

To chance those requirements to answer the question in regards to self compassion, I’d only change the first requirement to be that of having “A heart”. My heart can only be found from looking within.

I need to feel my own energy, something others tell me they feel but to which I’m completely blind. I need to get in touch with who I am. And who I want to be. I need to forget who I was. I’m not that person anymore. I know the only way to get in touch with these energies, to start to feel them, recognize and understand them, is to meditate upon them and pray for them to be revealed.

I think that’s the starting point for finding compassion for myself. I’m going to start praying tonight.

-Mikki

UPDATE 7/12/2023

I have eventually started praying. I still don't pray very often and for nothing at all really. I just express gratitude toward my HP and that's about it. I have zero expectations of an actual interaction with a HP as others have expressed to me. My HP is quiet, like me.

item.title: Future Vision of My Life
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded: This is my current goal. I want to be paying the loan on a nice RV. I want to live in RV parks across the USA during the summer. I want a driver who will transport the RV. I want to stay in different regions of the country close to people and conventions.

item.title: NA Online Services
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
The main reason I see the creation of NA Online Services is such that the recovery data is freely available and organize virtually. I want this done in a 100% anonymous manner for the users of our services. Allowing the Official NA Online Services to never allow the monitoring of NA resources.

I see what I believe is something missing from the Online Recovery Community. Just as NA World Services (and such) organize NA at a global scale, there needs to exist a NA Online Services who’s primary focus is that of organizing online resources such that the online presence of recovery is not easily known to the global community.

The need I see for this is great, as with current growth the NA Online Community as it should be is becoming very splintered and fragmented as we speak.

So that is the ultimate question here, “What should the NA Online Community exist as in the future?”. What is something we can help create which will make a difference to tomorrow’s addict? I exist for today, this 24 hours, but hope for tomorrows addict. How else can we leave Online Recovery a better place?

Let’s acknowledge what Covid 19 has given us! Online Recovery IS A THING NOW!

I think of that every time now when the words run through my mind “never before in human history has a method been so easily available”. The Availability spoken of has grown tremendously over the past few years! I want to keep that growth going, I want to keep the online recovery fire burning!

And I need help from the community. There needs to be a governing body. It’s organization performed appropriately, which I don’t know. So I need help with that to start. I wonder though, if there are na publications which lay out organization.

I think about the relationship between NA World and NA Online should be. As there are fragmented NA World organizations this will be put to the board’s decision. However the fact that NA World is fragmented helps dictate the need for NA Online organization.

I see a governing body making decisions as to how online recovery resources should be structured, such that any provider may make their resources available as they wish, their
