item.title: First Virtual Reality Meeting of NA
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I think the birth and growth of the Online Recovery Community is spectacular! In my opinion, it is one of the ONLY applications of technology that is spiritual, loving, caring, united, growing, and grateful. Something has *literally* been created, virtual online recovery. Something virtually has *literally* been created, online recovery.

I think the use of Zoom Video Conferencing is wonderful, and it is the first leg of growth for online recovery. I think the next step, and not that far into the future, is the move of a select few meetings existing in a literal Virtual Reality. A secure and anonymous location in cyber space where members of recovery may come together in virtual reality.

I want to start that meeting.

item.title: Sick
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I Am Insane

I don’t know what is wrong with me but I know something is very wrong with me.  I have loving and respectful confirmation from my son Michael Edward Michaelis II Prosecuting Atty. Green Co. MO.  My daughter, furious with me, says I have an “I’m better than everyone else” act, which I’ve heard also from my brother Charlie and others. 

Three failed families, failed career, drug and alcohol addiction, prison time, 15+ felonies, pending charges of Aggravated Kidnapping with Deadly Weapon, and DUI.

Kicked out of every treatment facility and program.  Even kicked out of the rehab in prison back into general population.

Suicidal and complete lack of regard for myself.

And I do have a Superior Attitude toward everybody and everything.

I am sick.  I am sorry.  I do not know why I am like this.

I really do love and care about people.

I agree with everybody else now.  I don’t like me either.

I am filth.  The most disgusting kind possible.  I go to those places on purpose.  I enjoy it.  If only everybody who sees me as thinking I’m better only knew how low I actually physically put myself.  In all manners like financially, socially, sexually.  I have exposed my most vulnerable and inner secrets to the world very late in life.

I know I am good.  I know my heart.   It was clean of hate.

Charlie and Mom broke my heart.  I screamed a while day.  It was a very terrifying scream watching myself.  I could not stop.  I am still having trouble speaking.

What was that screaming?  I don’t want to guess.  It scares me.

It scares me that I am not well.  Something I kept saying throughout my episode.  I texted it to several people also.

I am not well.

I was close to suicide.  Closer at least.  I’ve made more decisions.  I don’t want to be high or drunk.  I want to die sober.  I don’t care what I look like, I do not want visitation.  I would like to be cremated and my ashes disposed of by the funeral home.

It will be a hotel, on my CC.  I don’t care about leaving on the ankle bracelet.

I need to do a dry run here in my bedroom just to go through the steps slowly and become for familiar with the items.  I want it to be easy and rehearsed when I do it.

I want to set everything up for immediate use, maybe even having put it on.  Then leave.  Go and just relax.  Breathe.  Smell,  Star gaze, Moon worship, bare feet in grass, pretty toes and love the Mother Earth.

She understands.  I need to be reunited with her spiritually.  

My spirit is sick.  My spirit may be dead.  I am a very ugly person to everybody.  I see that now.

Wait, no I know lots of people I have quite recently while en episode made very good connections with.  Carol is a friend I made.  She is very sweet to me.  I did try to push her away during the episode, I had just met her and didn’t want to, you know.  And she was sick.  We are talking now.

I sat and talked to a woman on the square living a home free life.  We communicated well, I said “I usually have a hard time communicating with people, but you I can talk to, you are very smart”, she said she was a Psychology phD.  I bet she and I have a similar mental disease.

I son the attorney says I have the sin of Pride.   That’s a good question.  With all my pride I suck dick in Adult Theaters.

Or maybe I just put on this while pride act but it’s really just bullshit.  Nobody knows me, nobody is even close to the mark.  Well, I do have to admit their keenly pointed out observations have become quite truthfull.  Maybe people do know me and that’s what I don’t realize.

Maybe they see me as I really am and the person I think I am is just all fantasy.  Maybe that 80’s show about Dungeons & Dragons making the kids go crazy and live in mental institutions was true.  I will actually be quite honest.  I’ve always wanted to see that movie again because I really liked the idea of being that person who’s mind is locked in an alternate reality while being institutionalized.  Such a happy and peaceful life.

I think I did considerable damage to the development of my brain when I was 15 and started inhaling the fumes of Touline soaked paper towels in a paper bag.  The fumes would be so strong they would burn my lips so I would inhale mouth wide open fingers making big O around my outstretched lips, till my head would hang, my lips no longer burning I could breath so deeply then.  Stop, I’d be passing, deep breath of air, few more times to clean the lungs, then slow breaths of the gas.  I loved the smell the taste. 

Then I’d hear the helicopters and I knew it was time to stop.  I’d flush everything, I was in the garage bathroom.  I’d wash my face because I’d stink.  Mom always thought the neighbors were cooking meth.

I’d go lay down on my bed and just close my eyes.  I have no idea how nobody ever knew I was doing this all the time.  I don’t actually remember but I know it was a lot.  Months I think.  Possibly we ran out of fluid.  Maybe I ran away, yes that was it.  I ran away.

Before I tell the ran away, I want to say at age 15 is a very important time in the development of a child’s brain and I believe I did significant damage to the adolescent development of my brain and psyche during this time.  I never learned social behaviors.  I learned sex from a slut my first wife Melissa.  Oh how it broke my heart when my brother told me.

Note, first love pain caused by Charlie telling me what the other guys used to do with the girl I fell in love with.  My heart broke terribly.  Horribly.

I am a https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/understanding-narcissism/201708/the-truth-about-narcissistic-personality-disorder

Yes and no.  All of the initial description yes, but none of the Indicators except two.  Extreme sensitivity and Overreaction anger.  The two bad indicators.  I was terrified when reading it because it describes such a disgusting person, but it was perfecting describing everything that is wrong with me.  I am scared, terrified even.  

I have no problem with being open about the fact there is a scared little girl inside me. 

And when she gets hurt, I defend her to the extreme.  And when she gets angry, I lose control and go out of my mind.

I used to be able to keep her pretty happy when I lived alone.  I also smoked a lot of crack, or at times drinking, seldom meth and heroine here and there.

I no longer want to talk about my addiction, that now seems almost small compared to my larger mental illness.  Possibly addiction is a symptom of my mental illness?  Yes it is.  Why fix a symptom and not the problem?

I believe the Spiritual growth of recovery is good for any human being in any state.  The Dali Lama would probably enjoy working the 12 steps.  Hmmmm, I should ask him to sponsor me.  Is that NPD?

So, I guess I”m going to Google “How to cure NPD DYI”

I like to be used.  By terrible people.  I like to let them step on me, steal from me, and laugh at me.  I like to get on my knees for them.  I don't know why I just wrote the above but I'm going to leave it.

item.title: Loneliest In The World
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My heart is broken. I feel a huge weight on my chest. Or maybe that’s my sports bra? Joking aside, I feel empty inside. Or maybe that’s because it’s 11:28 and I haven’t eaten today short of crackers with the kids? Seriously, my heart is weighing very heavy right now, it’s squishing and hurting all my other guts.

I’m also high on weed. I had to. Immediately after the The Yellow Submarine disaster, I left the meeting and had no other thought but to ease the pain.

But before I wend down stairs and got ripped, I of course had to reiterate my exaggerated version of the story to my children. That is what I’m most ashamed of.

I pray Thank You to Paul’s Higher Power for him having excused himself prior to my share. I thank my HP for him being spared my fiasco.

I lied to my Sponsor and to the group. I don’t know why I lied, actually I do. I lied because I wanted to have something interesting to share about. It was a story of me saving the mail lady who was being mauled by two pit bulls. It never happened. The mail lady was mauled but I learned of it when the fire department, ambulance, several police, and local news showed up.

I was wishing I could have helped the lady. I was pushing Arlen around the neighborhoods back yards, chasing cats. I was fantasizing a heroic rescue, then realized the meeting was starting soon and wondered what I could share about.

When I went to the meeting I actually decided not to share at all. I did however chat with my Sponsor and she asked how I was and I relayed the lie, feeling better I was getting attention from her. I have witnessed a significant decrease in her communication over the past month. I actually thought she was distancing herself from me because of a nasty share about Christianity.

I shared about my childhood experiencing with Christianity, specifically it was Wheel of Freedom night and the topic of “Honor” came up for somebody else. As soon as I heard that word the Biblical verse of “Honor Thy Father and Mother”. And I went into a daydream reliving some of those experiences. I immediately thought of having broke my wrist, then physically abused by my step father, called and treated like a liar, then humiliated in front of the Church to illustrate the power of the Holly Spirit over, Me a bad child. Pastor Muench wrote on my wrist cast the the words "Ephesians 6:1-3”.

As soon as we got home I went to my room prepared to stay there alone for weeks, which wasn’t unusual. I immediately grabbed the Bible and whipped it open. The verse says

6 Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. 2 “Honor your father and mother”—which is the first commandment with a promise— 3 “so that it may go well with you and that you may enjoy long life on the earth.”

In brief, here is my side of the story. I was doing ‘flips’ essentially backflips out of swings. My best friend and I practiced them every recess. My mom knew I did flips as I called them ‘flips’. As a young introverted person having started my playground activities witnessing to friends on the yard, even bringing my beautiful pocket New Testament so we could pray, I eventually lost interest in and moved on from the flip to Dungeons & Dragons. My mind was starting to open. Thank my HP for it starting with Tolkien (something I was made fun of reading) (I was forbid to read the “Lion, Witch, and Wardrobe” by CS Lewis, the premier Christian author of the past 50 years or so? Tolkien and Lewis were best friends by the way. Go figure my Christian parents.

It had been a very long time for my last flip. I was playing alone at the ball fields, step-dad was practicing on the church softball team. My brother was in the school yard across the street, with some other kids. Brother yells at me to come over and I do. He’s been telling these kids I can do flips out of the swing and they don’t believe him. He tells me to prove it. I said it’s been a while and he egged me on so I did. I remember I did not go very high as I was terrified. I was scared. I leaned back, with a bit too much force and landed on my wrists, crushing the little bones in one, passing out, waking up and puking my guts out from pain nausea. My brother scooped me up and cried me to the church team. I was asked what happened and I said I was doing flips. I was told to go sit in the hot truck and I cried.

There was never another discussion about what happened, like why was I doing flips, did I want to go to the hospital and have it checked out, or even ask my brother what happened. Almost complete disregard. I stayed in my room and cried. At dinner my parents realized something was wrong with my wrist as it was exceedingly swollen. I don’t even remember using ice, or and nursing, I just remember being in my room thinking I was the red headed, right handed, step middle child, because I was, literally.

After the diner table was cleaned I was told to sit down at the left hand of my step father. Still no ice, he looks at my wrist and feels around causing serious pain, he declares it must be messaged. We need ot get the blood flowing, not ice, message.

He told me to lay my arm on the table and twist around so the hand is hanging off my side of the table. He comes over, puts one large construction working hand on my forearm pinning it to the table and with the other rotates my hand in a circular motion, then again in the opposite direction. I was in incredible pain and wanted to throw up my dinner all over, but I took it, then went to my room. I was a good Christian child.

That was a long night.

The next day being Sunday, we were on our usual front row on the right hand side of the Pastor. I was in love with the preachers daughter, Beth, but too shy to express it. Still no ice, a towel wrapped around my wrist, some of the old ladies took notice and examined me. I’ve no doubt the look on my face alone set them off. I could see on their faces the exacerbation or by todays standard ‘what the fuck?’ look. We all went home and it was again message time.

I wonder what that Sunday's sermon was on? I believed whole heartedly in Jesus Christ, God the Father, and the Holy Spirit. I prayed. Hell I took my leather engraved pocket New Testament to school to witness to the children with. I loved God. I would give 1/2 of my remaining life to know. I thought I’d be protected by God. I thought God knew the truth. There was no lie in my heart. I had not sinned.

I wonder if the Holly Spirit was trying to speak to the hearts of my parents. They were mega Christians in my eyes. They could do no long as every thing was done in Jesus’s name. I just remembered that after an abusive beating with the belt, not a crazy wild kind of beating (although my brother was sent to the hospital when the buckle whipped out of mom’s hand and wrapped around and rendered him possibly sterile as a result).

The step dad beatings were worse. He did it in a very controlled manner such as I’d expect a CIA interrogator to implement a controlled torture to extract the required information. He would line me up in front of the washing machine and told to reach for the control panel. I wasn’t tall enough to reach it, but I was not allowed to move my fingers from where they were, grasping at bare white metal. That’s when he would get out whatever he wanted to. If I moved my hands it was more lashes, with a twist.

I was told to bend at the waist and grab my ankles. And don’t let go. Amazing, at 51 I’m still able to touch my toes standing.

He would use brilliant probably Nazi or Israeli psychological tactics to turn each of us three kids against each other. Randomly he would put us each in our rooms with a pencil and a piece of paper and ask us to write down everything that happened those summer days alone at home. It was a whipping for every inconsistency for those with missing details. I took a lot of the belt those times, mostly for not being a rat. That is certifiable psychological abuse. It was routine, but done in the name of Jesus, until my older brother got at my tattling little brother, with me in the middle defending and taking the face punches and the face spits being pinned down, eventually my little brother stopped telling on my older brother and step dad lost interest in playing these games with the kids.

The ‘belt’, buckle still on, was hanging on the back of the front door, almost like another family member. One that you did not want to do wrong. Like a Nazi flag hanging there to remind you who is in power. I remember it very clearly. Sometimes there was peace in the house, there were good times, not much love, but peace and quiet. I love the quiet. “The sweetest sound is silence” But there was always a terrible rift in my family, I think it was that belt. Or now, I think it was Christianity.

You have to realize how brain washed my parents were and happy to indulge in the fantasy that Christianity paints. They were fucking scum bags. Later in life I learned my step father was my real father’s best friend. My step father abandoned his first wife late in their second (or third) pregnancy to snatch me from my loving father and run away across the country. Who fucking does that? At the end of my relationship with my step father, I confronted him and he became very arrogant and asked me what I wanted to know. He was not about to propose an explanation. I got to ask questions and he gave me a very curt answer as though I was bothering him and was crossing a line even asking. My mother was present and offered very little. She was quiet and went along with step dad’s tactics to squash the inquisition.

So when they were traveling back to Brooklyn, my mothers city, and stopped in middle of nowhere Republic, MO where my step fathers real mother lived. Oh my god, I just remembered Grandma Joan wasn’t his mother. S, tep dad’s parentsBrad and Charlotte, living in Republic and owning a construction business, offered step dad a job and we stayed. Finding Christianity, and a way to wash their souls clean, relieving them of the pain of knowing what they did, they went FULL FORCE indoctrination. Hell Yeah! They were REBORN, new people, able to start a new life regardless the terrible shit they did to their ex’s.

Oh by the way, step dad’s first child was a boy, who died of inverted encephalitis in infancy. His next one a beautiful girl and the third eventually a girl. My brothers and I could never live up to be Danny. And the desert was that both my parents would so often express their desire to have have 3 girls instead of us boys. Dan already had two daughters that he was just sure to be the best. Oddly enough, after I left home at 17, step dad moved from San Diego one of his daughters, who he both eventually put through law school also molested. At least those were my mothers accusations in the divorce.

After church that afternoon it was time for another wrist massage. This time I could not take it and my mother took me to the hospital. They x-rayed my wrist and pointed out the several crushed little bones. The doctor asked me what happened. I said I was doing flips. He asked what those were and my mother broke in and said like “handsprings”, I said no, I was doing flips out of the swing. That sealed my doom.

Step dad was furious but did not whip me. Mom, I don’t fucking remember. It was never a discussion. I lied to try to cover up what happened. They knew it in their hearts, probably relieved in their spirits that this was not them being abusive parents, it was a sin that I commited.

I learned later on from the old ladies it was because they threatened my parents with protective services. Mind you, this is like 1982. There was no 911. Children were still beaten in school with drilled out long hard wood paddles. So learning my parents were threatened with authority knowing that terrified me. I realize now more of the theatrics, I wasn’t not whipped out of mercy, it was because they were relieved to be able to rebuke the old ladies accusations.

That Sunday evening we went back to evening church service, which as very unusual. I was paraded around prior to the service showing the congregation my fresh cast and that I’d been properly taken care of. At the end of that evening service, my deacon step dad goes up to the podium. He is sweet and expresses love for the congregation, then bringing a spiritual story. He announces that last week he prayed to God for the Holly Spirit to be his children’s protector and discipliner. He put us three in the hands of the Holly Spirit, and that the Holly Spirit has been in one of their lives this weekend. He was disciplined by the hand of God for lying. Stand up Michael. Come down here to the front. Congregation, lets please pray for Michael.

Honestly, I was nothing but shame and hatred for myself standing up there. But I knew in my heart I did not lie. I was was doing flips and told the truth. I could let my inner child let lose on this page a fury of anger, hate, and disgust, but I wont. Only because I’m still high a little.

Ok, I’m high again.

That is just one of many, many things I experienced as a good Christian child. I still held on to Jesus in my heart. For many years, but then my heart changed. I was still a total introvert, never having a single girlfriend in any one of the five high schools I attended in my 4 years. My only girlfriend was a church slut who introduced herself on out first date by sucking my dick all the way to the movies. My brother and church girlfriend drove us in his VW Bug. After the date my brother asked me if I’d go out on another date with her and I said “No.”, my brother telling me it will break her heart, etc, until I agreed. I fell in love and eventually marrying her and divorced her the first year - because I discovered I could buy meth in bricks and mail them back to my brother in Missouri, him paying me by letting me keep a few eight balls for my personal use, and thus fueling my burning addiction.

I loved doing meth. I became somebody that I absolutely loved. I was very kind and sweet, and gorgeous. My boss at work started fucking me when I’d stay over the weekend. When his wife was out I’d get dolled up for him and we would have amazing times together. One weekend, he got me so spun I wrote an entire voice recognition system having just received the audio card’s API for raw sampling. In 386 Assembly I hand coded the cpu instructions to communicate with the sound card at a hardware level, and in C I wrote an app which provided a rudimentary neural network algorithm to do voice training and command learning and to recognize live voice audio commands. In just 2.5 days we ran the system from the living room and instructed a computer in the corner to launch X Tree Gold, move directory and start some porn. It was a huge moment. I was fucking brilliant.

I was also an addict. I really sweet Christian boy who was never ever talked to about women, dating, life, anything, including drugs. I always thought simply that drugs were bad. I held on to that until long after high school, I was the All-American Christian baseball rocking, redheaded, middle, step child. I didn’t realize that the first time I did drugs I would love them, I thought they were bad, like that they sucked, that only stupid people did drugs and it must suck doing them.

The first time I did meth I realized all the bullshit. Drugs were awesome and I waned to try all of them. Meth was perfect for an introverted nerdy young brilliant software engineer (btw I was working for the #1 retail software company in the world). My boss was also an addict and we were best friends before I reviled myself as a user, and lovers after that. It was a beautiful win-win as far as I was concerned and I loved letting him get me high.

This bliss lasted for about 6 months. My company got into a very historical legal argument and suit over reverse engineering software patents with the giant Microsoft. We sued, they sued, there was little president for such technical court hearing such that the court simply awarded the suits. We won $120M and they won $60M. Microsoft threw threw their loss to us into appeals, and my company was about broke at the time from legal fees and accepted an offer of $60M cash to the 4 owners for our software product and we were to close, letting Microsoft integrate out product into DOS 5 as DoubleDisk eliminating STAC Electronics Stacker Disk Compression. I was one of the last to be let go, it was devastating. My wife picked me up from work those days and I asked security to keep her outside because I knew I would break down as soon as I saw her.

I was in heavy active addiction and devastated, oh and with a $3000 severance check, which was cashed the next day to fuel my two month run.

About a month of me geeking out at home hacking code and wishing I’d not left college (because I seriously abused alcohol), and couldn’t just get a software development job in those days. In San Diego, I was terrified to even try. My boss wanted me to go to his new company Mitchell International, I didn’t. Besides, at the end of things I ended donkey punching the shit out of him for some inappropriate dialog and would have lost any job with him anyway.

The end started when my baby son of 8 months became paralyzed in his left leg. He was a resident of San Diego Children’s for over a month, had a new disease named after him regarding a spinal infection that was epidemic in Cali at that time. I fucking cracked under the pressure. All I did was meth. Meth, meth and more meth. And cigarettes, lots of those.

My brother from Missouri drove out to San Diego, we got a brick of dope and partied for a few days. I hated getting spun with anybody besides my boss, because I couldn’t be the person that I loved around them.

I remember a dream I had that weekend. My sister in law was in it, she couldn’t see and was screaming my name. She kept telling me to come out of hiding, I was in a tall cylinder in the middle of a white room with it hovering a few inches off the ground. I could see out it but she could not see me and I could not get out. She was screaming and then felt the obstacle between us, got on her knees and put her mouth to the few inches and kept yelling for me. I woke up.

Of course I could not open up to Holly. I didn’t know her other than she was my brothers girlfriend (my brother having caught her stealing his weed their first date while he was drunk in the living room). I had actually met Holly a few years prior, at the Madeline house, when I was just out of high school. My brother and I lived there. I would drink but no drugs. I was the designated sober person at the parties. I was the piece of reality when everybody else in the house was tripping acid. That’s who I was.

There at Madeline, I also met my 2nd wife. I’d broke up with Melissa, my Christian girlfriend from San Diego, who I had to literally kidnap there. She had joined a little cult, one of 1,000’s in San Diego at the time. In fact, cults were

While my son was

My subsequent life of career success, in my mid 20’s, unlimited money and a lax job I both loved doing and could do in less than half the time I was given, resulted in an out of control addiction.

item.title: Understanding DateTime and Timezones
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
1. There is only one clock in the world and that is at UTC.
  2. All millis values are that of UTC. In other words, no matter what timezone you are in, your local time is exactly the same as that of UTC in milliseconds.
  3. Enter Timezones
    • Timezones are nothing more than a way to represent the location's time millisecond value formatted for the location’s local time.
  4. Always remember -
    • Your millisecond value of time right this moment is exactly the same as the millisecond value of UTC.
    • Timezones do nothing more that represent that same millisecond value in the location’s correct view of time.
  5. In general, the timezone should be left ignored for computational logic, except in a few cases such as
    • Displaying the time to the user
    • When parsing a millisecond value.

item.title: I’m having an issue
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I feel torn, like my heart tore today, earlier. It hurt. I had a terrible thought, that Mikki was dying

I don’t have the confidence to be Mikki without using drugs. And now I’m out of practice, with a nice set of summer tits having come in beautifully - and I’m thinking of hiding them already. I’m feeling ashamed of myself.

I look at myself in the mirror and I’m not happy, I can see that in myself. Does being Mikki make you feel better about yourself? Yes, very much so, when I’m high. Now I’m clean. And I feel like I’ve lost my confidence in Mikki and I realized today that she is dying. And that’s what broke my heart, again, I don’t want to feel such strong pain, because it means that it’s true, and that I know it in my heart, and that I should just let her die, live your life in a RV trailer, alone and in isolation.

I also look absolutely ridiculous, my chest and stomach are shaved my my legs and arms are not. I look ridiculous to myself. I need to go shave, I’ll do that now, I did, I feel great, have to lotion. Storm coming, my mind is still attacking me hard, I don’t think it so much wants to get rid of Mikki as it just wants to cause me pain.

I think a lot of terrible things about myself.

I’m contemplating speaking at Dominique’s meeting at in a couple weeks, maybe just one. “End of the Month”. I first thought to say no, but then I remembered the “if ur asked, you can’t say no”, so I said yes - immediately regretted it, and have been worried about it since.

At first I was like all “Oh, this is going to be good for me, it’s goin to force to do things I want, most importantly, if I have to talk about my recovery, then I need to actually get some recovery"

And in times of doubt, I tell myself I have a terrible personality and people are going to no like me. I fear my mind going blank.

Anyway, my ability to “get some recovery” is proving rather lacking.

item.title: Moving On (Still Back Here)
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I'm not allowing myself to fall back into old ways. I'm happy, I am blessed by my HP, and I refuse to let go of it! I'm fighting here, I'm getting off this rollercoaster. I don't want it anymore. Never, I want to be happy sometimes, and then I'm ok with all the other emotions, but I get happy sometimes, once in a while is even ok.

It's over baby. You are free, you are alive, you are on the verge of financial success, you are clean, you are in recovery, you are golden - Zella Day "Golden"! I'm not going to use drugs, I won't let myself do that again. I've lost the desire, I've lost the fantasy, I don't even ever remember using - because I refuse to let myself ever think about using.

Once in jail, I laid in my bunk and thought about using and let myself slip into it, I felt high, I was high, there was no doubt - and all I could do was dream about that feeling. Later I realized the destroying power of having done that. I never tried to do it again, I refuse to even begin.

I am in recovery, I have a sponsor Dani ❤️. She is a good sponsor, I know that, but it really means absolutely nothing if I'm not a good sponsee. I have to put in the work! And I want to!

I'm going on a walkabout tomorrow, gonna bus to Manitou Springs and get into a bit of nature. I just remembered my last trip to Manitou, it was the day that led to me finally quitting.

I went to Goodwill for a job interview and got the job. I started after the weekend. I took the bus home and on the way I met a man just out of prison - like just out right now - he's trying to find the mission where the prison has released him to. So I told him I would show him around. He wanted the Army Surplus store to buy camping gear. He was a real - damn, I forge the word he used - he was very particular about it. It was a word that refers to people that spend their lives roaming, camping, hopping trains (a lot of that)...yeah, not hobo. Kinda like in "Into the Wild" there are "Leather Traps" - those that travel by the souls of their shoes, and "Rubber Tramps" - that by tires.

He had an amazing personality, could talk to anybody, make you feel like their best friend, like you were important. He asked where to buy liquor. I pointed and started to part ways. Look, really, I did not want to drink, I wanted to leave, but I didn't, I figured he could drink and I could enjoy watching him get drunk, which must have been spectacular.

He had no ID, so he gave me money, told me to buy two, I told him I didn't want one, he said both were for him. I bought only one (that's all they had - the $5.99 vodka). He gave me more money, sent me back in and I bought one of the $6.99 vodkas. He simply refused to take the 'good' vodka from me, so I'm standing in Murder Park with a 1/2 pint under a tree, listening to the craziest stories I've ever heard, was like actualizing talking to "Alexander Supertramp", I was mesmerized.....lonely, enjoying this man, and I finished my bottle way before he did.

Then some guy comes waling buy, the guy talks to my friend, blah blah boy stuff........meth....wait, what? Umm, did I just hear somebody has meth? Yes I use meth, and my friend buys me a little bag. I've no way to smoke it, that's ok, I found some

and I'm going to stop writing....if ur reading this, it was not a very good story anyway. I end up in Manitou, I got my nipples tattooed pink, naired my legs in some stream beside a highway, got kicked out of the mission, slept at the bus station with a girlfriend, then some strange (hot) guy. Spent the next day laying in filth beside a shit river, slept in a homeless camp on a cardboard box, had to rescue a pit bull from it's crazy owner, lost my cell phone, lost my canteen, fearing the police I fled to the train tracks, was gifted a tent by a wonderful woman, tent destroyed in wind story, lived out the 7 days of restriction.

In the end of all that, I lost the desire to use. I was gifted meth the next day by Katana, my friend. I didn't use it all day, or night. I'd lost the desire to use. The next day Katana was in bad shape, but was happy to hear I still had the bad, unopened. I also gave him that day my broken tent (better than nothing - he had nothing) - oh, Katana's girlfriend was a werewolf.

I've never used since that experience. It was being absolutely alone that was terrifying. I had absolutely not contact with anybody but Katana. I had no phone, no money, no friends.

When I went around my friends from the shelter during my restriction, they wanted very little to do with me. They would say hi, then go on about their non living in hell by the train tracks day. When Juanita ignored me out front, I sat across the street saying "Juanita - you dirty bitch, Juanita - you dirty bitch" over and over and over, until she finally yells back "I know I am, why do you think I'm living here!" Fucking priceless.

I've not used meth since, or alcohol, or coke. I'm clean now. I lived through - OH I have pictures!!!

item.title: To Drink or Not to Drink
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I'm getting pretty close to drinking. I can feel it. I've been talking a lot about this in meetings. Well, I mention I'm thinking about drinking. I was hit with this thought in Amarillo TX and I fought it off, not wanting to start enjoying a beer here and there, not wanting to bring alcohol back into my life. I would give myself about a week drinking before I'm smoking crack or meth.

I'm downloading movies to my Mac to take home and watch. I'd like to go home now, but it's hot outside. What sounds really good is a hot bicycle ride home, then sitting in the shade in the yard with a cold beer in my hand. That sounds really good right now.

Yeah, you know, going to a meeting just doesn't sound near as good.

I'm literally salivating sitting here in the library, typing this out, hoping somehow I'll come to a non alcohol conclusion to this evening.

Maybe something else for dinner would help, I've been eating nothing but frozen burritos and Franks hot sauce for a week with no menu change anywhere in sight. Yes, cooking a steak sounds good, but I'd definitely drink if I did that.

Maybe if I don't buy and bring home, I'll just go to a bar....but that's expensive. Why pay $5 for a beer at a bar when I can spend $6 on, ugh, yes, I'm going there....a pint of vodka.

Sure, a beer sounds great, but what I really want is to sit in my chair and relax. Vodka would work just fine.

item.title: Gratitude 2023/07/09
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Today I am grateful that I was gifted by my HP and aptitude for technology.  If not for this gift, I would be living a terrible a life of using and crime on the far frindges of society and probably rather quickly facing very significant amounts of incarceration.

Because of my gifted ability, I am able to reside comfortably in a semi-private environment, work on AANA, want for nothing essential, and grow spiritually closer to the will of my HP.  

I have weekly access to my grandchildren for a day at a time.  I have the opportunity to live at my daughters in mom's RV when my daughter gives me another grand baby girl.  OMG How lucky am I to be there for that!!!!!!!!

And I can live like this for as long as I need to.  This is my new existance!

This is an absolute dream come true in my life and I need to start acting like it.  I need to get out of this psychological cycle of existance that revolves aroudn depression.....am I really depressed, or do I just 'think' I am.  Am I 180 degrees out and it's acutlly my thinking that is making me feel depressed?

I DON'T HAVE ANYTHING TO BE DEPRESSED ABOUT ANYMORE!

I have things I need to do:

  1. Continue persuing my HP.
  2. Make the decision to work the steps in earnest.
  3. Find a Sponsor
  4. Work the Steps
  5. Goto 3

I have things I need to be worried about

  1. Discovery
  2. Using drugs
  3. Interactions with other people.

Discovery is the only actual issue as all others lead directly to it.  I am minimizing the risk of discovery

item.title: Step Work Summary 1, 2, 3
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
TL;DR

Steps 1, 2, & 3 Gratitude List

  1. Admitting my addiction.
  2. Realizing my powerlessness over addiction and the inability to break the cycle.
  3. Making the decision to quit using drugs.
  4. Being led to this decision and kept safe until I was ready.
  5. Having family to reach out to for help and support.
  6. Encountering compassionate individuals during my journey.
  7. Gaining the belief in a higher power (HP) that exists and loves me.
  8. Finding the strength to say no to drugs with the help of my HP.
  9. Losing the desire to use drugs.
  10. Experiencing the transformative power of faith in my HP.

Step 1 - I openly admit my addiction and proudly acknowledge my place in Narcotics Anonymous (NA). I reflect on my realization of powerlessness over my addiction, driven by my relentless urge to use drugs and my inability to break the cycle. The turning point occurs when I find myself living in a shanty homeless camp, realizing my life has become unmanageable and feeling terrified of the future. In a moment of clarity, I decide to quit drugs, rejecting the bag of meth offered to me the next morning. Making the decision to quit was challenging, as I had been dishonest with myself and struggled with depression, self-hatred, and suicidal thoughts. However, my repeated return to NA meetings provided me with inspiration and strength. I acknowledge that my decision to quit was ultimately guided by a power greater than myself.

Step 2 - After six months in isolation and recovery, I reluctantly returned to the place of my previous addiction battle. Nervous and lacking confidence, I contemplated the inevitability of encountering drugs. I oscillated between thoughts of giving in and facing my demons head-on. Disgusted, I stood on the bridge I used to sleep under, realizing that using would lead me back to that life. Despite serious challenges and harsh accusations, I resisted using and went to the shelter. Tests continued, but I maintained my determination. Through encounters with street people, I found faith in a power greater than myself. Eventually, I found another shelter and returned home, where I met my Higher Power and believed in restoration and salvation. I believe my HP guided me through hardships to teach me invaluable lessons: its existence and love for me, the strength to refuse drugs, the loss of my desire to use, and the transformative power of faith.

Step 3 - This step naturally followed my experiences. Although I was safe and lacked no essential needs, I recognized my lack of control over my life and grew accustomed to it. I acknowledged that most of my attempts to exert my will ended in frustration and failure. I started talking to my Higher Power (HP), not fully understanding prayer but simply engaging in heartfelt conversation. Surrendering my life to my HP wasn't a conscious decision, but rather a realization that my life was no longer in my hands. Letting go of my will occurred unexpectedly when my desire for NA meetings was obstructed. Frustration ensued, but it broke my will, leading me to understand that things won't unfold according to my plans, especially when seeking recovery. I now recognize that recovery is a guided path where I must align my will with my HP's and carry out their bidding.

​​​​Step 1 - Full Summary

Admitting now, that I'm an addict, comes without hesitation. Even while I was using I admitted I was an addict - and did so proudly. Now the only thing about being an addict I'm proud of is knowing that I've earned my place in NA.

Realizing I was powerless over my addiction was easy. Every time I could use drugs, I did so. Every time I had money I would relentlessly think about using it until I finally did. Over and over I used but kept coming back to NA. I quickly realized I was incapable of stopping this vicious cycle - I was completely powerless over my addiction. I would do anything for anybody that gave me drugs.

Admitting my life had become unmanageable was a terrible process. This realization finally came while living in a shanty homeless camp by the railroad tracks. An enormous wind storm came down off Pikes Peak and left what little I had in ruins. The only thing I really had any control over now was my bodily functions.

I found myself balled up in the dark and realized that this was my new life - and I was completely incapable of escaping this new hell. I had control over nothing - I was nothing - and I was terrified of the future. I cried out to god simply yelling NO over and over again. Something changed inside me that night - I made the decision that I was finally done with drugs. The idea of using did not excite me - just the opposite - what possible joy could I find in getting high here by myself, living in filth, with nothing, nobody, and no future?

The next morning I was immediately given a bag of meth - I was being attacked by my demon head-on. I initially refused but they insisted so I stuffed it in my pocket. When I thought to use the idea repulsed me - getting high was something I no longer wanted. I was NOT going to let being a homeless addict become my life. The next day I gave back the bag and it was tremendously empowering. I knew I'd made the decision to stop using and this was a turning point for me.

It was not easy to make the decision to quit. I'd always been like "Yeah I decide I don't want to use again" but it was not from my heart. I realize now that I was incapable of being honest with myself - I was incapable of even knowing what I really wanted - let alone needed. It was a brutal years-long process of existing in a very tight circle of using, depression, failure, self-hatred, suicidal ideations, psych wards, and NA. But I always went back to NA because as much as I hated the meetings, I knew the lives I saw there were better than mine and the people in the rooms had something I didn't. My decision to quit using started with my decision to go to NA - and going back over and over is what strengthened me to the point I was capable of making the decision to really quit.

Did I make this decision on my own? Nope - I was led to this decision and kept safe until I finally had the strength to make it. I knew this decision was always there but I'd just not yet gotten to the point to actually solidify it in my heart. It is a precious gift given to me by a power greater than myself.

At this point, the only thing in my life I could manage was not using drugs. Everything else was unmanageable and I was stuck. I realized I needed help and reached out to family and was on a bus home the next day. I was fortunate to still have family there for me. I spent the next 6 months in a tiny RV and the only thing to manage was my sleep schedule, which was all over the place.

Step 2 - Full Summary

After 6 months in isolation I had no choice but to return to the location where I'd previously battled my addiction. I was very nervous, I had a bit of clean time but didn't feel strong in my ability to abstain. I spent a lot of time thinking about the first time I would be approached with drugs - it was inevitable. Sometimes I thought "just use, you are going to eventually anyway - so why torture yourself?", "Haven't you been through enough and deserve a little break?", "Relapse is a part of recovery", "You can always start over with a white", etc., etc.

Other times I thought "It's about time to face my demon face to face and tell it to fuck off". I knew it was about 50/50 what would happen. I knew I would be tested and tried my best to prepare for it.

When I got off the bus I immediately felt disgust. I walked straight to the bridge I used to sleep under and just looked at where I'd been and knew if I used this would be my home again. Standing on the bridge I was approached by a dealer and I didn't say a word, I just started walking to the shelter.

It really felt good to walk away. It was a baby step in recovery that I was gifted. I passed my first test and I could feel in my heart that there was something greater at work here. 

But I was under serious attack - my first night in the shelter I was harshly accused by an employee of being high. The shelter has a lot of rules and on my second night, I was kicked out due to my own actions. And back to the bridge, I went. It was devastating, laying there all night thinking nothing in my life had actually changed. I spent some serious time cursing god and the next morning I cursed my sponsor. But, I didn't use and didn't want to use but I did think very seriously about buying fentanyl and killing myself.

That afternoon I was amazingly allowed back into the shelter and everything was good again. I realized the whole ordeal was a test that I was doomed to fail - and I did in spectacular fashion, but it opened my eyes to the existence of this thing called Faith.

A week later I was again restricted from the shelter for absolute rubbish - of my own doing. It was raining that night and I found myself in a car wash. There were addicts in the bay next to me using and I could hear them. It was maddening. Again I became suicidal and seriously lost my mind. I called a crisis hotline and was routed to voice mail. Falling to my knees I screamed out to god from the bottom of my heart every curse I could think of. I was finally done - and I thought "What do I do?" and I was told to start walking.

I walked out to the street and turned in circles. I wanted to walk to Walmart to buy a rain poncho but that way would take me by drugs. I wanted to head toward downtown and find a safe place to sleep away from the drugs near me now but it was a long walk. I kept turning in circles until the bus pulled up right in front of me and I got on. The bus took me to downtown but I was comfortable and just stayed on and got into an NA meeting online. The bus was headed to Walmart (fucking amazing) and I almost missed the stop during NA key tags when the host said for grey "If ur not having fun by now it's your own asphalt" I laughed so hard.

The next day I discovered I was not allowed back into the shelter for a month. I wasn't surprised, it's a routine punishment but I was surprised at two things. One, that I didn't say a word, and two as I watched as my middle finger slowly extended toward the administrators. Something was taking control and I was no longer in control of my destiny. I was ejected permanently.

I still did not want to use drugs. I knew if I used it would only make things so much worse. I went downtown to find food and ended up in a park with a girlfriend. Next to me sat down a dealer who was selling $10 bags to people walking by. The guy next to him was hitting a vein. Not in a million fucking years did I want to become of them. I could have easily used, but I knew I was being tested again. My demon was doing everything possible it could to snare me. But I'd lost the desire or something had taken it.

I returned that night to my safe place and fell asleep listening to an NA meeting. All I did was go to meetings. This went on for some time. I finally realized I just needed to find another shelter and there was one back home with my family and I got a bus ticket back - the next day.

That last day was when I finally met my HP and came to believe I could be restored to sanity. It started with Doug, a homeless person I met that morning at a bus stop who fed me, gave me money, and showed me compassion. Many street people were put in my path that day which opened my eyes to the beauty of humanity. I spent the evening with Don the Wizard until my bus came - he took good care of me. That day, it was through street people that I came in contact with a power greater than myself. I saw my HP in the faces of people as desperate as I was. I didn't know what my HP was but I knew I had something to believe in that was greater than I was - and I knew if I just had faith that I would be ok.

On the bus ride home, I again suffered the consequences of my actions. I stole a candy bar from a truck stop and ended up stranded in Amarillo, TX - and my vape disappeared. I knew in my heart this was because I stole - it was something I'd been trying to stop. 

I faced yet another demon in TX…I had the thought to waste some time eating chips and salsa in a restaurant. I very quickly realized that would end with alcohol and I resisted. I sat there on the streets for almost 3 days dreaming - "If I only had my own little place I'd be so happy and ok."

On my first day back home I hit FB Marketplace and found a room I was actually able to afford. I've no idea why I even looked - I just did. After all that, I was given exactly what I dreamed of having. My step 2 was complete - I truly believe a power greater than myself can restore me to sanity - because it had - and saved my life in the process.

I firmly believe that my HP sent me back to hell to teach me some very important lessons:

  1. That my HP exists and loves me.
  2. That with my HP I do have the strength to say no to drugs.
  3. That my HP has taken my desire to use drugs.
  4. That a little faith in my HP makes a huge difference in my life.

Step 3 - Full Summary

This step came very naturally after what I'd been through. I was safe and wanted for nothing essential but I still had no control over my life - and I was getting used to that. Let somebody else drive this bus - I was tired of it. I've come to realize that most of my actions - my desire to exert my will upon the future - ends in frustration and complete failure. I am 100% out of control of my life and everything good that happens has nothing to do with my will.

I started talking to my HP. I don't know what 'praying' is - I just talk to my HP. I realized I had actually been talking to my HP for some time now - in the form of cursing - but at least I was talking to them from my heart. Now I just say good morning and good night, and through the day tell them of my gratitude.

Turning my life over to my HP was not my decision - there was no other choice - I simply realized that my life was no longer in my hands. Now, turning my will over was a very different story and it happened in the most unexpected way.

I think of will as something that I want and I wanted NA meetings - all day long. 5+ hours of meetings a day quickly burned through my Obama phone data plan and POOF - no more meetings Mikki. I couldn't believe it! All I wanted was to go to meetings and how could it be possible that I can't??? I went out of my mind but then somebody reminded me that I can call into meetings and they provided me with the phone number! Every one of my meetings has a password that contains a-z characters that cant be entered on a phone and thus excluding dial-in access. I was so furious at NA meetings!

This is when my will finally broke and I realized I had to let go. Things are not going to happen in my life according to my will - even if seeking recovery. Especially seeking recovery - it's not going to be my way. I wanted meetings but what my HP wanted was my phone in my pocket and my nose in my Basic Text. 

I realize now that recovery is a path laid before me and that I must follow the will of my HP to walk it. My purpose in life is to align my will with that of my HP and to do their bidding.

item.title: Touched by Higher Power
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I think it's time I start thinking again about something that happened to me a very long time ago. It is an enormously significant event that I've always just shrugged aside as back then it conflicted directly with my refusal to believe in a Higher Power.

The year was around 2000, I was working as a contractor for Williams Energy and was sitting in my office at work around 1pm. Work was on my mind and I began writing code.

I felt a tap-tap-tap on my right shoulder. I turned to look behind me expecting to see a coworker who had somehow snuck into my office and there was nobody. A commanding voice entered my mind "TAKE YOUR FAMILY OUT TO LUNCH". Vividly I remember I looked back at my keyboard then back over my shoulder and was commanded again "TAKE YOUR FAMILY OUT TO LUNCH".

I'd already eaten lunch, but without hesitation I picked up the phone, called my wife and immediately drove home. I wasn't like wondering what was going on or what was I doing. I was on autopilot and hardly even thought about the voice. I picked up the wife and two toddler daughters, who were thrilled to see me early, and we went to the Delta Cafe and had a nice lunch.

When we came back home I let my little daughter Chloe out of the car and she shot across the front yard. It was OK, I had to drag in the trash can from the street anyway, so I wasn't in a rush and took a bit of time to eventually unlock the front door. When we entered the house my wife immediately said "something is wrong" as she noticed the fireplace matches were on the dining room table. Then I heard the back door slam shut.

I told my wife to "Get out" and I ran to the back of the house to see four people jumping over my back fence. Then I heard my wife scream from our bedroom. Entering the room was like something out of a movie. Everything was opened and dumped on the floor. I immediately went for my gun but it was gone. I screamed at my wife to get out of the fucking house with the kids. I retrieved my shotgun from the back room and cleared the empty house. In doing so I discovered the perpetrators .45 laying in the middle of my bed. We must have surprised them pretty good. Thank you Chloe for making me take the time to chase you around the front yard.

I went outside and my wife was on 911. While standing there stunned, a late 80's pea green Chevrolet Caprice Classic drove by with all the occupant's eyes on me. I jumped in my little sports car with my shotgun and raced after them.

Fortunately for me I was unable to stop their vehicle in traffic. I did get the license and thank god I didn't shoot anybody. The 12-gauge was loaded with 00 steel buck shot and given the chance I would have most definitely have used it.

Returning home the long wait for the police began. A good 4 hours later they show up, write a little report, thank me for the license number, and tell me that the car matches that of a gang that has been doing home invasions and anybody in the house would have been tied up, beaten, and raped.

There is absolutely no doubt in my mind that I was visited by a Higher Power that knew the future, gave me explicit instructions and then guided me into action that spared my family from a horrifying life changing event.

Ultimately this has been life changing for me. How can I deny what I know to be true and how blessed am I to have felt the touch of my Higher Power?

item.title: Last Love in Buenos Aires
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I loved this girl. She was an escort I found online, I simply picked the most expensive. I posted the picture and I find her much more attractive now than my memory served me. I have good taste. Love her fucking hair and makeup. We had an amazing time! I should have stayed there with her.

Look at me? Do I look like a raging alcoholic? Do I look like I'm insane? Do I look unhappy - no, for the first time in a LONG time you were very happy with her.....oh, I should have just cancelled the flight and went back to her family's house with her, taken care of her and her little brother and fell in love.

Yeah, I'm really not liking the thinking of the 'what if' aspect of writing about the past. But I think I should. I need to realize the opportunities that I missed in order to better understand WHY I missed them.

I know I wanted to stay and I know I knew in that moment that I was very in love with this person.

I was not scared, the opposite.

This is feeling dark, I don't want to go on so I'm refusing to read the above and continue.

She kept telling me that "You are mine". She spoke good English. But she made clear she wanted me to stay.

That now strikes me a little odd, I certainly could have been being made for a robbery. No, she knew I was one of them. I had proof, one sec.

Buenos Aires was rife with riots while I was there. It was very exciting. I'm starting a new blog for this

I used to call her once I got back home.

Crissi thew me out and I left. I'd earlier purchased a ticket home. She gave me the rings I'd bought her and I threw it off the balcony. She fell to the floor and I left.

I later knew Crissi long distance via voice and txt communication. She tried despirately to save me. But I was deep in my addiction. I hurt her many times. I don't remember how, just that I did. I remember apologizing to her.

She was with me until a few months before I fell.

I may stilll have her name, in my contacts, I'd have to search by country code.

item.title: Typing
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812

Just going to type. No, I don't expect my HP to type through me or anything weird. I just think I will end up typing words that my HP wants me to.

It's 4:19am, I probably should go to sleep. I'm tired. And that's what I wanted to talk about.

I've always been facinated by sleep depreveration and enjoy taking myself there. Like now, it's late, I'm tired, I wish I had somebody to talk to.

Talk to me.

How do I know I have a soul? Because I sleep.
