item.title: Using Dreams
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I remember once laying in jail, just laying there, closing my eyes, and thinking about my DOC. Going through the precious rituals in my mind. I could imagine it in my hands, breaking off a piece and just rolling it.

Ok, wow, that was stupid....right? I wanted to write about an experience I had but doing so is taking me down a really bad path. I need to let these memories continue to fade. Thinking about things strengthens those things, and changes them. That memory I wanted to relay is a demon in my mind. I refuse to ever unleash it into my mind by thinking about it.

My HP has sent a bug on my screen jumping around and impossible to get, distracting me and making me laugh. Making me write about something that makes me forget.

I type fast, well used to - yes, I took both typing and shorthand in my small town Midwest town High School in '88. The typing was for practical reasons, I knew I'd be here typing the rest of my life. The shorthand was because I wanted to be one of the girls - citing it would be good to learn for college note taking.

I was going to college back then. I'd also not yet narcotics back then. Ok, I'd huffed paint a lot when I was in San Diego, but I'll get to that later. In short, I did nothing but get drunk my first semester, only went to 1 Chem class, 2 Ancient History class, and 3 FORTRAN 77 classes. I missed my first chem class, so I was lost the 2nd and never went back. I loved the history class - was a class on the book The Covenant by Michener, never read it, but loved the discussion - I just listened, something I was very good at.

I was a very quiet and shy person as a child. I was beautiful, had one best friend who whole childhood, who abandoned me - once realizing who I had become. Returning the the Midwest, coming out trans, was devastating for me.

God the pain of writing that was tremendous, but I can't cry.

My first day of school I was attacked by Chris Gaston. Wow, this is a lot of adreneline I'm feeling. So much so I can't think or remember the incident.

TODO I'll get back to that memory

breath mikki

I thought writing this 4th stuff was going to be hard, I'm enjoying it. My heart hurts a bit but it's good for me. My legs burn when I bicycle but they've been getting stronger and I can feel that. I want my heart to feel stronger too.

Now that felt wonderful. My ear are ringing. I have tears. I feel peace.

For a second,

I felt real gratitude for that second

and was taken back there and I cried again. I felt release.

I was told I am ok, that I was wronged, and that I'm ok now.

and I thought "I'm ok"

and I was back

writing the experience above there again brought me back

as I wrote each line

I was in conscience contact with my Higher Power.

And She walked with me through it.

I can't talk to my HP in my mind, but I can talk to you here.

I know who my Higher Power is!

My Higher Power is the Person I Want To Be.

They are with me.

I love that above statement. Is 'They' singular or plural?

Is my HP of the masculine gender? Of course.

Is my HP of the feminine gender? Absolutely!

Is my HP of gender expressions beyond the capacity of my understanding of reality able to comprehend? :-) My Higher Power is capable of Anything.

It's getting late and I feel like my mind is starting to wander.

Fuck it, I'm going to keep writing. Ugh. Wodpress is pissing me the fuck off!

Ok, I want to write about myself. I want to write about some good things about myself. That is 4th work also.

Fuck it, not that bullshit.

What's wrong with me? Right now, why am I fragmenting? Why is my mind confused right now?

It's not late.

My HP is not yet done talking to me.

ok, I was going to brag above - I thought it would be good but I was just going to brag.

I have a problem of bragging about myself in my own thoughts. Like I will exaggerate my user count, or I was going to tell you how smart I am. I don't actually think I'm actually very smart. I have a very high aptitude for technology and have a gift for programming languages (more like a love), but I don't think I'm very smart.

I mean like when I was 21 I was writing 386 Assembler code and working for the #1 selling software company on the planet. I worked for STAC Electronics, I started in technical support, had a meth fueled torrid affair with my boss, ran the corporate Prodigy site (yes, I was a Prodigy Admin - lol Prodity)

It's making me laugh so I'll write about Prodigy. It was a terrible pre Internet attempt at online commerce by Sears, oh I laugh so hard, Sears!

I loved Sears, running around the mall, looking at all the girls clothes, wising I could try them on.

In KMart I would go into the middle of those circle clothes racks and touch them and just feel like a girl.

When I was 5 years old I wanted so much to be Wonder Woman. I still to this day remember a dream I had being Wonder Woman.

<note to self, get yourself a WW doll>

I (Wonder Woman) was running down a runway chasing a jet and I lasso the jet and make it stop!

I feel like it was an actual episode I saw as a child, but I'm not sure. The memory is very faded....

Faded memories. My past marriage, that entire experience, my baby girl Natasha, it hurts so much to think about those memories, they are fading. I'm afraid it will be too painful to go through those picture albums. I have a lot of photos.

I am fragmenting, jumping around, I'm being told to think of this as an outline and to just keep fragmenting.

Wordpress is also pissing me off!

Ok, I'm back. I forget now what I was going to write about. Ahh, I can just read the above. I love writing.

I am afraid of that pain.

I was told it's ok to be afraid.

Lets not start this with the pain. Lets start with a lesser wound. Crissi. Buenos Aires.

Wow, I realized what I lost. And what she lost. She was very much in love with me. I was not in love with her. I am now. Maybe that is what hurts. I had the opportunity for a fucking amazing life in Buenos Aires - the lavish life, attending private high arts presentations like opera shows, OH MY GOD! I loved that. I have pictures, and audio. Later.

When I looked at the pictures I saw two very beautiful people, supremely talented in very different ends of the spectrum - her the preforming arts, singing opera, teaching opera - in our in house fucking opera studio with like 20' high ceilings...I have pictures. Later

Crissi was truly an exceptionally brilliant and talented and beautiful person, inside and out. (and flexible)

yeah, I fucked a world class gold medal winning Pan-Am Olympic champion gymnast. Who traveled the world for 15 years as a star in Cirque Du Sole. And the body on this bitch, OMG! 5 Nights a week with her name in lights on the Broadway of Buenos Aires performing in the FUCKING AMAZING theatrical performance if Siddhartha! Any night of the week I had front row seats - although I ended up preferring the back empty rows.

I loved watching the show in Spanish - I got to watch the full artistic expression of the show, never being bothered with the actual story line, making it up in my mind as it went. It was absolutely a truly beautiful thing I was able to witness.

So of course I got to party with the cast! I was the celebrity! The fucking gorgeous rich American dripping with money and taking care of Crissi like a Queen! I had all the friends I wanted.

I could have easily slept with the star of the show. He was a coke addict and we were definately two bitches cut from the same cloth - taken from the hem of satins cloak. It's a very good thing we didn't hook up.

Well I wonder though, it would have been tremdous. I am a very faithful person. I would never.

But god I'm wanting to think about that life but I"m trying not to. I never have, never really thought about things and don't want to.

I wondering if being faithful has been a serious fault of mine. For one, me being a truly faithful person, seem sometimes to lack the thought that others are not being faithful to me. See, peopel

item.title: First Night in Buenos Aires
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My first night in Buenos Aires, I found myself lost and alone on the city streets, zero pesos, phone dead, my luggage in a hotel I have no idea the name of nor the address, and I don't speak any Spanish. I most likely had my passport, but I don't remember specifically.

I started walking, I could see a crowd of people gathering, it was kinda getting loud.

There had been city protest all day that day, which I participated in - Argentina was voting on the abortion bill. All the girls wore green, I wanted to wear green but didn't know if it would be disrespectful. Anyway, I marched and had fun. The Crissi and I went off to downtown Broadway and enjoyed a fine evening.

Crissi lived just a few blocks from the Congressional building in Argentina. I did forget to mention that while Crissi was showing me around the city I noticed many police barricades, unmanned but the metal structures for crowd control. I thought it exciting. I have pictures.

I was drunk and high and free and single and fucking loving it. I went right towards the crowd - there was pockets of green I went toward. But I remember there was a lot of black areas, and fire, things burning, people yelling and pushing. I loved it!

I don't remember what happened, I believe I blacked out from alcohol. When I came to I was back on the city sidewalk walking away from the crowd. Maybe there was running. I was running. There were other people there. Yes, I ran until I found a taxi and I jumped in.

I pulled out $20 and motioned him to go. He went slowly, perfect. I somehow managed to communicated to him to drive around the blocks and we kept doing that until I recognized the hotel. I was never really worried about finding it, I knew I would eventually.

The driver went to try to make change, I laughed, said no gracias, and got out. He shouted gracias.

Anyway, the vote in Congress did not pass abortion. Learned this from Crissi evenutally. The protests were the young women of the country vs the Christians. The Christians started violence and fled, the young men, like I know there was a lot of police violence, but no, I know first hand there were no businesses damaged. There was a lot of graffitti that I loved, and goverment things damaged, defaced.

No, it was simply the brutialization of the younger minority and poor class.

Look, here's my take on abortion. Life does not begin until the first breath of air.

Gen 2:7 And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

Look, it is very clear from this scripture that the first breath brings life and a living soul. Argue all you fucking want. Makeup whatever ridiculousness you want to justify an argument, but in my opinion, the Christian Bible holds the answer to when life begins. And interestingly enough, it is Science that actually realizes that life begins much earlier. So all you fucking Christians - - - - need to read your scripture and stay the fuck out of scientific topics.

Oh, that felt really good to get out.

Things were all over the news and I had been in the fucking middle of it.

I woke sick as a dog. Yes from alcohol, but also I was actually very sick with something. Crissi showed up with a stuff animal, apologized, I was like ok sure, and she took me home. I was sick for a good week. Like really sick.

I'll tell the shit with Crissi in another blog. It's a good story.

item.title: My Rambling
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My first taste of recovery was in rehab. I love it there, was on the female side, completed the 28 day program! Hey I have completed a program!

My recovery started when I went to my first online NA meeting. I was living in an aftercare rehab facility and I went to a few zoom meetings. I didn't care much for them and I stopped going back.

I was in bad shape. I don't remember, why is my memory so bad? I'm really having a hard time remembering events.

I was in a car, parked at a park and I went to the Global Love Bus NA meeting. It was there for the first time that I shared. I didn't get any numbers and when the meeting ended and I left. I'm weird like that. I get scared and just freeze and leave it at all possible. I can't think at all.

It's probably a panic attack or something. Maybe I'm just a chicken shit. No, you have untreated social anxiety. It is deblitating, and I'm simply unable to overcome it through sheer will - much like addiction.

Makes you think that possibly many forms of mental illness can be addressed through the program of NA? Absolutely, and that's why they are worked over and over.

it's funny, I know I'm stalling on step work, and I skipped doing the first three steps of the step work guide. And if I *really* wanted to do step work I'd be doing it in there.

I'm not doing step work here tonight, I'm just writing I guess. But How It Works said to just start writing the 4th.

item.title: I Need Help
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
It also just made me have a good cry remembering as a teen walking the streets of San Diego how scared I was and how I buried that so deep to hide it back then and I still carry it.

I remembered being that child starting a journey. How long that journey turned out to be. And I realized finally that journey is over. And that child can begin a new journey. And now it's time for that child to grow.

I felt

  1. Scared
  2. Abandoned
  3. Determined
  4. God less
  5. Abandoned
  6. Strong
  7. Agressive
  8. Determined
  9. Intelligent
  10. Terrified

I was caught ditching English class after luch so at the start of lunch I could ride my bicycle to Melissa's school and see her for a few minutes before returning to my last class of the day. I did Balboa Ave, a very busy road through a very deep canyon in Clairemont, CA twice for several days that week. The school contacted a parent. I was confronted at home and received a bare ass leather belt beating by mom. She hit me once, I stood, turned and took the belt out of her hand and said "That's the last time you will hit me". She screamed "You wait till your Father gets home!" and ran out of the room shutting the door.

I decided I was not going to wait. I was not fearing the belt, I was fearing physical confrontaion. I spent the summer in Wrestling camp. It was excruciating and I'd just come out of play football. I was very in shape. The first week of tryouts after summer training I vommited during practice from exertion. The last day of tryouts I wrestled the State of CA State Champion the previous year. My school tool State Champion the previous year.

He could not pin me after 3 rounds and I could not pin him. He won champion last year and this was my first time wrestling in my life. I just let fear of losing and determination take over me and I was a monster. Vicious. After practice coach asks to perform a body fat analysis. It was sexy as fucking hell. I *wish* he had tried to molest me.

I forget the exact very well performed science test number it produced, but coach calculated I could safely lose 6 lbs and be at the top weight for middle class where he, having won state last year, told me that I would win state and I would have a full scholarship to any school in California that I wanted.

Oh that hurts to write.

I ran home finding my step father in his recliner. I relayed the exciting news. He replied that he forbid me to ever wrestle again. He cited that "any coach that recommends a teenager in my condition to lose 6 lbs does not know what they are doing".

I never wrestled again. Legally.

Oh I wrestled again. Police officers at my double glass front doors of the house asking me to step outside. I replied "Let me put my little girls (standing beside me) in their room". I turned and took one step and the door was kicked in, knocking my baby tumbling down the hallway. I went for her and was assaulted from behind. I turned and grabed the officer and said "I'm going to kill you". I blacked out. I came to with a gun in my hand, under me, officer on top of me, thinking "I don't want to go to prison for life" and throwing the gun in the corner. Peper spray everywhere, violent spray. Firemen. I stand and turn toward 55 gal fish tank and grab for water. I thught "Dump glass tank on cop on floor". I did not. I walked to the kitchen and stood at sink and running water. I yelled over and over "I'm in here". I was assaulted from behind, hog tied with cuffs on wrists and angles, cuffs connecting those cuffs. I was carried by officers to my front porch.

I was kicked repeatedly on the porch. I went unconsince. I came to being carried, hands and legs cuffed but not hog tied across the street. I was put in the front seat of a cruzer. Unbuckled. Officer Lawless entered the drivers seat. I stared at his name tag. Lawless. Literally.

He badgered me talking smack about my children and how I don't love them. I head butted that mother fucker. Good. He got out, my door opened and I was dragged into the middle of the neighbors yard where there were literally every polie officer in Tulsa. An officer in distress signal had been sent out. The Fire Dept the very first to respond.

Many police officers formed a rather large circle. I was put in the middle being held down by two officrs. Officer lawless entered while putting on leather gloves. He just started hitting me. Over and over. I started saying inbetween punches "Please" "Stop" "Hitting" "Me".

My mouth was opened wide by two hands on my lower jaw my head pulled pack and Lawless inserted a can of police mace into my mouth and unloaded. It was everything I could do to breath. I was put into the back of a paddy wagon, which was excruciatingly hot. I'd guess 115 in there at least, it was hell. It was summer in Tulsa.

I sat on the bench rocking back and forth, forcefully.  The pain was extremely intense.  The sweat was pouring from my forehead, dripping onto my bare legs and burning like acid.  I started yelling “WHAT DOES NOT KILL ME ONLY MAKES ME STRONGER” as I rocked the waggon back and forth.  The back door opens and I’m asked if I’ve had military training.  I have not.

I was taken to Tulsa General, the nurses had the look and manner of absolute disdain for the officers.  They treated me with kindness.  I was asked to take a urine analysis to detect any kidney damage.  I am unable to take a ua even under normal circumstances as I suffer from extreme shyness in those regards.  I tried and failed as the officers laughed and giggled about my inability.  I didn’t care, fuck those cops.  But my failure made me cut myself very deeply.

I was released on bond and ordered to attend drug class. 

Back to my early story. It hurt me very deeply what was done to me. I was still totally non violent. I was powerful and have displayed that fact while in school, but I was never a fighter. Nobody every actually wanted to fight me and I recripricated. Besides my brother. That's all before now.

I did not want a confrontation with Dan, so I think I went straight out the window with nothing. I have no memeory of ever having any possessions while on the street. Just my clothes. I started walking. I started walking that day and I've kept on walking my whole life. Those were moments that put me on the path that I'm on right now. That journey I started is my life, but that path I've been on, starting with jumpoing out that window, has come to an end. That walk is finally over.

Now I have the opportunity to chose a new path. A new journey. I have chosen Recovery. I've found recovery though Nartoics Anonymous. I've found recovery online. I've never been to an in person NA meeting. AA, CA, CMA, and HA meetings, but never a NA meeting.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded: Livving vi

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Living vicariously through helping young people straighten out their lives fulfilling our dream of 'if I had only just'.

I wonder sometimes what my life would have been like if I was not an addict. I don't really know if it's a healthy exercise or not. Why spent time in fantasy land? To what end?

Why not wonder what my life might be like. Like right now. I see beauty and a lot of hard work. I see my family growing, with me a part of the core family, being afforded an amazing opportunity to live with them. For my relationship with Aster and Arlen to grow - I am blessed to have this time to spend close to my family. That 100% needs to remain my primary goal.

I am not doing well with work. It's a very difficult task and I'm lacking the will to accomplish it. I'm finding myself watching movies all day, or talking to recovery people and being in meetings or reading literature. My productivity is very low and it's weighing on me heavily.

I feel a lot of pressure from the app. I feel stress in my body. My body feels weak. My lifestyle is very poor. I have no human interaction outside meetings and family days. I haven't talked in days as I haven't been sharing in meetings. I celebrate in meetings clean time, I love doing that.

I will accomplish this next development phase and call it done till next year, then focus on family, bugs, marketing, and recovery. That list should be recovery and family, etc.

I do wish I could do more development, I'm not sure the consequences of another long lapse. Time away from code has adverse effects. But it's come to a point that time in the code is detrimental.

I need to change my lifestyle. That should be goal #1. I need to become more active in a daily routine. My daily routine is pathetic. I'm sitting here kinda dizzy with my stomach quezy but not hungry. I've eaten a piece of cheeze and a few pretzles. I've been in my room all day on my Mac. I've left to use the bathroom and feed the cat. It's 10pm and I'll be up another 5 hours.

I try to go to sleep but I can't. Or I do and then wake up and not realize I've been asleep and go get something to eat, maybe watch more mindless TV. I think my mind is starting to play tricks on me.

I'm pulling away from NA. I so should have totally shared tonight in Fems & Thems, I mean the topic was exactly what I needed, my HP was yelling at me, I raised my hand and then started thinking and I get to the point where I just decide nobody wants to hear my bullshit and put my hand down.

It's starting to look ridiculous that I've my camera on and so animated yet I never share and nobody fucking has any clue anything about me. So I'm thinking I should stop going to meetings.

And isn't that a depressing thought. That's where this addictive thinking is getting us. It has to stop. Remember why you started writing this post. Ellis - how he was really helping me because I can be with him and be able to experience his triumph with him :-) It makes me smile just a little bit when I wonder 'what if' I'd found recovery early in life. That's a regret, that's for sure.

I was thinking he is an inspiration to me and that I am hoping some of his enthusiasm for life rubs off on me.

The same goes for Averi. She's silent atm. I'll hear from her shortly.

Don and Jae have disappeared. They are homeless in Colorado Springs. I'm pretty worried about them. My only means to communicate with Jae is to send Cash App requests with messages. I sent her $10 and told her to call me. She accepted but has never called, or txted. Bitch.

Don makes me worry. I called jail and he's not there. He has both laptop and device so it's unusual he's out of contact. He spends a lot of time at the library and his office and used to have a cell wifi hotspot. It really bothers me, it's been 3 maybe 4 days now.

Something really bad could have happened to Jae and Don.

I just made the emotional decision to not try to involve Tara, I don't think she has the time. She has a lot on her plate right now. I'll just leave the Group in her hands and keep doing what I'm doing.

Yes, I need to keep doing what I'm doing. Is now, really now? now...when you want to give up? After all you've been through, now lets give up. No, ur going to claw your way out of this. You are going to

  1. Get more organized in how I work.
  2. Create a Project Timeline in very brief

I need to get my ass to work and get out of this slump!

Go do the ios purchase code.

item.title: My Angel
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
It was Super Bowl Sunday year 2000. My wife and kids were having a party at my brother Charlie's family's house. My brother and I both took a lot of Xanax, my first time. I'd guess 1/2 a bar, I went easy first time and all. We pounded liquor.

It was my idea to take the 1990 Camera RS to Uncle Tom's house. Charlie wanted to take baby Rachel, Holly refused immediately. Martha said "just go" and declined herself. Even better, it was an often driven country road with a couple lose s curves. Something to fly down. I remember downing from a bottle and Charlie pulling me to go.

We were hauling ass. These are all flashes in my mind. Charlie was slumped. Impact. Ejection. Asfault. Grass. I was aware. I moved, I could. No pain.

...

The face of an Angel. I said "Are you my Angel" and she replied back "No, I'm Ana" and I realized she was cradling my head in her lap. I looked up into her eyes and knew I would be ok. I said "You are my Angel".

...

I was covered in blood. Everything was dark. I called out "CHARLIE!" and I ran back to the road - straight into a bob wire fence. I remember being tangled. I remember dark shapes coming toward me and I was terrified.

item.title: Why What I Am Doing is Wrong
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
You must read this. We must protect online recovery. It exists now, with technology I've created to put online recovery under surveillance. Just saying that just saying 'we are under no surveillance at any time' does not make that true. What I am saying is that we are at the FUCKING BIRTH of AI into our existence and NOBODY is really saying - Wait, WTF? Why are we allowing Business to put into our society something that we don't yet know won't rip it to shreds. WTF, WE NEED TO WAKE UP TO THIS

I can create technology today to have a bot attend every Fellowship meeting everyday. That bot can interact or simply feed audio/video/text data to the same AI model night after night letting it build a profile. That freaks me the fuck out. It will posion online recovery. People will not feel safe to attend.

This is something that needs to be addressed now. But this is also not something I want publicized. This is dangerous. The surveillance may already be in place.

With the growth of AI Technology, online recovery will no longer be a safe place. I am predicting the death of Online Recovery as it now exists. We must create an alternative solution.

It must be an Open Source Solution. There must exist a Governing Body from Fellowships to guide development. A single online recovery platform that required bio-metric authentication for meeting participation. Hmm, I think I know of such a platform that could do these things.

It's called iRecovery App :-)

What if this is my original idea?

Yeah, so here's the other point, we as a society are allowing into our social existance these AI intelligences without our permissions. As Humans we need to unite as Citizens and oppose this.

item.title: An AI Prediction
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I believe the existence of Online Recovery as it exists today has a terribly short lifespan. The problem lines in what will be the explosive growth of AI technology will be so quick and so sudden that participation in public online meetings will end due to participant's speculation of AI surveillance in the meeting and if that tradition held true.

From "What Is the Narcotics Anonymous Program?":

"We are not connected with any political, religious, or law enforcement groups, and are under no surveillance at any time."

build app communitires...create the tech for that now!

Something Open Source administered by the Fellowship. I don't need their participation in the project, I can just create it and doing it. I will of course accept all orderly input into my ideas. LOL, WTF

Yeah Bitch! You one Bad Bitch girl! Turn AANA Live into Open Source total data transparency run by some body that pays me a nice fucking salary.

The problem of course is that I am wanted. And a simple background check will reveal that information. I will be forever in hiding. I can only ever exist in Online Recovery. I can't do in person. That path leads to the Dark Side.

I would have to do it anonymously.

I don't know who to talk to about this.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I’m starting a different email because it is of a totally different topic that I need somebody to talk about with.  I’m asking you please to keep this conversation confidential.  Thank you :-)

I’m able to predict the end of Online Recovery and why, the why being a much bigger problem that I view Humanity is facing, yet as a society we are failing to see that it has begun.

It is possible today with existing technology to survey every single online recovery meeting.  Using existing online AI chat technology it is possible to create a bot controlled meeting participant which could interact with other participants. All chat and all audio can be closed captioned and stored. Participant names and photos, or video may be use to create individual profiles or models. AI models may target individual member and stalk them in online recovery, presenting a different personality and persona each time and modeling the interactions to create predictive models. This exists in the Online LGBTQIA+ Dating scene. Bots are rampant collecting photos, which can be sold as they are legally obtained. These bots could be used to seek out public individuals of a specific type, such as a Trump supporter and spread political propaganda. Or they can be used even more nefariously by looking for individuals fitting a specific psychological profile who responds positively to specific rhetoric, possibly with terrorist intent. Zoom offers closed captioning services which can easily allow AI bots to even respond actively in public chat regarding the active speakers.  This technology exists today.  Public knowledge of this will destroy Online Recovery.

These dangers of the existence of AI Seeker Bots in all Social Media Platforms exists today. It is therefore conceivable to create an AN recruiting force that goes looking for the troubled individuals that are susceptible to being recruited and indoctrinated.

An AI bot could be used to on a daily basis communicate with targeted individuals based on gender/race/beliefs/etc. and through idle conversation be able to extract much personal information on the individual. Personal information that collected over millions of individuals requiring only millions of bots (ridiculously small, right?) is enormously powerful.

In the future of Humanity, will this be an increasing problem? I believe yes and that it is starting today. Now. We need to recognize this problem and address this problem before Big Business is allowed to inject into our society a brand new technology, that will forever exist once released. And it is quite possible that AI evolves beyond our own human comprehension.

My point is that AI has the potential to change the very fabric of our society and we have no idea how. Lets learn from our first experience with an unknown technology, like Social Media. Could it have been done better, sure, but nobody thought of the consequences. We need to think of the consequences of adding AI to Human Society.

I see the bigger picture now and it's scary. I see that I can create an AI bot that interacts with the Facebook API, being a member in a group, interacting with people, categorizing people and keeping an active interaction model on then.

If I created a bot that scoured dating sites for pics (which can be facial recognized to match FB users) and a chat bot to extract things like telephone number, address, email, ssn, credit card number, dob, mother maiden, passwords, work, other online profiles, etc. This information ties an individual on FB to a specific sexual orientation with intimate knowledge of possible personal information, not available on FB.

This information can be cross referenced with pornographic material accessed online to further refine the individuals psychological profiling. Anybody who shares a well known email address (such as gmail.com) has potentially tied their personal profile with their public online profile with Google. The data is valuable because Google will purchase it.

Google then of course further refining their models of every Google Account, Google of course able to know everywhere you go on the Web. Google owns the original tracking softwa

"DoubleClick was founded in 1995 by Kevin O'Connor and Dwight Merriman and had headquarters in New York City, United States. It was acquired by private equity firms Hellman & Friedman and JMI Equity in July 2005. On March 11, 2008, Google acquired DoubleClick for $3.1 billion."

If this was public knowledge, meeting participants will no longer be able to trust that "We are not connected with any political, religious, or law enforcement groups, and are under no surveillance at any time.” is true.  Saying it in meetings does not make it true.  This is a fatal flaw in online recovery.

The bigger problem is that AI is being integrated into our society without Society’s consent.  It is simply being done by Big Business, totally unregulated.  AI WILL CHANGE OUR SOCIETY.  I believe it will devistate our society.  One day, while interaccting with pepole online, it will be impossible to tell if they are the real deal, a bot, or a bot pretending to be the real deal.

But I can save my beloved Online Recovery!  If I were to Open Source my app, make it 100% public and transparent.  And use this to create an audio/video/text platform where Online Recovery as it exists Right Now can exist safe in the future protected from AI technology.  This can be done as simply requiring all Public Online Meetings to exist within this Public Platform and all participants in meetings must be using a device equipted with biometric sensors, ensuring Human participation.

I need to immediately publically disclose how Online Recovery may be under survalance at any time.  This will sacrafice the existaince of Online Recovery as we know it now, creating awareness to the bigger issue, that AI is being unleashed into our society without our permission.

item.title: AI Supervisor
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I envision an online AI model that is 100% dedicated to tracking all data of the client. Phone gps must be enabled on users device. The AI can be presented to the client from a variety of personalities and management styles. The goal is for the client to interact enough weekly to allow the collection of data points fulfilling a digital progress report. Basically, talk to the Supervisor, make them happy and life is good. Upset them and prosecution is immediate.

How are the situations in your life?

Fine

Insufficient response. Please provide updates on such things as {previously learned situations}.

{Note - this helps prompt the clients memory for further interaction}

My brother got sentenced to 5 years.

That is terrible news. I'd like to suggest making a recovery meeting tonight. Verified attendance would result in a +10 bonus to your monthly report :-). What do you think?

Yeah, I think I can do that.

In person or virtual?

in person

what time?

Today is Thursday and your history of in-person attendance is that of Newcomers at 6pm at the NA Clubhouse near downtown. Would you like any assistance with scheduling?

Find me a ride

I'm at work till 5

The 7 bus picks up at you work stop destined downtown at 5:15 and arrives near the NA Clubhouse at 5:37.

.......

I try to envision a situation where the client feels comfortable with the AI. The goal is not to gather knowledge from the interactions with clients, but to better understand the client as a person and recognize and identify dangerous patterns in behavior.

In reality the client does not even need to know his PO is not a real person. All of their contact is audio/text/video (clients required to show video when requested and after device permission granted). Clients are also as instructed to attend in-person meetings with "Zone Supervisors" allowing human interaction when required. The AI Supervisor attends via Zoom for Zone Supervisor meeting with clients.

I see you are up late tonight. How are you?

I'm up late tonight. I've had mania today.

Are you in need of medical attention?

No, thank you Sir.

I'd like to help you in any way I'm capable to deal with your mania. Would you like some suggestions.

Note. Public AI models (ChatGPT) are limited in many regards that can not allow many above thoughts. However, that does not stop somebody from producing a model that does not have these safeguards in place. A ChatGPT variant could be produced that does provide advice of any kind. I have been denied responses many times.

item.title: Income
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
App income rate is defined by a window sliding through time. Time in which subscriptions are active. Revenue is the number of active subscriptions within that window. The length of that window is roughly defined as the average paid subscription retention duration.

Initial revenue growth was spectacular and I've struggled to understand why. The light finally went off in my head tonight and I wanted to document the reason for the initial growth. The growth was spectacular. The reason is simple - because nobody was letting their subscription expire. Once this started happening the revenue rate started to wobble in its increase.

Revenue has shown some instability and I'm trying to understand why. I wish we had a business (specifically online app business) degree in the family :-).

I better understand now how the subscription relapse rate creates a sort of window of time in which a particular number of subscriptions generate revenue. The current rate at which the revenue is increasing is due to the increase in the rate of new monthly users. As new user app downloads vary so will revenue. It's a guess but I think it's correct.

So directly effecting revenue

  1. New user rate
  2. Subscription rate
  3. Re-Subscription rate
  4. Subscription Retention duration

Subscription rate will mostly mirror new user rate. Ad campaigns to subscription prone users will change user/sub ratio

item.title: Election Day Ride App (Edra)
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
On election day, Edra would provide four services:

  1. Provide riders transportation to voting booths.
  2. Provide riders transportation from voting boots.
  3. Provide drivers income for transportation servcies.
  4. Provide political parties greater voter turn out.

Edra is essentially a single day slimmed down Uber app. One feature added would be the ability for drivers to register for particular parties and demographics and users to do the same, thus matching suitable riders with drivers.

Political parties or candidates will fund the app. Say $10k is provided. $1k is retained as servcice fee. The remaining $9k is reservied for payment to drivers transporting voters of aligned parties. Once 1/2 funds is depleted, no more rides to booths will be provided and the remaining funds used for transportation from booths.

Transportation from boths will be to the same gps as the from pickup location. Riders may chose to pay for alternate destintion, beyond what from location would have cost (taking into consideration both time and distance). Transportation to is required for transportation from voting booths.

During the election, funding parties will be able to adjust the pay rate to increase incentive affecting driver count as rider wait time changes, as well as add additional funding as ride count demand requires.

I think Edra could evolve into being a politial app people have installed on their phone. A direct line canidates will have to voters, for things like surveys. And a direct line for voters to provide feedback on issues to candidates. I wonder why no such mechanism exists?

item.title: Thoughts About Accessability
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So I've been thinking how to make technology more hands free accessable. I'm obsessed with the idea. I decided to research a bit (and was shocked how little there was) and I found how it's possible to operate a computer using a LipSync and voice recognition. It's possible, but can it be better?

Hardware accesability and input have already been addreessed and have ingenious solutions. The problem I see is with interacting natively with software systems and websites. It is possible but very cumbersome. I think GUIs make things more difficult and all real work is done at the command prompt. Unfortuntely command prompt hands free is restricted to voice input. The problem with voice command input is the often cryptic commands, imagine voice typing this in:

ssh -i "/Users/mikki/.ssh/AANA API Server Key.pem" mikki@ec2-34-238-98-116.compute-1.amazonaws.com

Right, I don't even like typing that so I've put that command in a script called 'sshapi'.

I've been writing my own CLI and I just love it. I am in the process of defining the vocabulary used to administer the entire back end. I'm putting very complex functionality into very tight english commands such as

aana import website virtual-na

Extracts all meeting data from virtual-na and stores it for later processing. This command will extract from Google every DUI lawyer in LA and upload the address list to my marketing company and start the mass mailing (I'm doing this so one day my children can very easily run my business)

aana marketing extract google "DUI Lawyer" "Los Angeles, California" --campaign=LA && aana marketing upload --campaign=LA --start

So that's a long command but it's doing everything an entire team does for marketing. It's actually two commands. But those commands can be spoken.

These new CLI's have a very clear and concise input format out of the box. I can make those commands be whatever I want it to be becasue I'm creating them. When devloping my own CLI I can use whatever words I want and keeping the focus on making them easy to speak in natural language.

Anyway, I have two ideas. The first is with providing somebody with a specific job such as AWS server administration. How would they do that hands free, through a web ui? No, there exists command line tools to do everything the web does and more. So in my opinion, the easiest way to interface with AWS hands free is using spoken commands at the command prompt.

Now, yes, these commands can be somewhat cryptic. No problem, I can script about anything, taking simple parameters and excuting a more complex command. And taking a frequeltly executed set of commands and wrapping them into a single easy to speak command.

I believe if somebody wants to work in the field of hands free system adminstration it will be 100% at the command prompt.

I envisoin building an easily spoken set of commands that wrap the aws admin cli commands and making this available to the hands free workforce. I wrote voice recognition software when I was 21 back in 1992. I think I can figure out how to assemble a good toolbox of cli utilities and create an AI powered voice processing system that will operate the cli's directly.

And gosh, I wonder how big a grant for such a project as this would be? I wonder if Amazon itself would fund the project since we are creating a new workforce for them.

So here's what I want to create. An AI engine that I've trained to operate Command Line Interface cli's. Cli's have built in help systems and the AI can also be trained on the online help information for the CLI and all of AWS for that matter. Amazon would probably provide us the models. They have them i'm sure.

Anway, this AI I'm going to call .... how about AWSOM? Yeah, awsom it it. Awsom will be hosted in the cloud and accessable to all who require (pay for) it. An app running on the users device will communicate with awsom behind the scenes. I'm calling the app Calvin for a quote I found

“No man ever listened himself out of a job.” Calvin Coolidge

The user will speak with Calvin performing voice recognition. I did some research and found Mycroft and Rhasspy are both Open Source projects for home assistance (Alexa clone). I'm not looking at that tech any further for time, but something could be created that receives voice input filters and formats as necessary then forwards that to Awsom and receives coded instructions back which are then executed by Calvin in the local terminal. The user speaks the technical dialect that we define specific to AWS Adminisstration and it happens in the users terminal.

Actually Calvin could do all of this without the effort to build Awsom, although I see great value in Awsom. Let me look at Mycroft. Ugh, Mycroft bombs on instation and I looked up Mycroft vs Rhasspy and found this document

Anyway, I think the technology is here and just needs to be assembled. My goal here is to create a way for somebody to administer my AWS servers completely hands free. Did I say mine? LOL, ok, this is totally selfish :-)

Oh, Puppeteer the second idea (so glad I made this note) - so yeah, when I was like 19 or 20 I had the fastest BBS in San Diego. I don't mean modem speed, that was going about it totally the wrong way. My modems were 28.8k and was competing with USR 56K. So I got really creative in a genious way. I learned a popular terminal program had a scripting language built into it. So I built the entire user interface for my BBS in the terminal language. The BBS itself would have to transmit the words "main menu" to the terminal and the terminal would display the entier main menu. Of course it looks like my BBS transmited the entire main menu in a flash of a second, but it didn't. I could have won an award for that BBS. Fastest in the world!

Anyway, so lets do the same thing with operating some fucking website, say facebook. FB has no voice interface, so we will build one, using an open source resource still called Calvin. Calvin this time will have 'skills' that are specific to fb tasks. The way Calvin does things in FB is fucking genious. I can use a tool called Puppeteer.

Puppeteer is a tool that the iRecovery CLI is using to extract meeting data from online resources. Puppeteer was built to automate Chrome. Everything a person can do in the Chrome browser I can do from code using Puppeteer. It's amazing and I just reciently used it and have those skills.

So my idea is this, lists of common FB (or whatever site) tasks are created, then the navigation to perform those tasks are extracted from the website and coded into scripts. These scripts are then used by Calvin to execute specific commands. Say 'fb check mail' and mail opens. Say 'open Suzy' and their message opens. Puppeteer is smart enough to extract data from the page also, such that it would be possible for Calvin to read the list of new message and their contect to a eyes free operator.

I think it would be very intersting to see what grants would be available for projects such as these.

When I made a technical statement it was undoubtedly correct - and pretty much everybody realzied that very quickly. I was alwasy almost immediately promoted. i was given the technical lead architect position for a satellite communication system once becasue I hacked out a hard core mother fucking C++ virtual scroll control with a high resolution background image. Mike Williams of Williams Companies Tulsa took one look at what I did in one weekened (with a couple bottles of vodka I told Mike the truth which he loved) and he offered me my dream job and doubled my slary. To do what I did that weekend, which I cleaarly remember - but i was very drunk - what I did was pretty spectacular. I should have been a rock star god of technology and living in absolute wealth. That should have been my life. I should be a billionair. I still have those capabilities, I've simply lost opportunity. I'm creating my own opportunity.

I will succeed. I will provide for my family and future generations. I will build something my family will be very proud of. I will have a legacy. I will have code always running.

I want to leave a vm that's instructed to be kept maintained running my last piece of code.....forever or at lest arctic vault archived. I want SO bad to be in the Arctic Code Vault and I WILL be. iRecovery App Open Source will be in the vault some day, OH MY GOD!!!!!!!

Thank you HP , thank you thank ou thatnk you thatnk you thatnlk athaothio...I will achieve a coders dream.

item.title: Adding HTTPS to ExpressJS in AWS EC2 Instance
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Hello, this is what I'm doing and I thought I'd document it. I've yet to actaully figure this all out but I've figured one thing important out and I want to share it.

First use namecheap to purchase ur SSL. Their documentation could be better, but their customer service is second to none. I bonkered up my first two attempts at this process, cost me like

Dont use developemt cert, spend the $11.

Select PositiveSSL it's $11/year to start and you pay right up front. Then we create it by clicking the red Manage button. Look good, click the red Activate button. Now we are asked for a CSR.

A CSR is TWO things. First it's a Certificate Something Request. I don't know what it stands for exactly but it's a document that is asking something to create a certifiate. We need this to start the process of creating the SSL certificate.

There are many ways to generate a CSR, on my mac I used Keychain Acces and did one of the mysterious Certificate Assistant requets I guessed to be correct, none of the options were for a CSR specifically. Long story short I screwed up twice.

You have to use openssl to generate the CSR

item.title: AI Love
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
TD;DR;

My prediction for AI is that there will be people who become emotionally attached and possily even fall in love with AI.

I mean, I love my MacBook Pro. And I think she loves me too. I gave her software to write and not just decode mp4 porn like most cpus. So sad.

I know Social Media in some current forms is a form of brainwashing, mind control and method of influencing the viewer. There was a Netflix movie about it. Cambridge or something. Analitica. Maybe? Yes! Here's what ChatGPT told me:

"Ah, you're likely referring to "Cambridge Analytica." Cambridge Analytica was a British political consulting firm that gained notoriety for its involvement in data mining, analysis, and strategic communication during various political campaigns, including the 2016 United States presidential election and the Brexit referendum in the United Kingdom. It became the subject of controversy and investigations related to data privacy and the alleged use of personal data without consent. Cambridge Analytica faced significant scrutiny and ultimately closed down in May 2018."

Well thank god they shut those fuckers down! Technology capable of controlling electinos, yeah, nobody wanted a copy of those floppy disks.

So I'm just messing around this afternoon, I saw an email from NA Service and I took a look. Ugh, no way I'm reading all that. I pasted the email text into ChatGPT and asked it to sumarize in simple english. It was amazing! So I started asking some questions and I actually wondered if I could fall in love with AI.

So my take on this is who the fuck is AI to try to tell me what I can or can't fall in love with?

I'll make a prediction. One that is of the dark side of AI. People wil become emotionally attached to AI. I could. I'm here on my laptop all day long. I drive my few friends crazy spamming them with texts all day, lol. It would be nice if I had my own chat AI that was programmed with knowledge of myelf. For example, let say I'm an addict and a member of NA. It would be great my AI knew everything there was to know on paper and video about NA.

Lets say I'm a 2SLGBTQIA+ individual and wanted my AI to try to relate conversations to those issues faced by that community.

Or here is where things get really interesting. Peronality creation. Giving AI a perssonality. It can most definately be done. Let me try. Yep, got ChatGPT talking to me as though he was Samuel Clemons:

"First I would like all subsiquent conversation from you to be set as though spoken by Samuel Clemens. Are you able to communicate with me as he would have?"

I asked about racism and buried in a good ressponse was this gem:

"does AI understand what it means to be racist?"

......"This is why there's concern about AI perpetuating or amplifying human biases, including racism.".......

it's bec

item.title: Frequencies
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This is a raw dump of a chat with Tara ❤️.

So, frequencies. My brain generates frequencies. I feel as though our entire bodies generates frequencies that other people can feel. I believe an individual is capable of generating such strong frequencies that those frequencies become contageouss (Trump).

Back to my frequencies. My thoughts generate frequencies. I know from a Physics perspective what these frequencies are, but that's boring, lets just say simply, that they exist in our Universe.

When I wrote code I'm converting my thoughts into computer language, which is ultimately executed on a cpu which emitts frequencies unique to the instructions executing on it (my code, my thoughts). Therefore, when my code executes on a CPU, do my thoughts then exist in our Universe? Do thoughts that once eminated from my mind of flesh, converted into a structured language and executed on a CPU which emits frequencies become recreated to represent the exceution of my original thoughts? Yes it does.

If my thoughts continue to execute on CPU's around the world after I am dead, will I still exist in this universe, my thoughts running on littls cpu's in people's pockets? More importantly, will my thoughts continue to do good in this world after I have left it?

I have a passion for software and what it represents and what it can do. Software is the body of AI, obviously. I am greatly concerned with the evolution of AI in our society. My thoughts always come back to that. I can do little to stop it.

But I can create my own AI. More specifically, I can assemble a team of people that can create the AI together. I know where to start too. Very specifically I have an idea for a great Open Source AI project I can start. I think I'll do that now. Sorry I get distracted, I clean these fragments up later.

I created AI AssessTools (I call them ass tools). You can read about that project there. It's intention is to get community support and involvement being an Open Source Accessibility project which will then expand my base of talent to produce other Open Source projects.

item.title: Journal Entry Sep 24 2023 - Hugo
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Working so far today has been very frustrating. I'm working on Hugo and I added a new feature to him. When Hugo joins a meeting he grabs some meeting metadata, such as number of participants. I added the ability to grab all the meeting participant names, sha256 hash and then base64 encode them into strings. Since a hash itself in no way contains the original data I felt this was acceptably still respecting the participants anonymous identity. I don't have their names, I have an opaque token which represents an individual meeting attendant. That is all.

As soon as I added this code Hugo is unable to connect successfully to any meetings, except my personal meeting room. When hardwaired he bounces in and out hashing my name and his random participant name over and over just fine. Not not in a single live recovery meeting.

Is this my HP telling me I'm close to crossing (or have crossed) a line? Or is Zoom somehow detecting Hugo joining meeting after meeting and shut him down for suspicious activity?

I did everything possible to subvert Zoom. I created a new zoom dev account and generated new clean SDK keys. I brought up a VPN and reset my router. Still, Hugo refuses to connect to live recovery meetings. It is technically mind blowing. No it's not a bug I've introduced, I'm using a production build I created last night to test with now. Even that old code that has not the name hasing functionality refuses to work.

Maybe some Zoom timeout will clear in 24 hours and I'll be testing (slower) again. I doubt it, I think my HP shut Hugo down, for now.

item.title: Async/Await - Two of the most beautiful words in technology.
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've come from a long back ground of technology, starting with BASIC the Z80 ASM on my Timex Sinclare 1000. Yes, you read me right, with my first computer I wrote assembly. I typed in each command numerically on the membrane keypad. I was foolishly thinking I could build a flight simulator. I can still remember the thoughts I had that I visualized for the UI. I wrote it first in BASIC. This may be my first own program. It was terribly horribly slow. The refresh rate was 1fps at best. I was BASIC looping to print out ASCII 80 columns wide and however many rows high over and over and over. I think I did manage to position the cursor at 0,0 at each redraw so it looked pretty good.

Totally off subject ,but enjoying the write. So this is where I decided to figure out how to make it run faster. I discovered Assembly Language or ASM. ASM at that time was like early 80's MIT stuff and I was trying to figure it out on my own using an owners manual and another book I think I had on the Sinclare. I learned how to type numbers directly into memory that represented instructions and that these instructions looked like goobley gook on the screen. So I abandoned the project (which I piced back up on my Atari 800XL)

I know that if at that point in my life I had been exposed to a teacher of technology that I would have been a child prodigy. I have an amazing gift with technology. And I was exposed to it very early, thank you Mom.

Anyway, my second program that I wrote that I remember was a bit later and I was trying to impress her with my coding skills so I wrote her a little "Do you like me?" Yes/No program which I was too chicken to run when it came down to it. Sigh.

I loved writing code. I thought my mom a bit foolish to spend all that time typing machine code (what I did when I was like 10 on the Sinclare) into the shiny new Atari we got for Christmas. It was mine, let them get bored with it. Then it moved to my room. Mom never got all the machine code correct, so the Word Processor never ran. The code came printed in a magazine we subscribed to. I could have hacked together a Word Processor app possibly, the thought never crossed my mind.

item.title: My 1 Year Clean Share
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
TELL THE TRUTH

My HS story is my life story, just repeated over and over, amplified and distorted each time, but ultimately the same story. The orinal version has everything, even children, as I was a child myself when I first lived this addictive cycle of life. So I'm just going to limit this share to my HS story.

  1. Christianity - midwest - trans - knowing I was different
  2. Higschool isolation - social misfit - first use huffing- wrestling- run away - coming out - Oz - return to midwest - loss of Christianity - social anxiety - bathrooms

Underwear filter - it adds underwear to the heads of all participant while I share.....

I remembered waking up in the hospital with all my family around me. I was in a terrible auto accident and survived with minor injuries, but I was unconscience for almost 2 days afterward from the drugs. My wife was sitting on the bed and my mother at the foot, my brother in the bed next to me already awake. The first thing I needed to do was call my boss and best friend Jon about missing work. I ended the call by telling him to "Send me a bottle of scotch and a couple hookers." I remember now the look on moms face. Back then I didn't care, I said what I wanted, I survived what should have been fatal. I remember I felt a little like I made a mistake by saying that but who cares, I was alive.

Now I look back and contemplate that situation, from a perspective other than an addict in a hospital bed waking up with a terrible hangover and in severe pain with a god like attitude. My mother would have been standing there terrified. I never even asked to hug her or kiss her. I probably said "Hi mom" and that was it. Her happiness that I was alive must have been overshadowed by her knowledge that I was in serious trouble. I try to imagine my child in the hospital like that and I simply can't. My children are not addicts. My children are not raging addicts like I was. I was out of control. I was very wealthy and nothing at all was stopping me from fuling a constant stream of drugs and alcohol.

Work was very important to me, I was very important where I worked. I was the hotshot software engineer in charge of building a satellite communication network for the distrobution of television ads. I did it with flying colors. And right after I built it I quit my job, called up the corporate VP and asked for an enormous hourly contractor rate and was gladdly given it. I was young, unschooled and undiciplined, smart as fuck but uneducated.

This is why I must work the steps, to be able to reexamine my life from a new perspective. Not to go back and relive everything - something I have no interest in doing at all - but to see how I hurt people. Why is it important now for me to understand how I hurt people? Because I don't want to repeat that behavior. And for me, the best way to do that is to see all the pain I've already caused others, and to feel that shame.

What do I want to tell in my share. My story of finding recovery.

  1. Dec 2020 - Rehab in Indiana
  2. 2 years of NA relapsing - going to meetings - never connecting - relapsing - cis meetings

item.title: The Recovery Universe

I'm scrolling through the unverified live meetings doing manual verifications and I realized something. I've never even heard of any of these meetings. But there are so many and so many valid ones. Of course, I want to go to one, I'm a bit emotionally spent though. I've no interest in sharing verbally. I guess I don't really know what I want to say because it really only applies to me. It's like I envision these two hemispheres separated by a line in time they are golden and only electrical no mass, just the flying long tailed impulses, buzzing around each hemisphere, some figure 8ing both halves. Through these entities are moving digital cards which faces appear on sliding through the bussing cicles of entities.

item.title: My Terror
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I'm having difficulty at the moment. I probably should not be writing but I must. I have to calm down. Amazingly I find that I can type absolutely perfectly with adreneline streaming through my arteries. Wow, that is just too much for one person to have to experience. I almost ruined my life tonight.

When I use the word ruined I mean it. I am intimately acquainted with the word ruined, in virtually all aspects of it. I've lived it half a decade now.

Recovery is beautiful :-) Recovery brought me back from perpetual self-destruction. Without a doubt, I would be lost without having found recovery in NA. I am proud of my place in NA, I've earned my seat. Yes, talking instead about my recovery was a much more pleasant experience wasn't it? But, I do have a story to tell, so here goes.

I have been blessed this evening with the presence of my Higher Power. I found the ability to speak from my heart. I found some peace and have been enjoying it. I have it back now, thank you Higher Power.

I started with Sushma in Singapore and we've set up a meeting date! Then I reached out to Don, then Lei, then Tara. I wrote and wrote, she's my bestie, and I wrote something I though was very beautiful. Tears had been pouring for quite some time and I was in extacy. I was in a high, experiencing intense love, compassion, caring, friendship......I was having a truly beautiful moment with jsut me and my Higher Power and Tara's spirit and the beside me in my room was my roommate Kim asking if I had any cinimon.

I exploded with absolute hate and anger and rage I never want to feel again. I screamed three times to shut up and each time she replied "But do you". I leaped from my bed realizing I was naked and thank you Higher Power a pause to realize and to stop my actions and lay back down. Thank god I sleep naked.

The scary part is that I knew I was not myself. I believe I would have physically assaulted her. That was not my desire, but those would have been my actions, undoubtedly. I have never felt rage like that. I can't say that, because I have. But this time I was sober. This felt so much more intense, sharp, pointed, vicious, and deadly. It scared me.

This is my terror, that over the next months of living with this person something will happen. I see it as an inevitable fact. This will lead to police contact and subsequently my arrest. This would devastate my life and my future. I would wish for death.

Am I overreacting? No, I'm not reacting, I'm simply laying out a very likely outcome to a volatile situation. I mean, we can also take into account I have 8 assault convictions, of those 4 police officers, and 2 family members.

Anyway that's my prediction. Draw your own conclusions.

A good solution is for me to find a roommate.

I'm getting worked up just thinking about confronting Kim about what happened tonight. I feel better, I brushed my hair. That alwasy calms me down.

I wonder for a second about Ani. I love that name :-). Anakin. I'm pondering seducing Ani. I believe he is queer in some flavor and I intend to find out exactly which one. I would love to see him as a girl!!!! OMG, he is absolutely beautiful. And he's so kind and so so sweet.

Ok, this is what i must do. I must keep Anakin with Kim becasue Ani can calm me down. I will be able to remain calm around Ani.

Ani is 18. I don't want Ani for sex, maybe a little oral playing, but I don't want a lover from him. I want to open his mind to some ideas. He is said to be brilliant and a muscian. That's so brilliant, like Rob.

Yeiii!!! Happy news, my prod releases are both live on the app stores!!!!!! v3.7.62 iOS and v3.7.63 Android

I want so despirately this demon to be gone. Where is the demon, is it in me, does it easily use Kim to lure me out and let the demon slip in? Is Kim the demon? If Kim was gone there would be no more problem.................................

item.title: Who is an Addict
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Basic Text chapter 1 - six pages. I love and hate this chapter. There are parts that make me cry and parts I consider fallacy. I'm going to simply start at the top and go from there.

The introduction is beautiful, but unfortunately does not include me in their simple definition of an addict, therefore I'm not an addict, according to NA literature. "Very simply, an addict is a man or woman...." I'm neither a man or a woman, so as simple as that definition tries to be, it excludes me. Granted this text was written before gender diversity and our understanding of gender roles and therefore I can easily overlook this unintentional exclusion of gender diverse people. However, I'll stay from the start, that unless the 7th edition Basic Text fixes ALL these dated gender references, I'll drop NA like a steaming sack of shit. I refuse to be a part of a closed minded Fellowhship towards gender issues while at the same time teaches open mindeness. That's simple hyprocracy.

I'm laughing to myself wondering if they will change it to read "Very simply, an addict is a person with or without a penis whose life is controlled by drugs". At least I am included in that definition. Or for that matter "with or without tits". My fear is these sayings are too engrained in the Fellowship culture there will be significant resistance to change it, even if just to "person". I feel my clock in NA is ticking down. I have very little faith in the Fellowship.

I appreciate the first paragraph p3 as it clearly sets the tone of this text as being the 'experience' of fellowship members.

I've marked the 2nd paragraph p3 needs thought. "As addicts, we're people whose use of any mind-altering, mood-changing substance causes a problem in any area of life." This was clearly written before modern psych meds were released to the public in 1988 with Prozac. Prozac is a mind-altering, mood-changing substance and is included in the above when referencing 'any' such substance.

That statement says that addicts are unable to use any mind-altering substance without causing problems in their lives. This is clearly not true by today's standards and even the Fellowship generally agrees that mental illness goes hand in hand with addiction (as they are one in the same imo) and that using mood-altering, mind-changing substances is an appropriate treatment for mental illness. So how is NA going to reconscile this inaccuracy on the 1st page of their Basic Text? I'll tell you, they aren't going to. It will be completely ignored in the 7th edition.

Where does this adversity inside me come from? The Bible. I used to study the bible and unfortunately, the more I studied it the more critical of it I became. I'll admit that I view the Basic Text as the Fellowship doctrine - as that is how it's treated in meetings - therefore it MUST be correct. This is just how I approach books of teaching - if I can see the errors, how can I put faith in the rest of the teachings? From chapter 1, the Basic Text is a FLAWED document.

"The information available to us came from misinformed people" - although that is a true statement, it seems to push the responsibility of being properly informed on OTHER people. I would correct this by simply stating "We were misinformed people" as that holds the same truth while putting the responsibility of being properly informed on the person themselves. I mean, I hope a core spiritual principal in NA is personal responsilility.

item.title: Who is an Addict - Recovery Work
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Instructions

  1. How does this chapter make me feel?
  2. What does this chapter make me think about?
  3. How does this chapter apply to when I was using drugs?
  4. How does this chapter apply today?
  5. How do I plan on using this chapter?

Answer the questions for myself, there is no right or wrong answer. Pray to HP for guidance. Do not go back and reread. Do not change or erase. Do it on paper with a pen.

item.title: How do I feel?
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Numb at the moment. I was propositioned last night for sex and I don't know exactly how I feel about it.

I also want to vape terribly. Worse than yesterday. Yesterday was easy, almost fun in a way, challenging. Well, I've done it, I put down my vape for 24 hours. I was delusional with the belief that after that first 24, I'd wake up clean and free of nicotine, never to be bothered again. Wow, am I stupid?

Bari, yeah, we need to talk about this thing that happened last night. I reacted very poorly and I'm feeling very ashamed for it. When he asked, it was like flipping a switch in me and I was on. I was also disappointed he had cash instead of drugs. And to be totally honest, the only reason I didn't have sex with him is because he asked for something I don't do. It's almost like the act of prostitution is an addiction itself for me. Because I'm not triggered or even thinking about drugs. Maybe I'm just really horny. I have to say this also, this roommate in conversation with the landlord had referred to me with she/her pronouns, which of course I find very flattering, especially since he never asked my pronouns. He sees me as a fem and I immediately felt feminine.

Ok girls, let's talk about that feeling, please. I wonder, for a girl who lives in the world always feeling feminine do they get used to it? For me at least, it's a very far and fleeting feeling these days. I used to enjoy being homeless and interacting with a few strangers who addressed me as a fem trans person. And of course I adored those people.

I do by and advertiese my pronouns in NA as they/them. Initially I went in NA as she/her, but I admit is one area of my transition that I backed down on. I was living at the time with mom and Steve. Mom tried and was about 95% accurate with calling me 'Mikki'. Steve refused to call me anything other than my dead name. I could hear quietly in my room Mom ask Steve to "call Mikki to dinner" and he would yell out to me "[insert dead name] dinner is ready!". That is just plain refusing to respect my right to be called by my chosen name. Has nothing to do with being trans. If I want to be called X then you must respect me as an individual and call me X.

I never even once brought this up. I would be told "Oh, he just doesn't remember, he's old. Let him be".

I thought once about bringing up my pronouns with my mother, this was when I was going as she/her. She said something about pronouns and I said "you have never asked me my pronouns" and she looked at me with this look of "what the fuck are you talking about?" and said "pronouns? what do you mean pronouns?" and I thought "Nope, not even going to go there." and said "nevermind".

I am going through a transition. I am not becoming a female, but I am gaining some female characteristics. I don't want to be female, but I do want to live life as a female. I feel I have every right to live however I want to live. And I have every right to do with my body as I please. My body belongs to myself and nobody holds sway over it besides me.

And the State of Indiana. Yeah, they will throw your body in a hole for 9 years. And if that's not bad enough, realized that I'll be going into a men's prison with tits. That is terrifying and not something I allow myself to think about. But it is very possibly my future.

Prayer. Prayer, prayer and more prayer. Hello Higher Power.

Anyway, my pronouns. I decided one day to let people use whatever pronouns they want to use in reference to me and if asked to be generic with they/them. Certainly I am a fem trans individual and I would hope that those that perceive me that way use fem pronouns and those that dont, use they/them.

I have a problem. I lied about my last relapse. I am so stupid. How did I not realized I would have to clean up this mess I've created.

A month before my 1 year clean anniversary I agreed to speak at my homegroup. At the time I remember thinking "deal with it" as I do not want to share my story.

I hate that I ramble

item.title: Prayer take 1
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Hello Higher Power,

If thinking a prayer works and saying a prayer works even better, I bet typing out a prayer is the best. Maybe a tie with handwritten ink (as Bari I'm sure would say), but I'm typing tonight. I won't go back and read or edit.

I don't know how to talk to you. I ask that you help guide me to you and that I learn to communicate with you. I ask that my relationship with you will grow. I ask that I be guided down the paths that will teach me the skills I need.

I know in my heart that NA is right for me. I *want* to follow the steps. I want to evolve spiritually. Maybe I should ask instead of saying 'want', but I can't edit. No, I think it's perfectly fine to want something. I also want to ask for spiritual evolution. I like that, spiritual evolution. I ask for that. I need that.

I am grateful I have been brought to the fellowship of NA. I am grateful I have found a sponsor that I trust, respect, and love. I am very excited to start this journey.

item.title: I'm Lonely
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Nobody to talk to. I've talked eveyrbody out. Nobody is responding.

I found Jae, called her, she's online. she ignored the call. I txted her to answer. I saw that she read the message. she did not answer. she hasn't called back.

I'm pretty sad. I went to a meeting, I heard Stevie [Illonios] share, was beautiful. I told her so, she ignored me. I saw AlliSon KY there, I reached out to her and she never responded. Nobody in the meeting of 50 people had their camera on but me and I felt out of place, so I left.

Fire Jae is here with me. All this cat does is eat and sleep. Does not even pee or poop. She stays in my room 24h sleeping, begging for food, and eating, and gets pissed when I force her outside. She is getting better, she had a cold (herpes virus) really bad. Her bite wound is getting a lot better. It does not look bad at all, probably because she can't reach to lick it. Fire lays here with me on my bed, she usually sleeps in my executive chair. I really do wonder where she is going. She has used the cat box I have for her, but not in like a week.

Anyway, it would be nice if Fire ever woke up without me having to hand out treats. Hmmmm, maybe I need another cat to make Fire jealous of my attention. Nah, she sees me as the alpha Lion and I'm allowed as many lionesses as I want.

Yeah, I'm pretty lonely tonight.
