item.title: A Good Memory
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This is a good memory that I have that I would like to share. Forgive my writing, I have a poor HS edicuation and English was my most hated subject. I loved computers specifically software. At the age of 10 I was programming my Timex Sinclare 1000 Zilog Z-80 CPU in Assembly Language. I attempted to write a flight simulator in response to a laughed at response when I proposed the idea to my abussive stepfather. I knew I could do it that instant. I would prove him wrong. I clearly remember the images of the screen I would draw in in the built in BASIC compiler. I wrote that code and quicly realized BASIC performance was not adequate and immidately discover the world of ASM.

Long story short, maybe someday I'll wrote the long story, but in essence I know I had a gifted mind. An unfortunately abused gifted mind, poisioned by the christian religion and distorted further by it's interpertertration of my gender identity thoughts. By HS I was severely mentally ill.

My entire childhood I had had a single friend, my best friend. That friendship was broken with a move of myself from Republic, MO to San Diego, CA. My culture shock only esserbated my poor social skills

I'm crazy. Today, I know I am, I do things I should not still be doing, not at my age and experience. I still get violent, I still burst out, I still have an over inflated sence of importnat. blah blah blah, I'm so tired of listing the reasons I'm crazy, or whatever it is I am currently hating about myself. I am tired of butchering myself psychologically. Daily. I'm tired of the battle in my mind, each one moving a slider in one direction or another effecting me emotionally.

I will be completely honest and open. A battle I am waging in my mind today is regarding my transgender identity. I've started the filthy habit of urinating in a 1/2 gallon water jug instead of going to the bathroom downstairs. This was started to avoid interaction with roommates but it has persisted out of convience. Or laziness.

Am I less trans because I am performing a very male (and disgusting) thing many times a day and night? Or am I just a filthy fucking person? No, look less interaction with roomates is a very good thing, so this pratice is not going away. Live with it.

Stop trying to be trans, just be Queer as Fuck! So you wear makeup, so what? So you shave? So what??? So you have tits? So fucking what? Let me see!!!

That was so stupid, to think you were less trans or to question your identity. Stop doing that!

item.title: whaa;lsdkfa;lsdkfj
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Mornings are the hardest. I want to sleep but I keep waking up frequently with very heavy usually dark thoughts in my mind. I've gotten to the point where I'm starting to dismiss the thoughts as uncontrollable, where I was previously dwelling on them significantly. So progress, right?

Nobody will ever read any of my blog posts. Ever. Not even myself, so what's the point?

Does it feel good or acomplish something to write these terrible posts?

Ronnie is my sponsor now. I'm not sure how I feel about that, I'm really trying not to think about it. I've also created some boundaries in my mind for this new relationship.

  1. I'll not be reaching out to my sponsor for a relationship. If they want to persue one with me I'm open to the idea, but I'll not encourage it. My sponsor is a guide, a sherpa, nothing more.
  2. I will aproach stepwork as though it was school work. I've enrolled myself in Mikki's Recovery 101.

What does it mean to be honest with yourself?

What does it mean to be dishonest with yourself?

I lie to myself all day long. I lie to others in txt. I lie in shares. I say things that are not true. I lie to myself in my thoughts. I say things to others that are not lies, but they are untrue. For example, I'll say I'm going to do something that I know I'm not going to do. Or that I feel a way, which is an exageration. 

What do you mean?

item.title: Step 1 Questions
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Narcotics Anonymous Step Working Guides

The Disease of Addiction

What does "the disease of addiction" mean to me?

The disease of addiction effects me mentally, physically, and spiritually. I am not responsible for having this disease, but am responsible to recover from it. Using drugs is not my disease of addiction, it is simply a symptom of my disease. My disease of addiction manifests in many areas of my life.

Has my disease been active recently? In what way?

I've been acting out violently toward my roommates and I'm unable to control this behavior. I have physically asaulted 3 different roommates 5 different times, each time was criminal and could have put me in prison. My disease has been very active recently.

The mental aspect of my disease has been active reciently. Negative addictive thoughts are often in my mind. I'm struggling with depression.

What is it like when I'm obsessed with something? Does my thinking follow a pattern? Describe.

I don't really get obsessed with things, in fact the opposite is more the problem, my total lack of interest in things. But let's see, to answer the question....when I am obsessed I can't stop thinking about something. All my thoughts are bent on the obeseesion. The pattern will of course depend on the thing obsessed over. If it is drugs Im obsessing over my thinking will follow a pattern of trying to obtain and use the drugs successfully.

When a thought occurs to me, do I immediately act on it without considering the consequences? In what other ways do I behave compulsively?

No, not usually, I usually think before acting. However there are certainly times when I don't. When drugs are involved I usually do not think. In agressive situations I do not think I act. In general I'm not an impulsive person.

How does the self-centered part of my disease affect my life and the lives of those around me?

The self-centered part of my disease is specifically the spiritual aspect of addiction. I have no spirituality and I'll make an assumption answering what I think is an otherwise stupid question, but I guess not having spirutuality in your life makes you self-centered. How does it affect my life nad those around me? Well, it affects my life by making my life revolve around me. How does it affect those around me? I have no idea.

How has my disease affected me physically? Mentally? Spiritually? Emotionally?

Physically I've lost a lot stamina and healthy wellbeing. Mentally I am not near as sharp as I was. Spiritually I am dead. Emotionally I'm a disaster.

What is the specific way in which my addiction has been manifesting itself most recently?

In my thinking and quite honestly that's where ALL addiction manifests. This is a stupid question, but I'll answer it anyway. My thinking has been very negative. Maybe that's addictive thinking, maybe it's depressive thinking. I'm depressed too, so shit's confusing. I don't fucking know.

Have I been obsessed with a person, place, or thing? If so, how has that gotten in the way of my relationships with others? How else have I been affected mentally, physically, spiritually, and emotionally by this obsession?

The only thing I try to obsess over these days is sleeping in. I wish I could just sleep the day away, at least till noon, but I usually wake up around 9am. Actually I wake up around 6am and spend 3 hours tossing and turning trying to find deep sleep again and get up in frustration around 9am.

I lay in bed and imagine if I get up I'll have nothing to do in the morning and I'd be like thinking "wtf did I get up so early". Days are long for me, I spend time sitting and doing nothing, but technically that should be a good thing to do, it can be very healing, etc (I think) - like a precursor to meditating. Usually I reflect on my empty life, I cry a lot, and I usually take my thoughts to realizing that things can be a lot worse if I was in prison, so even sitting in my living room alone is heaven and I find gratitude.

Denial

Ok, so the following questions are asking for specific instances for answers. I'm confused then, do I answer these questions as though I would have a year ago while in active addiction, or now, today and my current live's events? Honestly I don't remember specifics from a year ago of my old behavior and I've no desire to put effort into digging through memories looking for answers. Or maybe that's the point? I don't know.

Have I given plausible but untrue reasons for my behavior? What have they been?

Yes, I reciently has a 1 year clean anniversary which I sidetracked by faking a relapse because I didn't want to speak at my homegroup. I felt like a fraud. I still don't belive I have a year clean.

Have I compulsively acted on an obsession, and then acted as if I had actually planned to act that way? When were those times?

Uh, well yes, of course that's how I acted. If I'm obsessed and I act out on that obsession I am going to act as if I'd planned to act on that obsession. I mean, think about it, if I'm obsessed I'm planning to do ANYTHING to resolve the obsession. So therefore, anything I do was a planned action.

* How have I blamed other people for my behavior?

I often blame people for the things that I think and subsiquently do. I blame my brother Charlie for the hattred I harbor toward him. I blame my parents for fucking me up and making me an addict.

I'm having a hard time answering this question and it really worries me. I think "I blame myself for everything so it doesn't apply to me". Yes, I know absolutely I have blamed others for my behavior. Mostly I blame others for the things that happen in my life or my situation.

Ok, I blame others when I get angry. Anger is a behavior. I blame my roomates every time they make me angry. If a specific example is required, once Kim left her TV on volume on high door open and wasn't even in her room she was down stairs talking to herself at full volume in the kitchen. I went into her room and tried to turn off the TV but couldn't find the controls or remote so I unplugged the TV. I then realized I could simply take the power cord and did. She shouldn't have done what she did, it was her fault I took the cord.

---------------------------------------

I want to write this thought. Just now looking out the window I saw a homeless dog. My heart went out to them but I know I can't be 'captain save-a-dog' and I thought "I relate to that dog being homeless and in dire peril as we both are". The dogs peril is death by being run over, which I then realized the dogs worst path is the same as my 'escape path' of suicide. My peril is much worse that that of the homeless dog's. This is the type of shit I think all day long.

How have I compared my addiction with others' addiction? Is my addiction "bad enough" if I don't compare it to anyone else's?

Just the opposite in my case. Is others' addiction "bad enough" compared to mine? My addiction is definately "bad enough", I've always acknowledged I was a coke addict. Admitting I had a problem with alcohol was more difficult for me.

Am I comparing a current manifestation of my addiction to the way my life was before I got clean? Am I plagued by the idea that I should know better?

Quite frankly, I've no idea what that question is asking or if it's even proper English :-), but I have an answer. My addiction reciently made me doubt myself. At my 1 year clean date I found myself acting out with extreme addictive behavior toward my loving family. I was ashamed of myself. I didnt' feel like I was where I wanted to be at 1 year clean. I was still an asshole bitch. My addiction told me to throw away my 1 year and 'start over' and I did. I lied to my home group to get out of doing my 1 year celebration by telling them I relapsed. Wow, what a mess, and yes, I should have known better than to lie. 

But reflecting back, no, there's no reason at all why I shouldn't still be acting exactly like an asshole bitch at 1 year clean. I was acting exactly like I should be acting. Why? Because I've zero recovery. One year clean does not equal one year of recovery. I didnt' even have a sponsor at my 1 year and haven't worked a single step.

Have I been thinking that I have enough information about addiction and recovery to get my behavior under control before it gets out of hand?

Absolutely not, I know I can't get my life under control. My life is already way out of hand. I also acknowledge I don't have hardly any information, there's still so much to learn.

Am I avoiding action because I'm afraid I will be ashamed when I face the results of my addiction?

Yes, I am terrified I will discover that I am a fraud, even to myself. I am afraid I won't like the person that I am. I already know I don't like the person that I am, so digging up more shit about myself won't help improve that image of myself.

Am I avoiding action because I'm worried about what others will think?

No, not really.

What crisis brought me to recovery?

The crisis of living homeless in Colorado Springs. I realied I was nothing, had nothing, had no future, and had no ability to make a future. I hit bottom and I gave up. In that moment I lost the desire to use forever. The desire is gone but the ego still thinks about it. I know that using again, even once, will awaken a fire in me that I may never be able to put back out.

What situation led me to formally work Step One?

I realize that my life depends on working the steps. I know in my heart that working the steps will save my life and that if I work the steps the rest of my life I will be safe. I belive this is a covenant between me and my HP. Also in the covenant I must never shoplift.

When did I first recognize my addiction as a problem? Did I try to correct it? If so, how? If not, why not?

I have always accepted the fact that I'm an addict.

Make Planned Parenthood appt

Seeking free therapy

https://www.free-heart.org

Over what, exactly, am I powerless?

I am powerless over my addiction. Specicially I am powerless over my ability to stop once I start using. I was once powerless over my ability to not use, however today I do have power over my ability to not use. Today, not using is a decision I make that is not made out of compulsion.

I've done things while acting out on my addiction that I would never do when focusing on recovery. What were they?

Neglecting my family, lying, manipulating situations, violent behavior, prostitution, permisuious behavior. I have done many things I would never do when focusing on recovery, or otherwise. The worst is neglecting my family as a result of my addiction.

What things have I done to maintain my addiction that went completely against all my beliefs and values?

The main thing I've done to maintain my addiction is to neglect my family. This goes against all my beliefs and values. I don't know if I neglected my family to maintain my addiciton or just as a result of my addiction. 

How does my personality change when I'm acting out on my addiction? (For example: Do I become arrogant? Self-centered? Mean-tempered? Passive to the point where I can't protect myself? Manipulative? Whiny?)

I'm a little confused by the meaing of 'acting out on my addiction'. Does this mean when using, or when I'm high? Or does this mean the person that I am when I'm not living in recovery? I'm going to answer it from the "when using" perspective since I think that's the most obivous choice.

When I use meth/coke my personality changes drastically. I become very sharing, open, and kind. Everybody is my friend.

When I use alcohol my personality changes drastically. I wear my feelings on my sleeve and become easily hurt, offended, disrespected, etc and react very agressively.

Do I manipulate other people to maintain my addiction? How?

Absolutely, I manipulated my mother for her money, car, house, and love. I would lie to my mother about things at work to get time alone with her car, saying I have to go in early, but will actually buy drugs.

Have I tried to quit using and found that I couldn't? Have I quit using on my own and found that my life was so painful without drugs that my abstinence didn't last very long? What were these times like?

Yes, I tried to quit and could not. Either drugs would just 'happen' or eventually I would seek drugs out. I alwasy returned to drugs. No, I don't think quitting caused my life to be so painful, maybe just boring, or uninteresting, and not worth living. 

How has my addiction caused me to hurt myself or others?

My addiction has caused me to completely destroy my entire life. I've also thrown away my children and thrown away all of our futures. They all grew up without me, I took my children's father from them. I abandoned my children. I have hurt myself beyond repair and I've put myself in great life long danger. 

Unmanageability

What does unmanageability mean to me?

Unmanageability is the evidence of powerlessness [over addiction]. Meaning unmanagebility is the result of my powerlessness over my addiction and thus my addiciton running rampant in my life. Unmanagebility is the result of the disease of addiction and my life is unmanageable becasue I'm powerless over my addiction. There are two types of unmanageability outward and inward (or personal). Outward is the real world negative results of my addictive behavior and inward unmanagebility is my addictive thinking.

Have I ever been arrested or had legal trouble as a result of my addiction? Have I ever done anything I could have been arrested for if only I was caught? What have those things been?

Yes, it all started with a simple ticket in Republic, MO. I was arrested over a traffic ticket. The judge put on the warrant to call him day or night when I was arrested, which they did and his daughter brought him into the station very late at night - she had nothing but disdain for me. The judge tried to communicate with me, but I didn't respond. He ended the conversation with "You don't trust anybody, do you?" and released me.

Many traffic violations, eventually resulting in revoked license, then driving while revoked, unregistered vehicle, no insurance.

Driving while impaired. Missouri - 4th July, Venus Flytrap, O'Reilly, Motorcycle. Oklahoma - Beating, Handicaped, . Indiana - Motorcycle.

Posession of Cocaine Tulsa, posession of cocaine Indy, Posession of meth lab, posession paraphanella Republic.

Assualt & Battery on Police officer. Kidnapping. Auto theft.

Suff I didn't get caught for.....

Terrorizing the convience store clerk, Mark Twain meth lab, purse snatch

What trouble have I had at work or school because of my addiction? What trouble have I had with my family as a result of my addiction?

Because of my addiction I was unable to continue working and ultimately lost my job. My addiction utterly destroyed my ability to function in a professional capacity.

Because of my addiction I have completely lost my immediate family three times in my life. My addiction caused me to walk away from three sets of beautiful children and persue using.

What trouble have I had with my friends as a result of my addiction?

What friends? During my addiction I didn't have any friends.

Do I insist on having my own way?

No, not anymore. I am ok with giving up control to othres.

Professionally yes, probably so personally. If the question were to read "Do I insist on having the right way?" then I would anwser this question "yes".

What effect has my insistence had on my relationships?

My insistence has played a key part of the destruction of all of my personal relationships.

Do I consider the needs of others?

yes, I feel that i have great compassion for others and their needs. Possiby I am very targeted with this compassion, although I produce a considerable amount it may also be very focusted and not really quality as being 'for others', more like 'for some others'.

What effect has my lack of consideration had on my relationships?

I do not have a wide variety of relationships. At this point they are all very few people in recovery.

Do I accept responsibility for my life and my actions? Am I able to carry out my daily responsibilities without becoming overwhelmed? How has this affected my life?

I belive I accept responsibility on the surface, but maybe I've not actually done the work of accepting responsibility, such as paying child support, etc. I am just now back to being able to carry out basic responsibilitires on a daily basis.

This seems like two different questions.....the first and then the 2nd and 3rd.

Do I fall apart the minute things don't go according to plan? How has this affected my life?

No, I'm rather resilient. I can take a beating like a pro. Possibiy this has affected my life becasue I think I may not have reaized how bad things really were, or were getting. I've been on the run my whole life most things don't even bother me any more. It's like I've become totally numb to my own existance. I mean, in my good times I'm numb, in the bad times, not so numb obviously.

Do I treat every challenge as a personal insult? How has this affected my life?

No, I've gotten over being insulted. More importantly I've gotten over insulting myself.

Do I maintain a crisis mentality, responding to every situation with panic? How has this affected my life?

Yes I do professionally, so probably personally also. No, not responding with panic, but responding with well through out solutoins to preceived problems in my life, or professional technical issues. Due to this my life is in a constant state of high alert.

Do I ignore signs that something may be seriously wrong with my health or with my children, thinking things will work out somehow? Describe.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I'm having a pretty bad day today. I am beginning to fully comprehend how damanged my life is and in how much danger I am in and that a likely outcome to my life could be a living hell.

I was just lost in thought daydreaming good things, then I came back to reality and it all sets in and I realize the nightmare is real life. And that there is no escape. THIS IS MY REALITY. I'm not going to figure my way out of this one. I'm not going to find a way to make a bunch of money to fix my problems.

I have no future. God I hate that feeling in my body when I realize this isn't a terrible dream. I really have fucked my life up this bad. I am so scared I will go to prison. I constantly contemplate suicide as an alternative.

I am heartbroken I will lose my cat Fire. I cried so hard when I realized I will break her heart when I am forced to abandon her. This has weighed heavy on my heart and today the landlady found out about Fire and as easy as that, I will lose her. Or if in my despirate search for new residency I'm unable to bring a pet, Fire will be left behind. I have nowhere, nobody to take her.

Arlen. Like I've done to all my children, I will be forced eventually to abandon her also. She loveds me so much and I can feel it. This is really hard for me. I want to end my life now while they are still young rather than break their hearts later. I will break Arlen's heart simply by leaving her and bouncing in and out of her life. And of course there is the possibility I will serve a prison sentence, devistating all relationships with my family.

Don told me I'm in it bad and that's the first time I've heard it from somebody else. It really helped me to accept my reality. My life is in utter shambles and my future is completely shattered.

I need a new identity. Don is offering me his, he has no criminal record. This is quite perfect, it will allow me an opportunity to assume an identity with a willing subject and learn the process for obtaining alternate identities.

Let's think this through. I get a fake id with my pic and Don's information. I obtain a lease using Don's background and credit via ssn and dob. Income will have to be shown. Possibly a faked bank account printout will work? Or fake w-2? Can they verify income?

item.title: What My Sponsor Did
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded: 1. My sponsor showed me in my life how I am beginning to live Step 1. I had been completely blind to any progress in Step 1, yet when given their perspective it became clear to me I was making progress. I am beginning to live Step 1 and my sponsor sees it in me and that's good enough for me.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I have to say this right now. I am starting my plan of suicide. I want to pack up and bus to Colorado and live homeless and am I planning a relapse? ultimately I want to kill myself with a fentanol booty bump, and I want it to look to my family that it was an OD, which means yes, I will need to relapse. But you spotted a hole in all of this, if suicide is really your goal, why pack up your stuff? Why not just abandon all of your stuff and buy a bus ticket?

Just pack a couple bags and go get on the bus. It does not need to be this difficult Mikki.

I don't want to die, but I don't want to live either and I'm terrified that while living in this hell limbo I will eventually make a mistake and do 9 years as a trans individual in a men's prison. I want death, but I don't want to hurt my family, including my recovery family. I have always and am thinking now that I wish I'd killed myself a few years ago when I reallly wanted too. What I don't want is my grandchildren to grow up knowing me only to lose me to prison or suicide years from now, when it will hurt them even more. Now is finally the time. Yes, I am justifying my suicide now to save Arlen, Aster and Aera the pain of knowing me.

Is my diseased mind telling me to kill myself becasue I love my grandchildren?

I saw the strength Shi has in dealing with the pain her father inflicted on her by commiting suicide. I'm faced with inflicting the same pain on so many people around me. I can spare Shi the pain of losing me by ending our relationship now.

I am violently pushing people away from me. I've been brutal to Kay when I love and respect her so fucking much.

or maybe I'm just an asshole. I minor blip on the Misift radar, forgotten in a month or so. Yeah, I am NOT going to hurt people needlessly.

I am so sorry Mauri, we love each other so much. You have been more important than anybody in my recovery. Abso-fucking-lutely.

I am going to push everybody in my life as far away from me as I can.

I can't ever tell anybody any of this or it will totally defeat the purpose of what I'm doing.

I need to quietly leave and end this life.

Fire is crying for me. Marlin is trying to console her, maybe leaving her here is the best plan. No, she's at my door, by my side now. I have to take care of Fire. My mother suggested leaving her here, but I can not abandon her like that. She would cry for me at my door till they just throw her out into the cold. Mom also suggested the Humane Society which is no kill, but that is the equlivalent of putting her into prison for life.

I'm trying to write a Facebook at for a local 'free pet' group, but it's very hard for me to write. I could really use some help with it. I have to find her a home before I leave.

This is fucking dangerous! I am putting myself into a very dark place. My emotions are coming on very strong and very painful and when they leave I'm left totally numb - like numb to everything. Like I don't feel any love for anybody right now.

I'm thinking about fentanol. I should start smoking it. No, I should not! The chances of enjoying it too much and laying around the Denver shelter high as fuck is too great. Although that sounds wonderful to me, the chances that during this drug induced bliss I find myself arrested is too great. So no, I will not be using when I return to Denver. I don't want to use meth either.

I'm really happy we came to that conclusion. Hmmm, but did I for the right reasons? I mean, is the decision to not do something becasue of its possible negative consequences really the right reason to not do something? Shouldn't you do something becaue it's the right thing to do, not becasue of consequences?

Maybe this is what's wrong with me

I woulld rather say I'm not going to use because not using is the right thing to do, not because I might get arrested. I may use a drug to end my life but I will die clean as I refuse to use it to get high. I will die clean, I will give that much to my family and friends. Sigh, then they will know it was suicide dumb ass. And your friends don't have to know about it anyway. Nobody in recovery will know you offed yourself. Yes they will, Chloe will contact all my FB friends and tell them - nevermind you only have a couple recovery friends there - nobody will know.

Anyway, my very loud and self conversing old prison bitch roommate just arrived and I can already feel the pressure building. Ok, headphones, Spotify.....

https://open.spotify.com/track/4zXZ5Mq2L6jnsOsTssgRh8?si=1ff4d8b8752449a5

I've been listening to music, I also contacted Mauri. I had to, I couldn't just leave her hanging like that. I thought long long time before I sent that message. I feel good right now. Yes, but I know it's fleeting. I know I will soon realize the nightmare is real. The music is really helping to keep out the pain right now.

I need to talk to Kay soon. I don't know what to say. I was contemplating letting her just read this and I was rereading the above and it all sort of sounded like a story to me, like it wasn't real.... that I could just share this to Kay and maybe Mauri and they would understand why I lashed out at all of them and everything would be ok and I could be happy again.

And then I realized that no, although I'm pretty fucking emotionally numb right now, this is my path. I have to leave. I can't go to Misfits tonight and let everything be ok. I have to go to Denver and end my life. This is not a terrible dream. This is not just some story in a blog, this is your life Mikki. These are your thoughts and will be your actions.

How do I leave Arlen? She needs you. No, remember, this is best. Remember, as she grows up you will be less and less important. Hell, you can't even understand most of what she says to you and it breaks both your hearts. I hate the frustration she has to deal with. I hate myself for not being able to understand her.

So decision time Mikki. Do you disappear and just let things go? Do you go to Misfits? Do you go to a new meeting? Do you go to the psych ward (yes). If you go to the psych ward for help, why don't you share this with your friends and reach out to them for help?

Things don't seem as dark rigth now as they were earlier. Just tell somebody what you are thinking. You don't have to let this be your life. Things are not that bad, well yes, they are, but I'm safe right now right? No, you are not! You have headphones on Mikki, as soon as you take them off it starts. How long will you make it before you assult that bitch? There is not fucking telling, I have absolutely no idea what will happen tonight. Bad things just happen.

Ok, then you MUST find a new place to live. Go live with your mother

I am mentally ill. I am an addict.

item.title: I'm Not Ok Today
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've been off Effexor XR 300mg for 2 days today. I can't get the prescription filled due to insurance issues. I will be fine once this is fixed.

I don't want to talk to my recovery friends. I wanted to talk to Daniele, but she shut me down. I would talk to Jae but she's not responding. I've been listening to my Spotify playlists, but I'm only picking out songs I'd play while high, or sad songs. I can't stop myself. My heart is really hurting, just a dull ache. My eyes are wet from crying.

I don't want to hurt myself but the thought has already crossed my mind. I have a 45 but no bullets, which can easily be fixed tomorrow at WalMart. I know I don't want to hurt myself but it seems my mind is riddled with addictive thinking, meaning I'm powerless and powerless means doing things against your own will. That much NA has taught me. So I'm scared.

I have the gun because two weeks ago I was suicidal and I wanted to familiarize myself with the weapon. I figured it out, putting it against my head and pulling the trigger, in my mouth practicing the proper angle so as to not just blow part of my face off. I also praticed once with a death hood I had assembled to get comfortable and better understand the feeling of inhaling pure helium. Either method would work fine and both have pros and cons.

It's a real shame there was no trigger lock on it and it was kept in the same place I had previously gotten it out to threaten my mother a long while back. You would think she would move it and/or secure it, but no, and she thinks she's so smart. I might as well kill her with it first as just killing myself with her gun will kill her anyway in a rather cruel and slow death of self-torture.

I think if I used the gun I would shoot myself in the heart. I don't want to blow my face off. I want to die with my face on and pretty and thus my first choice is to use a death hood, but when I get to the point to off myself I'll want it to be quick and without thought therefore a shot to the heart will both be very easy to perform and make a statement about my death. If I'm lucky I'll be conscience for some time after the shot, so I should do it laying on the ground looking up at the sky, maybe under a nice tree in a graveyard.

I wish I had a little 22 like the one my stepfather pointed at my head and told me he could kill me with if he wanted. It would damage my heart without severe trauma and leave me conscience for several minutes. I just worry it might deflect off my breastbone, so the 45 will have to be used. A 380 would be perfect. I wonder if I can buy one with my new ID?

I put way too much thought into suicide. Well maybe not since I've been pondering it my entire life. I wish I'd done it as a teenager and saved myself from this tragedy of a life. But then Chloe, Myka, Natasha, Aster, Arlen, and Aera wouldn't exist.

I just found a bed bug on me, I brought them into my mother's house. Shame on me. Well, at least she will have something to remember me by.

Daniele just offered me some batshit as to why she blew me off. When I reached out to her asking if the number I used was correct she replied "yes" and then "why". I replied I just wanted to say hi and she replied to that with "hi".

item.title: The Ability to be Vulnerable
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
"She doesn’t hate you. She just lacks the ability to be vulnerable and show the love you need to feel!!!" -Shi.

Shi said this as a response to my question I asked: "Why does my mother hate me"?

It is a really beautiful answer. Simple, clear, and concise. It is elegant. So I want to understand it.

Before I can understand the phrase "lacks the ability" I need to know what having that ability looks like. So what does "having the ability to be vulnerable mean"? Is there like a fuzzy between oversharing and being vulnerable?

Vulnerable may be the word used when somebody shows emotion.

Vulnerable may be putting your life in the hands of your HP.

Being vulnerable may be being in the state of true listening. It is dangerous to really listen and to not question things or looks for holes or lies, just believe what you are hearing and take the time to think about what it means before replying.

item.title: Today's Thoughts 4/20/2024 Happy THC Day!
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
These are thoughts I started as txt to people but got too long so I put them here today. They are in no particular order and end with some keyword notes and movies Misfit Kourtney recommended.

Thoughts

One thing I'd like to share back with you is that at one point you said I think "I want to get well" and I remembered in a lit study I was in reading It Works Step 1 I had noticed all the uses of the word 'willing'. And I talked about the difference between wanting and willing and rephrased it as "I'm willing to get well". Then I thought "Am I willing to get well?". I wondered if being willing would help my mental health. Then I realized that absolutely it would, I just need to become willing to work this program.

I also though this during you share. I've been to prison before and done a bit of time. I had a friend that I went through intake with. After we both got settled in our separate housing units, we started to walk the fence on day with was one mile all around. After a month my friend got a little TV for his cell. He started not coming out to walk and I kept asking and encouraging him not to hole up in his cell every day, that was mental suicide. He didn't listen and didn't come out for like two weeks. I was not allowed in his housing unit but one day I snuck in and found him in his cell. I encouraged him to come out, it was a beautiful day and I missed his company and conversation. He eventually got pretty short with me and I left. We never walked or taken together again l and if in passing we passed each other we did not acknowledge each other. I was very sad, I'd lost my only friend so I found another.

I also continued to walk the fence every day, 12 times. I also worked for 10 minutes cleaning the gym bathroom (with a hose and a bottle of cleaner splashed on the floor - I didn't scrub anything) then spent 2 hours working out, then playing handball will the sun went down. I also frequented the library for educational books and found one on electronics which I loved.

One day I was laying on my bunk reading the electronics book and I heard a pig noise. I disregarded it until the Lieutenant showed up. He was the person in charge. He walked past my cell and I saw his face and turned back to my book. He passed, then returned a few seconds later, opened my door and instructed me to come out.

I was told I made pig noises at the BBW guard. I turned to her and it was the guard I've never talked to but have had a friendly relationship through gentle eye contact and smiles. Once I was dying of food poisoning, laying on my bunk and she came into my cell (against the rules), put her hand on my lower leg in the fetal position (totally against the rules), and said "Poor baby". I just looked at her and she left.

I've never begged in my life till that moment. I told her I would never and that she knew that. I begged her in front of the entire cell block (they must have enjoyed that). I was taken to the hole and put in a little open bar cage. The woman guard had to put me into the hole, as she wrote the report I pleaded with her. She still refused to look into my eyes, but she got up came over to the cage and very quietly said "I'm sorry, these are the Leutenants orders, there's nothing I can do", but what she didn't say was "I know it was not you".

I was put into a cell with some scum bag on the top bunk (the top sucks). The door had no window but there was a window facing out and I could see the sun. Thank god it wasn't direct, it would have been unbearably hot.

Fulton heat

item.title: Mikki's Guide
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So I want this to be all the things I've learned about living in a feminine manner, or trying to at least. These are all my opinions, and please correct me where I've made mistakes <3.

Hair

Washing

Personally, I wash my hair once a week, sometimes every 10 days. I personally love dry shampoo. I've just reciently started using it so my hair washing is down to once ever two weeks. One Monday I wash, next week I dry shampoo, next week I wash. That works for me, and quite honestly my hair looks spectacular after the dry shampoo!

Don't use anything sold at Walmart, Target, Walgreens, or CVS. I only use professional products, I'm fortunate that my beautiful loving daughter Myka is a professional. <3. She taught me all this about hair. I strongly suggest buying quality products online. Search Amazon for highest rated/purchased products and go from there.

Brush your hair before you shower. Bring a gentle hair tie. Hair is at its weakest when it is wet. Be very gentle with your hair! Rinse your hair. Apply shampoo directly to the scalp. The point is to not wash all of your hair with shampoo, just the scalp. When you rinse your hair, the shampoo will run down to the ends and will gently wash away some oil.

So that process needs to be adjusted to a person's hair type and oil levels. The point is to only use as much shampoo as is necessary, however, this does not mean you simply use less or more shampoo, it means you wash more or less the shaft of the hair.

I wanted to give my hair a good washing today so I used shampoo all over it (something I never do) and my hair is so frizzy it's insane. I put a lot of coconut oil on it to calm it down and brushed it forever.

On to conditioning. The hair is very fragile when wet so be gentle. You need to get as much water out of the hair, then apply the conditioner. I suggest gently squeezing the hair. Do not flip the hair back and forth flinging water, this will damage the hair!

I prefer to hang my hair over my head and put equal amounts on both hands and smooth the conditioner onto the lower ends of the hair strand. The purpose here is to not get conditioner on the roots. Of course, this should be adjusted to personal preference and hair type. I don't condition my roots at all or even close. I then put my hair up into a very lose bun and start shaving.

Shaving

I have to shave my entire body (short a Brizlian lasering). It's important to understand the hair growth directions of the hair, if you want that ultra smooth skin.

If you have full grown-out body hair, I suggest using clippers to make the hair shaveable. Or totally go the Nair route.

I personally prefer Venus razors, obviously the more blades the better! Well there is something you have to realize. If you

So during summer I keep up with shaving, but it will fall off completely in Winter, as I'm currently alone. Anyway, if the hair is long it will quickly clog even a sharp razor. I have to get the most out of every razor because I go through a lot (and I'm broke).

Nair

So I totally learned this secret in Buenos Aires. I've been using Nair a very long time and always read the instructions. When in BA I bought actual Nair (tm) and it came with a plastic razor but instead of blades it was just plastic. Like a scraper. I read the instructions before use and it was essentially:

  1. Apply product
  2. Wait time until test
  3. Use the scraper to gently test a small area.
  4. When ready, use the scraper to gently remove the product from the body.

I've never seen those instructions or the scraper on a bottle of American Nair. Probably a lawsuit or something, I don't know. Anyway, follow the foreign method of using Nair, it works much better! I got a plastic scraper from Lowes/Home Depot paint department.

item.title: CPS Request
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So a CPS agent contacted AANA today and requested a user's attendance for the past 5 weeks. I looked up the person's attendance and there was only 1.

My first thought was to help this person out and forge her some attendance. I talked to Lexus and she wisely cited subpoena concerns, but those don't concern me at all. So I said I wanted to do something good for somebody and help the user out. It felt really good that I was going to give out free goodwill!

Then Lexus (thank you) asked what department this was for and I told her "CPS - Child Protective Services" and I was like "Yeah, I can help this user get her kids back!" But the word 'child' stuck in my mind and I realized this person was most likely in active addiction. Maybe the kids are better off without their mommy?

That's when I realized the mistake I almost made! That was a close one, I almost committed a moral violation, and I also almost committed a legal violation, and I almost destroyed the integrity of my app with an email history, and I almost possibly contributed to putting children in harm's way.

The user claims to have 10 attendance records since 4/1/2024, but only has one. I sent this information to CPS in the most professional manner I could (I should have fed it into ChatGPT and had it perfected).

I also accidentally sent this to the user first. I probably should not have done that, but possibly it helps me be more transparent to users to see all the communication I have with their case workers. But it's really going to piss a bitch off, for real! I'm fucking with her getting her kids back because the app lost her attendance. So, I don't want the app to get a bad name. Like, what if this user has like 1M followers on you-face-toc-x? Great, right? No publicity is bad publicity! Tell all your followers about the app!

item.title: Self Honesty is Bullshit
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Being in recovery I've heard said that 'Honesty' is one of the core spiritual principals I can not do without and that the most important aspect of honesty is self-honesty. I want to challenge the later assertion regarding self-honesty.

Yesterday was Father's Day. Although I no longer identify as a father (or a mother) I am still my children's parent and I'd like to think my children still hold me in that regard, just maybe not highly. Yesterday afternoon I woke up and received only a happy day wish from my mother (who reminded me of the day itself 😌). I messaged my son-in-law and wished him a happy day and he reciprocated, as did my daughter shortly after. I spoken pleasantly with my other adult daughter and there was no mention of the day. My other two children never contacted me.

It was also odd that my daughter did not have the grandkids call me yesterday, but I assumed they were all focused on the day for their father, so it's ok. I didn't put too much thought into all this as I spent a couple of hours doing myself up that day, for no reason other than for myself.

I simply assumed that my children no longer perceived me as a father figure and I'm ok with that, although they all still call me 'dad' (he/him).

I was thinking about a date I had the other night which was very sexually disappointing. Besides the fact the guy about broke my bed in half at one point. The really odd part was that afterward, he bolted. He pointed at the door and looked at me and I waved him off, quite literally. That was the last I'd heard from him and I found that a bit strange so I was pondering the reason this morning as he clearly had a very good time in my bed and said so in a message this morning.

My thinking was all over the place, but I came to a reason that I liked. I mean, isn't that what thinking is usually all about? Wondering until we come to some made-up conclusion that we can accept, regardless of reality? Yeah, that's exactly what thinking is. Well, I think my previous bedmate didn't contact me because he thought "There is no way that girl is ever going to want me to come back". Quite true, but I did want to hear about how amazing I was. Guys are dumb.

Anyway, he was right to not want to contact me because now that he has and I can quite literally hurt that man terribly with simple words, and he's right to be hesitant. I've little doubt I'm the hottest thing he's ever even gotten close to let alone in bed with his entire life, and now I'm about to laugh at him and tell him to kick rocks.

He really should have complimented me, or thanked me, or something. He deserves it, but I won't be mean. I'll let him remember the awesome sex I gave him without soiling it in his mind like a bitch.

I wondered if I was lying to myself, having made up reasons for two big life situations that satisfied me. Then I realized I could have easily come to some very dark conclusions that I turned inward. Yikes. So, yeah, I think I like the reasons I came up with.

So, those two stories told I'm back to self-honesty. I'll have to come back and finish, fuck.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So many amazing things have just happened in my life, and I must record the day.

Today started very dark; I didn't wake till sunset, sleeping further until well dark outside. I started the day in a terrible mood, watching my typical political comedians just angered me, I could not focus, and working frustrated me. I could feel it coming on, my thoughts were inward and hateful and harmful, I was becoming ashamed and questioning myself, and I even throught about how I can relate with Shi and how dark we can become so quickly.

I had received news last night that I had not yet processed, and it was very good news. I kind of put it on the back burner, but it came to mind and I thought "I'm simply not going to start off with depression"S

So I did what I do best, yes, that's right, work! I worked very hard, not really with a goal in mind I just jept accomplishing things, such as

  1. Creation of App Store Profile for Recovery Sky IOS
  2. Creation of Play Store Profile for Recovery Sky Android
  3. Build and distribute v1.0.0 build 2 to both platforms.
  4. Create Alpha Testing Tracks

It was very late, but it felt really good to accomplish those things. Recovery Sky is now an App in existence! I also spent the time to give the app a simple icon and images as well as App Store listing images. It felt really good to have accomplished all of this!

I don't really have anybody to celebrate all of this with, so I just kept working. The next task was the Zoom Meeting SDK App submission, a dreaded task. Zoom must 'approve' the app before I can use it publically. Their requirements are very high actually, and I was a bit intimidated., I am required to submit a lot of documentation.

I just put my head down and kept going slow and steady. Once I realized I could use ChatGPT ❤️ to generate the text documents, those all fell into place. I did spend some considerable time creating an extensive architecture diagram that's useful to show. [later]

All in all, I produced ALL the required documentation, all in a very professional format, to Zoom Review. I quickly withdrew it, I want to get a static website up first, then. submit it, like ASAP.

I'm very pleased with myself, I acomplished many huge milesones in the past few week. Well, three weeks ago is actually when I created iRecovry and have renamed that to RecoverySky.

This is all wonderful progress; I will submit the app to Zoom and relax for 72 hours. In the meantime, I'm enjoying having a new 1-year lease on my current residence! Yay! 2025 (oh gawd help us)

All of these wonderful accomplishments and relief and confidence building combined with the relief that this next year will be ok. And I'll just keep on working!

item.title: Ramona
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
When we moved into the small mountain community of Ramona CA my 9th grade year I thought my world had ended. I was shy and introverted and only ever had one girl friend my whole life. Jewel was my bff since kindergarten and I spent as much time as I could at her house. I'd always wanted to be a girl, Wonder Woman specifically! Jewel and I called each other sisters and grew up together.

Ramona was a weird place, but I loved how slutty the girls dressed and acted. I had no chance to be friends with them, bitches. So I was a bit of a loner till one day I found a group of guys playing some role-playing space game. I immediately fell in love with the game and begged to play. Eventually, I was allowed to make a character, so I made the only woman in the group, a technician. I was of course laughed at but I really wanted friends so in the game I went full slut, I loved it!

One day, walking home behind an apartment complex, a girl falls out of her window right in front of me! It scared the crap out of me! She jumped up, closed the window, grabed her bag, asked me who I was and started walking to the street. I told her I just moved here. She asked if I smoke weed and I hadn't but said I wanted to. Her name was Jordan, she had a connection at the convience store. She was a party girl, was in foster care and was on the run every night. Some guy picked her up and I rode in the back seat and we all got high. Then he got us drunk.

. We walked to the grocery store where she stole some lipstick, and I stole a mascara. We instantly bonded.

She was Jordan, my new best friend, she was a Jr and liked to party. She was sexy AF and knew it! We ended up at the one convience store in town. We

It was hilarious and when she ran I followed her to the one convience store in town. Her name was Nikki, she loved the Sex Pistols, bleached blonde, painted red lips, dark eyes, and she was wearing some concert t-shirt and flipflops. She would put on music, lock the door, and go party with the Sr's. We became great friends, but I still wasn't out with my gender identity so I tended to stay away from the guys. it was weird for me, but I did hang out with her in her room when she was there, which was a lot because we loved to hang out. I would pratice doing her makeup and dressing her up. I told her about Jewel and eventually I just cried and told her I wish I was a girl.

She asked me if I was gay and kinda looked at me and I said that Jewel and I were in love

item.title: Letter to Shianna
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
My dearest Shi,

My heart keeps breaking when I think about what I've done to you. The pain I've caused you, I'm so sorry 💔. Please know that I did not ever want to hurt you. You did not deserve any of this. All of this is my fault.

You don't know how much it means to me that you want to keep going with me as a friend ❤️. I know you must really love me (I always did) because what I did to you was the worst. I know that.

I’ve been up all night, these past 2 maybe 3 hours I’ve been writing. It started as a letter to you, but I got lost way off in the weeds talking about myself. I do think all that stuff is valuable, so I put it into another document for my therapist. I didn’t think you would want to read it, it was long. I’m fine if you want to read it all, it’s on my blog, but I never got to the point I wanted to express to you.

I want you to know how precious you are. If you can still allow me in your life, wow, what can’t you do? This is, without a doubt, the single greatest thing I’ve ever witnessed in my life.

What I want is to try to tell you some things that you would rightly think are lies, or I’m trying to not look so bad, cover my ass, whatever. I know how our fucked up our minds work. So, I'm just going to write my thoughts and not craft a story and I'll start with this. I broke your heart.

So, I feel it's important for me to try to explain the thoughts and feelings that get me to this point otherwise, I'll simply repeat myself. This is getting very old in my life, Shi. I ultimately hurt everybody who loves me. Everybody. Even you now. So, I want to use this opportunity you have offered and be a better friend to you! Yeah, I wish I could just splatter that with cute emoji and pretend things will be better, but that never workds.

I started writing an essay about my childhood and why I'm such a fucked up person. [I'll link to it.] But for now, let's just agree I am severely fucked up. I believe we relate very well in that regard.

I absolutely did not remember saying those things to Kris, I'm not doubting I did, I'm saying that when I was texting you the day after I blew up, I really did not remember saying those things to Kris. I was not

I did not mean any of those things that I said to Kris. I have a very bad habit of saying things that I don't mean to get my anger or frustration out, that have caused tremendous pain and destruction. I have also told Kris that I wanted to kill people. I've told Kris a lot, and she encouraged it, well, not the killing people part, for that she put up a wall.

Without getting into the weeds...I keep getting into the weeds. There was a point a long while back when I felt our relationship start to stretch thin. I don't remember the specifics, but I felt a loss. So, like a good psycho bitch, I turned it inward and thought of a 1000 reasons you don't like me anymore. During that time I also txted Jorday, quite a long one, that he never acknowledged, about your addiction actually. I thought maybe I offended him, or pissed you off, and I really thought you were done with me.

That's when I started the group. One of the reasons I wanted to bring everybody together was because I thought it might help you to have more direct communication with other women in recovery that I valued. I thought maybe it would be good for everybody.

I took that Lexus stuff pretty hard. I probably did do something horrible to her I didn't even realize. But back then, I didn't think that, but I thought of 1000 other reasons why she left like that.

I very quickly did not like the group. I found I liked 1:1 communication better. I understand the dynamic of the group, especially as simply a place to get things out and get support. But I have to talk about my problems, which I would frequently do, then delete them. It has really bothered me that nobody ever asked me why I delete.

Another serious issue I had was that I brought Tara there, hoping maybe she could connect with another. I kept asking her if anybody had reached out, and I kept suggesting privately the other members reach out to her. I was really upset nobody ever did. This was a group of friends, that I thought would be welcoming, beyond the recovery bullshit support group where everybody sends hearts and hugs and words of encouragement, but nobody actually knows each other. I'd say this was my unrealistic expectation.

item.title: AI Journal Report
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Use AI to review a person's (guided) journal entries used to produce a concise overview report of a client's journal entries during a specific window. The report will be tailored for psychotherapists. Extensive research work with professionals will be necessary to acquire the data to AI model the reports and extract critical and/or subtle data points. This will provide therapists will insight into how and about what a person journaled, without allowing direct access to the journal entries themselves. This will also conserve a therapists time by providing a quick view into a clients life between visits.

I have a hard time with therapy. I love it, or maybe I just love having somebody forced to listen to me for 45 minutes. I'm going to be more open with my therapist. There are some very significant things I've realized recently, like critical things I wanted to address in therapy. I didn't write them down.

item.title: Privy White Bitch
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded: I was coming over the Truman Tunnel in the Rocky Mountains of Colorado heading to Denver from LA. I saw on the side a car spewing steam and a rather terrified looking young woman. As always, I immediately pulled over. I just motioned for her to pop the hood, her upper hose had burst, the car was going no where soon. I communicated this to her and asked where she was headed. Her family in Denver was her destination, coming from University in Salt Lake. I offered her my identification, and encouraged her to call her father and communicate the situation and my information, which she did. The drive to Denver was really nice and the conversation was amazing. I dropped her off where requested and gave her my email, which she never used, privy white bitch.

item.title: Dear Mikki
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
You have a very strong and complicated mind that is also terribly hurt, scared, angry, lonely, and quite ill. Your mind is actively creating a reality based on invalid data. The algorithms that process the invalid data have many bugs themselves. It seems it has always been difficult for you to perceive reality properly in social situations. You have lived your whole life with these issues and they have become so engrained in your minds algorithms, and they color your perceptions taken as fact, that is impossible for you to get a grip on this spiral you are in. It will continue, you will hit bottom, and hopefully you will stand back up.

Please Mikki, let go of these faults inside of you! You are the one holding on to them, understandably you have lived your live by them, it's scary and difficult to change and let go the pillars of your life.

We both know how much you want to clean your mind and start fresh, you want to 'debug g=c800', your mind and wipe the metal of your mind clean. I know that's what you are seeking. Please stop this self destruction, destroying your life will not reset things, this does not end with you emerging as a phoenix. It ends with insanity, homelessness, and suicide by police.

How do I change my own mind?

The answer to that is the obvious Mikki, you have to make decisions. Not the decisions you make in your recliner, the ones you make in your heart. You know the difference, and we both know you don't make those kinds of decisions very often. The last of which, well was that you are currently a shit person, as Mauri would say, but before that it was to quit using drugs, almost 2 years ago.

So you decided to quit drugs, yes. But did you decide to change? Yeah, nope. And here we are now with the next heart made decision being that you are a shit person. So let's detail, or debug as you love, what went wrong here, it's not complicated.

You quit drugs but didn't change your life. You have been a clean, but active addict struggling terribly through the past 3 years of recovery. I bet it's because you are still operating on addict addict mindroutines. Mikki, just because you have new recovery data coming in, if you don't change the mindroutines processing that data, I'm pretty sure it will all just be corrupted data, memories, experiences, relationships, and spirituality. I could continue this line of thought, but you know where it is going, I hope. You are a pretty fucked up bitch Mikki.

I don't mean that to insult or degrade you, but at this point, I do think it's best to now focus on this last internal judgement of your character. This was a much harder acomplishment than the quit using one, harder, but so less important in your life. Realize that Mikki, ok, I am, and this is what I'm thinking:

You are basing the hardness of the decisions on the factors involving them. Being homeless and hopeless makes life changing decisions pretty easy to make, don't they? And having experienced a lifetime of being told drugs are my problem, my mind broke, or awoke, whatever, I made the decision to quit drugs. It was pretty easy, besides the whole homeless part, that was still a fucking struggle. As was the full bag of meth in my pocket that whole next day and night, remember that? Few addicts, on day one, can resist the urge to use with it in their pocket. That was tremendously powerful to accomplish wasn't it?

I have thought many times in my life about a movie I saw as a child called "Mazes and Monsters" It was an anti-fantasy game movie, depicting a group of university students playing such a game in their free time. [IMDB][Wikipedia]. I was very active in D&D and that was the target of the movie. As a christian I was not allowed to play D&D - it was satanic. And well, I did always play a chaotic evil wizard.

I have always wondered if I'd become Robbie, honestly the idea back then and the end of the movie was very beautiful but also so sad, that he lost all his friends. Here is the wiki plot ending of the movie:

"The film ends with the friends visiting Robbie at his parents' estate, hoping to pick up their friendship where they left off. Though he is now in regular counseling, it is implied that Robbie will live out the rest of his life trapped in his imaginary world, believing he is Pardieu, that his friends are their characters, and that he is living at an inn (actually his parents' home) and paying for his boarding with a coin that "magically" reappears in his pouch each morning. He then tells his shocked friends of a great evil lurking in the forest across the lake, believing that it threatens the lives of the "innkeeper" and his wife. The three, feeling sorry for Robbie and guilty for their role in his psychotic break, decide to engage him in a "game" of Mazes and Monsters, letting Robbie dictate the events to them. In the end, Kate says, "And so ... we played the game again ... for one last time."

Besides the friends sadness, I remember Robbie being very happy living in his fantasy. I know my mind back then was more than ready to live out a life of fantasy. I wished for that reality, which is why I still think of this memory.

I have two stories I should mention as they both relate. One just happened, a friend shared with me her UFO video and I came to the conclusion it is an airplane and have the trigonometry to prove it is an optical illusion. My friend probably enjoys having this video and is rather entertained by the unknown.

So, do I attempt the explain the rational explanation - probably a difficult prospect to do, and I get frustrated so easily and it shows like my nose, or pink toes, or pantyhose, lol, whatever. I'm not going down that route. So my options are, to just move on, or to engage further, possibly putting myself in a position where I may have to lie about my thoughts? Is it wrong for me to engage in a playful conversation, and possibly encourage a fantasy, or mental illness? I told her I loved the videos, and I did, she has a beautiful voice (jersey girl) and hearing her fright made my heart smile.

item.title: Don't you not miss......
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
1. Staring at smoke detectors and wondering if it's a camera?
  2. Trying for days to sleep after finally coming down?
  3. Remembering everything you did?
  4. (cont'd)

I'm not feeling very creative at the moment. This is similar to a list I created on My Spaced back when I was Darth Amphetamine entitled "You were born to be an addict if....". I came up with almost 10 really good ones and the post gained a lot of attention in the drug forums, and that's how I ended up on a Greyhound to LA and my lab in the luggage. As for the list, the only one I can remember is:

"You were born to be an addict if your mother weighed out your formula on digital scales"
"You were born to be an addict if daddy brought your formula home at 2am every night"
(the remaining lost in My Space)

  1. Lying to those you love.
  2. Putting on layers of makeup to cover the growing ugly.
  3. Abandoning my children's childhoods by destroying myself.
  4. Always fighting with my Mother.
  5. Being a slave to drugs.
  6. Living in a fantasy world.
  7. Making friends with the worst people possible.
  8. Being robed and cheated.
  9. (cont'd)
