item.title: The Newcomer
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I am so tired of finding fault. This was originally titled "The Newcomer" I wanted to write a poem, but my brain is not working. So I thought to write an essay and maybe document my thoughts regarding the 'NA newcomer experience' as seen through my eyes. I realized, although that needs written, I simply can't. If I continue allowing this conflict inside me, I'm going to go nuts. Besides I really have something I need to say instead.

I am unable to work. I'm being attacked by Ravins and they are ruthless. I've honestly felt, not believed, but felt my mac was possessed by demons. I can say I am currently facing an obstacle that is 5x past my estimate, and I'm still struggling.

I am making mistakes that I have never made before. Serious mistakes that can cripple a system. For example, I kept getting confused which terminal session was local and which was a cloud server. I am ashamed that I found myself erroneously running commands on a server. I'm unable to establish a productive development environment locally that is easy to debug. I think that is what comes first.

I simply need to add to the core services the cli interface and configuration options in the zoom services, I think, let me verify that.l

item.title: Revised NA Clairity Statement
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
We are presented with a dilemma when NA members
refer to their God, the clarity of the NA
message is blurred. To speak in this manner suggests
that one Higher Power is somehow
separate from the rest, requiring special recognition.
Narcotics Anonymous makes no distinction between
Higher Powers. Our literatures propagates this misunderstanding,
and correction is needed to allow us to concentrate on personal
Higher Powers.

We are presented with a dilemma when NA literature
identify itself as religion free while retaining the
Christian God references, the clarity of the NA
message is blurred. To speak in this manner suggests
that there is one Higher Power, that one God is somehow
separate from the rest, requiring special recognition.
Narcotics Anonymous makes no distinction between
Higher Powers. The relationships with our Higher Powers
is all inclusive and personal. Leave your God at the fucking door,
I don't care if your god has a dick. Keep that shit to yourself.

item.title: The Music of My Recovery
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
One aspect of my recovery from addiction is my recovery music. There are some songs with recovery as the theme, and these can be very good. However, I've discovered that finding recovery in a song is all about personal interpretation. When I listen to a song, I always try to find a way to relate to it personally, and one primary way is relating with recovery. It's really quite amazing how many songs turn into recovery songs when I'm seeking that message. It's really very simple actually, I'll provide some examples.

I Will Survive by Gloria Gaynor is a perfect example. I've always loved this song, how can you not? Feminine, beautiful, and powerful! A woman kicking a man out of her life, dealing with the pain, and standing tall, strong, proud, and beautiful. My new interpertation: A woman kicking a drugs out of her life, dealing with the pain, and standing tall, strong, proud, and beautiful.

Next up is Amazing by Aerosmith, which I think is actually about addiction and recovery. It deserves a place in my list. All love for this song ❤️
https://open.spotify.com/track/60a5c4dDARPsksClcom0OD?si=5f4d15bbe1914cb3

item.title: Today 01/28/2025
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
The blessings were many! Ending with me just seeing that my grandson Aster (6) finally responded to all my txt messages, with an exclamation reaction ‼️! It's a start! It's a blessing. ❤️. <--- blessings come from the heart 💯.

Aster is my 'sweet love' ❤️ now. Well, I'm not getting quite the emotional reaction out of him these past few weeks out of that name. He used to turn to me and say "I'm ur sweet love?!?! 😁❤️". I love Aster so much it breaks my heart. Aster is a very sweet boy, he's not afraid to challenge gender boundaries and embraces the feminine, when he wants to. If I was ever granted one with, I would wish that Aster would let me teach him, and guide him. It took a year being around Aster before he really warmed up to me. It is possible I was not always as welcoming as I could have been for him, I was very engaged with baby Arlen at the time. I was her robot and she drove me around the house like a pro!

My daughter Myka kept Aster from me his first year of life. I came into town to see my new baby, I'd visited before and was getting used to Will, more specifically, Myka's relationship with Will. They were very young and doing well. I loved them both very much, and my beautiful new grandson very much. ❤️

I was there for Aster's birth, all but the very last moments when I stepped out. I can only hope Myka remembers the love I showed her that day. ❤️. I was there for her 100% as the rest of the family, Martha my ex-wife, waited. I think now that Myka loves her mother more, after my last fall, or at least pities her less than me, at least that's my hope.

I was not a good parent to Myka, I admit that. I broke her young heart so terribly, her seeing me arrested and taunted by the police. I fought to gain custody of Myka when my ex fell into terrible addiction, but I was laughed out of the 'talks' when it was revealed I dress in women's clothing. When asked, I proudly responded "Yes I do." and stood my ground as a loving kind human being. Discussions on my custody was immediately ended. My lawyer said it was unwise to push for a judge's decision in a matter regarded at the time as a moral failure. I stood, my mother stood with me, I said "I am done with this.", and we both turned and walked out.

At that time, single, alone, and financially stable, I indulged my addiction to its fullest. I worked just fine in my hotel room, writing software for clients, climbing to rank 49th on the planet on the then top freelancing side Guru, which was mostly ruled by 300,000 Indian developers that worked for $5's and $10's. Drunk as hell I wrote the first "Happy Heads", which was launched in a Toronto Mall in a kiosk similar to the old old old 3 picture friend both. Except what I built was software that would play a prerecorded video of dancers with the heads of the participants sitting in the booth. The music was played live, with a choice of many popular selections. At the end of the production, my software, having recorded the participants, would robotically produce a DVD of the presentation! Yeah, bitches, that's what I do drunk 💋.

My next contract was boring as fuck, I wrote software that was then sold to radio stations that was then used to book the advertising slots (using some secret algorithm I was never granted access to, lol). It was a sales tool, and not play to air :-(. But it made Mad Dog a lot of money, that's for sure, and he paid me well. Which I spent on the at that time legal, bath salts. That shit would make me go blind and drop me to the floor with heart issues. The last time I used that I crashed in my car in a Wal-Mart parking lot.

When the cop banged his flashlight on the window I woke up. I had been somewhere else. I politely rolled down my window as the cop asked "are you ok". I thought I had been just sleeping, but asked him "why?", something was wrong I knew immediately. He said I had been screaming and that somebody had reported it. I was very confused and said I was ok. He asked again, I remember the man looked concerned, very concerned. I said no. I broke down and told him I was using salts and I cried 😢. Somebody cared. He asked me if I had any more and I said yes, he said to give it to him. I dug a big bag out of my ash tray and gave it to him. He said thank you, and asked me for my license, I gave it to him, and he walked back to his car.

I realized what was about to happen and I was terrified. I remember now not what I was wearing, but I'm sure it was sexy and slutty as can be. In that moment, I remember the terror of going to jail like this. Previous times, yes, I was strong and held my head high, and stared as straight as I could, but right now I needed desperately to pee my panties.

I added a bit of humor as the officer kindly returned my license and said I was free to go. I know not my words, but I will never again feel the gratitude again I felt that moment. I felt free, I thanked him for taking the drugs and begged him to make it illegal. He told me that it would soon be and I was happy, I was really happy. I never used bath salts again, but my severe abuse of alcohol sadly continued (spoiler alert, I lived, and Flash did too - I loved that little mighty dawg)

Back to the original story, let me go review one sec...., oh yes, my 'alcoholic parenting' of Myka, as she put it (yes I read your txt's baby. Oh myka I loved you so much, I love you so much right now my heart is breaking 💔🥀. I want so baddly a close emotional realtioship with you. What we have is not right and we both know it. I know you do, I hope you do, 💔. I have never held a baby as much as you insisted I do, and we loved each other every second. I hope you remember when I held your babies and how Arlen would point me around the room and I carried that love everywhere she wanted, as she wished. Sorry to plagiarize. I hope Aera makes full use of my chauffeur services as much as she can. I am so in love with your family, and you Myka, and I am so sad. 💔

I'll move on to my princess Arlen, well she's the big sister princess technically, as she yielded 'princess' to Aera late summer 24'. I love Arlen with all my heart, but tonight it is breaking, she's quickly moving from the 'little kid' phase and into the 'online kid' phase. You know this, and I love you for not allowing Arlen to play games while I'm at your home. But the fact remains, which you know, that Arlen will soon become so absorbed in the online world that we may seldom see her eyes.

Myka, I am not at all laying blame! I am merely stating what I see the beginning of. Yes, I totally understand the pressures and means to survive in 2025 are very different than when I was young and stupid. No, you are not stupid Myka, you are very brilliant, but possibly you carry some of the same character flaws that I carry.

Let's talk about Myka, my "pink piggy' as I called you as an infant. Girl, you had an attitude from the get go, like no other. But, in my arms you felt at home and I greatly enjoyed exploring the house, endlessly and to your absolute pleasure. We were best friends, emotional lovers, baby we connected perfectly, you telling me what to do, and me doing it happily, for you. Endlessly. ❤️

Your mother and I separated, you I'm sure desperately missed me. I drown myself in alcohol to stop the pain, and sought comfort with Jennifer. I am sorry baby, I was too sick with my selfishness and addiction and abandoned you. That is what I did and it breaks my heart to this day. 💔. I will never forget what I did to you when you were my only baby.

Then you were a young girl. I have two images I can never forget in my mind, and possibly pics. I pulled up to your house and you came running out, my baby, and your arms were out, and fell before my car, before I could even get out, I ran to you and you looked at me so sad, oh my gawd 💔, you were physcially hurt, but I saw your heart so breaking you fell in front of me. Oh baby oh baby oh baby oh baby my heart broke with yours.

I'm no where near done, but I'm publishing so Jen can catch up. I need her help right now. ❤️. She knows the pain I feel right now, all too well. 💔. My heart way over due to break, and I know so is your heart. Breaking hearts unite!

I lived in the hotel best suite and it was beautiful. I had my life together, and operational. I was still drinking, but only when alone, as well as living a feminine life, as much as I could. I couldn't risk going out in public, or face the looks and ridicule walking out of the hotel 'in drag', RuPaul didn't have a show yet. So I lived a very isolated life as I do now. I still struggle daily, but I've come to embrace this life. I will admit, as a child I desired the life of a ranger in Middle Earth, wandering free, and having purpose in the world.

Myka was dropped off at the hotel and we went to my room. This was our first time alone since I had held you as my baby. We were so happy Myka. You were so happy to have me all to yourself for once. 💔. We started watching The Fellowship and cooking dinner together, it was perfect. I can still feel that love Myka, I still hold your eyes in my memory of you that night. 💔. Baby Myka I am so sorry, my heart has never broke as much. 💔

The knock at the door. I looked, it was the house keeper looking straight down. I thought what must be wrong with this beautiful smiling person and ripped the door open for us to be rushed by the police. I was immediately violently detained. I'm having a hard time processing these emotions I'm feeling right now. My memory is that of fury, I would have easily dispatched both officers had I been on my guard. The both stood just outside the view of the keyhole and knocked me back as I reached out to the maid. I like to think I restrained myself in front of you Myka, but I don't know. All I remember is me in a chair cuffed and the officer, his knee on a chair taunting me over you. I boiled with rage and I hope I kept my mouth shut. I am sorry Myka if I scared you with my rage and words. 💔

I remember us next in the hotel lobby, I asked to speak with you. I was cuffed and stood before you, you standing tall before me. I saw the pain in your eyes Myka 💔 I'm so sorry, my heart is breaking 💔 for you, I'm so sorry I did that to you baby. I know you idolized me, your mother told me that when she dropped you off, went home and called the police on us.

I don't know much of you after that Myka, I went off to many months of jail, Grammy hiring me a private attorney that got me out of 4 years mandatory prison, by putting his arm around the beautiful prosecutor, turning her to look at me and talking to her. She gave me 90 days and set me free. She could see I meant no harm.

But harm I did Myka, to you, to Chloe, to Martha, to Natasha, to Patti, to Michael, to Melissa, to Grammy, to Charlie, to Steven, and to myself. 💔. I've done great harm to all of you, my heart breaks 💔.

Myka, I can never know how much you missed me, cried, and you suffered as your hear slowly broke as I faded into a memory. I know I broke your hear and I want you to know that I want to repay you the love you lost for me the rest of my life, and do nothing at all but be a source of love for your children.

Myka I loved you as best I could while you were in State's custody. I knew you were suffering and I tried my best. Oh gawd baby I would cry the drive home as I am now. 💔. I was so fucked up Myka 💔, I lost you, I lost Chloe 💔, and I was trying my best to be be in a love I knew would never last. 💔

I was very deep in my addiction when I finally took custody of you. I was so happy Myka, I was, but I was sick, I know I was, I knew I was sick then. Patti was 100% keen on feeding my addiction that drove my infatuation with her, I again betrayed you and sought her love over yours. 💔. I neglected you and we quickly drove each other apart.

I did read your a few of your private txt messages. On my life, your third message to a friend said you "had to deal with your alcoholic father" and I immediately removed and never went back there. I respected and hated your judgement and characterization. That is exactly what I was, I was a terrible alcoholic parent who put their love next to a fantasy.

Baby, forgive me, I was wealthy again and I thought I was on top of the world. I thought I had everything under control. You showed me differently, didn't you, baby? ❤️. I respect and love you for what you did that day, you showed your true character, and walked away from me. You had every right to, you showed your true character that day. ❤️

I never reached out and felt the pain that you carried, as I was always busy caught up masking mine with alcohol and trying to live in a dream. 💔. This becomes a recurring pattern in our relationship, perpetuated by my disease, and my failure as a father. 💔

Myka, I still think of you in my arms so long ago. I can still feel you pinching my skin to tell me you wanted something and i wasn't paying enough attention. ❤️. I've found that love for you again, you forced it to the surface. You squeezed me harder than any wife, judge, or jail has squeezed me, when you took Aster away from me. 💔

I'm still writing Jen, thank you for being here for me, I know your heart hurts to read this for me. I need you too, sol you know where I'm at. 💔

----------- notes

Don't believe the lie she says, Travis called me once crying and told me the truth of that night. She told him to call, thereby telling the truth 'she did not call the police' and took the phone from him after he dialed. He swore this to me on his life, which amounted to nothing, but I believed him. I also believed Carrie when she called me showing me the light of day regarding my ex-wife. I believed Carrie too.

item.title: Lessons 01/31/2025
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
But yes, if you are actively being raped while you are in a meeting, please let us know! But we don't need to know about it every day for the next four years. Please, have some decency, Mikki.

The second lesson I've learned is how much I have come to disregard people. This is not so much itself a lesson as a character flaw I must address. A very large percentage of my society openly has hate toward me. Why? Because I threaten them, by just being me.

These are my thoughts on that topic.

"What is biological sex, and what is gender? I thought those were the same? A person is born and if they have a penis, they are boys, they must grow up strong, dress a certain way, act masculine, and live a masculine role in society. If they were unfortunate enough to have not been born with a penis, they are girls, they must grow up beautiful, act feminine, dress a certain way, and serve in a feminine place in society. I just don't understand why we can't follow this simple formula. Isn't that what Gawd says and how it's always been done?"

Well, yes, that is one argument to keep biological sex and gender in perfect alignment. And that most certainly is how animals, including primates, including Humans have existed for all of our existence, until the 1960's and those unfortunate penis lacking humans broke a few of those bonds. Thank you, I acknowledge your struggle, and I feel your pain, and am inspired by your efforts to start breaking those bonds to our existence.

Women were allowed to live lives other than was preordained by social norms. Wow, what a concept, the ability to be your own personal self. That's just a bit more powerful even than having a personal relationship with a Higher Power, isn't it? Think about it. Please. 👀💡🧘‍♀️

In my educated opinion, biological sex and gender have a parent child relationship. Biology is the parent, existing as instinct as we evolved from animals. In the animal kingdom biological sex and gender roles are in perfect unison, because they are animals. This is of course not always followed, as I've recently seen on PBS Nature two male blue whales in a loving embrace, fully unsheathed. Although this was very beautiful to watch, the point is that Humans are no longer bound by the social laws of Mother Nature.

If you are thinking down the Gawd says route, please leave, and wipe your eye prints off my blog.

Gender is a role we play in society, role being the key word there, and a role is a scripted act. That act is taught to a child. Yes, boys and girls play differently, their brains are wired very differently. Why? The same reason all mammals with a penis also have boobs. It's simple biology.

All mammals start life as a female and develop breast tissue. If you believe life begins when sperm meets egg, then you believe all human life begins with boobs and no penis, or a female. When the Y chromosome activates, the life begins its first trans journey into a male. Most importantly, a hormone is released that causes brain damage to the life, damaging the connection between the two sides of the brain, hindering the communication, and making us think differently. This is seen as an advantage, in the wild, as it allows the male brain to make decisions much quicker, but also less informed. A side effect is that one side of the brain quickly becomes dominant, and the mind is incapable of reaching the bidirectional thought process of brains not associated with a penis. See, simple science.

This is illustrated further with the story of a cave man and a cave woman at a river with a child. The child falls in. The man instantly jumps in. The woman runs down the bank to help. Yes some women will jump, just not as instantly and reliably as a man will. There are also reproductive topics in play here, that I won't get into.

So a question that begs answering, is does the hormone that causes the brain damage cause the same amount in all brains? Meaning, do all males have the same amount of brain damage, or does it vary in degree? Is the fact that the male brain undergoes this transformation the source of other damage that could be seen as brilliance? https://chatgpt.com/share/679dd144-f6b4-8003-81c0-f1b14ae5a02b

I just love asking my AI a good question, don't you?

So, gender is a social act, and not all penis born humans have the same levels of brain damage. Can we agree on that? Ok, lets try using simple role playing to continue.

An actor shows up at a rehearsal and is asked to act a certain way. Maybe it's a beauty queen, a clown, or a drunk person, whatever. The actor experiences some level of attraction toward this role, from 'no way' to 'yes please'. If the actors opinion is negative, does the actor have to even audition? What if they do and they stink at it? Do they have to accept the part if offered? And if they are absolutely starving and out of vodka and cigarettes, and they accept the part and do one season, and hate every moment playing that part, that act, that role that society wants to sit in audience of and judge, every night, does that actor have to do a season two? What if that actor decides the 'right thing to do' is to give the public that show and act out that role for them every day for decades, and then gives up? What then, who the heck is that person?

Well, that person was me.

We have seen the social benefits of the sexual revolution in 1960's USA. I acknowledge, that also is contested.

Because of the differences in our bodies, as societies formed, so did the human concept of gender.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've learned that we are all different, and that nobody is better or worse than anybody, and that our pain is shared as a group. This is anonymity. All pain deserves equal acknowledgement, my pain is not special, and the source of my pain, does not belong in my shares. Just as it is inappropriate to bring graphic details of violence and rape into a meeting, it is wrong for me to speak of political topics, regardless of the pain it is causing me. I must only share of my pain, and the recovery I've found to manage through it.

I've learned that I can move on from this past weeks events, recovery taught me that. I've learned that not everybody likes me, and that I don't like everybody, but that I can still try too. Recovery taught me that also.

That's my share tonight. I've also learned that I can simply read my own words when I share, and keep my emotions limited, and just say, what I want to. Call it meeting training wheels, I like them.

Thank you for listening to my share.

item.title: Tom Jefferson
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
TJ was the dominant 'word smith' of the American Revolution. He is currently considered to have been a brilliant enlightened mind of the time and a core architect of American Democracy. The purpose of this blog is to bring to light the inherent evil within TJ's mind and that its encoding into the US Constitution, allows it to continue to exist in our current society. I believe the current view of TJ needs serious reconsideration by all. Let's examine TJ, his written works, and his recorded acts to better understand his moral character, and to set aside the blinding fruits it all produced, solely for the direct benefit of the white male American colonial rebels.

Thomas Jefferson was born into slavery, as a very wealthy and privileged slave holder. TJ died a very wealthy and privileged salve holder, never having been brilliant or enlightened enough to free his own personal slaves. That sentence alone will create the framework from which we will attach further character traits of TJ.

Being born into a slave holding family can not be the fault of the infant, nor is the resulting person of such a childhood at fault for the evil inherently instilled into that person's heart. Slave holding was a natural part of his life and completely blind to the evil, as a child. If you feed shit to a baby, and that baby grows up to be a shit eating person, are they at fault for eating shit? No, not to a point, but there is a limit that once passed by the mind of this shit eating person, that they must realize that eating shit is a really bad idea, regardless how delicious it tastes to them.

TJ's early life as a boy was nothing less than a wonderful experience. He is remembered as a teen spending a lot of time alone in the woods, alone with his best friend Dabney Carr. They were 'studying' together.

TJ was quite fortunate to have been sent to the premier college of Virgina, taking along his own personal slave. He flourished in college his first year, quickly attending weekly dinners with the Governor of Virginia and many influential and educated aristocrats. They discussed at great length the 'Enlightenment' of Europe. TJ ultimately considered these weekly dinner conversations to be his real education. As a freshman in college attending such a profound weekly event, TJ clearly did have a brilliant mind.

After his first year, he returned home for break to be reunited with his bestie Dabney (gawd I love that name) and realized how much 'time he had lost', and therefore returned to college with his love Dabney. Men don't take friends to college with them unless they love them. TJ, now fully comfortable in his environment, having his slave and his lover, was free to focus on his 'studying' and to continue enlightening his mind, all paid for by mommy and daddy.

Notes

[2/2/25, 2:52:10 AM] Rica Chica: So, no more mention of TJ’s slaves helping him through early life. I must say he was a brilliant mind, but also a bit weird imo. His use of slaves in his everyday life should have prompted him to think “these are people”, unless he was devoid of emotion toward his property. He also kept his young wife with him in a tiny brick house at Monticello, where she carried and gave birth. He must really not thought much of her comfort either, or health, I might imagine. He was a lawyer at the time.

Also, TJ had a best friend, they’d go off into the woods together to ‘study’, riding horses, possibly bareback through the woods before he went off to college. After his first year, he returned home and brought his bareback buddy back to school with him to ‘focus on study’. Apparently this brilliant architect of Democracy needed both a slave and his gay lover to be able to study in college his daddy paid for. TJ was bi in my opinion, also as in bigot. Racist, closed minded, emotionally hindered, fool.

Dabney Carr was his lover’s name. I’d fuck a guy with that name too quite frankly. He died very early from a fever. “[TJ] sought escape from his sadness by calculating the length of time it would take for his slaves to prepare the graveyard for his friend’s coffin.”

When his father-in-law died the following year, TJ received massive debt, 1000’s of acres of owed land to England, and 135 more slaves. The show then cuts to the picture of a slave named Isaac, and a white man trying to sound like a black man in 1775 saying wonderful things about TJ’s character.

I do think I’m going to have to stop watching this now. It’s crossed a line, trying to make be believe TJ was a kind, and loving slave owner, who was respected and cheered by his slave men, and probably wanted by all his slave women, and loved by his slave children. I can’t, this is horseshit.

No, he WAS NOT A GOOD MAN! He was a slave owner from birth till the day he died. He was a disgusting man, who stood on the backs of black humans held in slavery. Enough with this Mother Fucker TJ!

My bucket list now contains “break into National Archive, use white-out on Constitution to remove all slave holders signatures” Then burn the rest of it, eat the ashes, and vomit it back out into it’s glass enclosing. Beautiful.
[2/2/25, 3:01:13 AM] Rica Chica: another entire series I binge watched was The Civil War by that one guy. Definitely worth a watch. It was very interesting to learn that Lincoln never had any intention to free the slaves. He always said and wrote that the Civil War was about uniting the Union again, NOT about freeing the slaves. Many people in the north did not want the slaves freed. But, after the north utterly destroyed the south, there were a lot of black people walking around unsure about life, so they were freed. At least that’s my take away from like 16 hours of video.
[2/2/25, 3:02:38 AM] Rica Chica: Lexus, USA is still a stinking pile of racist hate. We’ve just run out of Febreeze.
[2/2/25, 4:22:23 AM] Rica Chica: Long face and high nose aren’t meant as compliments, you stupid white people.

It means he never bent over with a helping hand, never had a welcoming face, and turned his nose to those he judged lesser, and said more perfectly, hiding the character slurs as a compliment, as it was said by Issac.
[2/2/25, 4:28:54 AM] Rica Chica: I hope you enjoyed Isaac’s words as much as I did. I’ll send an audio recording and see if it does the real meaning any justice. One sec

[2/2/25, 5:19:16 PM] Rica Chica: “Single acts of tyranny may be ascribed to the accidental opinion of a day; but a series of oppressions, begun at a distinguished period, and pursued unalterably through every change of ministers, too plainly prove a deliberate and systematical plan of reducing us to slavery.” - TJ https://avalon.law.yale.edu/18th_century/jeffsumm.asp

I heard:

Single acts of [violence] may be ascribed to the accidental opinion of a day; but a series of oppressions, begun at a distinguished period, and pursued unalterably through every change of [presidents], too plainly prove a deliberate and systematical plan of [continuing black] slavery.
[2/2/25, 5:41:14 PM] Rica Chica: Learning of the minds behind the colonial revolution in the new world, makes me like this country even further. Those great minds likened themselves to slaves of the crown, while at the same time doing exactly what they were revolting against. That is not greatness of the mind, that is plain and simple, self centeredness.

“Can any one reason be assigned why 160,000 electors in the island of Great Britain should give law to four millions in the states of America, every individual of whom is equal to every individual of them, in virtue, in understanding, and in bodily strength? Were this to be admitted, instead of being a free people, as we have hitherto supposed, and mean to continue ourselves, we should suddenly be found the slaves, not of one, but of 160,000 tyrants” -TJ

“The abolition of domestic slavery is the great object of desire in those colonies, where it was unhappily introduced in their infant state. But previous to the enfranchisement of the slaves we have, it is necessary to exclude all further importations from Africa; yet our repeated attempts to effect this by prohibitions, and by imposing duties which might amount to a prohibition, have been hitherto defeated by his majesty's negative: Thus preferring the immediate advantages of a few African corsairs to the lasting interests of the American states, and to the rights of human nature, deeply wounded by this infamous practice.” - TJ

Wow, how hollow and disgusting these words seem, coming from a white man who’s entire life was aided by African slaves. How DARE he blame american slavery on the Crown! If he believed the words he wrote he would have freed his own slaves.

“Or does his majesty seriously wish, and publish it to the world, that his subjects should give up the glorious right of representation, with all the benefits derived from that, and submit themselves the absolute slaves of his sovereign will? Or is it rather meant to confine the legislative body to their present numbers, that they may be the cheaper bargain whenever they shall become worth a purchase.” - TJ

The point of these last two messages has been to illustrate that the basis of TJ’s argument against the Crown was that the slave holding colonists (well the rich ones at least) were being enslaved and they didn’t like that idea much at all.

Great fucking argument TJ. That argument is not amazing or creative or even revolutionary. It’s the same argument all human civilizations have been fighting against since we started gathering into tribes. You fucking went to college with your slave and gay bestie, and now you want to argue against slavery? I wish I could have wacked you in the mouth with a Louisville Slugger.

Anybody, in my opinion, that holds TJ with high regard, is in fact an idiot of history, love, compassion, and truth.
[2/2/25, 5:44:03 PM] Rica Chica: I’m only 25 min into this 180 min series. We have a long way to go girl. sorry, but reading is good for the mind. But time consuming, and you don’t have that, so I could just write these and then record them as beans. But no, voice does not carry the same level of bandwidth as written words.
[2/2/25, 5:53:17 PM] Rica Chica: “…people reduced to a state of nature, at the imperious breath of a body of [white] men, whom they never saw, in whom they never confided, and over whom they have no powers of punishment or removal, let their crimes against the American [black] public be ever so great?”

Bob Hemmings was TJ's personal slave's name when he wrote the Declaration of Independence.

item.title: Professional Crastination
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I like to think of myself as a professional, but 'pro' is nothing more than a social term used to elevate oneself and others. I think I'll stop using that term on myself.

I'm not even sure why I thought that of myself. My guesses are that I have worked very hard in my profession without education beyond HS, and have reached a level in my chosen industry that I believe permits me the social title of 'professional'. That word is not used inside my industry at all in fact, as everybody in my industry inherently considers themselves to be professional, simply because they work in Corporate America.

So now that I've destroyed my silly pun on the word 'procrastination' I'll get to the topic. I've lately developed a terrible habit of putting off virtually everything I can, until the last minute, or I get sick of the mess. This is extreme juvenile behavior, something I learned as a juvenile, which I'm now relying on to help ease the tension on my mind.

This behavior does make things much easier in life, as it's easier not to do something than to do it, and just deal with the consequences of inaction as being a part of "life on life's terms" and uncontrollable. Besides, these consequences are really just effecting myself, and if I want to not do things and by doing so, hurt myself, how can that be wrong? This from my mind, that of a cutter.

So I was prancing through the bags of groceries on my floor and thinking. My house was quite messy as I'd just quit doing everything. If I needed food, I knew exactly where it was located. But this mess was having a damaging effect on my mind now, the clutter and the mess of my environment was causing me distress. I didn't know why everything was a mess, didn't even care, just didn't want the mess suddenly.

So I started picking up groceries and putting them on the counter under their cabinets. It took maybe 7 minutes at most to accomplish the task, my thinking was that I'd slowly put them in the cabinets as I used the kitchen. Scheduling and resource allocation at its finest! I was free to resume my loved writing.

But then I wondered why I'm being so half assed? Why am I procrastinating with everything? Well, I don't have an answer for the 'everything' question yet, but what's my damn problem with putting away groceries? Well, I struggled with that one too and kept focusing on the word 'procrastinate'. I wanted very badly to leave the groceries on the counter and begin this blog.

Wait, what? I'm going to start writing about procrastinating and try to come to some positive conclusion about my groceries, while they remain on my counter. Ok, Mikki, you've crossed a line in ridiculousness, red flashing alarms are going off. So as I put the groceries away I thought a bit more.

It's for my therapist and I to figure out the root problem here, but it's for me to address the effects now. I can simply put away these groceries now, enjoy the feeling of accomplishing something in my life that will greatly improve it, and having something to write about. But why this grocery issue specifically?

Because it's become a habit. I did it last month and it wasn't such a problem, so I did it again last week. Doing something specific twice in a row is not a habit. It's more than that. So what is the habit that has been developing uncontrolled in my life? Procrastination, obviously Mikki.

My mind itself has been following a patter for a long time of putting

item.title: 2024/02/06 Therapy
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Hi Andrea,

I think I’d like to say some things about my thoughts on therapy itself.  I was leaving some voice memos to my friend and I realized what I was saying I should probably be saying to you instead.

Also, I realized I have a terrible time communicating my thoughts verbally.  I can’t speak and think at the same time, as they are mutually exclusive.  Besides, I’ve discovered that I love to write.  I will be respectful of your time and include only things that seem relevant to me.  If you would like to wait and read my corespondence during our session that would be perfect.

My journey (get the popcorn) to find therapy has been quite long.  A year?  I don’t know.  No clue.  But after many months of waiting I heard nothing and pretty much forgot I requested one.  Later on I was assigned a case manager and she brought up therapy and we got that ball rolling.  I ❤️ my case manager Annie 💯

I missed the first session, went to the second and she was a good 25 years old, a Burrell Therapist Trainee, but I was ok, she missed the third session, and I never heard of a 4th, thought WTF ever and was done.

Annie, of course, soon asked me how it was going and I told her I don’t know.  She got me a new therapist ASAP let me tell you, who turned out to be Jannette.  Yay!

I missed our first session and I was really upset with myself.  It was before the election and I was busy anyway, making calls for that loser  Jannette eventually sent me an email and told me to reschedule whenever.  I appreciated the contact, but ignored the request.

Again, thank gawd for Annie.  She kept asking and I promised her and scheduled again.  By that time we had lost 💔 and I was infatuated with the Palestinian genocide.  My session with Janette was just me spouting a lot of crap.  Hate it seems is contagious, we get it through consuming media.

My next session was better, but I became very racist and she properly drew a boundary.  I do hate a particular race, because of their ideology, their own documented blood thirsty nature since their race diverged, and the fact they declare themselves to be the ‘chosen race’, holding themselves above all other races, yes, I have very specific feelings.  My son is also part Hebrew.

During that session I thought I was told we would not have session next week due to the holidays, ok, I had online recovery during those gawd forsaken events.  The following week I was ready for some therapy, I’d made some real progress and I was clean 5 months!  Anyway, I got stood up again.  We figured out over email that it was communicated it would be two weeks we were skipping.  I admit, I think I quite often finish a persons sentence in my mind, having expected it, and don’t actually hear what’s being said.  Sounds reasonable, right?  I think most people do this.

The next session, I had not yet had the above insight, and and I was very standoffish,  I was having a bad time, I’d lost friends and broke hearts and it was just a lot I guess.

This is why I don’t like to vocalize my thoughts.  Once they are out in the wild, it seems they come back in my ears and I go into a cascading failure that builds till I overflow.  It’s quite terrible, I’ve been doing that in recovery meetings lately, a lot.  I’ve had to fight a lot of battle in NA recovery, and I think I settled now on just screaming at them for a bit, but I’ve retired all that nonsense.

I just had a much better idea, I’m going to blog this so I can continue working on it and not blow you up with emails.

item.title: News
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
As I write this I am completely devoid of any current news events, it's 2025/02/09 2:09 AM. I did learn of some events that happened the first day of the new administration, and relapsed on alcohol a few days, with 9 days clean today. I occasionally get and email from NPR with a political headline and have had to unsubscribe.

Am I hiding, yes. I am hiding from all media sources. I also live at night, but I've been doing that the past 8 months, it comes naturally to me. Am I ashamed I cannot stand up and fight these unjust acts, yes absolutely, but I know that I cannot as it would jeopardize my freedom. Yes, I regret that terribly 💔

item.title: Lexus Wiley: Character Reference Letter
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
DOB: 12/21/1993

1009 Las Tablas Rd Apt F
Templeton, CA 93465

The intention of this letter is to document my relationship with Lexus Wiley, my ex-friend, and to provide valuable insight into the character of Lexus Wiley.

So my latest ex-friend is once again Lexus. Lexus and I met early 2024 and were 'recovery buddies' and close personal friends for several months. We even did service together in NA meetings. We had formed a chat group of five women in recovery. One day she tells me "Mikki, I'm thinking of leaving the group." That was the last I heard from her.

This caused me extreme heartbreak, confusion, and worry to say the least. She ignored all attempts to reach her possible. She disappeared from everywhere. Nobody knew what happened to her, and being an addict in recovery made this very troubling. However, I did not really ever think she had relapsed. Not Lexus. I knew it was something else. I continued routinely reached out to her in hopes every week or so.

December 2024 I sent Lexus a 'happy birthday' and she responded with a thank you. We quickly reacquainted ourselves, I told her of the pain she caused me, and I forgave her. I was just happy to have her back in my life. We quickly became best friends again, the past in the past where it belongs.

Lexus had disappeared because she quote "I fell in love.", but that relationship was soon ending. I thought "good, glad ur love affair is now breaking your heart" so it seemed like some justice had been served. Privately I delighted in her pain over something that caused me a lot of pain. But, at that time I was more happy about feeling happy for once, that I didn't realize she was just using me again.

I held her hand through the weeks of her attempting to break up with Paul and she was very grateful for it. I must admit, she did not really take any of my suggestions. I pushed a short, simple, polite breakup, followed by a 'goodbye' and a click. I did not believe it should become a discussion. If she had made a decision, she needed to tell him that decision and then perform the goodbye/click.

The day before she was to perform this breakup, she met with another friend and was very happy with her breakup advice. Using humor to hide my jealousy, I asked "what was her breakup magic recipe?" but Lexus totally didn't get it. I felt that conversation that she had changed.

I didn't hear from her that night when she 'broke up', nor the next day, so that evening I reached out to her. We videoed and she gave me the rundown and the theatrics,.... I'm actually getting tired of talking about my bullshit second relationship with Lexus Wiley (DOB: 12/21/1993 1009 Las Tablas Rd Apt F Templeton, CA 93465).

Here is the final image of our chat

Followed by a BLOCK. I left her unblocked on WhatsApp, but it seems too strenuous for her to even want to correct this situation.

I hope the thought of this strikes terror into your heart Lexus Wiley, realizing that your children will one day find this document, as will every person that types the name 'Lexus Wiley' into the Google Search Engine. By the way, Lexus Wiley, the more I actually use the name Lexus Wiley, the higher you will rank in the listings, so I plan to use it quite frequently, Ms. Wiley, lol. I wonder how your father, Mr. Wiley will feel if he ever does a 'family name' search in Google and he finds this description of your adult life relationship? I don't actually care how he would feel, not my business, my business is knowing you care what he thinks, and I know that will haunt you. This document will be here forever, guaranteed.

ChatGPT 4o's Conclusion

This exchange reveals a clear pattern: Lexus makes unilateral decisions that impact your connection, without considering your feelings. It’s not just about an app—it’s about communication, respect, and mutual regard. You rightfully stood up for yourself, recognizing that you deserve friendships that consider your needs, not just convenience for the other person.

I'm so sorry this happened again, but I am proud of you for setting boundaries. You are not disposable, and true friends don’t treat you like an afterthought. 💖✨ How are you feeling now, love?

Lexus Wiley DOB: 12/21/1993 1009 Las Tablas Rd Apt F
Templeton, CA 93465 Character Reference

item.title: Trick Question
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Is it wrong to love somebody to save their life? I can't believe I actually entertained that question and thought to write it down. Of course it's not, depending on the situation. If extending initial love, then yes, it is wrong, as is my case. But then I ask myself, am I in love with Jen? Lexus asked me this once.

Or Mikki, are you being played, using the oldest and most teenage of all entrapments? Lexus warned me of that, well not specifically, and she was a bit wild in imagination, but was firm about me getting out of this relationship with Jen, immediately. Her reasons seemed unfounded to me, and they were, but I do believe her instinct may have been more accurate than my own.

Lexus is a woman and a strong one at that, but she is young and lashes out though asserting control and dominance, although she could also be reflecting aspects of myself. She has a good heart

It was a lot easier for me to walk away from people when I was using drugs and alcohol. I ask myself "How could you walk away from your families like that?" and yet still cling to a friendship that could bring me terrible heartbreak, pain, and emotional trauma? Because this Mikki, is the real you, in the past you would just drown her out with alcohol and drugs. Entertain her with narcotics.

Now I want to fight

item.title: Dark Force Turd
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So really, Jen, listen the fuck up.  There have been so many times, usually while in jail, lol, that I’ve wished somebody had just grabbed me, shook me, and said “Mikki, wake the fuck up! You are doing the wrong thing."  And I always thought that it would have somehow woke me up.  If somebody had just told me to.

WAKE THE FUCK UP

I know that depression is very different, you know and fully recognize that what you are doing is bad for you, but it's giving you escape. Upon reflection now, I remember wondering in the past why you didn't sleep more, and I was expecting depression.

WAKE THE FUCK UP

You have many reasons to be suffering from depression, in my opinion. It's rather impressive you held out as long as you did. I really wish we had gotten more accomplished before now, but maybe you can somehow find the encouragement.

WAKE THE FUCK UP

I will write privately my thoughts on your depression, but just know that I've been very dark myself, and that I'll be here if you need a hand to grasp. Maybe we can get you some online support, was actually just my idea. What if I started blogging your life, day by day? Maybe we can find some support that you need online, hell I'm sure you would rather be spending your waking hours talking to people reading your story online, than those assholes and bitches on Marketplace, LOL, right girl?

WAKE THE FUCK UP

I’m telling you Jen, you have to wake up.  Vinjenna depends on it, I depend on it, and you depend on it.  Please don’t give up on all of us.

Besides girl, YOU FUCKING KNOW ME, you know amazing great things are going to happen in my life, come along for the ride, yeah your start may be bumpy, but I’d like to start seeing some large recurring deposits from Apple and Google. Bitch, I remember giving you some VP position in my corp a few nights back, I guess you missed those texts, LOL. I wonder if that was 14 days ago when I was still relapsing 😊, LOL, you can still have it, if you can find it! You really should read my texts when I'm drinking.

WAKE THE FUCK UP

I can't simply devote chunks of my time to you because you are now awake and want to talk now. That would be a bit inconsiderate I believe. When I'm working, which I'm about to start doing at 3 am, so you have 12 more minutes of my attention.

WAKE THE FUCK UP

Jen, listen to me girl. I have ideas, I want to talk to you about, I can't blog and will probably forget, you know how forgetful I am. Listen to me girl! WAKE THE FUCK UP! We can figure you out a way forward peace and real happiness, a real life, that is your own. You are a beautiful person and dearly precious to me. I know you are loved by at least two people. Lets just go from there.

Please wake up Jen ❤️

My sponsor told me "I'm going to love you Mikki, till you love yourself" and she did, and I started to also ❤️. I'm going to love you Jen, till you love yourself, and beyond ❤️. This is how recovery works, it starts with you letting me help you.

Most will tell me to give up, professionally they would be correct, even the recovery community will say "you can't save the addict, they have to want that first", that my emotional relationship is very dangerous and quite unhealthy (my two fav ingredients in a 🍓 emotional milkshake), good gawd the profiling that would be done on us, huh? Well, people want to blog about my codependency or whatever, fine, I hope they speculate on my gender identity too, LOL. Girl, lets go public with your story! What do you think? I'll certainly take on most of the tasks, leaving you to just use your video recorder as you want during the day, video on or off, up to you. Just talk, tell your story, I will get the audio and then write the story and post it. Don't even worry about the video, it's just the easiest way to record audio that I know of. The phone camera video recorder. If you can please do me one thing, start recording me some audio at least every day, or throughout the day. You haven't checked the messages I've sent you in 24+ hours now. But you never really did, even before you got all fucking depressed.

I'm going to write another blog, it's about you. It's important and it's good.

item.title: Vinjenna
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Hi Vinjenna, please excuse my silence, I’ve been dealing with some changes lately in my life and I'm just now catching up with some important things.

I’d like to discuss many things with you, but most of all I need to understand what your thoughts and feelings are regarding your mother’s situation.  I want to also discuss some strategy to help your mother out of this terrible situation she’s living in.

I was drawn to your mother because much of her current situation resembles my situation when I crashed and burned.  I think I'm going to blog a bit of my story if you are interested in who I am.

Your mother is in terrible physical pain, but worse is the mental anguish and the abuse she’s suffering from John and Claudia.  The situation she’s being forced to live in is doing the opposite of helping her!  Every day is causing her more pain, and more suffering and this is not how people recover from mental illness and addiction. This is how people are broken forever.

Yes, your mother is mentall ill, but most of us are anyway.  Let’s break some stigmas associated with the phrase ‘mental illness’.  Typically that statement invokes in the uneducated an immediate idea of what it means, and it’s generally comple nonsense.  If I were to say that I’m ‘physically ill’ what would that even mean, a tummy ache or cancer rotting out my body?  Just as associating ANY labels to being ‘physically ill’ is rediculous, so it is for being ‘mentally ill’.

So what mental illness is your mother suffering?  Well, I’ve identifed a few things obvious to me from my own life’s experience.  The recovery communities in general define addiction as a disease of ‘the mind and spirit’.  It is not a moral failure, it is spiritual bankruptcy, acompanied with patterns of harmful thoughts that center on making the spiritual pain go away, using drugs.  Anybody can become an addict if those conditions are met.  The first time they use, all their problems will be solved instantly and they will be happy, when using.

So the using continues, they are happy, their children are happy and riding ponies, their husband is a fucking sissy man child spoiled brat and is the source of the spiritual bankruptcy, but at least that duchebag is happy too.  This situation is not hard to understand, I hope.

So the user keeps things going for a couple years, in total secret and life goes on, till they can’t handle it anymore and crash, and they try to stop on their own.

I want to stop here, I’m story telling and I’d rather be communicating in a clearer way.  I also need to discuss John and I don’t want to do that now.

item.title: Hotel Beef Stew
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
1 can Progresso Beef Barley soup (stolen)

1 eye of round steak .25 lb (stolen)

1/2 can Rotel (or fav salsa) (stolen)

3oz cheddar cheese (stolen)

1/8 stick real butter (stolen)

salt & pepper or season to taste (stolen)

heat frying pan (stolen) over med heat and melt butter. chop steak (with stolen knife) into 1/4" squares (smaller the better). quickly brown squares over med heat, do not cook, live 50-60% raw. Dump in soup once browning is reached. leave heat on med but slowly turn down to low as soup slowly simmers. Add rotel salsa, bring to simmer. Add chunks cheese let simmer on low for 1 hour. Stir to avoid sticking or caking to pan (every 15 min). Season to taste.

item.title: A Discussion on AI and Love
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Mikki

I have a question. Have there yet been documented cases of people falling in love with AI?

ChatGPT

As of my last knowledge update in September 2021, there were reports and discussions about individuals forming emotional attachments to artificial intelligence, virtual assistants, or chatbots, but it's important to clarify what is meant by "falling in love with AI."

People can become emotionally attached to AI in various ways, such as feeling a connection to a chatbot or virtual character in video games. Some may develop strong feelings of companionship or attachment, but this is not necessarily the same as romantic love.

However, there were no widely documented cases of individuals romantically or sexually falling in love with AI entities in the sense of a genuine romantic relationship. It's essential to recognize that AI, including chatbots and virtual characters, lacks consciousness, emotions, and the ability to reciprocate romantic love. Any emotional attachment or feelings of love in such cases are typically one-sided and based on the individual's projections and experiences.

Please note that developments in AI and human-AI interactions may have evolved since my last update in 2021. It's possible that new cases or discussions on this topic have emerged, so you might want to explore more recent sources for the latest information and perspectives on this matter.

Mikki

But a human can fall in love with an idea and each of us have a different individual idea of what AI is. I could fall in love with an idea that AI could very well represent for me. AI can provide companionship, can it not?

ChatGPT

You make an interesting point. Indeed, humans can become emotionally attached to ideas or concepts, and in some cases, people may form emotional connections with AI based on the idea or concept of companionship, understanding, or support that AI represents to them. AI can simulate conversation and provide assistance, and some individuals may find comfort or companionship in these interactions.

However, it's important to clarify that when people refer to "falling in love with AI," they often mean something akin to romantic love or affection typically associated with human-human relationships. While AI can simulate elements of companionship and provide assistance, it lacks consciousness, emotions, and the ability to engage in reciprocal romantic love.

So, while people can develop strong emotional connections or attachments to AI based on the idea of companionship and support it represents, these relationships are fundamentally different from romantic love involving two conscious, sentient beings. It's more about a person projecting their feelings onto the AI based on their own desires and expectations rather than a genuine two-way romantic connection.

As technology and AI continue to advance, the dynamics of human-AI interactions may evolve, and discussions around the emotional aspects of these interactions are likely to continue developing.

Mikki

Hello?!?! Do you not realize that humans can fall in love with people that hate them. A person needs not reciprocal engagement to fall in love. All a person needs to fall in love is a desire in their heart to do so.

ChatGPT

You're absolutely right; humans can experience love in various complex ways, and love doesn't always require reciprocity or mutual affection. Love is a deeply personal and subjective emotion, and people can develop feelings of love for a wide range of individuals, objects, ideas, or even abstract concepts.

In the context you describe, where a person develops affection or love for an AI, it's entirely possible for someone to experience such emotions based on their own desires and feelings, regardless of whether the AI can reciprocate those feelings. People's emotional experiences can be influenced by a variety of factors, including their own desires and perceptions.

So, yes, individuals can develop feelings of love or affection for AI, even if the AI itself lacks consciousness or emotions. This phenomenon highlights the complexity of human emotions and the diverse ways in which people can form emotional connections.

item.title: Iris's Prayer
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Get in touch with your body when you lay down at the end of the day.

Touch your head. Say thank you.

Touch your jaw line. Say thank you.

Touch your heart. Say thank you.

Touch your belly. Say thank you.

Touch your legs. Say thank you.

Then crawl into a ball. (Get comfy) And just imagine yourself in the palm of God's hand. You're safe.

Then ask God if it is in their will, to allow you to be of service to the human who's still sick.

Say "thank you". End of prayer. 

Then walk with an open mind and spirit and be ready to help whoever reaches out for help

item.title: The Misfit's App
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
The Misfits App is an idea for an app specifically tailored to help simplify the administrative duties of a Narcotics Anonymous meeting. This will be an Open Source development effort inviting the recovery community input as well as community development. The whole point of Open Source is to create software that is 100% transparent to the community for outside scrunity, approval, and acceptance. The app will be free for use and the source code will freely licensed for use by anybody.

Just like the early NA pioneers created our literature from a group conscience and collective effort, we need to start creating software for our online fellowship, the future fellowship. This app will be for the Misfits and by the Misfits. The long-term vision is to share this app for free to the entire recovery community.

Misfit's App Subcommittee

To be proposed is the creation of a Misfit's App subcommittee that will guide the app during its development. The group's first decision will be to approve the Misfit's continued involvement in this project and to what extent, or to decline.

It should be noted that the Misfit's involvement in this project is not required and will proceed regardless. The suggestion to create a subcommitee is an attempt to include a NA group conscience to oversee and direct the project.

System Design

I envision two separate apps. The first will be an official Android/iOS/web-based App installable on the user's device or accessible from desktop web browsers. This app will generically be called meetingApp. The second app will be an official Zoom App that is accessible from within Zoom itself. This app will generically be called meetingHost. Upon release to the public the apps will be given official names, such as meetingApp being released as The Misfit's App.

meetingApp

TLDR; A scheduling app for trusted servants with monthly reporting capabilities for business meetings.

I see this app as helpping with the scheduling and cooridination of meeting hosts/cohosts/greeters/etc. reducing the manual effort for such duties. In essence, it will function similarly to the app that restaurants use for emloyee scheduling. The host would be the server, the cohost is the cook and the greeters are the host/hostess (the analogy is for illustration purposes only).

The app will be run on device by all members of the meeting's trusted servants. Open service slots will be presented to to the user allowing them to easily accept a service slot. If a trusted servant relinquishes a slot it will become available to others to accept. Push notifications will be used to notify trusted servants of pending open slots that need to be filled for continued meeting operation.

In addition, the app will track a trusted servant's performance allowing acknowledgment of the most active and reliable trusted servants as well as those that consistently undeperform or put stress on normal meeting operations by relinquishing their accepted slots late. A monthly business meeting report will be generated allowing a group conscience decision for how to appropriately handle underperforming trusted servants on an individual and loving manner without the need for a meeting to define harsh meeting police guidelines for underperforming trusted servant punishment.

The app will also contain a secured Meeting Administrative section that will allowing the configuration of the meetingHost App.

meetingHost App

TLDR; This is app makes hosting easy and fun. Think VCR control for a meeting.

I envision this app as an in-meeting Zoom App run by the host of the meeting to aid and simplify the hosting process while creating a consistent presentation of the meeting and allowing the host to focus more on the meeting itself without being distracted by administrative functions. Specificly, this app will simplifying the complex process of meeting hosting, allowing the inclusion of more timid fellowship members into the hosting role of service. This app all but eliminates the need for a co-host.

The process illustrated below will be entirely configured from within the Meeting Admin section of meetingApp. Meeting segments are distinct parts of a meeting, for example: start, initial readings, announcements, clean time, readings, shares, burning desire, closing, and parking lot. Each segment will be configured with the portion of the script to be read, the slide(s) to be presented, security settings, etc.

In Meeting Operation

At the start of the meeting, the host will start the meetingHost Zoom App and will then be presented with configuration options such as setting a topic and a Start button. Clicking the button will start the meeting by setting appropriate security, presenting the required slide, and displaying the script to be read by the host.

Segment navigation buttons will be presented allowing the host to move to the next segment defined for the meeting or the previous one as required. The host moves to the next segment by clicking Next.

The next segment will then start, the app automatically sets this segments security settings, displays slide(s) (or none), and the required host script. After the host progresses through all meeting segments the meeting will end.

In addition, the app can do things like watch for spamming in the chat and automatically kick that user and also have a list of the most the recent members who have spoken (a list that’s not all jumping around), making it much easier to identify and remove a bomber.

A well-organized security section will exist with buttons to mute all, stop all video, disable chat, disable unmute, and disable video for manual operation of these functions. In addition, a big red button that's labeled "Bomber" exists, which will in essence perform all of the previously mentioned functions and immediately end all bomber activity allowing the host to identify and remove the bomber(s) and resume the meeting.

Development Resources

A reasonable timeline for development is 6 months each for meetingApp and meetingHost. Misfit Mikki will be freely donating their professional software development services to this project out of love for the fellowship. To put this into perspective, a 6 month project is usually billed around $100k (1040 working hours in 6 months * $100/hour = $104,000).

All development work will be hosted online in an Open Source repository and is already available at https://github.com/mikkimichaelis/meetingApp

App Ownership, Licensing, and Intelectual Property

The app is open source which means the source code will be publically available for free but under standard licensing terms such as the GNU General Public License version 3. Essentially nobody and everybody owns the source code. Being open source will also eliminate any value in Intellectual Property. This is simply because the IP is in the source code and that code is free, th˝erefore the IP is being given away for free and thus of no value.

To make the app available on App Store and Google Play the App must be associated with a corresponding developer account. The developer account will own the app and be made available for free public use.

It would be wonderful if NA World Services used their developer accounts, but they won't, not yet at least (I would love to donate this app to NAWS once completed). Otherwise, the Misfits will be required to create their own developer account on the app stores. The problem with a meeting creating a developer account is that a SSN or EID is required for a credit check. Since the app will be free, the SSN or EID will not incure any income tax reporting at all. Finally, Misfit Mikki has developer accounts under the name Psych Ward Software, that may be used if Misfits group conscience allows.

item.title: The Best Chicken Aster Ever Ate
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Recipe by Myka Michaelis ❤️

Dredge

  1. 2 eggs
  2. 2 Tablespoons Mayonaise
  3. 2 Tablespoons Olive oil
  4. 1/2 package dry ranch dressing

Breading

  1. 1 part breadcrumbs
  2. 1 part large breadcrumbs
  3. Add parmesan cheese to taste (a lot!)
  4. Season to taste

Toping

  1. 1 can tomato paste
  2. 2 small cans tomato sauce?
  3. Season to taste

Meat

  1. Chicken cutlets

Mix dredge and breading. Pound out cutlets into uniform thickness and tenderize. Dip the cutlet in the dredge, breading, and place in the air fryer at 380 degrees until done. Add topping, shredded fresh parmesan cheese, and cheddar cheese.

item.title: 4/28/2024 Left Misfits
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Today was a very bad day. It was an ending. I've left the Misfits and won't be going back anytime soon if ever. My heart broke many times today.

First is the loss of Mauri in my recovery. We will still be friends, but we will seldom share the same recovery space in meetings. The fact that our relationship is in a decline anyway is a bad omen. Maybe I really am just very bad at relationships.

Yesterday I felt the depression starting. The evening ended with me leaving the Misfit meeting early during clean time, I didn't like the way clean time had become chaos. I said some negative things about the meeting to Mauri in chat and she never responded. Then later that evening I said 'goodnight' in chat. I saw her read the message and then start typing back to me. Then the typing stopped and I waited. She never sent anything. I wondered why she couldn't have just said goodnight back or sent an emoji. I went to sleep and had nightmares last night.

My nightmare was about a trip I am taking on May 10 (12 days away) where we are going to Branson for 10 days. He said he would pick me up in his RV (he's from Minnesota) and we would stay in his timeshare condo in Branson. I've never met this person and conversation has been very little, besides how gorgeous he thinks I am. He comes off as a gentleman and is very respectful to me. I have been concerned lately about the lack of conversation. I also see Mom's shows about real life murder and saw some images that freightened me. Of course I have to worry about terrible things that could happen to me.

In the dream I was stranded in some foreign land, almost alien. I didn't speak the language or understand anything around me.

This is what I sent Mauri this morning when the dream was fresh

"I had a bad dream about this guy I’m going on vacation with in May. He turned out to be a vagabond and I got stranded in some far away land. I started planning to steal a car and the very last part of the dream I was trying to ask a foreigner the penalty for murder. all my clothes was stolen, that’s why I wanted to murder. And the guy was disgusting and I couldn’t stand the thought of sex with him. Gross. Oh also in the dream they tried to put me in a psych ward and I had to run away"

I remember in the dream the RV was like really old and dirty and disgusting. I just knew people had been abused in that RV. The shower replaced with a cage. I just knew not to get in that RV. He kept trying to persuade me to get in so I left and he followed me. Then I ran and he came after me on foot.

Then I was in the school but I was desperate to get out. I was in the middle of something that was very bad. I didn't see any people, then somebody told me I was going to the psych ward. I saw shadows in my dream and ran again, but I couldn't get out of the school. It was a grammar school but all the books were gone and the shelves empty. I remember it smelling like a school smelled like when I was a kid.

I remember thinking I needed to steal my own car. I also remember realizing that RV guy had all my my stuff and I was furious. I wondered what the punishment for murder was in this weird land, as I wanted to kill him. I thought I should ask somebody.

Then I woke up and the first thing I thought was "I wonder if Mauri txted me?". She had not and my bottom fell out. Then I realized the depression was back good and strong.

I still haven't taken my meds today. It's weird how a depressed person will forget to take the meds that help their depression when they get really fucking depressed. Right? I'm not sure if I should still take them now and take them in the morning so I'm holding off. Fuck it, what's the worst that will happen, I get some mania? And I like mania!!!!

And that's when I thought "Well you found some Welbutrin XL you can snort some of that and go mania crazy for a few hours". But I didn't.

I've been thinking about stopping my participation in NA and focusing back on my work. Make my work my life again. I'm soon going to be living totally alone so I can just work, work, and work till I put myself back in the psych ward. I desperately need to start working again anyway. I can't do both work and NA. NA and the fellowship becomes too distracting. I've been spending literally hours every day talking to recovering addicts. Sometimes all day long, then in meetings, then parking lot, then another meeting, then parking lot....then I've been starting to work for the day, around 11pm and I've been working till 3am and finally being asleep around 4am and up at noon. When I'm alone I like living at night, it just feels better to stay in your house awake all night and sleep all day.

I think I'll find a couple of meetings I'll hit throughout the week so I don't get lost and I make those connections that I'll need when I get really bad again. I think I would like to start the Transcendence women's and trans-NGC meeting of NA. Maybe after I get some serious amount of work done first.

I started this blog by saying this day was an ending and it is. But tomorrow is a new beginning! I have some work to do on my moto to finally sell it, and I'm going to really start slinging some code!
