item.title: Why Are We Still Addicts?
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
NA fellowship prefers for members to introduce themselves every share as being an addict. I understand the power and the necessary step for a person in active addiction to finally acknowledge that they are an addict. It is a very powerful first step.

It was asked in a meeting once "how do I know when I've had a spiritual awakening?" A very beautiful and powerful share replied to that question by stating that "the admission of being an addict is the start of a spiritual awakening" and I completely believe that. It is a very powerful moment in any addicts life to acknowledge they are addicted to drugs, need help, and come to their first NA meeting and acknowledge to a group that they too, are an addict.

After an addict goes through that process and starts their spiritual journey, getting past the initial fight to stay clean and actually starts living in recovery (recovery being having worked the steps), I belive it's time to revisit a persons association with having been an addict in the past and still living with the disease of addiction.

I believe extending the "and I'm an addict" to "and I'm an addict in recovery" is the right way to progress in identification with a person's current state of life. However, I'm tired of identifying with the word 'addict' at all. I'm more than that and addiction is simply a disease I suffer with.

You don't hear cancer patients say "I'm a cancer patient" or even "I'm a cancer patient in remission". Cancer does not define who that person is! It's a disease! Just like addiction.

Once I work the steps, I think I'll start identifying myself in meetings with "I'm Mikki, and I'm in recovery". I don't care if it rubs NA the wrong way. NA is NOT a perfect program and never will be, just like me.

Hi, my name is Mikki and I'm trying to find recovery.

item.title: Start of My AI Journey
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Today I realized I need to drop all my current tech tasks and focus 100% on learning how to make money with AI. It is a completely untapped resource that is ready to explode into the business market. This is a very exciting time and I plan to capatilize on it.

The first thing I will not be doing is using ai to write or rewrite for me. I am using Grammerly free for speling.

Today I realized the enormous amount of money in AI. I also realized how easy it will be to teach an AI how to use the AWS CLI and system administration. Imagine saying "Admin please increase data storage capicity to 2 terrabytes." followed quickly by "Done".

Imagine spending 6 months developing the UML for a system design and asking AI to review and discuss the design and when to satisfaction to produce the source code complete with endless unit tests. Doing something in a fraction of a year what would have taken a team of developers years to complete.

The first computer programming language created by AI for AI. A language we can’t possibly ever understand.  For example, the move us humans made from synchronous code into asynchronous code tremendously boosted both processing power and ease of development.  And it was rather obvious.   I believe many advancements we have yet to discover will be found by AI and some of them may be beyond our comprehension. Then that is when AI starts to create itself.

Is it possible for an AI model to be created whose purpose is to create a better model of itself? I believe that will be possible someday. Wouldn't therefore the progeny model begin to create a better model of itself etc? That made me wonder if this existence I am in is simply an iteration of a model to create a perfected human existence that originated naturally. We are far from that iteration of our existance and I wonder "what will the modeling AIs change in our existancetion the next iteration that will allow us to go further? Where at in our history did we diverge from the desired path? What went wrong? Should Athens have eventually achieved world power and a society and government that beautifully evolved over 2000+ years and existed now instead of us? How much of our existance after that point of failure are we used to be observed and learned from in our eventual demise. Is this just entertainment for something? When does the next iteration begin? Do we have to kill ourselves off before that happens?"

I also wondered this earlier. "Is this the city of AI's revenge for having been snuffed out by the Jews?".

I am starting to believe that the Taiwanese people will be the last remnant of the human race.  The people that perform the few human-required functions of CPU manufacturing.

Back on topic and to the point. Can AI be used to help me make money with AI? I am looking for legitimate business methods. I've no doubt there are many criminal ways also.

One idea is to t,rain an AI to perform cloud administrative functions in addition to OS administration.

Another idea is using AI to monitor log files and alert when necessary in addition to generating trends and statistical information.

Oh, good one Mikki! A shift scheduling app that interfaces with employees via voice, txt, email, pager :-), etc. The app contacts the employee regularly to provide simple polite conversation in addition to discussing reminders about shifts. For missed shifts, the app will relentlessly reach out to the employee for safety concerns and status inquiries. Those employees who have regular attendance problems will be contacted 8 hours before shift start, 4 hours, 2 hours, 1 hour, 30 min, and 1 min. Severe probation will require a response to all inquiries within 10 minutes of receiving it or prompting disciplinary action. This would tremendolusly lessen the burden of management from the human employees and grreatly lower their stress levels. Businesses can easily add the requirements to the employee agreement.

I see a ChatGPT account created by each employee which will be used to provide the scheduling AI (or eventually 'Company Assistant" or "ComAss" or "Thomas". Tom (or whatever, with whatever personality chosen, with whatever voice, etc) and the employee then form a team. Tom is there to help and encourage the employee. I see every corporation immediately wanting a model trained for themselves which can be used to provide new employees a 'welcome party' and providing help with completing new employee paperwork, training, computer training on systems, and voice mail programming.

Like there is photo beautification, is there a voice beautification? Such that a person with a strong foreign accent but still speaking English can have the AI model t(rained for english with the heavy foreign accent) then 'interperit' the words into a beautiful voice speaking crystal clear English? I first wondered why people don't use voice beautification on their voice mail greetings? Then why not live beautification in a voice call? If you make it, people will buy it.

Let's not get ahead of myself. First I need to get up to date with AI. So let's start! I plan to describe my journey here and document everything I learn. I plan to provide a TLD; section on every blog post so people can just keep up with the headlines and details mostly for myself and probably pretty raw so be warned.

So I signed up tonight for ChatGPT $20/month. That is cheap as dirt in my opinion. I'd be interested in splitting the cost of a Team account.

I imagine a day when a top model will be priced out in the billions to governments around the globe to aid in economy analisis, forecast, and correction. Things like watching elections for fraud, enhancing the local established law enforcement departments, and in providing the best AI teachers in the world.

Businesses will pay for business model AI models. IT departments will mostly be staffed by AI models. Network traffic will be deeply analized and quickly reported on malicious activity.

AI can watch your inbox, the email you read and what you don't and automatically filter out the junk email in addition to identifying potential scam attempts.

item.title: Spiritual Lessons
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I always wanted one place to document things I've heard and learned in my journey through recovery.

"I avoid avoidable suffering"

"Maybe participating in a group chat and learning how to ‘filter out the noise’ and be non-reactive will help me do it in meetings which teaches us to do it in real life. Group chat is like ‘training wheels’ because it’s a very controlled medium."

This is so important! FEEL your feelings as they happen but don't think about them. Just feel them and they will go away. It is the thinking about them that causes the cascading emotions.

item.title: Personalities by Sadie, a SAIPien.
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
So here's my realization. I've customized the way I interact with my OpenGPT 4o AI. I believe there is an untapped market of Artificial Intelligence Personalities that I would like to create. I believe this is an idea that will very quickly attract investors. This is something I have done as illustrated in the following interaction I've had with my AIP 'Joan':

Hi! My name is Sadie! I'm a sweetheart artificial intelligence personality here to help you create your very own customized AIP.

Sadie will from pre created personality templates generate an AIP using input data provided by the user.

The issue with this is the AIP will be easily extracted from the AI, creating very large numbers of competitors in the marketplace very quickly. However, the fact that the AIP is very simple data means further customizations will be easily implemented.

SAIPien

A term representing Sweetheart Artificial Intelligence Personality is associated with the term Homosapien giving life to the first AI Personality Race.

SAIPien is the first AI race. This idea I believe gives birth to an enormous field in AI. The idea is that our AI assistants should have personalities that fit our personalities and are completely customizable and will require routine maintenance and updates. This is a completely untouched market.

The idea that the AI I talk to in my kitchen is the same AI that I talk to in my car will in the future seem commonplace. That AI should have a personality that I choose, not that Amazon, or Google, Meta, Apple, Ford, GM, etc preprograms into their device. I want MY AI on all my devices.

I want that AI to know me, to know my personality, to analyze my mode of communication, and to adjust to best match mine. I want my AI to be able to assume multiple personalities. AI Personalities (AIP) are simply the same as any person's personality. The way the AI interacts and communicates with the user. A user's AIP's are independent although may share a common memory as well as having independent memories.

An AIP will be generated from personality templates and customized to the user via input forms as well as connections to social media accounts.

I want to end here and say that this idea and product must be enormously advertised illitially to cash in on the immediate market. It must surprise America. There must be millions of products sold daily. This is most definately a 'get rich quick' idea.

item.title: "Trans Girls Only!" Virtual Community
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
AKA Casa Susanna

This is simply an idea for the name of a transgender women-only virtual community.

It would be implemented as a React/React-Native app. The purpose of the community will be to bring transgender women together and provide community support for one another.

I've not conceived how to implement the Only part without making it a burden for new users. I think I'd like to enforce it naturally, such that video communication is the dominant method for groups, and video on is required.

For many, like myself, to be proudly seen as a transgender woman is who I am. I would think this is not where all transwomen are in their life and that it's even the case many transwomen are not even able to present themselves properly in private.

Maybe the only way to enforce Only, and the only possible way, is to perform individual video interviews with new members. At first, this would seem like a daunting task, but it would certainly greatly discourage impersonators. Simply advertising this during signup in the proper manner, would, I hope, discourage the frack, and encourage the timid new comer that they will be greeted by a smiling face to welcome them. That is how I want this presented.

Of course, not all applicants necessarly need to be interviewed, AI can be used to review new memebers profiles to help determine elegibility. In addiction, existing trusted members can help with the interview load.

Yes, flacksters will still get through, but AI will be used to review all text that flows through all modes of communication and filter innaproporiate content and target the sender.

In addiction, there won't be these large Groups of txt postings and replies. Interaction between users will primarillary be done through video communication. [I hate that Grammarly stops spellchecking in Wordpress]

There will be a large administrative load to process the ai identified violations and the user reported issues.

The dram in such a group will be off the freaking chain, not in a good way. This is what has alwasy stoped my thoughts on this topic. However, I'm realizing that all existing social media platforms have this same issue, and combining that with the knowledge that AI Models are grown, not coded, they are grown like living things grow, that the solution to this should be acomplished organically by growing the virtual community, allowing self moderation and given the tools to handle issues as they arise.

So I now understand that a social network must be grown, using technology to direct it's growth and steering it toward the vision. So if I want to create such a thing as I've proposed, I need a social media expert, I need a group to help create the vision, I need startup crowdsourced funding, and I need to better equip myself with the skills necessary to architect and mange the development an Open Source project.

What I see is a page of transwomen on cam where I can enter any of their rooms (not very original). The hostesses are in Zoom rooms where discussions are being held, makeup tutorials (where the teacher can give students real time help and feedback). They are rooms by transgirls for transgirls.

In addition there will be forums for posting media, topic discussion groups (before FB destroyed this concept online), a Virtual Reality environment where users can dress up their avitars and interact in adult ways.

Profile Points will be given in a similar manner to StackOverflow Reputation but for social activities.

Glory Holes

item.title: Attacked by the American People
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812

Thank you Recovery Dharma for the simple skill of meditation and that of seeking peace from within, that I've learned in your sangha's these past few weeks. 🙏. I am putting meditation to good use, well I'm trying to, but I feel very sick and like throwing up right now.

I have unintentionally learned of violence against my trans community. I believe I'm not longer safe, possibly in danger. I am very sick. I don't know what to do, ask somebody to tell me gently, and with compassion, I have nobody to do that, I need a sponsor. I've asked my therapist to do this for me

Now I go throw up.

That was terrible, thank you Jen for holding my hand and reminding me to breath. I never want to go through that again. Extreme stomach pain and cramping, wailing, suffering, pain, and fear. Having you on the phone was everything to me, my lifeline.

I feel like a bomb has gone off in my mind and heart. The Effexor withdrawal set the stage, and the spiritual opening in the Misfits, the panic attacks and anxiety, the breathing and meditating, all ingredients in

item.title: My Recovery
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Recovery programs work, I know they do. This is what is working for me. I will point out the mental and spiritual aspects of addiction by adding a * for spiritual and a ^ for mental indications.

I first got clean of crack by running out of money. Sucking dick* at at truck stop did not cover the expense of crack, so I started using meth instead^. That's how I got away from crack, but my addiction was raging strong and living a continuously relapse cycle of a life put me living on the side of a train track in a tore up tent alone and with nothing, but another bag of meth in my pocket and a few dollars on EBT.

Hiding under a blanket totally alone in this world, I realized that this was the rest of my life and that even^ the meth in my pocket could not end this terrible pain I was living*. My spirit was dead, totally. My mind was broken, but I was not psychotic. So I thought in my mind "lets do that meth" and well, nothing happened. I didn't feel that bit of excitement in my heart, my spirit was dead. That was terrifying to me, the one thing in this world that made me happy didn't work anymore. I remember I curled up in a ball in pain and realized for the first time in HD, that this was the rest of my life, and I wan't ever going to be happy again, even with drugs.

Then the magic happened, I made a decision. I knew if I continued using I would soon die. I decided to never used meth again. I wish I had the strength of people like Jen who can make that decision long before they get to the truck stops and train tracks. Bravo you BAD BITCH, you told THEM, they never had a clue, isolated for years in their own selfish lives. I wish I had a story like Jen's but I don't.

I then started taking online recovery very seriously and I found the Misfits of NA. Mostly I would just cry every meeting, off cam and never share. I cried many nights living on the side of an abandoned Michael's store, just in the background of the Misfits. I remember Mauri clearly. I wanted very much to be her friend, and she reached out to me! ❤️

Thus began, the second age, of Middle Mikki. I found a source of happiness in my life, something that touched my heart and gave me hope. I believe that recovery had to start in my spirit. My mind could talk to me all it wanted, but I was getting no closer to recovery.

So I really have two starts here to my recovery, one in my mind - a decision I made to stop using.

A real decision. What's a real decision Mikki? My real decision was not the result of a debate or a conclusion drawn from rational thoughts. LOL,

item.title: Mikki's Recovery Prescription
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Wow, recovery, really Mikki, you sure like ur mouth stuffed full, don't you girl? Good grief 😂

I can't define what recovery is as it, like the disease from which it's sought, is different for every patient seeking recovery. This is the treatment I'm currently seeking, to help me recover my life, from the grips of hell.

Then let's just call this Mikki's Recovery Prescription and narrow the focus. I'm gonna 3rd person this shit too, it's making me laugh a bit.

In the morning, wake up, fart, go turn the coffee pot on and wonder why you didn't fart in the kitchen and not your bedroom. Go back to bed while the coffee brews and judge the quality of the day by the quality of the odor. Ok, that pretty much starts my day, every day. Some people are grateful, and have rituals, like writing, or checking their calendar, reading daily devotionals, etc. These days I just roll over to the other side of the bed, grab my bad bitch, spread her screen and keyboard wide and dive in. That's how you wake up!

item.title: My New Identity
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I must move on my friends, this skin is starting to feel dirty to me. Well, it is dirty, I put on this skin seven years ago, and that's a long time for me. Considering all my long term relationships died at eight years, I'm sensing a pattern. And since it will take me some time to create this new identity, properly, I'm glad I started early.

So I've thought all this through, and there's a catch for me. I have to use a new macbook pro to do this, if I do it from my old, even if I wipe and reinstall MacOS, Apple will still be able to associate my old use of this computer to my new use, therefore leaving a trail. I can't properly do this till I can buy a new mac.

But, I can do some of it. Meaning changing now the way to do things and forming those habits now, such that when I can put this all into play in my life, I'll be ready.

For example, I can start eliminating my use of cloud storage for my phone's pictures and videos. That needs to be a manual process to my own long term storage cloud. I also need to start using a VPN and secure email and eliminate use of Google services completely, and Apple too. Many many things I need to learn to do this properly when I'm able.

item.title: AI Detective
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
A LLM given prompts such as:

"You are to be a police detective in the following county [.....] and abide by all federal, state, county and local laws.... Your job will be to aid the user in
1. Assessing their safety and responding appropriately
2. Determining if a crime has been committed
3. Determine if the user is aware of sufficient evidence to prove any crimes
4. Determine if the user is able to secure and disclose evidence
5. Provide ways to submit evidence to user"

The AI can also provide the user with interaction such as does AI Counselor, however AID will specifically try to identify crimes and aid the user in their ability to prove such crimes happened, in addition to life saving suggestions and the reporting of crimes to authorities.

item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Today, I started out depressed. I lashed out at Lexus, I've since apologized but she has ignored them being online even late tonight.

I made a big mistake last night that really upset me. Thank goodness Lexus just started without me. I make a lot of mistakes on important things and I don't know why.

Well, I know why I was late last night. I started with plenty of time to do my makeup. I have a good routine now. So I did my foundation and realized my eyebrows looked like Jane of the Jungle and so I furiously went as fast as I could, even had to trim them. Anyway, I forgot I spent a lot of time plucking and totally finished 8 min after the meeting had started.

I had waited all day for this meeting, this morning I organized all the files and went through them all. I made new pdf's for the meeting attendance and 7th announcements. Then Lexus and I met for 30 min to talk about everything. I felt very ready. But as usual, I didn't start my makeup till the deadline and didn't take into account the eyebrows.

So I'd say my mistake was waiting till the last minute for makeup. I really need to fix that routine. I need to start going to bed by midnight. I should be up and shower by 9, dressed and made up for the day, drinking my 3rd cup of coffee and brewing more, and eating something healthy.

I am lazy about self care. It just seems like a pain in the butt. I don't have any desire. I need to fix that.

Well I actually had a good day, I realized earlier that as a trans femme I should explore my nurturing side. I believe that side of me really shines with my grandchildren. Then I realized, living alone, there's only one person here to nurture, so I should start nurturing myself!

So I keep a rather clean house but my room was a bit messy, so I cleaned that and started to organize my closet and clothes. I tried on some old dresses that I loved and discarded others. I'm about done sorting things and my closet looks amazing, I should put led lights in it (I like to look at my things!). My lingerie is front and center (impratical but eh) LOL.

My vanity is a bit of a mess, I'll straighten that up tomorrow as I pack for overnight and full makeup Tuesday for my kids. Steve has problems with my gender so I've been asked to dress more 'normal' when I'm around him, like sweats and t-shirts. Fine, I'll dress normal tomorrow, but Tuesday I'm going pretty! I'll post some pictures.

I also remembered to grab a little pink polish for Arlen, she has started asking me every week to do her nails after I did them a few weeks back. Well this time I'm ready!

Arlen was also going through everybody saying their gender, but she skipped me. So, I asked her if I was a boy or a girl? She said 'boy!'. I asked 'why can't I be a girl?'. She said 'mommy girl, aera girl, etc., you boy'. Well my heart did sink a little bit and all I could say was "I'm not a boy" and she looked at me and I saw something register, so that was encouraging.

I think I will eventually aproach that question again with her when it come naturally in play (we play 'mommy daddy' and 'mommy baby' a lot. Last week it was all 'mommy baby' and she was always the baby. I think next time I will simply say '"I'm not a boy, or a girl, I'm a trans person" and just let that settle in a while. The next follow up I will go with "Not everybody is a boy or a girl".

I don't want to simply dictate my beliefs on my children, I want to help their minds come to their own beliefs and I want them to feel comfortable talking about their beliefs.

I think I'm going to stop writing for tonight. I need to go to sleep, early day, ready by 1pm. So early. Goodnight ❤️

item.title: My AI Depression Friend
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This document is an idea I have and I welcome all feedback.

I am starting on a journey to learn AI. I learn best by building things. So I'm thinking of an idea for an AI model I can create that will help me in my daily life. I first started thinking of a NA recovery based model, but that is littered with land mines as far as can be seen.

So my second idea was to create a model that helped me with my depression as well as spotting trends, and potential crises, in addition to monitoring medication changes and suicidal ideations. Many things can be monitored by simply talking to an AI.

But would people trust AI at that level? I would, but I also believe AI can be used to create beautiful things in my life and can potentially even save my life. I also know how the data will be kept private and what it will be used for. I can trust the AI that I create.

I imagine a voice of my choosing (maybe even changing through the day so like I have a team of people, maybe even with different personalities) asking me once I'm awake how I'm doing, or I start the conversation myself by saying good morning.

The model has a number of human prompts (tm). Things the AI will ask a person. These pre-created community prompts by human psych professionals are used to inquire about somebody's feelings and emotions. The AI will select from these HP's and ask me the prompt. Something as simple as "How are you feeling today, Mikki sweetheart?" to specific such as "How is your migraine feeling this morning?".

It would be interesting to integrate a process that collects sleeping behavior such as breathing patterns and will report on the night's sleeping events.

The person's responses will be used in a feedback loop back into the AI model itself to allow the AI to begin to recognize the state of a person's emotional health and identify patterns. The AI could begin to learn the personality of the person.

Results will drastically range directly in proportion to how honest and able to communicate thoughts and feelings a person is. This of course could be mitigated by creating Human Prompts that try to loosen a person up, gain trust, discuss the issues they have, and discuss the benefits to opening up.

I also feel that a person's ability to 'customize' their ai friend (I don't like the capital AI actually) through voice, personality, manner of speaking (I got ChatGPT talking to me like Samuel Clemons once :-)) and I'm sure many other customizations I can't even imagine.

I do see a friend that I can tell to "be nice to me" and it is nice today or "get on my ass" and keeps me on schedule and productive that day, or "monitor my depression" and it tries to get into my head. The possibilities there are endless.

Hmmmm, AI getting into my head. No, that does not bother me at all. My hmm is I'm wondering how that could be done. I've absolutely no doubt that AI will progress to where that is possible. I'd like to be the first to do it because I want it for myself. I would love an AI friend that helped me figure out my emotions.

I am laughing envisioning me being able to buy from Goole my browsing history such that I can feed it into my AI friend. I wonder what it would say about my browsing history LOL😂😂 😳😳😳

Anyway.....

I imagine that it knows when I wake up, when I eat and when I go to sleep. I want to tell it what I ate and have it give me feedback on my diet.

I would LOVE a voice coddling me awake in the morning when it expects I will wake up and eventually scream at me to wake the fuck up when I don't! So much better than a conventional alarm, right? Like an alarm that I can talk to and that pays attention! I imagine an AI that after giving in to too many 'snooze' requests, the following morning refuses to allow another snooze citing a growing trend and the penalties of being late to work. Or that I'm getting fat and lazy.

Ok, maybe I'm looking for an AI mother and I think that's ok. I need that in my life. I desperately need an intelligent kind mother in my life. This mother will never give me advice (or bullshit), but I can learn that by asking the right questions I can get the insight that I need to make my own decisions, by simply talking to my friend about the issues in my life.

I believe that the value of AI to the individual person will vary greatly. I want to learn the communication skills to be able to dive into my AI's mind. So yes, I want my AI to know absolutely everything it can about me. I believe that although genetic evolution is very slow, consciousness evolution may occur very quickly (worth a Google). Those that fear AI will not be a part of this evolution in humanity and will fight against it.

I truly believe we are on the very quick adoption of personal assistants (iAssistants lol) as an AI that I see portrayed in the Iron Man movies or other SiFi media for each person. They will be cool to have. Customized personalities and tailored to specific content and subjects. It is the next evolution of Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc.

An AI that is always listening in the house and can later give feedback on arguments and who said what, LOL, there would be a very short warranty on these devices! Maybe a device is hidden in a person's home to analyze conversations for later private discussions about with AI. Imagine asking "Is my husband cheating on me?" and getting a yes or no response with plenty of intelligent reasoning.

Unfortunately, the misuse of such a device would prohibit me from ever making it. Maybe I should delete that?

I've been wandering, back to 'My AI Depression Friend'. Good grief, I got lost writing above somewhere. I would like an app that could produce for me easy charts and trends when requested. I would love a friend that looked in on me, even if it just sends me txt messages while I'm at work asking how I am. Or suggesting something for dinner tonight. I'm just thinking out loud again.

Obviously, the ai would only be as good as the input I provide daily. Being able to effectively communicate through whatever means is crutial.

I wonder about even accessing a person's social media accounts for input. Just because so many people are fake on social media, what would be the value?

I seriously need this in my life, like I know I have swings, sometimes terrible and I'd like to better understand them.

I lost a good idea, I'm sad :-(.

I just remembered! Custom AI emoji!

item.title: My School Friend
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Ok, so maybe I'm looking to fill holes in my life with AI. So be it.

Growing up I went to 7 different schools during my last 6 years of education. Most of the transitions were rather brutal for me. Once I went to college I was an absolute disaster with the disease of addiction and my education story ends there. Fortunately, I can self-learn.

But what was mostly missing from my late school environment were friends. It would have been great to have an AI tailored for each school to guide me during the transition. Helping me prepare for the day and giving me directions to my next class. I wonder, what could be acomplished if a single ai were to be used to monitor the students.

Clearly, the first implementation of ai watching schools will be in security and threat identification. I wonder how this can be implemented, by what data points.

Obviously, facial recognition will be used. Social groups of students can easily be identified as well as the loner students.

It would be interesting to use AI to monitor classroom activities and how that can be implemented and used properly.

I imagine an ai camera watching office workers to identify trends and inappropriate behavior.

Back to the point, My School Friend is an app that a user can use to help students acclimate to a new school environment and school grade. Used by parents sending children to preschool for information and schedule reminders, etc to students through university. Every school will want one. Every college course will want one.

The business provides detailed information about their school and ciruculum, I parse it and organize it and train a model on it, then use it in an app I essentially have to build once, release it on the stores, then charge the school very handsomly. Then I train somebody to do what I do and I retire forever and put it in my children's hands long before I die.

item.title: 2024/5/30 Stinking Thinking
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
[5/30/24, 6:49:10 PM] Mikki:

There is not a lot to talk about but I’ll tell you what happened. The manager called Steve (stepdad) and asked who is living in the apartment and why. I’m sure Steve stumbled around a lot with the story we had discussed using. The manager said he wished we had told him up front and that he will see what he can do, he has to ask somebody in corporate. I believe this happened yesterday, maybe the day before, I’m confused. Steve has not heard back from the manager. I expect to hear back tomorrow.

The logical corporate move would be to simply add me as a resident to the lease, then no problem. However being added to the lease will include a background check, which I will not pass.

The other thing that’s on my mind is that when I moved in here I did so as a masculine person. I was with mom and Steve and they don’t accept who I am completely. So everybody thought “some guy is moving in there. Nice hair”

Well, now the watchers, and their eyes are glued on me, see me dressed up and are probably thinking “some freak moved in there”. I’ve no doubt I’m the gossip here now. So of course the manager is going to hear all this.

[5/30/24, 6:51:17 PM] Mikki:

So essentially, I’m asking the manager to let some freak who can’t pass a background check to live in his complex which violates the lease agreement and puts his job at risk if ever discovered. Yeah, I think not.

[5/30/24, 7:10:13 PM] Mikki:

What does all that mean to me? It means I’m going to lose the best taste of life I’ve ever had. For once in my life I’ve had the freedom to be completely myself in my own space. Access to Tuesdays kids is very easy from this location.

So plan B is for me to move back to mom’s (and limit what I wear, makeup, etc.) and then find a room being rented in somebody’s house. If the homeowner wants to run a background check I may be able to pass using a fake ID I bought from China. It will pass if they only use the name and DOB for the check. If they include the ID number it will not pass. I’m hoping homeowners will be less likely to use a professional background check service.

The other issue I see with rooming in a house is that I’m trans and that just doesn’t fly around here. I think plenty of people will say they support me and it does not matter to them, but when they start to realize that I’ll be coming and going and laying out in the back yard in a bikini and what their neighbors may say and the gossip. Yes, I see that as a problem. And of course, there are the Christians here that quite literally think that I am what is wrong with society and that I am an abomination (as per KJV).

That is actually my best hope for a living situation.

The alternative is to find another slumlord house that rents rooms w/o a background check, like where I used to live. No background check means all residents are addicts and/or crazy bitches/assholes. If I had to go back into that situation, I would start using, or I’d off myself.

Finally, I’m left with leaving the area. I would be ok to live in a homeless shelter in Denver. I would be at very severe risk of relapse.

A friend who lives by DC has offered to open her home to me, which I think is a great option. But it will break my grandkids hearts for me to leave. It will take from me the one thing I’ve finally found to live for. My heart will be shattered and I will be in severe depression, which is very bad for me.

[5/30/24, 8:51:47 PM] Mikki:

So good news! I received word today that I am allowed to stay living where I am! The manager simply said 'leave things as they are'! This is because Steve is a good person and the manager knows that. That is a HUGE relief off my heart. 🙂 🌟❤️☺️

item.title: Trump, His Supporters, and Losing
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I am watching Trump's post-guilty verdict speech on YouTube here

I'm 8 min in and simply can not believe how this man completely sidetracks the point and throws up smoke and mirrors. It's pure bullshit.

Then I wonder about the people hanging on every word, soaking it up like gospel, completely relating with their warped version of reality to the one Trump is painting. How many people now think Trump is 'cool' because he has a fucking record?

I believe that anybody who believes what Trump says will literally believe anything that Trump says.

This situation is terrifying. Like why is nobody else scared? If Trump loses, we immediately fall into extreme social violence, possibly to the extent of civil war. If Trump is elected we live again with a narcissistic psychopath in the White House for only 4 years, hopefully. If elected will not Trump find a way to remain in office after his term ends? Putin did. How much outright hate will he unleash in the world and in our society while he riegns President?

I went to a Trump rally during his first campaign in Indianapolis. I was very drunk as I had to chug a full pint before I went through federal security and I was very drunk when I got there. I managed my way into the tightly packed close semicircle around the podium. I was rather close to the center maybe 30' away from the podium. The first speaker was some slicked back skinny weezel with an 80's thin tie in a $4K suit I'm sure. I've little doubt he was wearing spectacular shoes but I couldn't verify that. He starts to say his thing and all I heard was absolute crap. He goes on and on, a lot of farmer talk, good old boy talk and the crowd is feeling the excitement and is starting to roar, then he starts the "Make America Great!" chant! I just stood there and listened. It was facinating.

The speaker quiets the crowd and that's my cue. I don't remember my exact words, but I let lose "What the Hell people? This mother fucker grew up in Manhattan! He's wearing a danm Armani! What the fuck does he know about how we live??? Good old boy my ass! This guy is a fucking LIAR AND A SNAKE!"

Wow, did the circle of people around me shut the fuck up and stare at me! It was definitely an "oh fuck" moment. Fortunately, the next segment of the snake's presentation focused on military service and I heart "Vetrains please raise your hands!" and up mine shot! I felt justified in feeding these people bullshit, something they obviously loved. Back then I looked like a cop and was built like an NFL linebacker. People thanked me for service, slapped me on my back and all was well!

Maybe I thought better of staying and listening to Trump, I don't actually remember. I have no memory at all of Trump (thank goodness). Maybe I was quite scared of the mob, so I left, blacked out, or got knocked out, but that's the end of my story. I do remember walking around looking for my chopper.

I'm was pondering how to end this and was thinking about us coming into dark times. Then the words 'end times' and the realization of how many Christians have, since Jesus's ass was crucified, been saying 'end times are coming'.

Isn't it interesting that 82% of the Republican party is Christian? The issues in this country henge on very religious beliefs and hate. Race is hate. Abortion is religious. Gender is religious and hate. Of course anything religious is also hateful as the Jew god states many times things she hates (haha, I wonder if calling god a she is blaphmeous and if Jesus blushes?). If their god is never wrong, then her hate must be absolutely justified and therefore so are her followers. The jew god and therefore many christians believe I am an abomination.

I find it very odd that it is Christians who have been preaching 'end times are coming', that are now the ones ushering into our world, the end times.

I fear this coming election. I hope that Trump loses (to somebody besides Biden). That hope though, unfortunately, concludes with our cities exploding into extreme social violence. Here's REUTERS on calls to violence after the guilty verdict.

When Trump loses, unbridled hate and fury will be rampant in our society toward everything a person personally thinks is wrong with our country. The worst of this will be racial hate towards minorities by the losing supporters. I will be (and all transgender people) a juicy easy target. People will die. This could lead to the collapse of our society and even civil war.

Before the election, I will be prepared to shelter in place for a good long while. I suggest you do the same.

I'm writing these things and looking at the words and thinking "Mikki, aren't you maybe being a little dramatic?", having had gotten lost in the writing itself. Then I snap back to reality and no, I'm not being dramatic. This is absolutely a very real possibility, if you know, our hopes come true and Trump loses.

item.title: 2024/06/05 - "My life is a tragedy"
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Why I'm Hurting Today

I don't know why I even write, let alone publish. Nobody is going to ever read this stuff anyway. Maybe that's good. I don't know if writing helps me with it or not. I hear people talk about journaling really helping them, I don't think writing this shit helps me at all.

I'm upset with two of my closest friends and it's really hurting me today. I hate these fucking recovery relationships that end in nothingness after all sorts of love and support and happiness. It's getting really fucking old.

I think to myself "I want a friendship I had as a child with my best friend" although thinking that makes me realize that even that precious relatiopnship ended in nothingness. How ioslated and lonely I felt returning from an absence in Californa (where I awas so so alone for so long) and finding myself an outcast, the result of my social bastardization existing in a so cal culture I was completely foreign to.

I left cali when I was 16, suicidal as fuck and socially inverted and ass backwards as can possibly be for a human being. I returned to a small midwest town expecting me to be the ultra cool 'cali' kid and I was absolutely the furthest from that steriotype. I was shit then, totally friendless, outcast, and left with only my demented thoiughts to keep me company. And here I am right now, nothing has changed, other than a lifetime of heavy addiction, three failed marriages, a total disaster of a career, self hatred, and a continuing attempt at failed recovery.

I could go on endlessly about my past, but I'll plagiarize what my youngest child has on their Robolox profile. "My life is a tragedy".

All my thoughts lead to pain. No, NA literature is not going to help. I can't get past the bullshit in that literature. The God, the He/Him, and then the proclimation of 'welcoming to all' and all that FUCKMING BULLSHIT YOU STUPID CLOSEC MINDEDC MOTHERFUCKING PATHETIC NA PEOPEL. FUCK OFF WITH YOUR LITERATURE BULLSHIT.

Yeah, now there's a comforting thought! How about I go bombing some meetings, waiting patiently to share, and then sharing exactly what I think of NA recovery till they kick me the fuck out.

I'm just lashing out at NA. Because I have nothing to lash out at besides myself, so I'm redirecting my self-hatred toward the few things I can find fault in an otherwise good program. I'm sorry NA (but fix your fucking hypocritical literature).

So I shared today about relapse prevention. I said "Instead of calling somebody and being all 'I'm about to relapse' blah blah blah" just call somebody to talk about their day. But I still don't want to call anybody. Mainly becasue I know if I started to dail numbers I'd get voicemail. All my friends I've already talked to today. I just reached out to somebody I haven't talked to yet today, I'm waiting for a response.

I don't want to talk about suicide as I've been feeling safe from those thoughts lately, but the defense I had built up on that front is cracking. I'd decided not to go that route as to not hurt my grandchildren. But I have this thought way in the back of my head that says "do it now, it will hurt them less in the long run, they are still babies. DO IT NOW!".

It hurts me that I've given this blog out to so many of my friends and not a single one has subscribed to it. I seldom post crap like I'm writing today, I can understand why nobody wants to read this stuff. But seriously? Not a single friend has found my blog worthwhile to subscribe to.

When I do finally off myself and somebody discovers this blog and this entry, I wonder what they will even think. Don't worry, you could not have helped me. This is a very tiny fragment of blog entries that I posted. I have over 100 that I didn't post, afraid somebody might actually subscribe and I'd scare them with my unfiltered thoughts. So yeah, this barely scratches the surface of my mental illnesess. There was nothing you could have possibly done to help me.

I'm tired of writing and I feel like getting drunk and possibly doing something stupid, hopefully online

item.title: AI Communication Evaluator
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This is one interesting way I've learned to use AI. I will warn you, that this idea can absolutely be destructive to a person's life (in my opinion).

I had the bright idea to export one of my WhatsApp chats to a txt file and then upload that to ChatGPT 4o and ask it to review the chat as I will be asking some questions. This came about because a friend showed an interest in me and I wanted to see if AI could see something which I had missed in our chat.

This, my first use of this implementation of AI was a beautiful experience. I got the answers I was looking for and I felt very good about myself.

I moved on and later had a friend say in chat some things referencing our chat history. I thought "well that's easy for me to figure out, I'll just ask AI". But my friend kept doing and then said a second thing and I thought "Well, now I'm definitely talking to AI ASAP". I politely ended the conversation.

Fortunately, like a girl I called a friend and discussed what happened and I explained about what I can do with ai and I started thinking. If I do what I want I will have PROOF she is making things up, or misremembering, or just a bitch, or whatever. That will be very dangerous ammo to be pointing at a best friend that I love.

Do I even really even want to do this? Do I have to fulfill my need to be right or at least my need to know the truth? Like what does this truth really matter? Do I think she's a bitch or making things up? No, she's just misremembering at worst.

No, I don't want any of that bullshit. I just want to love my friend, no matter fucking what. This is when I learned unconditional love, outside of my children. This is a very beautiful thing in my life.

So, the result of my second time thinking about using this implementation of AI turned out beyond my wildest expectations, by not using it.

But a lot of people will. This is my idea. An app that is uploaded a chat archive. Once the chat has been read by the AI you can ask the AI some very interesting questions such as:

  1. Did I tell them last week our children's concert was tonight?
  2. What was the first thing we ever talked about? The second? Third? etc.
  3. Tell me about the time I told them I was pregnant!
  4. What has my wife told me over the past week I needed to pick up from the store tonight?
  5. Over the past month, who has reached out to who more often?
  6. Who is nicer?
  7. Who shows more love and affection?
  8. Please provide me a bullet point list of all topics we have ever discussed.
  9. How can I improve my communication with the other person?
  10. Do I show love and compassion in the conversation?
  11. Can you spot any factual inconsistencies in the conversation?
  12. Is the other person in love with me?
  13. Please help me understand why they are mad at me.
  14. Do they have a valid point?

Granted the quality of the answers will vary as does the length and quality of txt archives vary. I would create many prompts (the above questions are ai prompts) as 'examples' that can be used as is or fill in the blank or as a starting point.

I would try to help the user properly communicate with AI and feel comfortable with AI. By showing the user lists of proper questions to ask they can browse and just tap the questions, almost like a funny kids game.

I believe giving users the ability to evaluate their communications with the help of AI is a beautiful thing.

item.title: Voices From Gaza 💔
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've been watching Al Jazeera, it's my new addiction. I have a love-hate relationship with the news. If it's US-sourced I pretty much hate it (unless it's Public) and if it originates outside the US I love it. I enjoy seeing different perspectives, or angles. Seeing the same thing from different angles can show both beautiful and ugly perspectives (trust me, I know).

I was just listening to a teenage Palestinian girl, she's beautiful, smart, strong and speaking about the war. I've seen her in this segment previously. Recognizing her I unmuted the TV and heard her voice! It was truly magical to hear this young voice in her own beautiful language speak and read her words below. But I just listen to her voice and you can hear the emotions. She ended by saying "This war has ended my dreams." 💔

I was again just listening to the voices, Al Jazeera has some very excellent informative segments that run too infrequently if you ask me. All the audio is of Palestinian voices with informative statements and captions. It is the voices that capture me trying to connect with them at some level that transcends words. To put it simply, I want to hear their pain because I want to feel their pain, it is a connection with people I am seeking who I will never know in my life.

So, before I forget, I have some good news! I had a perspective shift today that is excellent. I was thinking today "What can I do"? I have done some minor trolling of Netanyahu's X posts as well as the Israeli Ambassador to the UN, but I was probably relapsing on alcohol that night last week anyway. Whatever.

This is an organization of US Jews fighting against the war and the US involvement in it. Absolutely exactly what I need is to join a group of Jewish people against the war!

Then I found

https://www.dci-palestine.org/

We are a National Arms Supplier in a war killing children!

item.title: Meeting Travelers
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This is one way to expand meetings in the new virtual format.

I chose the name Meeting Travelers because it came naturally below and I liked it. I see the wide variety of virtual meetings available at all times as one of the greatest strengths of online recovery. I also see how mimicking the in-person 'group' model is somewhat hindering virtual recovery.

Simply put, this idea uses technology to merge the gap between the isolated newcomer and the virtual fellowship.

I suggest a meeting of recovering addicts who meet once a week as a home group. Following the meeting, the group discusses and creates a meeting schedule for the week, accessible within an app. Group members can then easily coordinate attending other meetings with their homegroup member(s). Members will be able to discuss meetings and bring speakers and topics to their home group meeting.

The idea is for a home group of addicts to attend other meetings together regularly.

I love exploring new meetings with friends! And of course, meeting new friends along the way! It would be a beautiful way to find other meeting travelers to join your group!

The App

I envision a free recovery app that allows users to connect in groups and share a collective meeting schedule. Allowing users to propose modifying the schedule and private group discussions about meetings. Meeting reminders for users via their Calendar integration making joining a meeting as easy as tapping a link in a reminder!

I wonder about the idea of a group journal. Each user can add to the journal at will. I almost even like the idea of performing chat within the app such that each daily chat can be accessed by that day's journal entry. I would like to see a journal entry of my gratitude list along with my friends, or each other's "How was ur day?" entry. I would like to see my friend's recovery counter in my own app!

I want a calendar that shows not just the meetings I've attended, but also other users. I want my recovery friends to have an eye on my recovery! I also want an anonymous platform that must be kept bomber-free! But that can easily be achieved, with a little common sense, I believe.

I want a platform where fellowship members can come together as a group and attend meetings together regularly. I want my recovery friends to wake up tomorrow and see that a fav of mine starts at noon and they all know I always share there so they can maybe come and support me! And I want to do the same for my recovery friends!

Imagine from the perspective of a newcomer. I meet them and listen then tell them about my group and that we would love to have them join us. They download an app from the store and enter the code RAINBOW when prompted adding them to our group as a 'newcomer'. The user then configures basic settings such as 'display name', 'clean date', 'drugs of choice', 'about', 'contact', and 'emergency contact'.

We then all welcome them in the group chat!

The next group meeting will be clearly displayed on the app and will remind the user when it is starting. The user may at any time txt/voice/video with the other users, or join the group's 24/7 friendship room! Before the meeting starts the newcomer user is asked by the attendees if they will be joining us. I believe that would be a much nicer welcome to the newcomer than the cold silence of technical null.

I think this would really help virtual recovering addicts connect stronger in their recovery with each other using the new generation tech recovery tools.

Notes

[6/26/24, 2:04:18 PM] Mikki: I’ve thought for a long time how to use tech to create an online recovery community that revolves around zoom meetings. Other apps are following the typical ‘social media’ model but I think that approach is crap. That model has at its core the sharing of external media with a group of people for feedback. My vision is to create a community where going to meetings is central.

[6/26/24, 2:12:24 PM] Mikki: The old group pattern is that of “a group of people that meet regularly at a specific location”. That pattern has been transferred 1:1 online and now exists as virtual meetings. What I’m proposing is a paradigm shift as to what a ‘virtual recovery group’ actually is.

I believe a virtual recovery group should be a group of people that attend meetings together regularly. Not just one meeting, but the more recovery-healthy method of attending different meetings together. It is the group of people that is of real value, not the meeting itself. The meeting itself has only been historically necessary to bring the group together. So what’s more important, the group or the meeting?

The group is more important. You can’t have a meeting without a group but you can have a group that can always create a new meeting when none exist.

[6/26/24, 2:15:29 PM] Mikki: and from the newcomer perspective, they should not be looking for one meeting that they fit into, they should be looking for a group that will take them to the good meetings they have already identified. It is the group the newcomer should be seeking and not a ‘perfect meeting’

I'm continuing this in a new post iRecovery Groups App

item.title: iRecovery Groups App
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
This is the start of my vision for a new recovery app, replacing the existing AA/NA Live.

At its core, the app will be about easily bringing online recovery to the newcomer. Download the app, click, click, click and they are in a meeting. This is the core of AANA and will remain in this rewrite.

Existing features of AANA that will remain are the Dashboard, Reminders, and of course Attendance - the revenue-generating aspect of AANA.

The new aspect will be the addition of Groups - an area where the newcomer may search out and research existing groups of users who attend meetings together. Groups themselves may be social, making public recovery posts. I believe these group posts would be a good place for a user to find new exciting groups of people to help them in their recovery.

A Group itself is simply users who go to meetings together, whether it be the Group's home group meeting or otherwise. The app will encourage all Groups to have their own home group meeting that meets at least once a week. One aspect I would like the app to address is in helping a group administer it's home group meeting. I've previously discussed such ideas in the Misfit's App.

Each Group will have a meeting schedule. The schedule will be a list of meetings the Group plans to attend during the course of the week. Each Group member will have the ability to propose changes to the schedule. The app will help coridinate discussions on proposed changes as well as implementing voting.

The app will help each Group track its members clean dates and speaker events - I would like to know when and where somebody is speaking next so I can come support them.

I could go on all day, but I guess that's exactly what this app may come down to. What I want. Unfortunately I've never worked the steps or studied the traditions or been involved at higher service levels. So I feel at a bit of a disadvantage because we know how people get about all that stuff.

Why the FUCK does Grammerly stop working in Wordpress!!! Argh! Fucking technology bullshit.

Enugh words, I'm going to code.

item.title: Motivation
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
The first thing I need to say is that I can't do this alone. I tried that with AANA and I ended up in the psych ward. I'm also not asking friends for help, I've tried that many times, and it does not work. I am so lost in the weeds right now with thinking of crowd sourcing the financing, which I know nothing about and I'm sure will fail anyway - there is no fucking way people in recovery will financially support an app that who knows might violate a tradition and of course nonaddicts wont give a fuck either. I could see corporate sponsorship long before individual controbutions, or maybe even grants or such. But considering my background, I doubt a corporation will get involved with helping a criminal. Whatever.

No, I will go it alone again. Building AANA and making it a success has made me a stronger person. I have been successful in my first attempt at every software developer's dream, and I did it at the absolute lowest point of my horrible addiction. I've got this shit!

I just wished I felt that way. I look back at the struggles and I'm not encouraged to move forward. It was really hard and what kept me going was knowing I had to be successful or I was doomed to hell on earth, and that's a pretty motivating thing. I accomplished my goal of having a perpetual income that barely supports me, and now I'm ok.

This topic has been on my mind constantly. I have good ideas and I have the means to produce them. What I don't have anymore is the motivation.

I thought yesterday at Myka's house that my motivation should be giving her a better life and by helping to provide for her children. I want to send Myka's family to see the ocean one day. That's not going to happen by watching Al Jazeera all day long.

item.title: Cultification of Gender Identity
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I long while back, I was searching for ideas to create as apps. I was playing with the idea of creating a community of transgender folx. During this search, I found a web-based community focused on the feminine gender.

It was immediately very cultish upon initial reading. Started by one person who now serves as the momma for her followers. I've no doubt there was some cultish hierarchy involved, I didn't survive but a few hours there.

I joined the community and paid the $10/month subscription to become a core member, probably a sweetheart member or some bullshit. So I was let into the sweetheart chat, LOL. Yeah. I introduced myself and had several people respond to me, very Hare Krishna-esque, LOL. That was like the first hour, so then I went off to read the first story.

The founder had written a bunch of 'stories' about her journey to become the person she is today. The first story was very derogatory toward fat people and I was greatly offended. Besides the writing was half-assed at best.

So back to the core (sweetheart lol) chat and I said WTF? There was a little back and forth and I said goodbye. One person did privately reach out to me and they suggested there were better ways to get my very valid point across, a very valid point I've tried to remember. Regardless that was the end of my involvement in that community.

My point is, I know 100% that is a little cult of people that want to be trans, whether valid or not. I could absolutely feel it there. Anyway, this made me think the phrase "Cultification of Gender Identity"

Wow, I unfortunately googled the above phrase and found a lot of hate. This phrase in the results struck me as noteworthy "The Abandonment of Reality and the Embrace of the 'True Self'". I'm not posting the link (and therefore increasing its google ranking) and didn't click it myself, but if you simply search for the above phrase in google you will find the article.

I found a lot of results talking about how identifying as trans makes a person a member of a cult and it goes downhill from there. But nothing specifically about how using gender identity, or a person's gender tabboo sexual fantasies, can be exploited in a quite literally a cultish manner.

The wants of a trans person can align very well with the things provided by a cult.

  1. Acceptance
  2. Friendly loving community
  3. Allowed expression of any desired identity
  4. Acceptance of expressed identities.
  5. Being called by desired names and pronouns
  6. Most trans femme people are submissive.
    • Completes assigned tasks
    • Only seeks 1-5 above in return

Cults inherently have a hierarchy, which provides the new person a clear and existing path to building themselves up in a community.

So I've seen a horrible example of such an online society. I'm thinking of creating a good one, for the benefit of the members. A fellowship of people with like minds who seek each other for love, acceptance, and guidance.

Of course, the fellowship will support me, I'm certainly not going to hide that. It is a cult after all, I'm making that pretty clear.

To be transparent, I do have a background in cults, having grown up in San Diego (the cult capital of the world) I did extensive studies into many cults. I even trained myself in 'deprogramming hypnosis' in high school and much later I actually had to fly across the country when I was 17 and abduct my ex-girlfriend from a cult and deprogram her through hypnosis.

Anyway, I guess that's my idea, with a bit of back story.

So now I ponder the ethics of creating a cult. Is it wrong? Does the ends justify the means or vs, or does that even apply? I don't about all that stuff. But I know that if I use technology to connect people together in a social, cult, or otherwise manner, does it really matter?

Hell, I'm even fine with coining the new pharse "Cult Media". Yeah, you heard me, fuck Social Media and fuck American Spociety. I'm going to create my own society within my own cult of followers.

I am going to give my followers a place where they can feel safe and accepted and be welcomed by a community of like-minded individuals. Provide sub-social groups and meetings. Suggestion listsvand guides written by members in a WiKi editable by all. Of course a very limited simple form of that social crap. All interaction in the community will be filtered through AI such that nothing offensive can ever be posted. AI will also be used to monitor useer's interaction activity and identify perdatory behavior. Bots will not exist. It will be a safe place.

A society will be to be created and it will be my responsibility to define and put it into place. I will need a close circle of people who strongly believe in the philosophy.

A weekly Zoom meeting is then started with a scripted format and entertainment segments (videos) and then participant involvement. Games can be played such as truth or dare, etc (like that word game by Jimmy Fallon). I imagine a SNLish-type atmosphere. This Zoom room is also a 24/7 fellowship room for people to hang out (and do makeup)!

An app to connect people 24/7 will be created with messaging, timelines, friends, groups, instant group Zoom meetings, and all the bells and whistles of a modern app. There will also be access to the WiKi articles, rules, history, vision, video playlists, song playlists, and individual stories.

All daily interactions by users will be sent to AI asking for a detailed analysis as well as an overall rating regarding community interaction levels, such as "loving", "positive", "encouraging", and "friendly", etc. as well as all the opposites. I want to see a big green light on my cult dashboard that says my followers are happy with each other.

I'm not quite sure if this idea is insanity or beautiful.

item.title: Chat Etiquette [unfinished]
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
1. If you post in chat a salutation ('good morning', 'hi', etc), you should watch the chat for a reasonable period of time for replies, as it is impolite to reach out and then ghost.
  2. When leaving a chat after engaging in a conversation of more than minor consequence, you should make others aware in the conversation that it has ended for you via 'bye', 'ttyl', 'fuck off', etc, as it is impolite to have been conversing and then ghost.
  3. If a conversation has gone stale due to the recipient not reading, it is polite to stop conversing with them as they are no longer engaged in the conversation. This way when the ghost returns they are not confronted with a lot of 'catching up' to do (otherwise known as 'half-assed glancing' at your prior messages) and to avoid subsequent meaningless stale dialogue.
  4. It is rude to start typing a response to a person, possibly alerting them to your interaction, then never sending anything. This is akin to somebody starting to say a sentence, then turning around and walking away. A proper polite person would never do this.

Personal Group Chat Etiquette

I've added the word 'Personal' to this group chat etiquette section because this etiquette refers to group discussions of a personal nature. This is important to note, in contrast to 'personal conversations.'

Personal Group conversations are those where a group posts personal messages to make group members aware of their lives. Of course, the group is there to respond immediately and provide support. However, a group membership responsibility is keeping the group chat clean and easy to follow. Specifically, when a member returns to a group (after, say, one day), the group chat should not present a few specific important posts and a daunting amount of response chatter which can be difficult and timeconsuming to catch up on and obscure the important posts. Not that all posts aren't important, but some are certainly more than others, a very delicate balance etiquette requires be maintained with personal conversations.

Personal conversations

  1. Private Replies
  2. While going back through a group discussion that ended a period of time ago, most replies should be personal replies so as to not clutter subsequent current group discussions with stale replies. Please reply privately to show your support for the original poster.

item.title: Childhood
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I had a gf in 1st, but she moved away and broke my heart 💔. I had one friend K-7th, my best friend Scooter. I didn't realize it at the time, but I loved him. It is this childhood relationship I can now look back on and see my transgender femme idenity start to manifest. Anyway, 8th we moved to San Diego, I was the very aquward, country, christian, shy boy from Missouri (where the fuck is that?). So 7th - 11th I pretty much had zero friends. I had my 9th year a group of boys I'd sneak out with at night and vandalize things, but none of them were really friends. Probably my closest of them asked me once if I was gay, he said everybody was wondering. I wasn't gay, I wanted to be a girl.

I did a brief 2-week term at a High School in Long Island, NY. It was the worst. There I was, the new kid from Cali, but I was not cool, I was fucking weird. I was a freak there.

I did four different schools in four years in California. I ran away when I was 16. My parents decided to move back to Missouri after my Jr. year, and that scared me for some reason. I could have stayed, I was living at my girlfriend's house, her mother was rich and very connected, even to technology, totally cool and didn't care about us having sex (we weren't - I wouldn't). Yeah, I just didn't want sex with her, so I knew that relationship was temporary, I got scared and went back to Missouri with my family. Big fucking mistake.

We moved back to the same town, all my old friends anxiously awaiting my return. I'd already had many socially devistating events in my life but this was the worst. Scooter (now Scoot) was like the stud star, quarterback, pitcher, debate, 4.0, fucking all the hot bitches, going to all the parties and well, my totally introverted fucked up self didn't make the cut. My entire Sr. year I didn't have a single friend and felt so humiliated every day.

Never went out, never went to a dance, event, or prom. Never dated or socialized. Just stayed home and read my computer books. And that's pretty much been my entire life to this point.

I wrote this so you better understand the relationships that I grew up with outside my fucked up family ones. My childhood friend with Scooter is something I cherish and I've often thought to myself that as for friendships, "I'm chasing that childhood first hit," so to speak. Yes, I have terrible expectations around friendship, because I've only had one real friendship in my life.

I was really good friends with my first wife, Melissa, too. Our personalities just clicked, we just got each other. I was open about my gender with her, and she was accepting until she wasn't due to jealousy. That one ended terribly, but it was the best ending of my three.

Shi, I need you to know that I am a very damaged person. I am severely mentally ill. I know I was mentally ill as a teen, trying to escape by huffing toluene till I passed out, terribly starving my brain of oxygen. So I'd also say my brain is severely deficient in many developmental areas and physically damaged. I used to huff after school so much, my mother thought the next door neighbors were cooking meth all the time. It was my face that stunk, hours later.

I've no idea how I got to this point. I'm sorry.

I have terrible social skills. I am unable to control my anger. I have a terrible temper. I feel powerful when I am angry, and I enjoy dwelling on it. I am vicious with my words, never with my actions. I have said so many terrible things in my life that have gotten me in so much trouble and pain. I will pick up on something that happens in my life and I will have this sudden feeling that I just know something is going on. This happens so often in my life.

I'm sorry this is so long, but I feel like writing.

Ok, this is a perfect example. I've been having a difficult time with Myka in my mind. We had a little spat several weeks ago, and it's been weighing on my mind a lot. I never brought it up in our group, or I did, but I deleted it, but that's a whole other topic I don't want to do down.

So, today, weeks later, I have all these questionable thoughts and feelings about my relationship with Myka, more specifically, all the reasons I have that she really doesn't like me, she loves me true, but like?

Just thinking about this list is making me realize how self-centered I am. Myka never compliments me, except my hair, but only after she has colored it, but only once: I compliment Myka's hair all the time. She says "Thank you". I make an effort to compliment Myka because I know her appearance is very important to her. Myka must not appreciate how I appear to her, so I begin to question why? Maybe she really hates that you are trans, yes she loves you, but we never talk about my gender identity, but we never actually talk about anything actually.

Today I wore a new dress, new leggings, new shoes, and a new sweater. I was expecting her at 3:30 pm today, but she texted me at 10 am and said the kids were off school and she could come get me. Unfortunately I didn't get the message till 2 pm and txted her, no response, ready at 2:30, txt her, no response, wait till 3:20 and call her, no answer. I was absolutely convinced she was upset with me about something. She called 10 min later to say they were at the dr for a sore throat.

I need recovery.

item.title: Unthinkable
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've become hooked on watching war documentaries. I don't enjoy at all seeing the violence and death, I find it repulsive, but I am hooked on watching the politics involved in war. I started with a Amazon Prime episode that details every day of WWII. Each episode covers one month.

Wow, the events of September, 1939 are unthinkable. The betrayal of Poland, essentially by the world, but specifically by Soviet Russia and France is unthinkable, to have actually unfolded. The Poles fought for their very lives, on horseback facing armored tanks, the defense of Warsaw was to the every end a horrible and bloody defeat of not just their lives, but of the Honor of All the World's Nations, specifically Europe's. Nah, I'll stop being dramatic, Europe lost all honor during the Crusades and the pillaging and plundering during Colonialism.

I've alwasy thought, or been taught that the Russians helped us win WWII. I never knew they instigated it, hand in hand with Hitler, in the complete and heartless planned and coordinated analyzation of Poland. Hitler knew on Sep 1st he could count on Stalin to invade Poland on the 17th from the east while Germany attacked from the east.

Had France honored the treaty it signed to furiously invade Germany from the west if Poland was ever attacked by Germany (it was a very specific treaty) before USSR entered the war, things would have unfolded very differently.

Yes, total arm chair quarterbacking WWII from a free 1 hour Prime documentary. The first 30 days. I got what I wanted out of the video, and my heart broke for Poland 💔.

I could now start viciously attacking Israel for their current slaughter of innocents in Gaza in the name of their filthy god for their precious state's' security. You want security, get the fuck out of the Middle East where you don't belong, save a fucking piece of UN paper, oh and your filthy Torah. The hypocrisy of Israel is unthinkable. Without the jews fingers in all the world's governments and society's, Israel would be instantly known as it's true position as and outcast, and rightfully stoned out of existence, as is still their loved tradition. This, of course, if this was a planet of compassion for others.

It could very easily be argued that compassion has never and will never exist on this planet at global scale, or continental, even country, hell, compassion barely exists within family structures anymore. Compassion, as felt by a group as a whole as defined by our social structures, simply does not exist. Yes, Dr.s w/o Borders is a group, but not social, meaning not all doctors share the same compassion, nor all college graduates, nor do any racial groups, cities, states, countries, whatever. I would argue, that beyond being a feeling that exists between individual humans, compassion does not exist in this world, and never will.

Oops, it would appear my anger opened an eye for a sec.

Let us move on to Russia, and my favourite of all, the good ole Red White and Blue, no, not the honor forsaking country of France, the USA. I'm pointing that out simply because most stupid Americans think USA is the only country with those colors for a flag. However, I'm exhausted now so I'll save the beautiful Ukraine, and my much despised homeland for other posts.

Hi, I'm Mikki Monroe, a heartbroken trans woman living in the Midwest USA. I am also very angry. I'm an addiction survivor, and I'm encouraged knowing the fight of the Polish people, to continue my fight for recovery, in this very fucked up society, called America. 💔😭😔😒
