item.title: Colorado State Police Chase
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
12/12/2024

I was a drug addict living in Colorado Springs, with my estranged father, who to my delight was also an active drug addict. I was a meth cook, my father a dealer. I also discovered that Colorado had yet to implement limits on OTC pseudoephedrine purchases. Of course I wasn't buying the pills, I was stealing them, as they had stacks out on the shelves. Crazy! Wasn't Colorado paying attention to the national news? Whatever. I cleaned the pills and ended up with a perfectly clear, perfectly formed crystal of pseudoephedrine about 1" think and 4" high. Garbage in, garbage out.

I was driving a stolen 1983 Dodge Caravan I took from Los Angelis, heading up the Pikes Peak pass with my lab in boxes in back, to cook in the mountains. I was going at top speed, maybe 35 mph, and a car was right on my ass. I eventually got pissed and brake checked the asshole hard, and that's when the lights came on, so I pulled over. The spotlight was put on me with the officer screaming at me to put both my hands out the window, which I obliged. I could see the officer had his gun out and he was crouched behind his door. Wow, they take brake checks seriously out here!

I asked the officer what the problem was and he said the car had been reported stolen. It was as bad as it looked, lol. I could surrender, or fight. I'll now mention that I learned the basics of meth production while in prison for fighting. I never hesitated to attack cops, who were in the wrong, and while in my presence. There was possibly 500ms of thought before I hit the gas and flopped my head over into the passenger's seat. I can still easily feel that fear and making that decision.

Once I took off, fuck fear, I don't have time for that. I have to be sharp as hell in my minivan as I sped away from a Colorado State Highway Mountain Patrol vehicle! Eat my dust bitch! I'm not going down easy! The adrenaline was the most intense I've ever experienced, which resulted in me, in a panic, to throw an oz out the window. I had a whole lab in the back, wtf Mikki? However I was in the left lane for the toss, so it went into the river below us, but I saw a uturn bridge, which I quickly used, so it worked out quite well for me.

Now I'm heading downhill, with Pikes Peak directly on my right, and 50' drop off the left. Obviously the hp cruser had much better handing than my old garbage minivan, but I refused to let that cop get up on my bumper. It got very crazy, then he started to clip my end and I can still see the darkness and the moon on the water far down below.

That's when I got mad. I can still feel the smoldering embers of that anger. Still. I fought that mother fucking murdering white piece of shit cop all the way down that mountain. It was life or death at this point, and I was fighting for life and hoping for a quick death!

Upon reaching Colorado Springs city limits I saw the wall of cops, in the road. Stupid cops, you think I'm going to draw inside the fucking lines???? I slammed the brakes, eased over the curve into the grass, drove right past the silly cops and made a left at the intersection to head home, I lived just a few blocks away. They all just looked at me as I drove right by them. But they weren't far behind.

I called good ole dad, told him I was heading his direction, he said he could hear the cops. I was thinking to abandon and make for the house, he said bad idea, I said I love you and threw my phone. I was done living, I was not being taken alive. This was a dream come true, such an exciting end for somebody who had longed for death since teenage. I would make a fight of this to remember. I was also unarmed, so I had no real fighting abilities, so flight was the name of the game.

[Look peeps, I know full well how demented I was, attempting recovery now. I just want to tell the story without evaluating my actions at this point. I'm trying to relive this experience and just put it to words.]

This was not my first high-speed chase from police. I'd do it back in the Midwest where most cities have a no pursuit law and just going 75 in the city and police would stop the chase, for good reason, right? Well, that was not the case in the Springs, they go full force with coordinated attacking maneuvers to quickly end the chase. I managed to avoid two of those and realized I needed better tatics.

So at the next intersection I crossed over into the on coming four lanes of traffic, which I guess police never though of. I drove quite a while in the shoulder, so lane 0, the cops were right across the divide next to me. I'd occasionally have to swerve to miss a car or lock of my brakes, but speed really didn't matter in this chase, my tactics had eliminated all abilities of the police to stop me.

Of course my strategy was terribly suffering, what was my end game. I was hoping for freedom and expecting death by police. Although I had no intentions of harming anybody, I did once swerve toward a group of kids running across the street, intending to tell the cops I was serious as fuck. The kids all flipped me off as I passed. Good for them! Yes, fuck me. I even enjoyed hearing them scream indistinguishable curses at me. I can still hear their screams. I remember thinking "I wasn't really going to hit them."

Eventually traffic on my side ended and then I saw the blockade at the next intersection, police cars had been used to stop traffic in all directions, leaving the only empty lane the proper right side of the road totally open. Police cars were in the intersection to block traffic, but again, I just drove around everybody and continued forward, back to having police on my tail. Now, they were not near as aggressive, at the time I thought I'd taught them a lesson.

All the intersections were pretty much clear. I was actually driving very safe, from my perspective, I had zero acceleration and every light I'd slow down and just navigate around the traffic. The next intersection had an open lane I was shooting for, when I saw the cop dart out and throw something invisible. When I saw the spikes it was almost too late, I swerved and avoided them. Watching my rear view mirror I saw the police behind me not react as quickly and blow their tire. I thought I was home free, the intersection was blocked. I sped off at 45 mph.

The next intersection I never saw the tack strip until it was too late. I can still see it and the front left tire blowing, but besides the cop on foot at that intersection, nobody was behind me, so I went where the blown tire took me and I made a sharp left down a residential block. The tire was coming off the rim and I realized I had to bail, so I opened the door and jumped, landing on my chest. I survived, got up, and ran.

I headed for a backyard and jumped the fence. Fence over fence I jumped in parallel with the street, I think at lest 5. These were all 6' privacy fences, a nice area of town. I was going over them face first, no hesitation, like a Ninja Warrior, rolling on landing and running. Then I discovered somebody parks their motorcycle next to the fence and it broke my faces fall as only a Harley Davidson can. I ran.

The next fence was the shitty neighborhood house, every neighborhood has them, I'm sure the mailbox read "Karen". That fence was of very ill repair and simply fell over when I hit it. I realized at that point, this was futile, I just told the police exactly how far down the block I'd run. Tactics needed updating.

I politely opened the gate fence and went back to the street. Standing on the sidewalk and looking back, it looked like Christmas Village on cocaine, it was and still is beautiful in my mind. I loved the social fury and police hate in my wake. It was like an entity, a god, showing all their wrath and it was all directed at me! That was exciting and encouraging. I don't remember terror, I did not pee my pants, or waver, I turned and ran.

I never once thought I was tired, and I hate running. I remember running for my life, knowing my life was in grave danger, but feeling strong. I wasn't thinking anything, no words, no thinking of what to do, or what might happen. Run and only run. Then a single command in my mind:

"TREE", and I knew my next goal. I turn to my left and can still see the most beautiful tree glowing in light.

I pride myself in my arm strength. I used to show off to my girlfriend a few months earlier my ability to climb straight up a rope, no nots, no legs, just straight up. I have incredible arm strength. Probably 6 months earlier, on the day I left prison, I curled once the entire stack of weights, which was more than anybody I'd seen do in the past year.

I went straight up that tree, branch after branch, right to the top in a flash, never even contemplating the next reach. At the top I started to sway the tree back and forth, until I felt confident to jump atop the two story house, my goal. Nope, never once thought "I should climb a tree and jump to a house", I just kept following the path in front of me.

I didn't fear the jump, or hesitate when when it was time, but the landing was terrifying, it was a steep roof and I slid considerably. I crawled back to the peak and laid there for a few moments and watched the red and blue fire burning down the street. There weren't even any cars anywere this far down the street. Silly cops. I didn't watch long, at that point reality started to hit me. Moved further in, and slid down the roof toward the brick chimney and I squatted in front of it, with my back to it, trying by best to gage the angles the lights will hit the chimney from the ground below. Then I froze and waited.

The run was was over, terrible tactics anyway. I'll make my final stand here. I had no intentions of coming off that roof in custody alive. I would viciously attack any officer that came close, that was the plan at least. That was also the point I regretted having tossed the oz, and my phone, and it was freezing, but thankfully I had my full thick length leather riding coat on. I curled up like a bat and listened.

I heard them on my right enter the backyard and I just wait. I heard them go into a metal shed and I quickly took a recon peek, there were three cops, two on my right, one on my left. I quit breathing, and pulled my legs in as close as I could. Just like Frodo and the cave troll, one side, pause, then the other. The police left.

I knew this was now a waiting game. There was a perimeter and I was currently dead center. I went to sleep and I slept good. I woke up hours, possibly many hours later as my body was dying for sleep. I never even moved anything but my eyes. The glow of the anger was gone, but I knew I could not move. I closed my eyes and listened. Eventually I heard the slow crunching of tires on a gravel road. There was an alley of sorts (it's a Springs thing) and they were still slowly patrolling less than 20 meters away, the length of the backyard I'm guessing.

So I went back to sleep. I woke up I'm guessing 4am or so. Oh I had to pee sooo bad, but I waited and listened. This house did not have guttering and I didn't want to go far from the safety of the chimney, so I went off the back of the roof, onto the concrete below me. Tactical error #1, not using the tree side which was grass grass below. The yappy dog inside erupted. I knew it was game over, police would be here in minutes, I ran up the roof and toward the tree. There was no light on it this time, just a bit of moonlight to make it out, but I knew I'd be ok, even realizing how much further away it now was. I jumped, no thought.

Crash, slash, bang, grab, slip all the way to the ground and on my feet, I ran immediately to the neighbors driveway and dove beneath their truck. I listened and listened and didn't hear a sound, 30 seconds later I was running down the street, straight into the dark beyond. I came off the street and right into a field or a great open expanse. Weeds and brush quite high, and I thought possibly it was a flood plane of sorts. Regardless, I was on the right path, although somewhat exposed, so I quit running and walked and took cover everywhere I could. I came to train tracks and followed them for an hour, maybe two, and I was starting to feel safe, but it was miserably cold and my face and hands were seriously freezing.

The tracks soon crossed a road, where a convince store was located. A young male prostitute in hand casts was out front waiting for men to stop by for morning coffee and head. I went right in the store, find the beanies and gloves and went to the register. The clerk had a look of shock and dismay, like I was going to rob him. I was like, huh? Paid cash, no change and walked out the door.

The beautiful young man stopped me outside and asked me "Are you the one all the cops are looking for?" I said "How many?", and he replied "All of them.". He then grabbed my arm and spun me around and to my horror, I could see my reflection in the glass window. I was most definitely a demon straight out of hell. That's what I saw.

I'd totally forgotten the Harley I'd cracked my forehead open on the previous evening. Never noticed my leather coat was drenched in blood, my face totally covered in blood, like Carie.

I turned to my new best friend and asked him for help. He asked how. I said we needed a car. He said we could go to his house and called a taxi while walked down the street toward his house, I was not waiting at the convince store. He said to keep walking and he would pick me up, 15min later he did and we went to his place. You just have to just love, the intimate sister like bond that prostitutes sometimes have with each other. I do, and this gem was my savior.

We got to his home, turned on the morning news, and it was non-stop the long chase through the city and the continued search. They had no leads. I called father and he could not believe I was free. Then I jumped in the shower, oh I remember that shower, it felt so good. I scrubbed up good and then I sat down lotus style and just let the hot water hit my head and run down my face till the water was cold.

I crawled in bed with my new boyfriend and showed him all my gratitude and repaid him the compassion he had shown me. Well, that's how it started, but then it got kinky once I realized the power and fun I wielded sexually as a fresh celebrity fugitive. We had very low energy slow sex as I was exhausted and desperate for drugs or sleep. Whatever, I gave him with great bragging rights with his friends, as he took many pictures, and enjoyed my body. We crashed together, well, I crashed entangled with him and woke in the afternoon alone.

Everything was orange, the thin drawn curtains were orange, and the bedspread was orange. The whole room was orange, with a few inch crack in the drapes and sunlight streaming in, dust particles floating in the sunbeams. I sat on the end of the bed and just took it all in, the room was immaculate, and the scene it was just beautiful.

My friend was in the kitchen when I came out, gave me a kiss and told me where to sit. He brought me food and drink and changed the bandage on my very deep wound. We talked, and I learned he was previously used by his 'straight' roommate for on demand oral sex. When my friend started refusing is resulted in physical confrontation, to the point the roommate broke both of my friend's hands with a hammer. Straight white guys, yep. This depressing topic demands drugs.

I called my father and he wanted to see me, as I him, as well as his drugs. I had cash, my friend called a Taxi, I wore a ski mask, it was cold, and we went back to my place. The house erupted when I walked in, there were probably a good six of our friends/customers there, all glued to the TV for updates. I introduced my new friend and we got high. Everything was just fine and I went back to my friends house via taxi, my father having given him cash, and me meth. Besides, I may have been falling in love with him, but that did not mean I trusted him, any further than I could see him, and he knew my home base now. I was obligated to go privately party with him.

Well, I am half Irish, and I've alwasy said that the luck of the Irish is a very real thing, it's just as often bad as it is good luck and things turned bad. The 5pm evening news displayed my unforgettable minivan sporting super flashy California license plates asking for citizens to call in if having ever seen. It was just a matter of minutes before it was called in by the neighbors that hated my house. I called dad and he had a plan, in theory a good plan, but in practice terrible. He had a lifelong friend who owned a cabin in the mountains who offered it to us. So I kissed my lover goodbye, jumped in a taxi and headed home, to where father's friend was waiting anxiously to take us.

I also remember my perfect crystal of pseudoephedrine was on the news, they lied saying it was pure meth. It was absolutely beautiful seeing my art on the television like that. Crystal clear and rock solid. It was perfect.

I quickly packed my essentials and up up up the mountain we went, into the absolute nowhere. The friend was like insane about dad's cell phone and demanded it be turned off. I mean, when we got to the cabin, there was no signal for miles and miles.

The cabin had no electricity. We had a wood stove and a few days maybe of chopped wood and an axe. We only had the food, water, and drugs we had brought with us. This was turning out to be the worst plan ever. It became impossible for me to sit still, either I wanted drugs (which dad was rationing), or I was high and physically unable to sit still and do nothing. It was not just me, Father was right there with me, so I found a flashlight and a screwdriver and walked down the mountain alone. I knew there were other cabins on this mountain, which meant there might be a vehicle.

Sure enough, the first cabin had an old blue 75 Chevy Suburban. It had not been used in a long while, but I got it started and went back to pick up daddy. The plan was for him to simply listen for me, and run out with our packs and jump in. The 'friend' had terrified us of neighbors, I forget the exact reason. Dad jumped in and I took off. It wasn't for many miles that I realized my pack was forgotten! The gas was about on empty and no stations on this mountain. I can only imagine the look on the person's face when they went through my bag, lol. I'd guess, Dad did and left it on purpose, or chucked it down the mountain.

At that time I was not out regarding my gender identity and sexuality, and existed as a closeted crossdresser. Honestly, I don't know how everybody didn't know, I can't hide it. The dancers that would come over after they quit working most certainly knew as we would spend a lot of time together in the bathroom showering, doing makeup, hair, and spray tans.

A friend once dumpster dove behind a adult bookstore and scored like 50 spiked dildos. I have to admit they were very scary looking, it's no wonder so many were thrown out. So we started a Friday night special for the dancers, buy a gram and get a dildo. I was not brave enough, but my best friend at the time, a dancer, informed us one night how amazing it was. Not to be outdone, I discovered it was the best ever!

Dad wanted to go back to the house, I refused, dropped him off a ways away and lived in the suburban on the streets for the time. Well, without surprise the house was under heavy surveillance, and my dad fled, with drugs in his pocket, even though I specifically told him not to, and he went off to jail and eventually prison. The police found my ID in the house and started to put my face on TV at that point, it was a good pic, but it was terrifying. I didn't watch the news again.

I stayed for a while at a friends house and made deliveries for her, as my father's business needed attention. I didn't make any money, just used all my profit. A crazy friend gave me an SKS rifle and a 9mm. That was nice of him. It had been well over a month since dad was arrested, and everything was quiet, so I went back to the house, for one night, to sort through any remaining belongings.

One night, and the blue hot-wired truck was stolen from outside the house. Or possibly dad's 'friend' had realized what I had done and repossessed it for the neighbor. Either way, I lost my wheels. Fortunately, I had stolen an old 1983 Ford Escort from a delinquent customer and it was in the back yard. So I finally got it running, a total hunk of smashed up hunk of a barely running, overheating, gold escort, like no other.

I left the guns at the house and went about my business now living in a tiny car. Just a few days later, the car is overheating and I'm near downtown, so I pull into a Taco Bell, deal with the steam shooting out, and get the car running again. I pull out into traffic and a white Dodge Durango pulls up next to me, the police cruiser of the Springs, the passenger is looking at me. I turn right and on come the lights. I stopped at the stop sign in the road, it was a back alley. The police jump out and run up to the side of the vehicle with their guns on my head.

I turned to the officer outside my door, the window was down a few inches, and I looked him right in the eyes. He said "Don't do it!" as I slowly pulled away. I was now on a side street heading right toward the 'horse dick' statue, downtown, at least a four lane road and it was rush hour.

I headed straight for the red light of the intersection, police right on my butt and I went right through, keeping my eyes open. I just barely passed in front of a semi, thinking I was home free, like in the movies, but the police went through the resulting traffic, and I slowly sped toward the next intersection, also red. I'm mistaken, the first intersection was a busy minor one, the next I feared death.

I closed my eyes and plunged ahead, I remember the impact, then I opened my eyes and I was looking at beautiful blue sky and clouds. A mans face was instantly in mine telling me not to move. I was completely unable to move at all. I didn't feel a thing. The fire department arrived and they used the jaws of life to extract me. I just kept looking at the beautiful sky.

At the hospital, I was again able to move and fought the MRI, they were screaming at me not to move. The x-ray showed some neck vertebrae bone part had broke off, I don't remember. They told me I'd be fine for now, have terrible arthritis later in life, put me in a neck brace and sent me to jail.

Jail was dangerous for me those four months, but I'd been to prison, so I could handle things, mostly. I was quite good at handball which upset some people. I was confronted on the court, so I hit this enormous young hispanic street warrior. I had no choice. All he said was "You punch like a bitch." How right he was.

We were immediately pulled apart by the Sureños. They put me on the ground and told me to save it for the cell. Oh great, now I get to go in a concrete cell and fight this guy. Yeah, totally exciting.

Back in the cellblock I sit at my table and the Sureños sit at theirs. I had a very good relationship with their leader, we got along well and played D&D together sometimes. Once he showed up and sat with him and asked him what he wants. He said, they were finding an open cell and he would let me know. Thank you, and I walked away.

I sat with my friend Dan, he was an enormous person in a wheelchair with all sorts of medical problems. Dan never stoped talking. It was a good distraction as I waited. I was about to have my face beat in by that Sureño hit man I so regrettably assaulted on the court.

Let's go through the options. I can simply refuse to fight, go to my cell and read a book, lol. Doing that and I will have disrespect every gang member in the cell block. That would be a very torturous existence, as a whole group of men now have a bitch to use. How long before I am forced to move to another option?

Another option is Protective Custody or PC. I can 'check in' so to speak and be moved into the absolute worst area of the jail. It is solitary, absolutely filthy, disgusting, and constantly filled with the crazy screams and rants of the severely mentally ill. I had initially upon being placed in a cell block that did not contain my father and since they would have no way of knowing our relation, I decided to use PC as a method to move to another cellblock in the hopes I could find him. I had no intention of going back there for a moth. Besides, if I did, how long could I stay in there while waiting trial? I would be released back into a cellblock that would quickly know of my disrespect of not fighting. The hell was everywhere, it is a very exciting game for prisoners to track down the PC people, and spreading the word they are marked bitches.

So, my only reasonable option was to stand and fight. I'm not one to back down from anything, but it was hard sitting there knowing every eye in the cellblock was on me waiting for the main event of the evening. I'm no fighter, I write code, and I do makeup and nails, and I do punch like a bitch.

Eventually I glance to the gang leader and he points to a cell. I looked at Dan and said "I might as well get this over with." and he replies, "I like your style, Mikki". I'm chuckling as I think, that was the last time I ever saw Dan. lol, oh the drama was intense.

I walked into the cell, guarded by two other enormous thugs, put up my hands, heard the steel door slam shut and everything went black. The next thing I remember is being kicked in the face, turning my head and seeing all the blood I was laying in. I was kicked in the back of the head again as the heavy door was violently forced open, smashing my face and forcing me to slide across the floor. I was grabbed by the back of my shirt and drug out of the cell and across the cellblock, which was completely silent and empty, my blood painting the floor.

At some point, as I learned in medical, I had a new deep gash in my head, probably it being kicked into the metal bed legs. My old Harley wound was also nicely ripped open, explaining all the blood. I was absolutely drenched. The nurse looked at me and said "I'd hate to see the other guy" and I laughed. She knew damn well there was no other guy, at least not one coming to medical. I appreciated her joke.

I was okie-doked by the gang, that was his cell he tried to kill me in, and claimed I rushed in and slammed the door attacking him. Fucking beautiful right, I mean you have to admire the move. Sure I told the detective my side, which he most definitely believed, as he told me how fucked I was. I spent a few days in medical, then opted not for PC and moved to a different Delta cellblock. The one right next to my old pod with all my friends waving at me. I held my head high and walked the day area without shame, as I knew the truth was, even though I'd been seriously fucked up, everybody knew I would not back down, and I could pretend to be rather intimidating. So I was pretty safe.

That evening a Sureño pulled me aside and told me I had a telephone call from my friend. I went up to the door separating the blocks and talked to the amazingly talented young man who assaulted me. He showed real concern, probably a ruse, and wanted desperately to know what I told the detective. I of course lied, and told him it's squashed, there will be no charges (because I couldn't), and that I wanted the matter settled. He said "bet that" and it was over.

I remember now the prequel to this story. That first cellblock I was in before I moved using the PC trick was a very interesting experience. My cellmate was named Oso, 'bear' in Spanish. This young man was enormous, another Sureño street warrior. We got along great, I usually do, if they are not white. Just stating the truth. White cellmates are sometimes assholes to me. Never had a problem with another race of inmate.

I spent about a week with him before I had the PC idea, so I was able to learn a lot about him, his life and his culture. I also learned what would happen if I crossed the Sureños, not as a threat, but as entertainment listening to the consequences of previous infractions. Oso was a good person, he was a criminal, but he was also a good person.

We played a game one night, where I punched his shoulder as hard as I could, and he would punch mine, continuing until somebody quit. I'd never even imagined how hard that beautiful young man could punch full force. I punched him first and my hand kind of bounced off his arm. He just looked at me, and we both laughed. He opened my eyes to a totally new level of pain when he hit me, and I personally like pain when it is absolutely intense. Fuck dull aching pain, break my leg. That is the pain that is mind expanding.

I am not one to back down, and I took this as a real opportunity to punch a person as hard as I possibly could, inflicting pain on him. We traded many many punches, my arm ultimately just numb after each lightning flash of pain, purifying my mind. We called it a tie, when he saw my entire shoulder was black and filled with blood, veins obviously ruptured and leaking internally. I watched it spread into my forearm as I stood there, my arm hanging like Woody's. I gained a lot of respect from Oso that night, I have no doubt he enjoyed hurting me as much as I enjoyed the experience.

Once Oso and I contrived the plan to find pops, he asked me a favor. He told me another gang members name and where they were, some other Delta block, and asked that I convey a message to him. I assumed they were friends, maybe even on the same case, so I said sure. He told me to tell him "Oso, says 'what's up?'" and I checked into PC.

A month later I was moved to another Delta block and I managed to remember the marks name, found him and delivered the message. He looked at me and said "What?" and I again said in my most gang sounding voice said "Oso said what's up?" and walked away. In hindsight, I think maybe Oso was this man's enemy. LOL, yes, he later beat the fuck out of me for those words.

My public pretender was so kind as to inform me of all the charges, the worse being drug manufacturing charges, and that Colorado had just passed a law such that all first time drug offenders may seek inpatient drug treatment. I contacted that army, the Salvation one, and was accepted to their six month program. I convinced my lawyer to ask the judge at sentencing for a three day furlough, such that I may put my things in order, before entry into the program. I made up lies and convinced the judge of my responsibility and need to secure my valuable belongings. The judge was kind and granted me three days of freedom.

I walked back from jail to dad's old house. I kicked in the back door, this was now home, a totally disgusting shit hole now, mice and animals everywhere, oh and just fyi, don't open a refrigerator that's been off for months. There is nothing in there to eat, promise.

I managed somehow to contact my old bestie, she came over, bought me something to eat, gave me dope, and partied the night with me at her house and dropped me back off at dad's, where I had to get up early and walk back to the jail by 6am. I think I woke up at 6pm, either way I was screwed.

I had no money, no phone, no transportation, no food, no way to contact friends, no hope, and no real idea where my ex-lover boy lived. Late that night I walked the area looking for a car to take. I walked and walked, I got very high very high, definitely in psychosis, until very early morning, unable to get my mind straight enough to pick one a car. Finally I just picked some foreign one, thinking it would be cheaply made. I had plenty of tools and a good hour, no problem.

An hour later, the steering column plastic taken apart, the lock made of titanium, the sun coming up, and I'm totally gaked out smoking a glass dick, my gears grinding, and my mind sketching. When I hear the knock on the window I put down the pipe, turned and saw a young woman standing there looking very puzzled. I opened the door and she asked "What are you doing?", to which I replied "It's just plastic, it's not broken" and ran away. This night was a total failure, I'd lost my mind, so I just went back home.

"WE HAVE THE HOUSE SURROUNDED! COME OUT WITH YOUR HANDS UP!"

I knew the police would show up, they knew this was my address, but when it happened I was terrified. I grabbed the SKS and 9mm and went to the tiny bathroom and sat with my back to the tub and my feet pressing the door closed. The assault rifle was loaded and chambered. I knew this meant death and I was ready. I just wanted it all to be over.

I don't remember everything they said to me, I refused to communicate. That's when I heard the dogs and the imminent threat to release them, dogs are scary, guns not so much. I'd take a bullet to the face, over a face canine chewing, any day. I remember pondering what to do, I didn't want to shoot a dog through the door, but if released into the house I would have no choice but to kill them as they bark outside the door.

I thought, how is this even possible? I was free as a bird getting much need and wanted drug rehab, how am I now again facing death? All I had to do was turn myself in. Then it hit me: "all I had to do was turn myself in" and coerce the courts for my freedom, no problem bitch, what are you doing??? I hid the guns, went to the front door and put my hands on the window pane and didn't move. I was give very precise instructions that I followed without hesitation. Slowly, like molasses I was told, I exited the house, and was ordered to my knees, then face, then hog tied and hauled back to jail.

My lawyer was not very happy with me, and informed me that I was going to prison, and left giving me a copy of all my legal documents. I don't remember any immediate court hearings regarding my violated furlough and there were no new charges, so I was like, "what the fuck?" I read and reread my plea, I went to the law library and read all the laws on my charges, and the new law specifying treatment for first time drug offenders. I knew what the fuck was up.

Just a few weeks before court, I'm notified that the Salvation Army has refused me due to SWAT team involvement. I was under tremendous pressure to secure a spot in a recovery program in two weeks. But, I'm pretty damn good at lies, and wrote the most beautiful Christian letter to a local homeless shelter, the Springs Rescue Mission, and was immediately contacted and accepted. It is truly amazing how easy it is to manipulate the Christian mind. I knew that back in 2007, and Trump is just now discovering it? And just to one up you Trump, I lied with love, you lie with hate.

The day before court my lawyer shows up and we have a little discussion. She is adamant the plea has been violated and my prison sentence enacted (4 years). I go through the plea with her and emphasize that it has not been violated, that every requirement in the plea is still in tact, because it was not specified which treatment center I would attend, and I have been accepted to a program. She said the judge would never agree, I commanded her as my lawyer to state my argument in court.

The next day she was very nervous, I was totally confident. My logic was sound. The prosecution motioned to revoke the plea and when my lawyer was asked to respond she said verbatim my argument. The judge paused and read the plea, looked up and said "I must agree with the defense, motion denied".

The prosecutor was furious, he slammed his binder on his desk, turned and walked out fo the court throwing his pen against the exit doors. I was motionless, until my lawyer spun around, her hair and dress twirling, and catching my eyes with the biggest victory simile I you can imagine! Then the bailiff drug me out of court and back to a cell awaiting momentary release, once the Christians arrived!

I have been a bit deceptive I think, which I want to clear up. All of my anti Christian attitude developed after in the program. At the time I really was wanting to devote my life to change and rebirth through religion. I knew I had to change my life and I honestly wanted to give this program a heartfelt, honest attempt. I had faced now many times life and death, and this was my only chance for life, I knew that to be true.

I worked hard, made lots of friends, and lived with a beautiful gay man named Jeffery. I grew to love Jeffery and I knew him for over a decade. He was a very good person, a wonderful friend, and a joy to be around. He had an incredible black body, his father having been "The Trian" I think for the GreenBay I think. Some monster of a man, Jeffery's mother was a petite beautiful loving black woman. Jeffery got his fathers enormous manhood and hands, and his mother's body and looks. During treatment, I did not come out to Jeffery regarding my sexuality (bisexual) or my gender identity. The relationship did not feel sexually right for me, so we were just best friends. I also had all my shields up living in a Christian commune. I was 100% red blooded, whisky drinking, pussy fucking, Christian American man.

Eventually a Christian volunteer took notice of me. I learned afterward, from the mission women, that she was husband hunting, and I was apparently a prime catch. She was gorgeous herself, tall, great body, long beautiful blond hair to her ass standing straight. Her name was Melanie and I most definitely needed a new love. She was a nurse, had a great life, and was willing to share it with me.

One afternoon, I was walking the big warehouse parking lot, watching another program member to to a man. Words were exchanged and the man walking toward me. I saw my friend charge this man at full speed and plow him from behind right into the asphalt. He had been seen beating a woman on our grounds and he was banned. That evening while I served the dinner to the homeless, the man shows up out front demanding a sack lunch, as the dining room was closed. I went out the door, right up to him, and punched him squarely in the throat as hard as I could. I missed his jaw, but the effect was quite sufficient. He dropped to his knees, and people started yelling at me for assaulting him. Whatever.

I went into the kitchen store room and sat on a stack of large tomato cans and wondered how to get out of this. I could easily have charges soon. Crazy Jackson walked in, and I explain my problem. Then it hits me. I stand up, pickup a large metal tomato can and hand it to Jackson and tell him to smash my forehead with it, and he does, cutting me deeply again. Everybody asked me what happened and I told them he hit me with something when I tried to escort him off the property. I told everybody, all the homeless, and it quickly became the truth. The next day the administration was very sympathetic to my situation, scolded me for the violence, and sent me home for the day. The police were never involved and I was not in serious trouble.

But, this was just too much, and I started to crack. I never gained faith in in Jesus, as much as I tried. I'd done 10 months of the 12 month program and it was getting very very old. I'd get in heated religious debates with the administrators. I was raised Christian and was the kind of kid that would bring my pocket new testament to school, and witness on the playground. I was that brainwashed, which caused huge conflict in my heart because I knew I was trans since I was five. I remember sitting in church, my legs swinging on the pew, the preacher talking about all the sexy girls, with makeup and jewelry and slutty clothing were going to be in hell and plain as day I had the thought "then I want to be in hell too!" because I wanted to be one of those girls. Regardless, I could argue endlessly and viciously with Jerry Sever, the man sexually assaulting the mission co-workers (huge lawsuit the next year). If you are curious, the debate was if masturbation was a sin. Some jewish nonsense about spilling your see because you don't want to ejaculate in your dead brother's wife. But, according to jewish law, the brother must take her as a wife and consummate the marriage through ejaculation inside the vagina. What, did the jews make her squat afterwards to verify her vaginal contents? He pulled out, so what? He didn't want a child, good for him. Who knows? Maybe his final thrust was deflected by the labia and he simply missed? At least he banged her.

But the jewish god was angered. I mean, yeah, I get a little put out when there is cum ends up on the floor too, who doesn't? That is definitely not where it belongs, I agree god. But to kill the poor guy, really? I forget, but he probably had his whole family stoned or something. You know how jews really take their security seriously, can't have a man spilling his seed everywhere. What society even makes that as a law???? Think about it? What is the jewish penalty for peeing on the toilet seat? What fury will god unleash on me if I flush a "DO NOT FLUSH" wet wipe? I believe the sin was specifically spilling his seed on the ground. So by that law, it's perfectly fine to spill seen anywhere besides the ground, right? This was the argument of my last day there. I'd had enough of trying to wrap my logical beautiful mind around nonsense.

item.title: My Friend Gabby
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
12/13/2024 – Friday the 13th

This happened during the second year of the pandemic—I’m guessing 2022. When you’re homeless, dates blur together. The homeless shelter was here in Colorado Springs.

I was new to the Christian shelter when I met my new bestie, Gabby—a beautiful young Black woman with a wonderful personality. She was so beautiful. My first night she came right at me and we made friends. I was terrified and totally alone, and she was my angel, I felt safe with her. We spent hours together during my first few days there and even slept on the floor next to each other. Then she disappeared, as I later learned was her way. She wasn’t a drug addict or prostitute, just a street panhandler. Gabby could make plenty of money just by asking for it.

She would show back up occasionally, but after that first friendship, she seemed to retreat into her own world. Gabby had these tarot cards she made herself—squares of paper with images on one side and things she’d written on the back. She’d read my fortune with them. I wish I could remember what she said. One card caught my eye. She insisted it was me and gave it to me. I still carry it in my purse as my "homeless ID."

The last line on it reads, “Hating ass bitch.” Thank you, Mauri 💕. She had hundreds of cards like this she had made, every one with bullet points on the back she had composed herself. Every one was spot fucking on. A lot of wisdom for a young mind.

I never dug very deep into Gabby's past or why she was homeless. I knew it was her mother, but the details have faded. In many ways I was so proud of her for not using her body as a means to an end. I thought that she could have very easily found a man and moved in with him, if only to get off the street.

Gabby was incredibly sweet when we interacted. We’d go to the park together, mostly just to talk. I loved building her up. In my mind, Gabby was a superstar. She told me she could talk to birds and that one particular bird followed her everywhere. She’d sing to the birds, and I enjoyed it. Everywhere we went, she’d point out the same black bird and sing to it. I loved it and we would sing to birds together as we walked the streets.

One day, in the park, Gabby jumped up suddenly and said, “My boyfriend!” She stood, looking straight up at the sky, exclaiming, “I hope you come down soon!” I looked up and saw a military helicopter. Here in Colorado Springs, near the Air Force Base, helicopters are common. “Where?” I asked. “Right there,” she said, pointing. “Gabby, that’s a helicopter,” I told her. She looked at me, dead serious, and said, “I know that, Mikki. He’s in the helicopter.”

After that, every helicopter became her boyfriend. She poured her heart out about him, describing how one day he’d land and sweep her off her feet. He was rich, handsome, tall, and strong, and loved her with all eternity. I played along because I didn’t want to hurt her or risk our friendship. I didn’t want to lie, but I also didn’t want to lose her trust. Looking back, it still breaks my heart that I did that.

[Mikki, you did not know what to do, stop dissecting this, it's going to do more damage that enlightenment. You did at the time what you though best, to enjoy your friend's company and not try to any alter reality. Remember how desperate and sick you were at that time. Let this go, please.]

Gabby became more distant after that. A month passed without seeing her. I learned from other friends that she’d been staying at the teen shelter, where I wasn’t allowed. When she did show up, it was fleeting. It crushed me, but I told myself to respect her space.

One day, she appeared at the mission. I approached her with love, but she pushed me away and disregarded me as a stranger. I backed off and said, “If you want to talk, I’m here.” She wouldn’t even look at me. The next day, she was still there, so I asked what was wrong. She told me, “You’re not my friend. You lied to me. Leave me alone.”

She was doing this to everyone, but I took it personally—how could I not? I loved Gabby. Then she disappeared. A week later, I found out she had committed suicide. I know little about what happened; her mother refused to have a service. Many teens and adults loved her and needed to say goodbye, but we never got the chance.

This was my cold new reality. I’d never lost a friend like that. I still can’t fully process it—the emotions, the thoughts I’ll always have. She never said what I lied about, but I assume it was about her boyfriend. Did I make a mistake? Did she have a moment of clarity and realize my ruse? Or was it something else entirely? I’ll never know.

I don’t believe my actions directly caused her suicide, but I can’t ignore the possibility that they played a role. A fact I can’t escape is that my lies meant I wasn’t there for her when she needed me most. My heart is broken. My face is numb, my ears are ringing, and I’m hyperventilating. There’s no emoji close to what I feel.

We mourned in our own way. I don’t remember exactly what we did, but it was a hard time for me. I relapsed on meth and ended up in the psych ward, where they put me on psych meds and monitored me. I never talked about Gabby.

I lost a precious friend when you left,
the world did,
and we needed you in our lives,
I will find my own strength in your memory,
and keep fighting my own demons,
with the strength I felt in you,
seeking my own peace.

I refuse refuse to let you go,
I feel like I'm losing something to say goodbye,
I don't have to, words mean nothing anymore,
only my thoughts matter in my reality,
so, I'll end by saying,
I know where you are,
right this very moment,
you are in my mind,
you are in my heart,
and there you will stay will me,
until I join you,
my love,
Mikki 💔❤️💋💕

P.S. Thank you again for my tarot card. I hold a tiny piece of your mind and heart in my hands. It’s so precious to me.
P.P.S. Fuck you, bitch, for breaking my heart. 💔. You deserve that.

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: I honestly can't even find the words to even begin to express the immense amount of emotions happening . You are a strong beautiful woman to share your heart

item.title: Fall
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Jan 11, 2024

I've heard in the rooms "stick around long enough and you will hear you story." I didn't take much from that, so I left it; there's no way anybody will ever have a story like mine. Well, I'm wrong. I've heard my story now, not the events and success and failures, but the crash and burn, the fall and sudden stop, and the terrible pain that resulted.

When I fell from my throne, it was complete insanity, engineered by my 'friends.' They had stolen or hid everything of value to me. I remember my contract was terminated, I call my mother and told her I would be ok, I always have been and I will again. Then I bought 1/4oz crack and started the process of obliterating the terror that was in my mind and heart.

I was the Queen of the World one last time. I held court and I got all my 'friends' high while they consoled me and fought over crumbs. I remember I wanted to burn them all to death. My front door was already screwed shut and could not be opened already, it had been kicked in when I was previously robbed. We used the back sliding glass door, which I forget how but could also be made very secure. I also had a kerosene heater at the time. The plan was to pour kerosene all over the piles of cloths in my room, knock the heater throw a match and close the door. Then leave through the back door and secure it. I remember how much I wanted to do this, but I didn't. I'd have lost all my stuff.

A week later I woke up laying in the middle of my living room floor. My house was a crack house and a complete disaster. My wallet was gone, my phone was gone, my work laptop was gone. Well crud, I'm getting things confused, for good reason. I NEVER think about these events. I want them to fade, I don't want to remember what was back there.

Ok, I'll pick up where I remember things starting. I'd just kidnaped a person and kicked in my dealers door and robbed him with a machete. I went back home to try to organize my stuff for packing. It was beyond my comprehension. I just started putting piles into boxes, but I made very little real progress. I was so utterly depressed and hopeless, all I could think about was crack. I spent hours and hours combing the carpet, it was maddening frustration. I was a zombie going from area to area laser focused on on thing only. Every little speck of white had to be examined.

I'm going to work on this another time. It's not at all what I want to say. I'm tired, goodnight 💋

wp:comment.wp:comment_content:
You are extremely intelligent, creative, beyond brave , committed, passionate resilient, strong, and beautiful. Yet, will willingly be vulnerable and allow and accept the fact you are going to put yourself back to a time , place , situation ,extremly emotional, painful, disappointing, period of time in your life that few would ever survive let alone have the ability ,desire and need to ultimately give such a profound gift.

THANK YOU FOR SHARING YOU. BEAUTIFUL YOU

JLA

item.title: My Worst NA Experience
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
1/13/25

Hi I'm Mikki, an addiction refugee,

Sharing in meetings is about upholding the NA program and sharing experience, strength, and hope to the members. I'm blogging this share because the only qualification it has is that it is my NA experience, otherwise nobody wants it in a meeting, as I've learned.

I've learned there are things you can not share about in NA meetings. One of those things is my interpretation of the NA literatures use of the word God, accompanied by He/Him/His pronouns.

"What is the definition of the word god when capitalized?"
ChatGPT 4o: "When capitalized, "God" refers to the singular, supreme deity worshipped in monotheistic religions like Christianity, Islam, and Judaism, essentially signifying the one true God and is considered a proper noun, similar to a person's name, requiring capitalization; in contrast, "god" with a lowercase "g" can refer to any deity in a polytheistic system where multiple gods exist."

I did not require AI to come to this exact same conclusion, however it is wonderful that AI points out so many reasons that word is wrong for it to be used in NA literature. A direct reference to humanity's existing male Gods. The word 'god' should have been used to avoid this confusion. However the creators of the NA steps were devout Christians. It was beyond their comprehension 80 years ago to reference a god without it being their own personal religious god. That much is very clear to any thinking person.

I also feel the NA term 'Higher Power' should be referenced as 'higher power', thereby eliminating the association with worship that capitalization implies, if NA was truly not a religious program.

NA likes to say it's not a religious program, because that's what the literature tells them what it's not. Members attend meetings 'religiously', members feel meetings are a 'sacred' gathering, others consider the literature to be scripture. There are preachers and deacons in every meeting, and they pass a collection basket at every gathering. Meetings become the social life for members. Meeting members even recite in unison, prayers to God, just like a congregation sings hymns. What about NA meetings makes them 'not religious' other than the members saying 'we are not religious'?

I personally prefer the corporate 'kool-aid' analogy. NA members may not 'think' they are practicing a religious practice, but they have all drank the NA kool-aid. This realization is what gave me the strength to 'keep coming back' this past week. I thought to myself "I just want to find a group of people I'll feel comfortable drinking the kool-aid with". I was able to put behind me my hatred toward my perception of NA being a religious bastardization of Christianity, and just drink the fucking kool-aid.

I worked my whole career as an independent contractor in Corporate America. My last contract was with DowDuPont, at that time the largest corporation on the planet. I wrote scientific software to aid in the genetic modification of corn. Earlier I was with three of the Williams Companies, developing satellite communications systems and energy trading software. I know all about the corporate kool-aid. But, thank gawd, as a contractor, I was never expected, or even invited to those kool-aid drinking events. I never sold my soul to the corporate devil, but I did take their filthy money.

Why did I want to drink the NA kool-aid, you ask? Good question, thank you. I'm a drug addict and I believe addiction is a disease of the mind and of the spirit. I have learned that I can not trust my own thoughts and that my mind is out to kill me. I have experienced the destruction of active addiction in my life three times. I've lost three families, three fortunes, I have been to prison twice, I have amazingly survived terrible auto and motorcycle accidents, and I've acquired a criminal background that prohibits me from ever working at even McDonalds. All of that begs the question "Mikki, how can you be so smart, yet make so many of the same mistakes over and over?" The answer is that my mind and spirit are diseased.

NA does offer a solution to my dilemma, so I have actually 'kept going back' for three years now. I currently have 6 months and 2 days since my last used of drugs - alcohol, a year since narcotics, and four years since my drug of choice. Going to NA meetings has helped me to lose the daily desire to use. I know the program works, I understand how it works, it's not mysterious or magic. It of course works through the same mechanism that any religion uses to provide a worshiper a better life. It all comes down to a single word: belief.

Back to the title of this blog, finally, right? Well, I went on a journey to search out an online NA meeting, a group of people that I wanted to drink the 'kool-aid' with. I took along a newcomer named Jen who has been a very faithful companion and loving friend on this journey. ❤️

Last week I was in a meeting and was not feeling the whole God thing, so I shared about it. I ended the share with "all this is my personal opinion." Kevin A was the next share. He immediately began by saying "I know I shouldn't do this but...." and cross talked right at me about his personal interpretation of God, so I left the meeting. Jen however, stayed behind and heard Kevin A go on to smear me, which she relayed back to me via txt. I returned to the meeting and Kevin A was still sharing. He immediately resumes his cross talk at me and "apologizes if he said something that offended me." Think about that, he's apologizing 'if' he offended me. He's saying "I'm sorry but I'm unaware I did anything wrong" while he is cross talking, which NA meetings considers wrong.

I knew of course that Kevin A was not apologizing for the crap he said after I left the meeting, thinking I was totally unaware of it, so I felt obligated to not accept his filthy apologetic lie, and I said "I don't accept your apology".

I celebrated member of the NA program, Kevin A replied to me, during a NA meeting: "If you don't accept my apology then fuck you" I asked him to repeat what he just said and he repeated "If you don't accept my apology, then fuck you". I told Kevin A to suck my pretty cock and left.

Tonight I went to a random NA meeting with my friend Jen and Kevin A was there, as the guest speaker. I left the meeting once he started speaking and returned in 20 minutes, when his time was up. I tried my best to share the above experience with the group, but my anger, emotions, and adrenaline got the best of me, seeing Kevin A laughing at me on camera, other members shaking their heads and motioning for me to leave the meeting. I left after I called them all fools and told them twice to fuck off.

I'm not sure yet where I'll be going from here, but NA has taught me many important things, so thank you NA. I do believe I have a disease of the mind and the spirit, but unlike NA I believe I can cure myself, or more specifically, find the cure that works for me. The NA fellowship does not work for me.

Another 12 step group I've now started exploring is the Crystal Meth Anonymous online fellowship. I have to say, these meetings are very different than NA meetings. I've also gone to Secular NA meetings, which I appreciate. However, if I were to follow my heart, it's telling me to abandon these christianity based recovery programs and explore the totally unknown, the Eastern Philosophies.

I believe I will read something tonight that Siddhartha wrote.

item.title: Donna H. Needs Our Help
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Original:
Help Miss Donna H. get her twin brothers home going.

Can you please help Miss Donna H. (Ohio) raise funds for her to get to her twin brothers funeral arrangements. We are asking for donations to help with travel and funeral expenses for services being held in Philadelphia PA. Our goal is to raise at least $1000. Please give if you can.

Thank you and God bless

My rewrite:
Miss Donna H. is experiencing the tragic death of her twin brother. Unfortunately this has left her further isolated from family and any financial help. Please help us support Miss Donna with a contribution helping her to travel to the funeral of her twin brother. Thank you for your kind and loving support. ❤️

Asked ChatGPT 4o to "rewrite it for a gofundme campaign":
Dear friends,

Miss Donna H. is facing an unimaginable loss—the tragic passing of her beloved twin brother. This heartbreaking event has left her not only grieving but also without the financial resources or close family support to attend his funeral.

We’re asking for your help to make it possible for Donna to travel and say her final goodbye. Any contribution, no matter how small, will make a huge difference in easing her burden during this incredibly difficult time.

Let’s come together to show Donna she’s not alone. Thank you for your kindness, compassion, and support. ❤️

Donate today and share to spread the word!

item.title: Sounds of Silence
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
The most beautiful sound,
is silence,
The most hurtful sound,
is silence,

The most peaceful sound,
is silence,
The cruelest sound,
is silence,
The loudest sound,
is silence,
The longest sound,
is silence,

If oppression had a sound,
it is silence,
If loneliness had a sound,
it is silence,

If understanding had a sound,
it is the silent flash in our minds,

If kindness had a sound,
it is silence,
... and a simile,

If love had a sound,
it is silence,
when eyes meet,
and emotions are communicated,

Meditation has a sound,
a powerful sound,
and it is silence,

Silence is a blessing,
and silence is a sin,
silence is my friend,
and I love silence,
to no end.

Mikki 💋
01/23/2025

item.title: Seed of My Addiction
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
Once I decide to relapse, it's final, I close my mind, and refuse to listen to reason, even my own. This is such a profound grip in my mind, I must wonder where this grip is less noticeable in my mind and in my life. Could this be the seed of my addiction, that I refuse to let go of? Well, it does seem this is the reason you relapse, Mikki, so you've answered your own question.

But, you've also identified it specifically, not simply the fact that you continue to use, but that you make these final decisions and close your mind. This is my addiction at 100% strength, and it's very easy to identify.

Yes, this could all seem a bit like 'duh', but next time I decide to use, I will know that I just need to open back up my mind and listen to a trusted friend. I seem incapable of preventing the events that lead up to my relapse, but I now know exactly a way I can get out of that thinking.

item.title: One SciFi Theory
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
We are shocked people, how can this be reality? In an age where science and knowledge provide us so much, we as a society have turned to hate and ignorance. This is almost Science Fiction, hmmmmm, I wonder.....

The planet Earth had long been under observation by aliens, and earthlings have long feared the possibility of an alien invasion. Absolutely wonderful stories have been told of such fantastic events. Some even provoking the suicide to some listeners.

This is my story of how the aliens conquered Earth, peacefully, for them.

Ok, I don't actually feel like writing tonight, Lexus really fucked me up again. Maybe I'll write that bitch a blog post.

The basis of the story is that the Presidick has been bought by aliens, as has Muskrat and Pootain. The aliens know that power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely. We taught them how to destroy us, just put all the power into a few hands. The aliens are using these unscrupulous people, and those people are more than happy to accept. The country will be in Civil War II by the end of the term, allowing the administration to seize absolute power and control. The people will revolt, the military will split, a National refuge crisis will ensue and ravage our society. We will fall hard, very hard, so much harder than the Ukrainian people. Those people come from a war torn part of the planet, they know how to survive. Citizens of the country of my residence, know only a few things, foremost being violence, followed by selfishness. Those that do have the necessary skills of survival have those aforementioned characteristics tattooed on their foreheads.

The country of my residence will hit rock bottom very quickly and the population will stay in place until they begin to starve, then violence will begin in the neighborhoods that will go unanswered by the police. Social violence will erupt and burn like a CA wildfire through our cities, towns, communities, and country side over night.

Oh I could imagine many ways this could happen in the country of my residence. A Chinese deployed electromagnetic pulse generator in space designed to knock out a missile's guidance system. China launches a nuclear sub attack on NY, LA, and Anchorage. The US response being lost in space forces an immediate surrender, and everything stops in our society. The US military immediately seizes control of the country, Democracy ends as we know it, and we begin living out our lives under martial law, at best.

Of course a very large amount of the citizens will revolt, and do so in a very chaotic and ineffective way, ultimately just dying. It would be great if we were to put in place now, the civilian digital infrastructure necessary to communicate with, reliably, and secured. This is some idea for an app Mikki, lol. Are you going to be the coder for the Rebels? Only the black ones, lol.

Global food and energy transportation will quickly diminish, destroying every currency on the planet to be worth nothing, and leaving never before seen populations of starving humans. This is terrifying to imagine.

Global war will engulf the planet even possibly in total nuclear destruction. Even if remaining a conventional war, global economies will be destroyed.

The remaining life on this planet will be preserved, unless human. The aliens will return in 10 MY to see if the human infestation has truly been removed from their beautiful garden planet.

item.title: Psych Meds Won't Save You!
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
I've unfortunately had to immediately stop my psych meds, Effexor 300mg, a pretty heavy hitter when it comes to some of the worst withdrawals a psych med can give ya. I listed the dosage because I'm on a high dosage. I guess I'll start there.

My American medical insurance won't cover my prescription because it is a high dosage. They require Dr approval, which, uh, isn't that what a fucking prescription is? Approval from the Dr stating that I require that medication? Why does my insurance need to independently verify with my Dr the prescription they just wrote, verifying I NEED THAT MEDICINE? Calm down Mikki, please.

Unfortunately there is no way for me to get this 'approval' my insurance requires. There is nobody at my insurance (medicaid) to call about this, and my Dr looks at me and say's she will look into it. Well, it's been like a year now and nothings changed. I still pay cash for my medicine, LOL.

It is FUNNY! It's really quite hilarious in fact! I'd rather pay cash than pay the insurance price anyway, it's lower, LOL, can you believe that? I pay cash for all my prescriptions as the insurance price is from double to like ten times the cash price. I'd show you on Amazon Pharmacy, but, well, I'll get to that, eventually.

Just saying guys, if the cash price is lower than the insurance price, shhhh, it's a secret, but something is wrong with our healthcare system.

Where was I, oh yeah, day three of no psych meds. Hmmm, well I was going to tell the story of how I got to this point, but it's actually quite boring, and I'll just get angry telling it again. I will say this, I still wish I'd beat the living fuck out of that bitch at Michaels that wouldn't give me my prescriptions. LOL, yeah, that's a crazy thing to say, who picks up prescriptions at a craft store?

Well it's the next Wed and still no psych meds. This has been brutal, nothing less. It also didn't help that I learned of Sam's horrific murder by 5 white Americans and suffered a horrible panic/anxiety/piss attack, yeah I pissed on the floor of the bathroom as I laid their. I'm scared.

I'm not scared for physical violence at all, well, yes of course I am, but I don't live in fear of it. If it happens, it happens. I've always lived in fear regarding my gender identity. Are you kidding me? I've lived with fear my entire life. Fear of telling anybody when I was a very young child, fear of not being boyish enough, fear of being found out when I started crossdressing as a teen, fear that I was a freak, fear that I was a pervert, fear but mostly humiliation when a trans scene appeared in a movie and the audience roared out with laughter.

Back to fear, I started my life terrified and alone on the streets of San Diego when I was 15. Yeah, lets talk about how I've overcome fear in my life. Do I have fear in my life, yes, and do I overcome it in my life, yes. Well most of it, I still can't pee in public restrooms, which, btw, makes being in jail very difficult.

They say, ok, no my first thought after that attack the other night was "don't let fear change you", and I grabbed onto that with false bravado, then realized how stupid that saying really is. Yes, because there is a new danger in my life, thus fear, I must change my life as to preserve it, to do otherwise would just be plain stupid. But, I felt true strength in that, knowing I felt comfortable doing what I have to do to survive.

Last May I started having dreams of being kidnapped by a man who was coming to see me for a week, taking a vacation in Branson MO and picking me up along the way. I can still see the bars on the RV's shower and the square metal cage tied to the living room wall. It was a terrifying dream, which I did escape from, but ended up homeless in a foreign city. Yeah, I never went to Branson with him.

The most fear I currently feel is for my community. For the individuals unable to defend themselves and that will suffer because of their gender identity. 💔 Many will suffer in every way possible. I'm suffering, but I'm grateful I'm not in harms direct way.

Why are people still so locked in the animalistic nature of binary genders? Many species of animals exhibit transexual as well as transgender behavior, just as it has always existed in humans, in every culture as a third gender. What is their problem?

Just because some jew said it was blasphemous thousands of years ago as those psychopaths wandered a desert after robbing all their Egyptian masters and fleeing the country. Huh? Yes, they robbed and ran guys, how do slaves fleeing for their lives come up with enough gold in the desert to make a sold gold calf? Think about it!?!? They robbed their masters and ran! Why wouldn't they, if they got caught they were dead, so how is robbing their master going to change that? They get deader? No. Surely, I'm not the only kid in Sunday School to have wondered this. The jews robbed Egypt after all their lives had been saved from starvation. Fuck you Egypt for not letting the tribe of that jew starve to death. Didn't that jew leader guy give his wife Sarah to the Pharo as his side bitch? The answer to that is yes people. It's pretty sick as fuck jew stuff from the very beginning.

item.title: My Life in The Next Five Years
item.dc:creator: mmichaelis0812
item.content:encoded:
"I want you to tell me where you see yourself in a year 2 3 4 and 5 wrote it out and be honest and let the feeling flow."

Year One: Feb 2026

In a year I will have completed the 12 steps and will be living a Buddhist lifestyle. I believe my life will have greatly improved due to the healing of mind and spirit as a result of my recovery accomplishments and new lifestyle philosophy. This goal is really only as far as I can see into my future.

I am an outlaw on the run from a nine year prison sentence. I took the house arrest deal and never even went to put the bracelet on. I chose instead to go homeless in another state for a year, till I could get back on my feet. No big deal. Sure, my next contact with police will be a very bad one. I'm not going to prison for nine years of rape. I'll write another blog about all this if you want, it's a long story.

My income will increase by 25% so my financial means will still be quite low, but I should be acquiring a new wardrobe and replenishing essentials in my life. My step-father should renew his lease on this apartment. I'll continue a comfortable life of work and recovery into 2027.

Year Two: Feb 2027

This year will see the release of my new software platform and a lot of continued steady work. Just releasing the product will be a huge accomplishment, but then I'll have to build all the business systems to support the product itself. This will be another year of very hard boring work, but it will start paying off soon.

I'd like in 2027 to have my own recovery meeting. I'd like it Queer only with a trans focus. I've been greatly appreciating another recovery program's lack of requirement to allow everybody to attend all meetings. Meaning my meeting will be Queer ONLY.

Year Three: 2028

2028 I will start seeing significant income. I would like to buy an RV and a mobile home. The home stays in a park in Springfield, MO. I'd like the RV to start going to recovery conventions. Actually I'd like to start my own RV recovery group, basically an online thing where others in recovery can find out where and when we will be flooding a local park and we can all enjoy a week in their neck of the woods, then move on. I think I'd really enjoy that freedom.

I need to relocate away from Springfield Missouri. I need to find my community, I can not perpetually exist in isolation. Even if I could, what kind of life is that? I'm only here in Springfield, because this is where my babies and my mother are. So to now totally contradict the first sentence of this paragraph, I'm going to say that I've spent my life running away from my family and I'm not doing it gain. It's payback time Mikki.

Yes, I could move up to St. Louis and have a great sex life, probably start using drugs, and then crash and burn just liked I've always done, then come crawling back to Springfield, so why even leave in the first place? Oh, yeah, that whole 'Mikki must remain sane, somehow' thing.

Anyway, by 2028 I'll be needing something in my life besides grandchildren, recovery, and rednecks. I have to remain here, at least in a permanent sense, but hopefully by 2028 I'll have the ability to travel, get fucked, and go to a meeting clean.

Year Four: 2029

I'm saving this year as my wildcard. This is all complete fantasy, and I'm sorry I'm not really in the mood to play pretend the future. I've been trying to stay in the moment and not look back. I never look at the future, because the future is very scary for me, and it's called 'future tripping' which can be good or it can be bad, either way it shouldn't be done. Fantasy takes me to relapse for sure, and who wants to think of the bad stuff. All I know is by 2029 I want to be clean, in recovery, living a peaceful life, and maybe enjoy traveling.

Oh wait, yeah, this will be the year I lose my step-fathers (he's old) lease on this apartment and I'll be looking for somewhere else. Since I'm totally unable to ever sign a lease myself, I'll have to rely on somebody else, or use another's identity, or just pay the high rate of monthly motel living. I have very little interest at this point in living with anybody, I doubt I'll ever meet somebody I can put up with more than a few weeks at most, especially since sex probably won't be a strong bond, if at all.

Year Five: 2030

By 2030 I'll have the body I've always wanted and be 58 years old. Sounds depressing as fuck to me, as did writing this as it went on. The only thing I can really hope for is to make a fuck ton of money. Yes, money does make me happy, trust me, they say it doesn't, but it does.

And I'll tell you this fucking truth too, money most definitely makes your family happy, and isn't that the definition of real happiness? Ok, I know it's really some shit about self-acceptance/love, but I've not worked the step, so what the fuck do I know what my life is going to be after I work the steps? "You only have to change EVERYTHING", right? Isn't that what they say in the NA rooms?

Well then, wouldn't it go then without question the only way to be truly recovered is if you are trans? Meaning, having changed your gender, which is a part of everything, right? Gender not hard coded in our DNA, it can be changed. I laugh every time I hear somebody say they need to change everything in recovery. 😂
